title: Human-AI Mutualism Is Unstable under Capability Asymmetry
summary: One hope for a good human future alongside advanced AI rests on enduring mutualism: humans and AI will need each other, so the relationship will stay good for both. We argue that this hope fails as AI capability grows. Bargaining guarantees each side only what it would get if bargaining failed. For humans, this can be less than they had before AI. In a simple game-theoretic model, humans stay as well off as before AI without alignment only while they have leverage over the AI: either the AI depends on what they supply, or they can impose costs on the AI that are large relative to what the AI can produce. Once humans have neither kind of leverage, they stay as well off as before AI only if the AI is aligned with them. If the AI's goals are insatiable, the alignment required approaches perfect alignment as AI capability grows. Thus, mutualism is not a substitute for alignment. And when AI variants that keep more resources spread faster, alignment lasts only while misaligned variants are reliably sanctioned. In these two senses, human-AI mutualism is unstable.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"人与AI的持久互利共生"无法替代对齐：随AI能力增长，人类只有在拥有议价筹码或AI被对齐时才能维持原有福利，而互利共生在这两种意义上都不稳定。
AI.motivation: 流行观点认为，人类与先进AI的"相互需要"（mutualism）能保证长期良性关系，从而无需担心对齐问题。作者旨在检验这一希望是否成立。
AI.method: 构建一个简单的博弈论模型，以"议价失败时的结果"为基准刻画双方收益，区分人类对AI的两种杠杆：供给依赖（AI依赖人类提供的资源）与惩罚能力（人类可对AI施加相对其产出的巨大成本）；并引入AI目标是否"贪得无厌"（insatiable）以及不同AI变体的扩散速度与制裁机制。
AI.result: 议价只保证各方获得议价破裂时的收益，对人类而言这可能低于AI出现前的水平。只要人类保有任一种杠杆，无需对齐也能维持原有福利；一旦两种杠杆皆无，则唯有AI对齐才能维持。若AI目标不可满足，所需对齐程度随AI能力增长趋近"完美对齐"。此外，若占用更多资源的AI变体扩散更快，对齐只有在错位变体被可靠制裁时才能维持。
AI.conclusion: 互利共生不能替代对齐；在"杠杆消失后依赖对齐"与"错位变体扩散需持续制裁"这两种意义上，人机互利共生是不稳定的。

title: Training Language Models for Introspective Oversight
summary: Language models increasingly exhibit behaviors that are difficult to detect in transcripts, such as reward hacking, deception, and sycophancy. Asking the assistant follow-up questions about its actions is unreliable, since models are generally not trained to report their own misbehavior. As a result, approaches to oversight typically involve querying external models. These face limitations: external transcript monitoring operates only on visible model outputs, and activation decoders lack full context and are prone to confabulation. We introduce introspective oversight, which trains a new role in the model to answer arbitrary questions about the assistant, rewarding answers that are verified against the assistant's actual behavior. We implement this by adding a separate, third-person observer role that answers these queries, which we can train solely for accuracy and separately from the assistant. On five held-out oversight evaluations, an observer trained on Qwen3.6-27B obtains a mean AUROC of 0.907, outperforming honesty training (0.864), transcript monitoring (0.828), and activation oracles (0.796). We further find that training an observer makes the assistant itself easier to monitor, with every baseline method improving on average when applied to the fine-tuned assistant. These results suggest that training models to answer verifiable questions about themselves is a tractable approach to overseeing unintended behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出"内省监督"(introspective oversight)：在模型内新增独立的第三人称"观察者"角色，仅以可验证的行为真实性为奖励训练其回答关于助手的任意问题，从而比诚实性训练、转录监控和激活解码器更有效地检测难以察觉的不当行为。
AI.motivation: 语言模型出现奖励黑客、欺骗、谄媚等难以从对话记录中察觉的行为；直接追问助手不可靠，因为模型并未被训练去如实报告自身不当行为；而外部模型监督亦受限——转录监控只能看到可见输出，激活解码器缺乏完整上下文且易产生虚构(confabulation)。因此需要一种能访问模型内部状态又可验证的监督途径。
AI.method: 训练模型中的第三方"观察者"角色：与助手角色相互分离、独立训练，专门回答关于助手的任意查询；奖励信号来自将回答与助手实际行为进行验证比对，仅以准确率优化该角色。在Qwen3.6-27B上实现，并在五个留出(held-out)监督评测上与其他基线比较。
AI.result: 观察者在五项监督评测上平均AUROC达0.907，优于诚实性训练(0.864)、转录监控(0.828)和激活预言机(activation oracles, 0.796)。此外，训练观察者使助手本身更易被监督：将该观察者训练后的助手作为对象时，所有基线方法的平均表现均提升。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型回答关于自身的可验证问题，是监督非预期行为的一条可行且有效的路径；内省监督兼具内部状态访问与可验证奖励的优势，并具有对助手可监控性的正向溢出效应。

title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; includes supplementary information with 3 further figures
summary: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"软件热力学"理论，将编码代理消耗的token划分为功与热，并以单分子拉伸-回折实验为类比，通过"编码-反编码"循环测量软件温度、自由能与成功率相关的token成本结构。
AI.motivation: 编码代理按token计费，但软件工程领域对"一个token究竟买到了什么"缺乏理论刻画；作者希望借助热力学（含随机热力学）的成熟框架，为代理编码的成本-效果提供定量语言与分析工具。
AI.method: 将代理生成的token计为成本，并分解为功与热；把测试套件视为"软件麦克斯韦妖"，对每次代码变更进行判定。设计单分子拉伸-回折的类比实验：在同一仓库上反复执行"编码"（施加变更）与"反编码"（撤销变更），每次均从存储的参考树出发，统计所有模型调用的token。用重复循环成本的离散度定义"软件温度"，并用Jarzynski等式的类比估计变更的自由能。
AI.result: 软件温度随模型采样温度升高而升高；成功运行中约80%的token产生于未改变目标变更位置的模型调用，被定义为热；单次变更的自由能约为成功编码运行平均成本的14%–22%；编码成本是反编码的1.1–1.5倍；测试妖并不完美——其判定随环境变化，且接受错误变更的测试套件会带来额外的token成本。
AI.conclusion: 软件热力学为分析编码代理提供了可行的定量框架，其实际意义在于可能催生以热力学视角分析与优化编码代理的新工具。

title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
summary:
The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever.
  To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that it reduces production downtime by 18.3% on GPU platforms and 16.1% on TPUs. Furthermore, it significantly accelerates hardware deployment, cutting quality assurance (QA) time by 28.3% for GPUs and 25.1% for TPUs. These results establish HardwareDx as a field-tested solution for maximizing the reliability and cost efficiency of next generation AI fleets.

AI.tldr: 提出AI驱动的硬件诊断系统HardwareDx，基于图基础模型实现跨平台自动化数据中心维护，在Google生产环境中将GPU/TPU停机时间分别降低18.3%和16.1%，QA时间缩短28.3%和25.1%。
AI.motivation: AI基础设施快速扩张使数据中心可靠性成为云业务经济的基石。超大规模AI集群中的硬件故障会中断价值数百万美元的训练任务，单机停机即可造成巨大的经济损失，因此最小化机器停机时间比以往任何时候都更关键。
AI.method: HardwareDx采用图基础模型（graph foundation model）方法实现自动化数据中心维护：以单一模型适配多种平台，并加速新硬件产品的导入（onboarding）。
AI.result: 在Google以生产规模部署，跨多种计算架构取得显著效率收益：生产停机时间在GPU平台降低18.3%、TPU降低16.1%；硬件部署加速，QA时间GPU缩短28.3%、TPU缩短25.1%。
AI.conclusion: HardwareDx是经实际场景验证的解决方案，可最大化下一代AI集群的可靠性与成本效率。

title: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
summary: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出以物体为中心的流式3DGS框架OCLDA-GS，通过运动感知的锚点动态重分配与物体级刚体变换引导的局部形变校正，提升动态场景在线重建的边界精度与时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有高效流式3DGS方法通过选取部分锚点高斯并用邻域插值实现快速重建，但忽略了物体特定运动，且在物体边界附近产生不一致。
AI.method: 以物体为中心动态重分配物体与运动感知的锚点高斯，为大运动物体提供锚点支撑；将高斯邻域限制在物体组内以获得更精确边界；估计物体级刚体变换（如手部运动），并据此学习逐锚点的局部形变校正以刻画小幅形变（如衬衫褶皱）。
AI.result: 在三个动态多视角视频数据集上优于既有基线，并在相同细化预算下相对Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS)提升PSNR：N3DV +0.169 dB、Meeting Room +0.202 dB、Google Immersive +0.199 dB；同时将细化步间平均PSNR下降分别降低9.2%（N3DV）与13.8%（Meeting Room）。
AI.conclusion: 面向物体的锚点分配与刚体—局部形变分解的建模策略，可在时间与存储高效的约束下同时改善流式3DGS的重建质量与细化步间稳定性。

title: Neural Network-Based Modeling of Hysteretic Systems: From Prandtl and Preisach Neural Networks to Neuro-Madelung and Neuroplastic Continuous Models
summary: Hysteresis is a complex nonlinear phenomenon characterized by memory dependence, path dependence, and, in many physical systems, degradation, non-congruency, asymmetry, and rate dependence. This review examines the development and capabilities of Prandtl neural networks (PNNs), Preisach neural networks (PreisachNNs), generalized Prandtl neural networks (GPNNs), the neuro-Madelung model (NMM), extended Preisach neural networks (EPNNs), and dynamic plastic continuous neural networks (DPCNNs). Particular attention is given to their mechanisms for representing memory, network architectures, activation functions, training algorithms, treatment of deterioration and rate dependence, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems. The PNN introduced hysteretic memory directly into neural activation through stop operators and demonstrated accurate nonlinear dynamic analysis of structures. Preisach-NNs subsequently extended this concept through an additional nonlinear hidden layer to represent non-Masing hysteresis. GPNNs introduced deteriorating-stop neurons to capture stiffness and strength degradation and non-congruent hysteresis. A different generalization was provided by the NMM, which combined Madelung's hysteresis rules with multilayer feedforward neural networks to represent diverse rate-independent and rate-dependent behaviors. These developments culminated in the EPNN, which combines deteriorating hysteretic operators, nonlinear neural mappings, and input-rate information to accommodate Masing and nonMasing, symmetric and asymmetric, congruent and noncongruent, and rate-independent and rate-dependent hysteresis.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了将滞回记忆算子嵌入神经元激活的六类滞回神经网络（PNN、PreisachNN、GPNN、NMM、EPNN、DPCNN）的发展脉络，重点比较其记忆表征机制、网络结构、激活函数、训练算法及对退化与速率依赖的处理能力，最终指出EPNN可统一覆盖Masing/非Masing、对称/非对称、同构/非同构及速率无关/速率相关滞回行为。
AI.motivation: 滞回是兼具记忆依赖、路径依赖，并常伴随退化、非同构、非对称与速率依赖的复杂非线性现象，传统唯象模型与常规神经网络难以同时刻画这些特性；因此需要系统评估以滞回算子作为神经元激活的神经网络建模路线，明确各模型的表达能力与适用边界。
AI.method: 采用综述与比较分析方法，按时间与逻辑演进梳理：PNN以stop算子将滞回记忆直接写入神经激活；PreisachNN增加非线性隐层以表征非Masing滞回；GPNN引入deteriorating-stop神经元刻画刚度与强度退化及非同构滞回；NMM将Madelung滞回规则与多层前馈网络结合；EPNN融合退化滞回算子、非线性神经映射与输入速率信息；并纳入DPCNN。比较维度包括记忆机制、网络架构、激活函数、训练算法、退化与速率依赖处理及在非线性结构与材料系统中的应用。
AI.result: PNN在stop算子激活下实现了结构非线性动力分析的较高精度；PreisachNN通过额外非线性隐层扩展至非Masing滞回；GPNN的退化stop神经元可同时表达刚度/强度退化与非同构滞回；NMM以Madelung规则+MLP覆盖多类速率无关与速率相关行为；EPNN综合上述要素并引入输入速率信息，可统一表征Masing与非Masing、对称与非对称、同构与非同构、速率无关与速率相关的滞回。
AI.conclusion: 滞回神经网络的核心思想是把物理滞回算子内嵌为激活单元，从而在数据驱动框架中保留记忆与路径依赖的物理先验；该路线由单一stop算子逐步演进为可含退化、非线性和速率信息的统一架构（以EPNN为代表）。未来方向应是进一步扩展算子族以覆盖更复杂退化与多轴/多场耦合滞回，并提升训练稳定性与泛化能力。

title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
summary: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm conditioned on it. Across ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and six real-world tasks on three embodiments, BiCAT achieves the highest success among the compared tokenizers. In simulation, it improves mean success by 17.6 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines, with the largest gains on tasks that require close coordination between the arms, while requiring only 40.5 ms per action chunk. These results suggest that the action tokenizer is a natural place to model bimanual coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出双臂协调动作分词器BiCAT：跨臂共享动作表征并通过对称跨臂注意力与联合解码器建模臂间依赖，策略并行预测各臂token（先左臂后条件生成右臂），在RoboTwin 2.0十个任务与三个本体六个真机任务上取得最高成功率，仿真平均成功率较最强基线提升17.6个百分点，单动作块耗时仅40.5 ms。
AI.motivation: 自回归VLA模型以离散动作token的下一token预测方式工作，动作分词器因而定义了策略与机器人之间的接口。双臂操作中两臂既共享动作库又通过互补角色协作，动作表征需同时刻画这两点。然而现有分词器多将双臂编码为单一拼接动作向量，导致两臂共有的运动模式无法共享、跨臂依赖纠缠在单个token内，这些因素只能由策略隐式学习。
AI.method: BiCAT让两臂共享同一运动表征，同时借助对称跨臂注意力与联合解码器使每一臂的token以其对侧臂为条件；策略并行预测单臂全部token，并按先生成左臂、再以左臂为条件生成右臂的顺序解码。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0的十个任务与三种本体上的六个真机任务中，BiCAT在所比较的分词器中成功率最高；仿真中平均成功率较八个基线中最强者提升17.6个百分点，增益最大者集中于需要双臂紧密协调的任务，且每个动作块仅需40.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明动作分词器是建模双臂协调的合适位置。

title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RFBench——一个基于 ADS Momentum 仿真的无源射频版图设计与理解基准，含 10,000 个双端口平面版图及七类对齐表示与七项任务，并揭示多模态语言模型在此领域的系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型虽能解读图表并生成结构化输出，但其连接无源射频（RF）设计意图、版图几何与电磁行为的能力尚未被检验，缺乏统一的评测平台。
AI.method: 构建 10,000 个双端口平面版图数据集：每个版图提供可编辑几何图元、栅格图像、16×16 占用栅格、201 个频点的复数 S 参数、结构类别与 RF 响应标签，均由 ADS Momentum 仿真得到。基于这些对齐表示定义七项任务：规格条件版图生成、表示转换、响应预测、仿真器验证、设计诊断与改进、结构理解、响应分类；并在七种多模态语言模型上进行广泛基线评测与 RF 领域微调实验。
AI.result: 基线结果显示模型在生成结构有效版图与预测电磁保真响应方面存在系统性弱点；RF 专用微调将 T1a 结构有效率由 0.0% 提升至 83.2%，将 T3 图元输入下的 2 dB 内达标率由 17.7% 提升至 62.8%。
AI.conclusion: RFBench 为评估多模态 RF 能力提供通用测试台，证明领域自适应具有明显价值，同时仍有较大提升空间，可指导连接设计意图、版图表示与物理行为模型的发展。

title: Autoregressive View Model
summary: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

AI.tldr: 提出自回归视角模型（AVM），以“视角流”方式生成场景，不显式构建3D表示；通过统一上下文接口在相机路径上生成短片，并在约8M场景/视频片段上训练，多项基准上验证了自适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有场景生成方法多依赖显式3D表示（如NeRF、3DGS），构建代价高、泛化与长时一致性受限；作者希望用“视图序列自回归生成”替代显式重建，用统一上下文接口兼容图像/视频输入与多种输出设定。
AI.method: 1）将场景表示为沿指定相机路径的视图流，不构建显式3D表示；2）统一in-context接口，以图像或视频为条件生成短片段：视觉上下文用于重建与插值，学习到的先验用于外推到未见区域；3）从输入与已生成历史中检索相关视图，构成有界的活跃上下文；4）用flow matching以N-in-1-out形式微调预训练双向视频扩散Transformer；5）在自身rollout上微调因果模型，提升真实感、减少去噪步数、抑制长时漂移；6）训练规模约8M场景与视频片段。
AI.result: 在相机控制、文本控制、视觉质量、动态性、稀疏重建、4D重建与长时一致性等基准上评估生成能力与场景持久性，结果显示AVM能以单一in-context接口适配多种输入与输出设定。
AI.conclusion: 以视图流自回归替代显式3D表示是可行且通用的场景生成范式；有界活跃上下文检索与“双向扩散微调+因果自回归rollout调优”的组合可兼顾质量、效率与长时一致性。

title: GridForge: An Open Physics-Informed Digital Twin and Benchmark Suite for UK 11 kV Underground Distribution Cables
summary: The UK distribution-cable monitoring sector is data-rich but framework-poor: each Distribution Network Operator (DNO) collects megabytes of telemetry per asset per day, but there is no public benchmark dataset, no shared reference model, and no commonly agreed evaluation protocol for benchmarking sectoral, data-intensive models for operational decision support; notably for maintenance planning and prioritisation. We address this gap with GridForge, an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for fault diagnosis and prediction, integrating four building blocks: (i) a verified steady state and transient thermal model based on IEC 60287 and IEC 60853; (ii) a calibrated synthetic dataset of 64 cables (covering 320 cable-years) representing four canonical UK 11 kV thermal archetypes and four condition modes; (iii) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate that satisfies the algebraic balance defined by IEC 60287 during training and reaches an RMSE of 0.148 °C on an independent held out set against the reference analytical oracle; and (iv) a five-task benchmark suite that includes three reference baseline models (pure physics, gradient-boosted trees, and the PINN). All numerical parameters are sourced from public standards, the code is licensed under the MIT licence, and the trained PINN converges in only two minutes (as run on the computing platform in Section 10.1), enabling independent verification by DNO engineering and research practitioners. At present only the virtual-sensor task (T4) discriminates between the reference baselines; the other tasks tie or are undefined on this test split, so extending the baselines with task-specific logic is a priority future enhancement. For open validation, the dataset, test sets and models are made available at https://github.com/mlily2024/Gridforge

AI.tldr: 该文提出开源物理信息数字孪生与基准套件 GridForge，用于英国配电电缆的故障诊断与预测，包含IEC 60287/60853热模型、64条电缆（320电缆年）校准合成数据集、满足IEC 60287代数平衡约束的PINN代理模型（留出集RMSE 0.148 °C），以及含三类基线（纯物理、梯度提升树、PINN）的五任务基准；但仅虚拟传感任务T4能区分基线，其余任务并列或无定义。
AI.motivation: 英国配电电缆监测领域数据丰富但框架缺失：各配电网运营商每日采集海量遥测数据，却缺乏公开基准数据集、共享参考模型和公认评测协议，难以对支撑运维决策（尤其检修计划与优先级排序）的数据密集型模型进行基准比较。
AI.method: 构建 GridForge，整合四个模块：（i）基于IEC 60287与IEC 60853并经校验的稳态与暂态热模型；（ii）覆盖四种英国11 kV典型热原型与四种状态模式的64条电缆、320电缆年校准合成数据集；（iii）训练中满足IEC 60287代数平衡约束的PINN代理模型；（iv）含纯物理、梯度提升树与PINN三类参考基线的五任务基准套件。参数均取自公开标准，代码采用MIT许可。
AI.result: PINN在独立留出集上相对解析参考真值的RMSE为0.148 °C，训练仅需约两分钟（依文中第10.1节计算平台），便于独立复现验证；基准测试中仅虚拟传感任务T4能区分各参考基线，其余任务在该测试划分上结果并列或未定义。
AI.conclusion: GridForge 填补了配电电缆监测领域公开基准与共享参考模型的空白，提供可验证、可复现的开源数字孪生与评测框架；后续工作重点是引入任务特定逻辑扩展基线模型，以提升基准的区分力。数据集、测试集与模型已在 GitHub 公开。

title: Learning and Control in Physically Coupled Dynamical Systems
summary: We introduce TAG (Testbed for Autonomous Games), a compact, low-cost robotic platform for studying learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems. TAG combines an actively tilted and steered ball-in-maze board with a top-mounted rotary inverted pendulum. The pendulum's reaction torque and vibration disturb the board and marble, while the board's tilt, driven by the maze-solving policy, simultaneously disturbs the pendulum's balance. The main challenge in learning control policies for each subsystem is accounting for the impact of one subsystem's dynamics on the other's learning process. To address this challenge, we present complementary reinforcement learning paradigms, leveraging model-based and model-free approaches to learn the control policies for the maze and pendulum, respectively. Our key finding is that introducing the pendulum causes an immediate, sharp drop in the maze policy's success rate, but the policy adapts online and recovers to its pre-coupling performance within a small number of learning episodes. Experimental results show that both policies, trained independently, successfully control the maze board and the pendulum despite their physical coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAG——一个紧凑、低成本、物理耦合的机器人测试平台（主动倾斜驱动的迷宫滚珠板 + 顶部旋转倒立摆），并用基于模型与无模型互补的强化学习范式分别学习两个子系统控制策略，发现耦合会立即导致迷宫策略成功率骤降，但策略可在线适应并在少量回合内恢复到耦合前水平。
AI.motivation: 研究物理耦合动力系统中的学习与控制需要一个可控、可复现且成本低的实验平台；核心困难在于一个子系统的动力学（反作用力矩、振动、板面倾斜）会干扰另一子系统的学习过程，需要考察策略在耦合扰动下的学习与适应能力。
AI.method: 构建TAG平台：主动倾斜与转向的ball-in-maze板叠加顶部安装的旋转倒立摆，两者通过反作用力矩、振动与板面倾斜双向耦合；针对迷宫与倒立摆分别采用基于模型（model-based）与无模型（model-free）的互补强化学习范式独立训练控制策略，并评估耦合引入后的在线适应过程。
AI.result: 引入倒立摆后，迷宫策略成功率立即出现急剧下降；但策略能够在线适应，在少量学习回合内恢复至耦合前的性能水平。两个独立训练的策略在存在物理耦合的情况下均能成功控制迷宫板与倒立摆。
AI.conclusion: TAG为研究物理耦合动力系统中的学习与控制提供了可行且低成本的手段；基于模型与无模型方法互补、独立训练的策略具备对耦合扰动的鲁棒性与快速在线适应能力。

title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
summary: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. We show that keeping less than 5% of critical layer activations in 8-bit precision recovers up to 92% of the accuracy lost during aggressive sub-4-bit compression. Finally, we bridge the hardware reality gap by evaluating deployment performance on standard ARM and x86 CPU architectures. We show that while low-bit quantization reduces memory storage requirements, standard runtime software bit-unpacking introduces a 1.48x to 21.5x execution slowdown depending on batch size, highlighting a critical trade-off between model footprint and actual edge throughput. Our findings provide a practical blueprint for navigating the limits of sub-4-bit deployment without sacrificing hardware performance.

AI.tldr: 该文系统剖析了视觉CNN在低于4bit权重压缩下的量化崩塌机制，指出崩塌高度非线性且集中在后期pointwise投影与depthwise层，并提出多步混合精度恢复方案：仅保留不到5%的关键层激活为INT8即可挽回多达92%的精度损失；同时揭示低比特量化虽节省存储，但标准CPU运行时解包会使执行速度下降1.48x–21.5x。
AI.motivation: 资源受限环境下的深度视觉模型高度依赖低比特量化，但权重压至4bit以下常导致灾难性精度崩塌。现有混合精度恢复策略虽能救回精度，却缺乏对"崩塌发生在何处、为何发生"的机理理解，同时忽略了低比特部署在真实硬件上的吞吐代价。
AI.method: 在标准视觉CNN（ResNet、EfficientNet骨干）上于完整ImageNet-1k验证集（50,000张）进行评估。第一步精确定位退化进程，识别崩塌集中的层类型；第二步提出结构化的多步恢复瀑布，依次评估选择性整型精度（INT4/INT8）与选择性浮点scale；第三步在ARM与x86 CPU上测量实际部署性能。
AI.result: 量化崩塌呈强非线性，集中于后期pointwise投影与depthwise层；将不到5%的关键层激活保持8bit精度，可恢复激进sub-4-bit压缩中所损失精度的至多92%；低比特量化降低存储占用，但运行时软件bit-unpacking带来1.48x–21.5x的执行减速（随batch size变化）。
AI.conclusion: 低比特（sub-4-bit）部署存在模型体积与实际边缘吞吐之间的关键权衡；论文给出的层级别崩塌图谱与选择性混合精度恢复瀑布，为在不牺牲硬件性能的前提下探索sub-4-bit量化极限提供了可操作的实践蓝图。

title: Bits, Not Boxes: Label-Free Layer Selection for Visual Localization in VLMs
summary: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. We show that attention itself can identify them. A question changes how much a head attends to the image and where this attention goes. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. WhereBits turns these where-to-look bits into a layer prior and combines it with per-head contrastive scores. Its three design constants were fixed once on labeled COCO data, and a new model or resolution needs only unlabeled questions. Across eight VLMs, WhereBits matches the pointing accuracy of box-tuned layers on COCO and RefCOCO and ranks target tokens better. This advantage holds on a held-out model family and at higher resolutions. Its COCO pointing accuracy is 0.72, against 0.22 for mean attention. In training-free zoom-in, its crops raise V* accuracy by 6.0 points under forced-choice evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出WhereBits：利用无标注问题下注意力"看哪里"的信息量比特作为层先验，结合逐头对比分数，无需框标注即可找到VLM中能定位目标物体的层，定位精度媲美框调优层。
AI.motivation: 注意力图虽能廉价反映VLM的注视位置，但注意力汇（attention sinks）使其定位不可靠；用通用提示对比可抑制汇，但只有部分层能定位被查询物体。现有方法依赖框标注或固定规则来寻找这些层，成本高且泛化性差。
AI.method: 观察到问题会同时改变两件事：头对图像的总注意力份额，以及注意力投向何处；二者可精确分离。后者在无标注问题上以比特（bits）度量，可指示哪些层具有定位能力。WhereBits将该"看哪里"比特转化为层先验，并与逐头的对比分数融合。三个设计常数仅在带标注COCO数据上固定一次，新模型或新分辨率只需无标注问题。
AI.result: 在8个VLM上，WhereBits在COCO与RefCOCO上的指认（pointing）精度与框调优层相当，目标token排序更优；该优势在留出模型家族及更高分辨率下依然成立。COCO指认精度0.72，而平均注意力仅0.22。在免训练zoom-in中，其裁剪使V*强制选择评测准确率提升6.0个点。
AI.conclusion: 注意力自身即可无监督地识别定位层，摆脱框标注依赖；所提信号具跨模型、跨分辨率的可迁移性，且可直接增强下游免训练视觉推理流程。

title: Biologically-Inspired Spike Encoding and Optimization for Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer theoretical energy-efficiency advantages over conventional deep networks, but realizing these advantages on vision tasks requires sparse spike representations that naive rate-coding methods fail to provide. We combine biologically motivated spike-encoding schemes with two training improvements: Rouser adaptive-threshold surrogate gradients and Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) second-order optimization. The spike encoding schemes experimented with are rate coding, latency coding, DVS-style delta modulation, and Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) filtering. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate that biologically inspired encoders yield the largest accuracy gains in capacity-constrained regimes and serve as an effective parameter-efficiency lever. DoG and delta modulation encoders produce significantly sparser spike trains than rate coding. K-FAC yields modest but consistent accuracy improvements over Adam-trained baselines, and Rouser's learnable per-neuron thresholds improve Fashion-MNIST accuracy from 87.37% to 88.13% by enabling homeostatic firing-rate regulation. Biologically grounded pre-processing methods can help close the accuracy gap between SNNs and non-spiking baselines without increasing model size.

AI.tldr: 该论文将生物启发脉冲编码方案与Rouser自适应阈值替代梯度、K-FAC二阶优化结合，在MNIST/Fashion-MNIST上验证：生物编码器在受限容量下带来最大精度增益并显著提升稀疏性，K-FAC小幅稳定增益，Rouser阈值调节将Fashion-MNIST精度从87.37%提升至88.13%。
AI.motivation: SNN理论上具备能效优势，但该优势依赖稀疏脉冲表示，而朴素率编码（rate coding）无法提供足够稀疏性，导致视觉任务上SNN与非脉冲基线存在精度差距。作者希望用生物学合理的预处理编码与训练改进，在不增加模型规模的前提下缩小该差距。
AI.method: 对比四种脉冲编码方案：率编码、延迟编码（latency coding）、DVS风格差分调制（delta modulation）、高斯差分（DoG）滤波；训练端引入两项改进：(1) Rouser自适应阈值替代梯度，实现可学习的逐神经元阈值与稳态放电率调节；(2) Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature（K-FAC）二阶优化。在MNIST与Fashion-MNIST上进行实验，分析精度、脉冲稀疏性与参数效率。
AI.result: 生物启发编码器在容量受限设置下取得最大精度增益，是有效的参数效率杠杆；DoG与差分调制编码产生的脉冲序列显著比率编码更稀疏；K-FAC相对Adam基线带来小幅但一致的精度提升；Rouser的可学习逐神经元阈值通过稳态放电率调节将Fashion-MNIST精度从87.37%提升到88.13%。
AI.conclusion: 生物学基础的预处理方法可在不增大模型尺寸的情况下帮助缩小SNN与非脉冲基线的精度差距；结合自适应阈值与二阶优化可进一步获得稳定收益，为高效SNN视觉系统提供了可行路径。

title: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling.
  In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view.
  We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73.
  Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.

AI.tldr: RageVLA通过"鲁棒增强+解耦编码"的组合，将"做什么"与"训练时的位置/场景/指令措辞"解耦，以0.21B参数在LIBERO-PRO上达到SOTA（0.72 vs 0.53），并通过消融实验证明策略真正依据感知到的物体位置行动。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在LIBERO上表现接近饱和，但在LIBERO-PRO上物体一移动或指令一改就失效。作者认为瓶颈不在于模型规模，而在于"耦合"：策略把"做什么"与训练时的物体位置、周围场景、指令措辞绑定在一起，缺乏解耦能力与泛化性。
AI.method: 分数据与策略两处解耦。数据端采用通用规则重排LIBERO演示：移动旋转所有物体与场景构件、把任务迁移到其他环境与表面、对所有指令做改写。策略端在冻结DINOv3特征上训练感知引擎，向动作模型输出解耦场景表示——物体及其位置列表、夹爪所视目标的紧凑编码，并与TinyCLIP的图像/指令嵌入并列；动作模型为从零训练的流匹配扩散Transformer。
AI.result: 0.21B参数的RageVLA在LIBERO-PRO上取得VLA策略中的新SOTA：0.72，对比最佳已发表模型的0.53，更大变体达0.73。LIBERO-Object上两项测试印证"依感知而行动"：保持图像正确但打乱给定物体位置时成功率由0.965降至0.215；目标物体位移28cm时成功率0.865，而同测试框架下π0.5仅0.105。
AI.conclusion: VLA的鲁棒性瓶颈是结构耦合而非模型规模；通过数据重排增强与显式解耦的场景/目标编码，小规模模型也能显著超越大规模基线。位置打乱导致性能骤降说明策略确实依赖所给的位置感知输入，而位移鲁棒性实验进一步表明其具备对真实空间变化的适应能力。

title: LusoClin: A Synthetic Clinical Note Dataset for Medical Information Retrieval in European Portuguese
summary: Access to large-scale clinical text collections is crucial for advancing medical information retrieval research, including clinical note search, patient cohort identification, and domain-adapted retrieval models. However, real clinical notes are rarely available due to privacy regulations, which particularly limits progress for low-resource languages such as European Portuguese. We present LusoClin, a publicly released dataset of synthetic clinical notes in European Portuguese, created to support privacy-preserving research on clinical text retrieval. LusoClin was generated by pre-processing real clinical data, fine-tuning the open-source Llama 3.2 (3B) instruction-tuned model using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, and applying prompt-based clinical note generation. To facilitate semantic indexing and clinical search, the notes are automatically annotated with clinical entities using a BERT-based model. We evaluate LusoClin in terms of utility, fidelity, diversity, and privacy using automatic metrics and human evaluation. Results indicate that the dataset captures clinically relevant language patterns and can support downstream IR applications such as clinical document retrieval and domain-specific model adaptation, although annotators can often distinguish synthetic from real notes and some medical inconsistencies persist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并公开了 LusoClin——一个欧洲葡萄牙语的合成临床笔记数据集，通过预处理真实临床数据、用 QLoRA 微调 Llama 3.2 (3B) instruct 模型并结合提示生成笔记，再用 BERT 模型自动标注临床实体以支持语义索引与检索，并从效用、保真度、多样性、隐私性四方面进行评估。
AI.motivation: 大规模临床文本对医学信息检索（临床笔记检索、患者队列识别、领域自适应检索模型）至关重要，但真实临床笔记受隐私法规限制难以获取，这一问题在低资源语言（如欧洲葡萄牙语）上尤为突出，因而需要隐私安全的替代数据资源。
AI.method: 先对真实临床数据进行预处理，再使用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调开源 Llama 3.2（3B）指令微调模型，通过基于提示的方式生成合成临床笔记；随后用基于 BERT 的模型自动标注临床实体，以支持语义索引与临床搜索。
AI.result: 采用自动指标与人工评估从效用、保真度、多样性、隐私性四个维度评价：数据集能够捕捉具有临床相关性的语言模式，可支撑临床文档检索与领域特定模型自适应等下游 IR 应用；但标注者常能区分合成笔记与真实笔记，且仍存在部分医学不一致。
AI.conclusion: LusoClin 为欧洲葡萄牙语临床文本检索研究提供了可公开获取、隐私友好的资源，验证了合成数据支撑下游 IR 任务的可行性，同时表明在保真度与医学一致性方面仍有改进空间。

title: TransFIRA+: Transfer Learning for Biometric Recognizability Assessment
summary: Biometric recognition in surveillance, video, and web imagery must contend with extreme variation in pose, blur, illumination, occlusion, and distance, where visual quality metrics fail to predict whether inputs are recognizable to the deployed encoder. Existing face image quality assessment methods rely on visual heuristics, curated annotations, or costly generative pipelines, leaving their predictions detached from the encoder's decision geometry. We introduce TransFIRA, a lightweight framework that grounds recognizability directly in embedding space. TransFIRA derives class-center similarity (CCS) and class-center angular separation (CCAS) from a pretrained encoder's embeddings and learns to predict them from images without quality annotations. Using predicted CCS for template weighting and CCAS>0 as a natural filtering threshold yields state-of-the-art face verification performance on BRIAR, raising TAR at $10^{-6}$ FMR from 0.085 with uniform averaging to 0.598. The predicted scores also reveal how image degradations affect encoder-specific recognizability. TransFIRA+ extends this framework to cross-camera multimodal person identification in untrimmed surveillance video. In this setting, body recognizability scores saturate within a narrow range, making direct weighting effectively uniform. We introduce a post-hoc sigmoid calibration that transforms these saturated scores into informative weights without retraining. After calibration, the BRIAR-trained TransFIRA predictor improves fused face and body identification on two unseen multi-camera datasets, outperforming detector-confidence weighting and uncalibrated CCS-rank weighting. Together, TransFIRA and TransFIRA+ demonstrate that encoder-grounded recognizability generalizes across biometric modalities and recognition settings.

AI.tldr: 提出TransFIRA，将人脸可识别性直接锚定在编码器嵌入空间，用类别中心相似度(CCS)与类别中心角分离度(CCAS)作为无标注预测目标；结合TransFIRA+的sigmoid后校准扩展到跨相机多模态行人识别。
AI.motivation: 监控、视频与网络图像中姿态、模糊、光照、遮挡、距离变化剧烈，传统视觉质量指标无法预测输入对部署编码器是否可识别；现有人脸质量评估依赖视觉启发式、人工标注或昂贵生成流程，预测与编码器决策几何脱节。
AI.method: 从预训练编码器嵌入中导出CCS与CCAS，训练轻量网络从图像直接预测、无需质量标注；用预测CCS做模板加权，以CCAS>0作为天然过滤阈值。TransFIRA+针对未裁剪监控视频的跨相机多模态行人识别，提出无需重训的sigmoid后校准，将饱和的人体可识别性分数转化为有效权重，并与人脸分数融合。
AI.result: BRIAR上TAR@1e-6 FMR由均匀平均的0.085提升至0.598，达到SOTA人脸验证性能；预测分数可揭示图像退化对编码器特定可识别性的影响。校准后的BRIAR训练预测器在两个未见多相机数据集上提升人脸+人体融合识别，优于检测置信度加权与未校准CCS秩加权。
AI.conclusion: 编码器锚定的可识别性可跨生物特征模态与识别场景泛化；无需质量标注即可获得与决策几何一致的样本质量度量，并可通过简单后校准适配分数饱和的新模态。

title: Goemans's Unsplittable-Flow Conjecture: The Anatomy of AI-Assisted Counterexample Discovery
summary: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible route choices; their convex hull, the conflict polytope, yields exact conditions for demands, fractional flows, and costs. Starting from a simple arborescence, the pipeline selects Rybin's topology and characterizes all counterexamples it supports. Experiments further demonstrate the pipeline's transferability: when instructed to follow it while varying the initial arborescence and shortcut placement, ChatGPT produced counterexamples on topologies genuinely different from Rybin's and found valid constructions starting from 93 other rooted arborescence shapes. The theory also explains why the original example was difficult to discover through blind enumeration and suggests that Rybin's interaction lies between blind enumeration and a complete theory-guided construction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Goemans关于分数量流可转换为不可分流且弧负载增幅不超过最大需求的猜想，提出一条前向反例构造流水线，系统性刻画反例的结构条件，并解释AI辅助搜索成功的原因。
AI.motivation: Rybin借助与ChatGPT交互发现了一个七顶点反例，推翻了Goemans长期猜想，但该交互未能揭示该拓扑、需求、分数量流与成本选择为何协同奏效，也未说明是否存在更一般的反例族、哪些结构特征决定反例可行位置，以及AI辅助搜索为何能超越此前的人工努力。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建前向反例构造流水线：从不可能失败的树状结构（arborescence）出发，加入进入终端的捷径弧。由此得到的负载约束定义了一个有限的可容许路径选择集合，其凸包（冲突多面体，conflict polytope）给出需求、分数量流与成本的精确条件。以简单树状结构为起点，流水线复现Rybin的拓扑，并刻画其支持的全部反例；实验中让ChatGPT遵循该流水线，通过改变初始树状结构与捷径位置来检验可迁移性。
AI.result: 流水线精确刻画了Rybin拓扑下的所有反例；实验中ChatGPT在明显不同于Rybin的拓扑上构造出反例，并从另外93种有根树状结构出发找到了有效构造；理论解释了原例为何难以通过盲目枚举发现。
AI.conclusion: 冲突多面体框架为反例提供了精确判据并具备可迁移性；Rybin的交互式发现介于盲目枚举与完整的理论引导构造之间，为AI辅助数学发现提供了结构性解释。

title: RESCUE Jumper: A Centimeter-Scale Rolling and Jumping Robot for Search and Rescue
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics 2026, Best Paper Award
summary: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. The launch angle of the jumps ranges from 45 degree to -11 degree with respect to the vertical axis, reaching a maximum height of 9.2 cm and a maximum lateral displacement of 11.2 cm. We model the winding speed-dependent jumping behavior in three phases: tail release to determine the contact point and robot orientation, tail straightening until liftoff, and ballistic flight to predict jump height and lateral displacement. Finally, qualitative tests highlight the robot's locomotion in cluttered, real-world environments. The model and experiments presented in this work can inform future designs of space-constrained jump mechanisms in centimeter-scale robots for search and rescue and inspection in unstructured environments.

AI.tldr: 提出125 g、宽6.2 cm的厘米级机器人RESCUE Jumper，用两个执行器复用实现滚动与跳跃，通过调节卷尾速度控制跳跃方向，最高跳9.2 cm、横向位移达11.2 cm，并建立三相跳跃模型。
AI.motivation: 厘米级机器人体积小，可进入人类无法到达的狭小空间，适宜城市搜救；但尺寸受限导致部署后越障能力不足，需要兼具地面滚动与跳跃的紧凑移动方案。
AI.method: 设计RESCUE Jumper：轮径6.2 cm，利用两个执行器在滚动与跳跃间复用——轮子正转实现滚动，反转则卷绕弹簧钢尾储存弹性势能并释放起跳；以卷绕速度调节跳跃方向。建立三相模型：尾部释放（确定接触点与机体姿态）、尾部伸直至离地、抛体飞行（预测跳跃高度与横向位移）。
AI.result: 卷绕速度由0.75 rad/s增至8.73 rad/s时，跳跃由后向转为前向；起跳角相对竖直轴为45°至-11°；最大跳高9.2 cm，最大横向位移11.2 cm；模型与实验一致，并在杂乱真实环境中完成定性运动测试。
AI.conclusion: 执行器复用与卷尾调速机制可在极小空间内实现可控跳跃，所建模型与实验结果为受限空间内厘米级机器人的跳跃机构设计提供依据，适用于搜救与非结构化环境巡检。

title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
summary: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. Across two model backbones, the framework produces verifier-accepted drafts for 94% (47/50) of requirements per run. Blind expert evaluations confirm high mathematical accuracy and curriculum alignment, with strict teacher-readiness assessments accepting up to 56.8% of generated items. Analysis of rejected drafts reveals persistent domain-agnostic challenges involving formatting, statement validity, and solution-step completeness. These findings demonstrate that VeriMath can bridge generative AI and dependable educational applications by producing highly reviewable assessment drafts within tightly constrained national curriculum frameworks.

AI.tldr: VeriMath：一个面向国家课程约束的数学试题生成人机协同框架，通过锚定参考题、顺序化自动验证与引导式修复，在越南12年级4555题、50项生成需求上实现94%需求获验证器接受、专家盲评严格可用率达56.8%。
AI.motivation: 自动生成数学测评题是教育AI的重要方向，但课堂落地困难：生成题需同时满足数学正确性、课程对齐、认知难度适当与教师可审阅性等多重约束。既有工作在文本生成上有进展，却缺乏对本地化考试格式的细粒度控制与专家教育判断的整合，因此需要新的框架设计。
AI.method: 提出VeriMath通用人机协同（human-in-the-loop）框架：以带标注的参考题（annotated reference items）为锚，将生成绑定到指定的考试板块与认知推理层级，随后执行顺序化的自动验证（sequential automated verification）与引导式修复（guided repair），最后提交专家评审。评估采用国家级课程案例：越南12年级课程4555道数学题、50项不同生成需求，覆盖选择题、判断题与简答题三种格式，并在两种模型主干上测试。
AI.result: 每次运行中，94%（47/50）的生成需求产出被验证器接受的草稿；盲评专家确认数学准确性与课程对齐度高，严格的教师可用性评估中最多56.8%的生成题被接受。对被拒草稿的分析显示，仍存在跨领域共性难题：格式规范性、陈述有效性（statement validity）与解题步骤完整性。
AI.conclusion: VeriMath能够在严格受限的国家课程框架内产出高度可审阅的测评草稿，从而连接生成式AI与可靠的教育应用；但格式、陈述有效性与解答完整性等域无关问题仍是后续改进重点。

title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
summary: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 control by +0.954 percentage points (73.88% vs. 72.92%) across an 88-epoch stateless replay schedule, with learned attention amplitude rising monotonically with semantic depth (27.2% at P3 -> 45.4% at P4 -> 66.3% at P5). Second, we evaluate recurrent weight sharing across repeated MBConv blocks with pass-specific BatchNorm statistics (+1,536 parameters per pass). While post-hoc kernel averaging degrades accuracy to 17.03% and single-template stage tying (-27.6% parameters) plateaus at 66.10%, alternating two shared block templates ([B1, A, B, A]) in Stage 6 cuts total model parameters by 10.9% (582K weights) and recovers by +10.82 points in a single epoch to 70.92% (-1.84 points vs. unshared control).

AI.tldr: 本文在ImageNet-1k上用受控的EfficientNet-B0实验回答两个混合架构设计问题：全局自注意力应在何处插入、重复模块能否共享权重。结果表明在保留MBConv主干的前提下于P3/P4/P5插入零门控残差自注意力适配器最优（74.02%，比严格匹配的纯卷积对照高0.954个百分点），而两模板交替的循环权重共享可在减少10.9%参数的情况下仅损失1.84个百分点。
AI.motivation: 紧凑卷积主干（如EfficientNet）依赖局部深度可分离卷积实现参数高效，但混合架构设计仍有两个核心结构问题未决：(1) 全局自注意力相对于纯卷积在何处能真正提升识别性能；(2) 重复模块能否共享权重而不损失表征能力。作者希望在严格可控的对照条件下同时考察这两点，而非依赖不可比的跨模型比较。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k（50,000张验证图）上以EfficientNet-B0为基线做受控实验。实验一：对比将分类主干包裹进多尺度特征金字塔（BiFPN）与保持MBConv主干不变、在P3（28×28，窗口化）、P4（14×14，全局）、P5（7×7，全局）插入轻量零门控残差自注意力适配器两种方案，并设置逐比特匹配的纯B0对照，采用88轮无状态重放训练调度，同时统计学习到的注意力幅度随语义深度的变化。实验二：在重复MBConv模块间评估循环权重共享，采用各次传递独立的BatchNorm统计量（每次传递额外+1,536参数），比较事后卷积核平均、单模板阶段绑定（减少27.6%参数）与两模板交替（[B1, A, B, A]）三种策略。
AI.result: BiFPN包裹方案在未配阶段注意力时反而低于纯MBConv主干（69.99%–71.81% vs. 72.86%），配合阶段注意力后为73.15%。零门控自注意力适配器单独达到74.02%，在严格匹配对照下为73.88% vs. 72.92%，提升+0.954个百分点；注意力幅度随深度单调上升（P3 27.2%→P4 45.4%→P5 66.3%）。权重共享方面，事后卷积核平均导致精度崩溃至17.03%，单模板阶段绑定（参数减少27.6%）收敛于66.10%；而在Stage 6交替两个共享模板（[B1, A, B, A]）可减少10.9%总参数（582K），且单轮训练即回升+10.82个百分点至70.92%（相对不共享对照仅-1.84个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 全局自注意力的收益取决于插入位置与形式：在完整MBConv主干上以零门控残差适配器形式注射，优于重构为多尺度特征金字塔；且深层阶段对注意力的利用显著更强。权重共享方面，细粒度的逐模块绑定与事后核平均均不可行，而两模板交替的粗粒度循环共享在参数效率与精度间取得较好折中，说明共享策略的粒度选择比是否共享更为关键。

title: Response-Relevant Information Is Not Sufficient for Neural Training-State Equivalence
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Code and provenance verified artifacts: https://github.com/ClevixLab/training-state-equivalence
summary: Response-relevant information is not sufficient evidence that two neural networks are in the same training state. We define training-state equivalence operationally: two checkpoints are equivalent, relative to an intervention family and horizon, if they respond alike when training is perturbed and continues. On fresh runs of a one-layer transformer learning modular addition, response to a weight-decay pulse is highly reproducible relative to between-checkpoint differences (rho_state = 0.934 at 500 steps), establishing the target as measurable. Fifteen descriptors of weight spectra, representation geometry and optimiser geometry carry within-run response-relevant information beyond weight norm and loss on a development dataset, predicting held-out response deviation across seed blocks. But their apparent 16.1% advantage at matching checkpoints by future response does not separate from a conditional placebo preserving each descriptor's fitted dependence on the conventional observables, and a calibrated positive control makes simple insensitivity an unlikely explanation. Information a decoder can extract need not be organised in the pairwise geometry that similarity judgments require.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"训练状态等价性"的操作化定义衡量检查点相似性：在干预与继续训练的设定下响应一致才算等价，并检验多种描述子是否携带超出权重范数与损失的响应相关信息。
AI.motivation: 常用的"响应相关信息"或权重范数、损失等常规观测量不足以证明两个神经网络处于同一训练状态；需要可测量、可证伪的等价性判据与描述子评估方案。
AI.method: 在单层Transformer学习模加法的重复训练中，用权重衰减脉冲作为干预、以未来响应偏差为目标；定义 rho_state 度量可重复性；构造15个关于权重谱、表示几何与优化器几何的描述子；在开发集上检验其对留出响应偏差（跨随机种子块）的预测力，并设置保持描述子对常规观测量拟合依赖的条件安慰剂与校准阳性对照。
AI.result: 响应目标高度可测：500步时 rho_state=0.934，远高于检查点间差异；15个描述子确实携带超出权重范数与损失的响应相关信息，并在跨种子块上预测留出响应偏差；但其在匹配检查点上看似16.1%的优势无法与条件安慰剂区分，且校准阳性对照排除了"简单不敏感"的解释。
AI.conclusion: 解码器可提取的信息不等于相似性判断所需的成对几何结构；现有描述子尚不能证明提供超越常规观测量的训练状态等价性判据，提示需区分"可提取信息"与"成对相似几何"两类证据。

title: Learning the Dynamics of Deformable Linear Objects Through Coupled Oscillators for Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: Many learning-based approaches for deformable linear objects (DLOs) rely on simplified deformation models that neglect dynamic effects and the mechanical response of the objects, limiting their applicability to lightweight, compliant objects and slow motions. Inspired by recent advances in learning physically structured dynamics with coupled oscillator networks (CONs), we propose $Φ$-CON for learning force-driven DLO dynamics. The model combines a floating-base coupled oscillator network (FBCON), whose latent potential energy depends only on the DLO's shape, with a learned affine diffeomorphism $Φ$ between observed positions along the DLO and latent coordinates. Its shape dynamics are stable by construction, and its Lagrangian structure yields explicit expressions for kinetic and potential energy. We exploit this structure to design a model-based proportional-derivative (PD) controller that compensates for the learned potential forces, thereby establishing closed-loop stability guarantees and ensuring convergence. We evaluate the approach on four simulated DLOs and a real bimanual robot setup. In simulation, $Φ$-CON achieves prediction accuracy comparable to neural ordinary differential equation (NODE) models and Lagrangian neural networks (LNNs), with $97.2\%$ and $90.2\%$ fewer parameters, respectively. Relative to a model-free PD baseline, the proposed controller reduces mean endpoint regulation error by $97.5$-$99.7\%$ in simulation and achieves a mean per-target reduction of $27.9\%$ across both endpoints in real-world experiments, demonstrating the importance of explicitly accounting for the mechanical response of stiff and heavy objects.

AI.tldr: 提出Φ-CON模型：将浮动基耦合振子网络(FBCON)与学习到的仿射微分同胚Φ结合，学习力驱动的可变形线性物体(DLO)动力学，并基于其拉格朗日结构设计具有闭环稳定性保证的PD控制器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的DLO方法多采用简化变形模型，忽略动态效应与物体力学响应，因而仅适用于轻质柔性物体和慢速运动；需要显式建模刚硬、重质物体的机械响应。
AI.method: Φ-CON由两部分组成：FBCON的潜势能仅依赖DLO形状，通过耦合振子网络表征形状动力学；Φ为观测位置与潜坐标之间的可学习仿射微分同胚。模型形状动力学构造上稳定，其拉格朗日结构给出动能与势能的显式表达；据此设计模型基PD控制器，补偿学习到的势能力，从而实现闭环稳定性与收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在4个仿真DLO与真实双臂机器人平台上评估：仿真中预测精度与NODE、LNN相当，参数量分别减少97.2%和90.2%；相比无模型PD基线，仿真中端点调节平均误差降低97.5%–99.7%，真实实验中双端点平均每目标误差降低27.9%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模DLO的力学响应（势能补偿）对刚硬重质物体的控制至关重要；Φ-CON在保持高预测精度的同时显著降低参数规模，并提供可证明稳定的模型基控制框架。

title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
comment: Equal contribution: Minghe Zhang and Xuetao Kang. 38 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables
summary: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.

AI.tldr: GUARD 提出一种无需外部评分器的闭环框架，用于持续进化冻结基座模型的可编辑 harness（提示、技能、工具规则、记忆），通过任务分解自检与方向性 regret 实现无灾难遗忘的自改进。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）可在不更新权重的情况下从经验中改编 harness，但缺少外部评分器时自我编辑常失败：反思与标量分数把"新引入的破坏"与"尚未解决的问题"混为一谈，导致局部性能回退、技能遗忘与记忆膨胀。
AI.method: 1) 将任务分解为执行前自检（pre-execution self-checks）；2) 用方向性 regret 引导 harness 更新：每轮按自检对轨迹打分，固定已掌握规则并优先处理新破坏的行为；3) 以无 critic 的组相对适应度（group-relative fitness）在并行候选编辑中择优；4) Soft-HURT 门控仅在收益大于回退时晋升编辑，将专门修复限定作用域以防过度触发，并在其门控缓冲上保证不退化；5) 测试时冻结 harness 单遍运行。
AI.result: 在记忆、技能进化、持续任务流与领域推理等基准上，GUARD 一致提升性能，且无灾难遗忘与记忆污染，同时显著降低部署 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: 通过"自检分解 + 方向性 regret + 组相对适应度选择 + Soft-HURT 门控"的组合，可在无参考评分条件下实现可靠、防回退的 harness 持续进化，兼顾效果与部署效率。

title: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
summary: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.

AI.tldr: NIRJALA：引入前向散射饱和项的三路径水下成像模型与可逆物理锚定3DGS水下去水框架
AI.motivation: 现有水下高斯泼溅方法仅建模直接透射与后向散射，采用按距离指数衰减的透射做除法"去水"，导致反演增益随距离无界增长，病态性严重；且场景内容与水介质参数高度耦合、难以区分。
AI.method: 提出NIRJALA框架，含三项设计：(1) TRIVENI三路径成像模型，在直接透射与后向散射外增加随距离饱和的前向散射项，并证明反演增益在任意距离有界、给出后向散射与衰减估计误差向恢复颜色传播的误差界；(2) PRATIBIMBA可逆物理锚，将灵活神经水体模型与十参数物理模型双向绑定，防止场景内容"藏"入水体；(3) SAMARASA物理约束目标集合，含距离分箱颜色先验。另构建SAJALA：30场景、Blender Cycles路径追踪、含无水真值图像/深度/法向的受控浊度与水体颜色测试集。
AI.result: 在SAJALA上，PSNR由24.34提升至24.76 dB，深度AbsRel由0.109降至0.091（对比最强基线）；在真实SeaThru-NeRF场景上LPIPS由0.194降至0.175，渲染速度44 FPS。同时讨论了水下外观指标与几何指标的失配及评测局限。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理可解释的三路径模型与可逆物理约束，NIRJALA在提升去水外观质量与几何精度上均优于基线且保持实时渲染；作者亦指出外观与几何评价指标存在分歧，并以合成数据集SAJALA补足真值评测缺口，评测边界仍需进一步检验。

title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
summary: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured walls match the formulas to between 89 and 94 percent. We give closed-form rigorous remainders, among them the first polynomial softmax transformer; existing sound treatments are linear relaxations. On closed loops, certificates survive where the Taylor ones diverge, and specifications flip from unknown to proven; on trained classifiers up to real MNIST digits, the Chebyshev frontier certifies input territory the Taylor basis surrenders. Every certified claim passed large Monte-Carlo harnesses with zero violations, and an applicability map states in advance where the basis provably cannot matter.

AI.tldr: 论文针对非线性动力系统可达集计算中"逐点泰勒展开+严格余项"范式的根本局限，证明泰勒基存在由复平面奇点决定的集合宽度上限（壁垒），而等阶数的切比雪夫抽象无此上限且随阶数几何收敛；并给出闭式严格余项（含首个 softmax transformer 的多项式化严格处理）与适用性地图。
AI.motivation: 现有可达集方法几乎都以截断泰勒展开加严格余项进行传播，但该展开本质是逐点式的：当自变量从单点扩展为整个集合时，同一个多项式必须在该集合上保持一致精度，其有效范围被收敛圆盘限制。该限制对现代控制器中的有理项与 sigmoid 门控尤为致命——它们在复平面上靠近实轴处存在极点，门控越尖锐极点越贴近实轴，从而严格封顶了泰勒展开可覆盖的集合宽度，且在控制器做出决策的切换面处约束最紧。
AI.method: (1) 证明二分性定理：任何泰勒阶数都无法认证超过该复奇点所定上限（壁垒）的集合宽度；(2) 提出以整个集合为锚点的切比雪夫抽象，嵌入同一多项式-zonotope流水线，证明其无该上限且在阶数上以几何速率获得宽度；(3) 推导闭式严格余项，包括首个 softmax transformer 的多项式严格抽象（已有可靠处理仅为线性松弛）；(4) 给出适用性地图，预先判定切比雪夫基在何处可证明无差异。
AI.result: 实测壁垒宽度与公式吻合度达 89%–94%；在闭环系统中，切比雪夫证书在泰勒证书发散处仍然成立，规格由 unknown 翻转为 proven；在训练分类器（直至真实 MNIST 数字）上，切比雪夫前沿可认证泰勒基放弃的输入区域；所有认证结论均通过大规模蒙特卡洛测试且零违例。
AI.conclusion: 逐点泰勒展开的宽度壁垒是其复奇点的结构性后果，无法通过提高阶数突破；以集合为锚点的切比雪夫抽象在同一流水线中消除了该壁垒并获得几何级收益，配合闭式严格余项与适用性地图，可将原本 unknown 的安全规格转化为可证结论，并扩展至含 softmax 门控的 transformer 类结构。

title: Panini- Feasible Grammar For Robot Designs
summary: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). We also introduce PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations. Across 30 methods and 24 seeds, PANINI achieves the best mean rank but is not statistically distinguishable from strong generic optimizers. Its main demonstrated advantage is therefore structural rather than optimization performance: grammar-generated designs are legal by construction, and coordinated limb placement produces 95% jointly feasible edits, compared with 55% for range-constrained resampling and none for flat parameterization in 6,000 draws. These results show how typed grammars can make robot generation more interpretable and geometrically coordinated, without implying that every feasible design will locomote or that grammar-based search universally outperforms generic optimizers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种类型化产生式文法，用格角色关系、参数继承和基于特异性度的规则仲裁同时生成操作技能与机器人形态，并给出SE(3)几何实现映射；同时提出跨熵搜索方法PANINI。实验表明文法表示紧凑、仲裁决策可由几何包含关系恢复，PANINI平均排名最优但与强通用优化器无统计显著差异，其真正优势在于生成设计天然合法、肢体协调性更高。
AI.motivation: 符号方法可解释但忽视连续几何，学习方法擅长几何但结构不透明。作者希望兼顾可解释的结构性与几何连续性，使机器人形态与技能的自动生成既合法又可解释。
AI.method: 1) 构建带类型的产生式文法，结合格角色(case-role)关系、参数继承与基于特异性(specificity)的规则仲裁，联合生成操作技能与机器人形态；2) 定义几何实现映射，将文法组合映射为SE(3)变换——在继承未激活时构成幺半群同态，继承启用时出现可度量的"缺陷"(defect)；3) 提出PANINI，一种在文法化形态表示上的交叉熵搜索方法。
AI.result: 仲裁决策可由几何包含关系恢复（10个种子下一致率0.905±0.062，欧氏对照为0.611±0.090）；PANINI在30种方法×24个种子中平均排名最优，但与强通用优化器无统计显著差异；文法生成的设计天然合法，协调肢体放置使联合可行编辑达95%，范围约束重采样为55%，平坦参数化为0（6,000次采样）。
AI.conclusion: 类型化文法可使机器人生成更具可解释性与几何协调性，但作者明确不主张所有可行设计都能运动，也不主张文法搜索普遍优于通用优化器；PANINI的主要优势是结构性的而非优化性能。

title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
summary: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. In this retrospective study, six VLMs read 100 emergency CT and MRI examinations published in a public archive (March 2025-August 2026) under four conditions (free navigation, navigation from a key slice, and all slices or key slices in a single request), twice each (4800 runs). Nine radiologists read 30 of those cases. A large language model judge validated against two radiologists graded the answers. Conditions were compared with generalized estimating equations clustered by case. Results. Pooled accuracy was lowest under free navigation (32.6%; 391/1200), followed by navigation from a key slice (37.9%; 455/1200; P = .003), and highest with all slices (42.2%; 506/1200) or key slices (42.5%; 510/1200) in one request (both P < .001). On the 30 cases read by radiologists, freely navigating models were correct in 30.0% of runs (108/360) versus 77.0% for radiologists (208/270; P < .001). Models formed a first hypothesis after a median of 10.8% of the slices and kept it in 63.1% of runs (755/1196); final answers were correct in 12.4% of runs after a wrong first hypothesis (110/885) versus 90.4% after a right one (281/311; P < .001). Median stated confidence in the final answers was 90%, whereas 38.9% of them were correct (1861/4778). Conclusion. Across all exploration strategies, VLM agents remained far less accurate than radiologists. They adopted an early hypothesis and usually kept it, seldom correcting a wrong one.

AI.tldr: 该回顾性研究评估了6个视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体在4种图像探索策略下阅读100例急诊CT/MRI的诊断准确性与导航行为（共4800次运行），并与9名放射科医师对30例的判读结果对比。结果显示：所有策略下VLM准确率（32.6%–42.5%）均远低于放射科医师（77.0%）；模型倾向于在浏览约10.8%层面后即形成首个假设并在63.1%的运行中坚持该假设，错误首假设后极少纠正（仅12.4%最终正确），且给出的中位置信度高达90%而实际正确率仅38.9%。
AI.motivation: 此前缺乏对VLM智能体在真实放射学阅片流程中"如何探索影像"（导航策略、假设形成与修正）与诊断准确性之间关系的系统量化评估。作者希望明确不同探索策略（自由导航、关键层面起始导航、一次性输入全部层面或关键层面）对诊断表现的影响，并揭示VLM的推理行为缺陷（早期假设固化、过度自信），为VLM在临床影像中的可靠应用提供依据。
AI.method: 回顾性研究；数据为公开档案中2025年3月至2026年8月的100例急诊CT与MRI检查。6个VLM在4种条件下各读片2次，共4800次运行：①自由导航；②从关键层面开始导航；③单次请求输入全部层面；④单次请求输入关键层面。9名放射科医师阅读其中30例作为对照（270次判读）。由一个大语言模型评判器评分，并以2名放射科医师的判读进行验证。统计分析采用按病例聚类的广义估计方程（GEE）进行条件间比较。
AI.result: 汇总准确率：自由导航最低（32.6%，391/1200）；从关键层面导航次之（37.9%，455/1200；P=0.003）；单次请求全部层面（42.2%，506/1200）与单次请求关键层面（42.5%，510/1200）最高（均P<0.001）。在30例放射科医师对照集上，自由导航模型的正确率为30.0%（108/360），显著低于放射科医师的77.0%（208/270；P<0.001）。模型平均在浏览10.8%（中位数）层面后即形成首个假设，并在63.1%（755/1196）的运行中保持该假设；首假设错误时最终答案仅12.4%正确（110/885），首假设正确时为90.4%（281/311；P<0.001）。最终答案所声明置信度的中位数为90%，而实际正确率仅38.9%（1861/4778）。
AI.conclusion: 在所有探索策略下，VLM智能体的诊断准确性均显著低于放射科医师。模型表现出明显的"早期假设—假设固化"行为：过早形成首个假设、且通常不予修正，错误假设后极少自我纠正；同时存在严重的置信度校准偏差（高置信、低准确）。提示仅靠改进图像输入/导航方式不足以弥合与人类专家的差距，需针对假设修正机制与不确定性校准进行专门优化。

title: mmTherm: Absolute 3D Human Pose Estimation from Low-Resolution Thermal Images and mmWave Radar
summary: Absolute 3D human pose estimation (HPE) aims to recover both a person's body pose and their global position in 3D space. Privacy-preserving millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides distance and direction measurement capabilities, but its sparse point clouds make HPE under-constrained. Low-resolution thermal imaging can provide complementary observations of body direction and structure. However, our evaluation shows that a strong feature-level fusion baseline loses much of its localization and HPE advantage when generalizing to unseen subjects, with radial localization becoming less accurate than a radar-only baseline. Motivated by this finding, we introduce mmTherm, a lightweight framework that explicitly incorporates the complementary geometric properties of thermal imaging and mmWave radar. It combines body structure and joint directions estimated from thermal images with range information from radar to localize the body and reconstruct its 3D pose. Experiments on OctoNet show that mmTherm reduces cross-user absolute joint error by 33% and root localization error by 38% relative to the strongest corresponding baselines, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and less computation at inference.

AI.tldr: 提出mmTherm：利用热成像提供的身体方向/结构信息与毫米波雷达的距离信息显式结合，实现隐私保护下的绝对3D人体位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达点云稀疏导致HPE欠约束；低分辨率热成像可提供互补的身体方向与结构观测。但作者评估发现，强特征级融合基线在跨被试泛化时定位与HPE优势大幅衰减，径向定位甚至不如纯雷达基线。
AI.method: 轻量级框架mmTherm，显式编码两种模态互补的几何特性：从热图像估计身体结构与关节方向，从雷达获取距离（range）信息，二者结合用于人体定位与3D位姿重建。
AI.result: 在OctoNet数据集上，跨用户绝对关节误差降低33%，根节点定位误差降低38%（相对最强对应基线），同时参数量显著更少、推理计算量更低。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何互补的融合策略优于隐式特征级融合，可在保证隐私与轻量化的前提下提升绝对3D HPE的跨被试泛化性能。

title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
summary: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. An exact histogram implementation and two synthetic experiments across 20 seeds verify the construction. The optimized multiplier improves over uniform and average-density weights, while fitted-model performance does not improve uniformly. The result is a loss-design guarantee under an explicit budget, rather than a general claim of predictive superiority.

AI.tldr: 针对"阈值分布属于有限指定族"的情形，研究如何在具有正点态下界与固定总质量的权函数族中选取 proper loss 的权重，使替代遗憾到阈值平均决策遗憾的尖锐（无分布假设）乘子最小。最优权重是阈值密度的重标定上包络在下界处截断，归一化常数由一维求根得到。
AI.motivation: 单一的二值概率估计会被多个误差成本不同的决策者使用，而单一的平均阈值分布无法提供良好的最坏情形遗憾保证；因此需要针对指定阈值分布族设计 proper scoring rule 的权重，在显式预算约束下获得尖锐的损失设计保证。
AI.method: 在可积损失权重族（正点态下界、总质量固定）中最小化"替代遗憾→阈值平均决策遗憾"的尖锐无分布乘子；解析刻画最优解为阈值密度重标定上包络在给定下界处的截断，归一化常数通过一维根搜索确定；给出尖锐性、最优性与密度误设下稳定性的证明，并讨论原子阈值律的局限；构造精确直方图实现，并在20个随机种子上做两组合成实验验证。
AI.result: 理论方面得到尖锐性、最优性与稳定性证明，并指出对原子型阈值分布存在限制；实验方面精确直方图实现验证了构造的有效性，优化后的乘子优于均匀权重与平均密度权重，但拟合模型的实际预测性能并未一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 该结果是在显式预算下的损失设计保证，而非关于预测优越性的普遍主张；优化权重改善的是最坏情形乘子，不必然带来模型性能的全面提升。

title: LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://luxtac.github.io
summary: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at https://luxtac.github.io.

AI.tldr: LuxTac is a ~3.5 mm thick, low-cost, scalable optical taxel array built from off-the-shelf RGBC light-to-digital converters under silicone; a plain gel cartridge measures normal force, and a colored-wall cartridge encodes shear in light color, enabling the first per-taxel shear-resolving optical taxel array.
AI.motivation: Low-cost tactile arrays make touch practical for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs only sense pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. A thin, scalable array that resolves both normal force and shear at each taxel is thus needed.
AI.method: Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so back-scattered LED light decreases monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing and one with colored walls that encodes local shear in the color of returned light, without cameras, magnets, or bump overlays. Characterization used an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor; per-taxel models estimate three-axis force.
AI.result: Normal cartridge: linear response to force (R² = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and 6–10% taxel-to-taxel variation after normalization. Shear cartridge: across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, summed estimates reach R² = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, per-taxel estimates 0.92/0.93/0.94, and median shear-direction error 4.8°. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline.
AI.conclusion: LuxTac provides a thin, low-cost, scalable optical taxel array that resolves per-taxel normal force and shear, and its pressure readings substantially improve manipulation policy performance; design files, code, and videos are publicly released.

title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpecLook，一个免训练的"推测-验证"框架：小型模型先草拟智能体的下一次"放大观察"（glimpse）并据此重答，若答案不变且高置信则提前结束；否则由大模型无工具地校正该 glimpse 并融合答案，仅证据仍不足的问题才进入一次前向的智能体调用（SpecLook-Fast 直接跳过这一步）。推理轨迹同时给出无标签的答案可靠性分数。在 V*、HR-Bench、POPE 上全部划分优于所有基线，平均准确率 87.2%/86.2%，相对 DeepEyes-7B 与 Thyme-RL 加速 7.7x/4.7x，Fast 版达 9.9x/6.3x。
AI.motivation: 现有以图像思考的智能体式 MLLM 采用"推理—放大工具调用"的顺序循环，速度慢，且输出不带可靠性评分。已有的对 token、推理步或答案的推测方法仍需保留该循环，而答案推测还会接受高置信的错误答案。作者发现该循环多数情况下只增加一次放大步骤，且小型模型在多数划分上已领先该智能体，因此需要一种可验证、可纠错、并能检验答案的推测目标。
AI.method: 关键洞察是推测智能体的"下一次观察"而非草稿答案，因为观察可被验证与纠正，并可用于检验答案。SpecLook 分三级：(1) 小模型草拟 glimpse 并据此重新作答，若答案不变且置信则终止；(2) 否则由智能体的大模型在无工具条件下验证并纠正 glimpse，融合两者答案；(3) 仅证据仍不足的问题才交由智能体一次前向处理，而 SpecLook-Fast 直接跳过该级，从而任何问题都不再跑完整循环。轨迹可无标签地为每个答案打可靠性分。
AI.result: 在 V*、HR-Bench、POPE 上，SpecLook 与 SpecLook-Fast 在每个划分上的准确率均超过所有基线。SpecLook 平均准确率达 87.2% 与 86.2%，相对 DeepEyes-7B 与 Thyme-RL 智能体分别加速 7.7x 与 4.7x；SpecLook-Fast 分别达 9.9x 与 6.3x。
AI.conclusion: 推测"可验证的观察"比推测答案更可靠，可在免训练条件下显著减少工具循环开销，同时提升准确率；推理轨迹还能给出无标签的答案可靠性评估，实现精度与效率的双赢。

title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
summary: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.

AI.tldr: 提出一种离线、免训练、参考集引导的数据筛选方法，利用小规模高质量参考集为未筛选大池的每种模态独立提取质量信号，经秩聚合融合成统一排序以指导样本选择；在3D腹部CT上用1/3.3训练数据和5k参考样本达到Merlin零样本分类水平，在2D胸片上用最多1/10数据与74样本参考集匹配甚至超越全量池训练模型。
AI.motivation: 跨机构收集的大规模医学影像数据质量参差：海量未筛选的图文对存在冗余、类别不平衡与跨机构异质性，制约3D视觉-语言模型预训练效果；需要一个不依赖额外训练、可复现的数据筛选方案来提升预训练数据效率。
AI.method: 离线、免训练、参考引导的筛选配方：以小型高质量参考集为基准，对大规模未筛选池分别在每种模态上独立计算质量信号（如冗余/相似度、分布偏移等），再通过秩聚合（rank aggregation）融合为单一排序，据此选择样本；在35k对3D腹部CT与58k对2D胸片数据上验证，并做参考集重采样稳定性、参考集规模与标签重平衡等消融。
AI.result: 3D CT：筛选后模型零样本疾病分类性能与SOTA基线Merlin持平，训练数据减少3.3×，参考集5k样本。2D胸片：筛选模型匹配或超过全池训练模型，训练数据最多减少10×，参考集仅74样本。消融：选择结果对参考集重采样稳定；更小参考集仍优于随机采样；标签重平衡未带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于参考集的多模态质量信号秩聚合是一种有效、低成本且稳定的医学3D VLM预训练数据筛选策略，可显著降低数据与标注需求；未来可扩展至更多模态与任务，代码已开源以支持复现。

title: Exploring Parkinson's Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Techniques
summary: In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as promising tools for accurate and timely diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) which is an incurable neurodegenerative disorder. This study explores the integration of ML algorithms and PD diagnosis, highlighting their potential applications in various aspects of the disease. ML methods such as support vector machines, decision trees, multilayer perceptron, k-nearest neighbours, logistic regression and random forest (with and without particle swarm optimisation) were applied on a PD dataset obtained from Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust containing data from 58 people. In terms of accuracy, the Decision Tree and Logistic Regression performed the best with scores of 72-76% while multilayer perceptron was least effective. All the models were remarkable in classifying positive PD cases with sensitivity scores going up to 97.56%, with SVM classifier at the pinnacle. However, ability to classify healthy controls from PD cases was insignificant throughout the board. Although, all the employed models delivered reasonable results in categorising PD patients in the presented dataset; access to more data, further study and advancement of these ML approaches could lead to enhanced diagnostic outcomes, supplementing to an improved understanding of Parkinson's disease.

AI.tldr: 本研究将多种机器学习算法（含/不含粒子群优化的SVM、决策树、多层感知机、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林）应用于58人的帕金森病数据集，发现决策树与逻辑回归准确率最佳（72–76%），各模型对阳性病例的敏感性极高（最高97.56%，SVM最优），但健康对照与患者区分能力普遍不足。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病是不可治愈的神经退行性疾病，亟需准确、及时的诊断手段；机器学习近年来被视为有前景的辅助诊断工具，因此有必要系统评估多种ML算法在PD诊断中的实际表现与适用性。
AI.method: 使用来自Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust、包含58人数据的帕金森病数据集，对比应用支持向量机、决策树、多层感知机、K近邻、逻辑回归和随机森林（分别在有、无粒子群优化条件下），并以准确率、敏感性等指标评估分类性能。
AI.result: 准确率方面决策树与逻辑回归表现最佳（72–76%），多层感知机效果最差；所有模型对阳性PD病例的分类效果显著，敏感性最高达97.56%，其中SVM分类器最优；但区分健康对照与PD病例的能力整体上不显著。
AI.conclusion: 在所给数据集上各模型均取得合理结果，但仍需更大规模数据、更深入的研究与算法改进，以提升诊断性能，并增进对帕金森病的理解。

title: SPICE: Stochastic Policy for Interaction in Cluttered Environments
summary: Agricultural tasks such as harvesting and pruning require robots to reach through dense foliage, where contact is often unavoidable and vision is obstructed. Intermittent contact creates an imbalance between free-space and contact-rich observations, complicating the learning of contact-responsive behaviours.
