We present SPICE, a tactileconditioned diffusion policy for reaching targets in dense plant canopies using tactile sensing as the sole environmental feedback. SPICE exhibits three behaviours: moving through compliant foliage, manoeuvring around partially obstructing stems, and manipulating branches that block the target path. To the best of our knowledge, SPICE is the first tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for target reaching through physically cluttered plant canopies. Across over 180 real-robot trials, SPICE was evaluated against tactile-conditioned, image-conditioned, and reactive-control baselines. Spatial tactile information and explicit contact conditioning proved important, with SPICE achieving 95% branch-manoeuvring success versus 45% for the strongest tactile baseline. SPICE also achieved branch manipulation beyond the reactive controller and remained effective under visual occlusion, where the image-conditioned DP failed. Zero-shot transfer across 40 trials on unseen tomato and lime plants achieved 87.5% success rate. These results demonstrate the potential of tactile-conditioned generative policies for interaction in visually occluded plant environments.

AI.tldr: SPICE：一种以触觉为唯一环境反馈的触觉条件扩散策略，用于在密集植物冠层中完成目标到达，并展现穿行柔性枝叶、绕行部分遮挡茎干、操作阻挡枝干三类行为。
AI.motivation: 采摘、修剪等农业任务要求机器人伸入密集枝叶，接触不可避免且视觉被遮挡；间歇性接触造成自由空间与富接触观测之间的数据不均衡，使接触响应行为难以学习。
AI.method: 提出触觉条件扩散策略（diffusion policy），仅以触觉感知作为环境反馈；引入空间触觉信息与显式接触条件化。在超过180次真机试验中与触觉条件、图像条件及反应式控制基线对比；并在未见过的番茄与青柠植株上进行40次零样本迁移试验。
AI.result: 空间触觉信息与显式接触条件化被证明重要：枝干绕行成功率95%（最强触觉基线45%）；枝干操作能力超出反应式控制器；在图像条件DP失效的视觉遮挡下仍有效；跨物种零样本迁移40次试验成功率87.5%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉条件生成式策略在视觉遮挡的植物环境中具有交互潜力，是首个面向物理杂乱植物冠层穿行到达的触觉条件扩散策略。

title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练推理方法 BOS Summary：在预填充的单一层内仅对 BOS 查询行放松因果掩码，使 BOS 聚合全部输入形成上下文表示，无需额外参数与解码开销，在多类 VLM/LLM 与八个基准上提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: LVLM/LLM 中普遍存在 attention sink 现象，BOS 等起始位置获得不成比例的注意力；但标准因果掩码下 BOS 查询只能看到自身，导致后续 token 反复读取的那条"常驻通路"不携带任何输入信息，造成注意力分配与信息利用的低效。
AI.method: 在 prefill 阶段选定单一 transformer 层，仅对 BOS 查询行解除因果约束，令 BOS 将全部视觉与文本输入 token 聚合为一个自生成的上下文表示；其余 token 仍保持标准因果注意力。该表示在解码过程中持续可被访问，不引入参数、辅助模块或解码期开销。
AI.result: 在多个 VLM 与 LLM 家族、八项多模态与纯文本基准上，优于直接提示与 Chain-of-Thought 提示，并在多步推理任务上超过近期 sink 干预方法。机制分析表明，BOS 携带输入特定信息后其 sink 主导性减弱，注意力向承载内容的提示 token 重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 改变"汇聚点承载什么"可重塑后续层的注意力分配，BOS Summary 以极低实现成本验证了将 sink 通路改造为上下文传递通道的可行性与机理。

title: GRID-UAV: Geometry and Ray-depth Integrated Decision-making for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. On long aerial routes, adding depth features directly brings no significant gain (42.5% vs. 42.6% success), so we study how 3D information should be given to the policy. Analyzing flight failures, we find that two forms of 3D grounding fail in opposite ways: explicit 3D lifting of depth collides less on the way but more often fails to finish at the target, while implicit alignment with a 3D geometry model finishes more often but collides more. We propose GRID, which combines both: (1) it lifts monocular depth into ray-corrected 3D positions in the UAV's frame for both cameras, and (2) during training only, it aligns its visual features with a frozen multi-view geometry model, at no inference cost. GRID adding explicit lifting to implicit alignment significantly increases how often the policy reaches the target ($61.5\% \rightarrow 69.5\%$, $p<0.001$), and adding implicit alignment to explicit lifting significantly increases how often it completes the task once there ($57.7\% \rightarrow 61.4\%$, $p<0.05$). On TravelUAV (3,005 test episodes), GRID achieves the best success rate on every split, with relative gains over the state of the art of 9.5% (seen), 17.1% (unseen objects) and 25.4% (unseen map).

AI.tldr: 提出GRID，将单目深度显式提升为无人机坐标系下射线校正的3D位置，并在训练时用冻结的多视角几何模型进行隐式特征对齐，二者互补，在TravelUAV上各划分均取得最优成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型用2D编码器，缺乏3D结构；直接向策略输入深度特征在长航线上无显著增益（42.5% vs 42.6%），因此需要研究3D信息应以何种形式提供给策略。
AI.method: 通过飞行失败分析发现两类3D接地方式失败模式相反：显式深度3D提升途中碰撞少但到达目标后完成率低，隐式与3D几何模型对齐到达率高但碰撞多。GRID结合两者：(1) 将两路相机（前视与下视）的单目深度提升为无人机坐标系下射线校正的3D位置；(2) 仅在训练阶段将视觉特征与冻结的多视角几何模型对齐，推理零成本。
AI.result: 隐式对齐基础上加显式提升，到达目标率由61.5%升至69.5%（p<0.001）；显式提升基础上加隐式对齐，到达后完成任务率由57.7%升至61.4%（p<0.05）。TravelUAV（3,005测试回合）各划分成功率最优，相对SOTA提升：已见9.5%、未见物体17.1%、未见地图25.4%。
AI.conclusion: 面向长航线空中导航，显式3D提升与隐式几何对齐是互补的3D接地形式，联合使用可同时降低碰撞并提高任务完成率；训练期对齐不增加推理开销，具备实用价值。

title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.

AI.tldr: 针对生成式推荐（GR）推理中长输入、宽束搜索、极少固定输出token的特点，提出基于Tree Attention的端到端生成流水线优化方案，在Ascend NPU上无需自定义算子即可相比vLLM最高降低25倍端到端时延。
AI.motivation: GR推理与常规LLM服务差异显著：输入极长、beam width大、输出token极少且固定。现有引擎（如vLLM）将各beam视为独立序列批处理，导致对共享prompt前缀的KV cache重复访问；且vLLM把束搜索的每个生成步骤当作独立引擎调用，引入主机端beam处理开销与PagedAttention中大量的运行时KV块管理开销。
AI.method: 采用Tree Attention将各beam沿序列维度拼接，消除冗余KV访问；并配合预生成的部分注意力掩码、静态KV cache分配、循环展开的生成调度、TorchAir图编译、自动算子融合以及词表约束解码等系统性优化，全程不使用自定义kernel。
AI.result: 在Ascend NPU上，端到端时延相比vLLM最高降低25倍，生成时延与采用自定义kernel的SOTA方案相当。
AI.conclusion: 在转向自定义kernel开发之前，应首先对生成流水线进行整体（holistic）优化；系统级协同优化即可获得与专用kernel方案相近的性能。

title: Recoverability, Not Invariance: Certified Safety for Robots at the Limits of Performance
summary: Safety certification in robotics typically rests on forward invariance of the deployed controller, a property that demands high-fidelity models at the edge of the operating envelope, exactly where models are least reliable and robots perform best. As a result, many of the behaviors we most want robots to run, from learned policies to aggressive maneuvers at the limits of traction, cannot be certified at all. We introduce recoverability, a contraction-theoretic safety concept that resolves this tension by certifying a robot's ability to reengage a trusted recovery mode rather than the invariance of a deployed behavior. We prove that switching to the recovery mode from anywhere inside a certified tube guarantees exponential convergence, even under disturbances and model error. To decide when to switch, we derive the contraction insertion gradient, the first-order effect of a recovery insertion on the certificate, and embed it in a switching-time program in which feasibility alone guarantees safety and optimality only shapes performance. To supply the certificates, we develop sequential convex synthesis that monotonically grows the certified tube toward the exact viability kernel. We validate our approach in simulated quadrotor flight through uncertain obstacles, where it outperforms invariance-based safety filters, and in hardware deployments aboard a full-scale IndyNXT autonomous racecar, where it repeatedly recovers the car from an aggressive raceline at the limits of handling in the rain. Recoverability provides a certified exit strategy, extending formal safety guarantees to aggressive, learned, and experimental behaviors without requiring their invariance.

AI.tldr: 提出"可恢复性"(recoverability)这一收缩理论安全概念：不再要求部署策略前向不变，而是认证机器人能从某一"认证管道"内任意状态切换回可信恢复模式并指数收敛，从而为激进、学习型与实验性行为提供形式化安全保证。
AI.motivation: 机器人安全认证通常依赖部署控制器的前向不变性，而这需要在工作包络边缘具备高保真模型——恰恰是模型最不可靠、机器人性能最好的区域。因此学习策略、极限附着下的激进机动等最想实现的行为根本无法被认证，存在安全性与性能的根本张力。
AI.method: 1) 定义recoverability：认证"能否重新接入可信恢复模式"而非部署行为的不变性；证明从认证管道内任意点切换至恢复模式可保证指数收敛（含扰动与模型误差）。2) 推导contraction insertion gradient，即恢复插入对证书的一阶影响，并嵌入切换时刻优化程序：可行性即保证安全，最优性仅影响性能。3) 提出sequential convex synthesis，单调扩张认证管道以逼近精确viability kernel。4) 仿真四旋翼不确定障碍飞行 + 全尺寸IndyNXT自动驾驶赛车硬件实验。
AI.result: 仿真中优于基于不变性的安全过滤器；硬件上在雨天、操控极限下沿激进赛车线行驶并反复成功恢复车辆。
AI.conclusion: Recoverability提供了一种经认证的退出策略，将形式化安全保证扩展至激进、学习型与实验性行为，而无需这些行为本身满足不变性。

title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
summary: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GRAFT方法，在进化式智能体架构设计中引入父代特定的执行证据来引导语义交叉，利用有界成功/失败样本反馈提升LLM智能体性能，平均测试准确率达82.0%，超过最强基线9.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有自动智能体设计通过进化方法（语言模型交叉）重组任务分解、模型协调与验证等机制，但搜索通常仅由聚合适应度引导，掩盖了每个分数背后的实例级成功与失败信息，导致搜索信号贫乏。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT（Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design）：以聚合适应度用于选择与存活，同时用父代特定的执行证据引导带集成变异的语义交叉。其反馈框架复用适应度评估中有界的成功与失败运行样本，隐藏参考答案且无需额外任务执行。
AI.result: 在六个推理与编程设定中使用开放权重优化器与执行器模型评估，平均测试准确率82.0%，比最强基线高9.8个百分点；控制消融显示在初始化、搜索规则、修复策略与评估预算固定条件下，加入执行证据可提升测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持父代特定执行证据在进化式智能体设计中的价值，表明实例级反馈能够有效改进语义交叉质量与最终智能体性能。

title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
summary: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MedHarness-paper-release-A7F3/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MedHarness——一种可注册的多成像面运行时可靠性层，将答题后的控制重构为"共享决策对象"挂载，用单一共享策略+各成像面配方适配器统一管理停止/补证/修复/拒答四类动作，显著减少误接受与远程调用成本。
AI.motivation: 医学影像智能体已在多种异构成像面上给出答案，但部署时验证预算有限，每次错误接受都会损害临床信任。薄检查与深度证据核查在同一样例上不一致时，缺乏共享控制器导致"何时停止、是否补证据、修复还是拒答"难以决策。现有工具调用流程要么按数据集锁定特定成像面的证据顺序，要么采用私有的全深度验证路径，成本高、误接受多，且无法跨模态共享同一控制器。
AI.method: MedHarness 作为运行时可靠性层，在提案者初始预测之后，把答题后控制重述为共享决策对象的挂载问题。设计三条原则：共享决策对象（Shared Decision Object）、最小充分验证（Minimum-Sufficient Verification）、中间修复（Intermediate Repair）。单一共享策略配合各成像面的"配方适配器"实现控制，新成像面只需注册配方即可接入同一控制器。
AI.result: 在512例在线案例池上，相比全验证基线，误接受降低约47%；在86.1%覆盖率下接受准确率达83.2%（基线为72.9%）。在多成像面故障富集压力排序任务中，匹配上下文负载设置下，同一控制器将每例估计远程服务调用降低约71%。三成像面留出检验与替代语言模型迁移实验保持相同的控制排序。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享决策对象与配方注册机制，可在不牺牲准确性的前提下大幅压缩验证成本与误接受风险，并具备跨成像面、跨语言模型的可迁移性，为医学影像智能体的可部署验证控制提供统一且可插拔的框架。

title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
summary: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. A nine-dimensional feature-quality prior and duplicate-aware sample initialization are calibrated using materials domain rules and statistical evidence. Confidence is further refined through sample-feature bipartite graph propagation and weakly supervised graph attention, while a Memory-GAT module provides historical reference scoring. Experiments on 23 ODDS benchmark datasets show that the generic module achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.866. In five repeated mixed-contamination experiments on mp\_20, rule calibration improves HistGradientBoostingRegressor test $R^2$ from $0.538\pm0.008$ to $0.616\pm0.014$. Graph refinement increases average precision from $0.943\pm0.004$ to 0.953\pm0.004$, while the rule-calibrated configuration has the highest mean test $R^2$ among the evaluated screening configurations. Five repeated MACE subset experiments further show an increase in $R^2$ from $0.590\pm0.053$ to $0.880\pm0.027$ after rule-based screening.

AI.tldr: 提出基于置信度的材料数据质量评估框架，融合领域知识与图结构学习，将数据质量建模为连续置信度估计问题，并在多个基准与真实材料数据集上验证其对下游模型性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 材料机器学习依赖大规模异构数据集，但真实数据库存在测量误差、计算失败、缺失/重复记录及隐性违反物理化学约束等问题；这类"统计上看似合理"的污染样本难以通过显式离群点检测识别，导致模型可靠性下降。
AI.method: 将数据质量形式化为连续置信度估计而非二分类异常识别；构建九维特征质量先验与重复感知的样本初始化，依据材料领域规则与统计证据校准；通过样本-特征二部图传播与弱监督图注意力细化置信度；引入Memory-GAT模块进行基于历史参考的批次评分。
AI.result: 在23个ODDS基准数据集上，通用模块平均AUC-ROC达0.866；在mp_20的五次混合污染实验中，规则校准使HistGradientBoostingRegressor测试R²由0.538±0.008提升至0.616±0.014，图细化将平均精度由0.943±0.004提升至0.953±0.004，规则校准配置在评估的筛选方案中平均测试R²最高；五次MACE子集实验中R²由0.590±0.053提升至0.880±0.027。
AI.conclusion: 领域规则校准与图结构学习相结合的置信度评估能有效识别隐性低质量材料数据，并显著改善下游回归与势函数模型性能，为材料数据质量治理提供可量化、可复用的框架。

title: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
summary: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"逆运行"冻结潜在世界模型的方法，用于检测并校正部署时实际执行动作与指令动作之间的偏移，实现对视觉规划器的自校正。
AI.motivation: 冻结潜在世界模型 + 采样型MPC构成的视觉规划器在部署时，实际执行的动作可能偏离指令动作，而冻结模型无法察觉这种"动作接口"失配，导致规划失效。
AI.method: 逆向运行冻结模型：对任意假设的执行偏移，预测在该偏移下"应当观测到"的结果，再与实际观测比较得到偏移分数。该分数只保留偏移可解释的残差部分，剔除了模型自身误差（区别于混合二者的残差能量），从而以局部最优检验检测偏移、以Cramér-Rao界给出估计误差棒、识别主导偏移来源，并在报警后补偿规划器。
AI.result: 在PushT、TwoRoom、OGBench-Cube上，实测检测性能与理论预测偏差在0.05 AUROC以内；自校正将成功率从0.650提升至0.862（PushT），0.378→0.432（Cube），达到同一block下已知真实偏移的oracle水平，优于五种常见测试时自适应方法。真实机械臂上可识别关节编码器无法反映的基座关节偏移，将到达误差从36 mm降至3–5 mm；随机密封偏移下回收92–94%的真实偏移误差削减量。
AI.conclusion: 冻结世界模型可通过预测未来、检验动作接口的不确定性与有效性、最终校正失败，充当一种"滤波器"，从而在无需模型更新的前提下实现部署期自校正。

title: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
summary: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that shifts model capacity from weights to learnable Bernstein polynomial activations. BeFit (i) finds compact Bernstein-activated convolutional neural networks (BeCNNs) through hardware-aware neural architecture search and trains them via knowledge distillation; (ii) projects their weights to multiplication-free codes, freezes the codes, and recovers the resulting accuracy loss through the learnable activations; and (iii) generates model-specific kernels that exploit the projected weights for multiplication-free convolutions. On human activity recognition, BeCNNs are 2.75 percentage points (pp) more accurate on average than ReLU CNNs of identical architecture. On a TI CC3220SF (Cortex-M4), weight projection speeds BeCNNs up by 2.2x on average while losing 0.8 pp, compared with 2.4 pp for ReLU CNNs. Against the MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN reference model running on TensorFlow Lite Micro with CMSIS-NN, the unprojected BeCNN achieves 1.0 pp higher accuracy, 2.2x lower latency, and 6.4x lower flash, while the projected model remains within 1.0 pp of the reference accuracy and runs 5.9x faster. In emulation on a RISC-V core without a hardware multiplier, the instruction-count reduction relative to the DS-CNN increases from 5.2x on the Cortex-M4 to 147x. BeFit also extends to transformers and MLPs, and across all tasks the final models stay within 1.56 pp of their float32 teachers on average.

AI.tldr: BeFit是一个端到端框架，将模型容量从权重转移到可学习的Bernstein多项式激活函数，结合硬件感知NAS、知识蒸馏、无乘法权重投影（乘法免）与定制内核生成，在Cortex-M4与RISC-V上显著降低延迟与存储且精度损失小。
AI.motivation: 时序感知日益依赖神经网络，但在资源受限MCU上部署困难：激进压缩会掉精度，而将权重限制为乘法免表示会带来额外精度损失。作者希望在保持无乘法高效推理的同时，把精度损失转移并弥补回来。
AI.method: BeFit分三步：(i) 通过硬件感知神经架构搜索得到紧凑的Bernstein激活CNN（BeCNN），并用知识蒸馏训练；(ii) 将权重投影为乘法免编码后冻结编码，利用可学习Bernstein激活恢复精度损失；(iii) 生成模型专用内核，利用投影权重实现乘法免卷积。
AI.result: 人类活动识别上，同架构BeCNN平均比ReLU CNN高2.75pp；TI CC3220SF（Cortex-M4）上权重投影带来2.2x平均加速、精度仅降0.8pp（ReLU CNN为2.4pp）；对比MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN（TFLite Micro+CMSIS-NN），未投影BeCNN精度高1.0pp、延迟低2.2x、Flash低6.4x，投影模型精度差距≤1.0pp且快5.9x；无硬件乘法器的RISC-V内核上，相对DS-CNN的指令数缩减从Cortex-M4的5.2x提升到147x。
AI.conclusion: BeFit可扩展到Transformer与MLP，所有任务最终模型平均与float32教师模型差距在1.56pp以内，验证了以激活承载容量、权重乘法免编码的端到端部署范式的有效性。

title: Trust the Ray, Not the Depth: Ray-Lateral Agreement for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Fusion
summary: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. Its error therefore points almost entirely along its own viewing ray, and the calibration tells us that direction exactly. To address this, we introduce the Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA), which follows one rule: trust the ray, not the depth. RLA first slides every estimate along its own rays, which removes the depth bias and leaves the shape untouched. It then fuses the views one point at a time, under a Gaussian error whose precision follows each viewing ray. The maximum-likelihood solution is closed-form, interpolates between averaging and midpoint triangulation, and stays well conditioned where triangulation is singular. Robustness is the harder half, because correct views also disagree along their rays. Any weight built on the full residual therefore punishes good views together with bad ones. Ray-lateral agreement instead scores every view, at every point, by its residual across that view's own ray alone. We evaluated RLA on multi-camera public benchmark datasets. Across two, three, and four cameras and three per-view pose estimators, RLA consistently achieves lower worst-case error than all triangulation baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA)，一种面向标定多相机系统的单目网格估计融合方法，核心原则是"信任射线而非深度"，通过沿射线滑动消除深度偏差，并基于射线横向残差进行鲁棒的多视角融合，在公开多相机基准上取得更低的最坏情况误差。
AI.motivation: 将单目网格估计器放到标定相机的每个视角后，重建的人体重建结果彼此相差一米以上。原因是几何性的：每个估计位于网络所假设焦距隐含的深度处，而非相机真实焦距对应的深度，其误差几乎完全沿自身视线方向。标定恰好给出了该方向，因此需要一种方法利用射线方向而非依赖有偏的深度估计。
AI.method: RLA分为两部分：1）先将每个估计沿其自身射线滑动，消除深度偏差且不改变形状；2）逐点融合各视角，采用精度随各视线射线变化的高斯误差模型，最大似然解为闭式解，在平均法与中点三角化之间插值，且在三角化奇异处仍保持良态。鲁棒性方面，由于正确视角沿射线方向亦存在分歧，基于完整残差的权重会同时惩罚好坏视角，因此采用射线横向一致性：在每一点上仅用该视角自身射线上的横向残差为每个视角打分。
AI.result: 在两个公开多相机基准数据集上，覆盖两、三、四个相机配置及三种逐视角姿态估计器，RLA在所有三角化基线中一致性地取得更低的最坏情况误差。
AI.conclusion: RLA通过"信任射线而非深度"的几何原则，有效解决了多视角单目网格重建中的深度偏差与鲁棒融合问题，其闭式最大似然解兼具理论优雅性与数值稳定性，并在多相机、多估计器的实验设置下稳定优于三角化基线。

title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
summary: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads; most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models were trained on PTB-XL for six input sets (I; II; I+II; I+II+V1; I+II+V2; I+II+V1+V4), see only the measured leads at inference, and were tested on the PTB-XL test fold (2,198 records) and two external cohorts (Georgia, 10,275 records; Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo, 43,559). From lead II alone, the pooled median Pearson correlation (PCC) over the 11 predicted leads was 0.914 on PTB-XL, against 0.784 for a least-squares linear filter (lead I: 0.906 against 0.789). As limb leads are exactly derivable from I and II, multi-lead inputs were compared on predicted chest leads: 0.939 against 0.849 for I+II and 0.979 against 0.962 for I+II+V1+V4. BiMa-SR exceeded the linear comparator in all 18 configuration--cohort pairs (by 0.012--0.136), a margin that shrank as chest leads were added. From lead II, regression was more accurate than diffusion (DiBiMa-SR: 0.903 one-step, 0.862 with six DDIM steps). A 12-lead classifier trained only on real ECGs reached a superclass macro AUROC of 0.912 on real PTB-XL ECGs, 0.843 on reconstructions from lead II and 0.908 from I+II+V1+V4; externally, reconstructions from three or four leads scored within 0.004 of real ECGs. BiMa-SR (2.68\,M parameters) takes 45.8 ms per 10-s record on a GPU. Reconstruction makes reduced-lead recordings usable by 12-lead tools; it cannot add information absent from the measured leads.

AI.tldr: 提出双向Mamba状态空间编解码器BiMa-ECGSR，从少量导联重建12导联ECG（回归版BiMa-SR与扩散版DiBiMa-SR），在PTB-XL及两个外部队列上显著优于最小二乘线性基线，并使重建信号可被12导联下游分类器使用。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备与监护仪通常只记录少量ECG导联，而多数诊断工具默认输入12导联，两者之间存在输入格式鸿沟，因此需要从缩减导联集重建完整12导联ECG。
AI.method: 以双向Mamba状态空间编解码器为核心，构建回归模型BiMa-SR与扩散模型DiBiMa-SR；在PTB-XL上针对六种输入组合（I；II；I+II；I+II+V1；I+II+V2；I+II+V1+V4）训练，推理时仅使用实测导联；在PTB-XL测试折（2198条）及Georgia（10275条）、Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo（43559条）两个外部队列评估，与最小二乘线性滤波器对比，并用仅在真实ECG上训练的12导联分类器检验重建信号的下游可用性。
AI.result: 仅用II导联时，11个预测导联的合并中位PCC在PTB-XL上为0.914（线性滤波0.784），I导联0.906对0.789；四肢导联可由I、II精确导出，故多导联输入在胸导联上比较：I+II为0.939对0.849，I+II+V1+V4为0.979对0.962。BiMa-SR在全部18个“配置—队列”组合中均优于线性基线（提升0.012–0.136），且随胸导联增加优势收窄。仅用II导联时回归优于扩散（DiBiMa-SR：一步0.903，六步DDIM 0.862）。12导联分类器在真实PTB-XL上超类宏AUROC为0.912，在II导联重建上0.843，在I+II+V1+V4重建上0.908；外部队列中三或四导联重建与真实ECG差距在0.004以内。BiMa-SR仅2.68 M参数，GPU上每条10 s记录耗时45.8 ms。
AI.conclusion: 重建可使缩减导联记录被12导联工具使用，但无法补充实测导联中不存在的信息。

title: LoRN: Low-Rank Noise Steering for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Noise steering improves pretrained generative robot policies by learning to select their initial noise without updating model weights. We find that actions in the evaluated world-action models are more sensitive to video noise than action noise, making video noise an expressive input for steering. However, the noise-steering methods we evaluate, in their published forms, struggle to scale to the high-dimensional noise inputs of large policy classes such as world-action models. We introduce Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN), a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models. A small steering actor selects a direction through a fixed low-rank random projection, while our norm-controlled construction keeps the resulting noise near the typical scale of a Gaussian sample. This separates the actor's control dimension from the full noise dimension, enabling steering of both video and action inputs. Across three world-action models and ten model-task pairs, video steering improves average success by 26.2 percentage points over the base policy, compared with 7.1 points for DSRL action steering. For smaller action policies, the same construction achieves comparable final success while generally improving early-training success. Steering actors trained in simulation also transfer to three physical bimanual manipulation tasks across two base policies, without additional real-world training.

AI.tldr: 提出低秩噪声引导（LoRN）：用小型强化学习actor通过固定低秩随机投影选择噪声方向，在冻结生成式机器人策略权重的前提下引导初始噪声，成功将噪声引导扩展到世界-动作模型（WAM）级别的高维噪声输入，视频噪声引导平均提升成功率26.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 噪声引导可在不更新模型权重的情况下提升预训练生成式机器人策略，但已有方法难以扩展到世界-动作模型这类高维噪声输入；同时作者发现所评估的WAM中动作对视频噪声的敏感度高于对动作噪声的敏感度，使视频噪声成为更具表达力的引导输入，因而需要一种可扩展到高维噪声的引导方法。
AI.method: 提出LoRN，一种强化学习方法：训练一个小型steering actor，在固定的低秩随机投影上选择一个方向，从而得到高维噪声；采用范数受控的构造，使生成的噪声保持在标准高斯采样的典型尺度附近。该设计将actor的控制维度与完整噪声维度解耦，可同时引导视频与动作输入，且不更新基础策略权重。
AI.result: 在三个世界-动作模型、十个模型-任务组合上，视频引导相对基础策略平均成功率提升26.2个百分点，而DSRL动作引导仅提升7.1个百分点；在较小的动作策略上，该方法取得相当的最终成功率，并普遍改善训练早期成功率。仿真中训练的引导actor无需额外真实数据训练即可迁移到两个基础策略下的三个真实双臂操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 低秩随机投影加范数控制的参数化使噪声引导可扩展到高维世界-动作模型，视频噪声引导显著优于动作噪声引导，并具备仿真到真实的迁移能力，是一种无需微调基础策略权重的轻量策略增强方案。

title: FACET - Facet Aware Contrastive Embeddings for Traits- Big Five Estimation from Life Narratives
summary: Personality is only weakly and inconsistently signaled by written language, and existing text-based methods typically combine language-model and psycholinguistic representations at the input or decision level. It remains open whether a more deliberate combination of the two views, and a decomposition of the prediction target, can recover more of the signal. We present a three-phase framework for estimating Big Five personality domain scores from life-narrative interview text. It encodes text and psycholinguistic features separately and combines them by concatenation or by a learned weighting, decomposes each domain into contrastively trained facet embeddings instead of predicting the domain directly, and pools the facet embeddings by attention into a domain-level prediction. We compare end-to-end with staged training and ablate the input modalities, their combination, and the facet-pooling strategy. On 1,332 participants from the St. Louis Personality and Aging Network (SPAN) study, facet embeddings reach AUC up to 0.740, and domain-level R2 reaches 0.328, highest for Openness. End-to-end training gives lower error than staged training in every domain, and attention pooling gives the lowest error in every domain. Combining the two views lowers error relative to text alone for Conscientiousness and Agreeableness, whereas a learned weighting of the views shows no consistent advantage over concatenation. The framework provides facet- level predictions that a domain-only model cannot, and it improves modestly on a regression from the raw features in four of the five domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三阶段框架，从生活叙事访谈文本估计大五人格：分别编码文本与心理语言学特征，通过拼接或学习加权融合；将每个域分解为对比学习训练的分面(facet)嵌入，并用注意力池化得到域级预测；在SPAN 1,332名被试上，分面嵌入AUC最高0.740，域级R²最高0.328（开放性最高）。
AI.motivation: 书面语言对人格的指示信号弱且不一致，现有文本方法通常只在输入级或决策级简单结合语言模型表征与心理语言学表征，是否能通过更"刻意"的双视角融合及预测目标分解来恢复更多信号尚不明确。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：文本特征与心理语言学特征分别编码后，采用拼接或学习加权进行组合；每个大五域不直接回归，而分解为对比学习训练的多个分面嵌入；再以注意力池化将这些分面嵌入聚合为域级预测。实验对比端到端训练与分阶段训练，并对输入模态、融合方式与池化策略做消融。
AI.result: 在SPAN研究1,332名被试上，分面嵌入AUC最高达0.740，域级R²达0.328（开放性最高）。端到端训练在全部五个域上误差均低于分阶段训练；注意力池化在全部五域上误差最低。双视角融合相对纯文本在尽责性与宜人性上降低误差；学习加权相对拼接无稳定优势。框架相比原始特征回归在五域中的四域有适度提升。
AI.conclusion: 人格文本建模中，预测目标的分面分解与有意的多视角组合可提供域级模型无法给出的分面级预测，并带来适度但一致的性能改进；注意力池化和端到端训练是有效选择，而学习加权不及简单拼接，双视角融合的收益因域而异。

title: Beyond the Sink Token: Sink-Guided Key Editing in Vision-Language Models
summary: In vision-language models (VLMs), a few sink tokens attract a disproportionate share of attention. While previous studies have examined why these tokens attract attention, we investigate how the sink-key direction affects attention to image and question tokens. Across four probed VLMs, boosting the magnitude of positive sink-aligned components increases attention on average, whereas boosting negative components decreases it; these responses persist through later layers. This identifies the native sink key as a reference for controlling attention beyond its own position. Motivated by this finding, we propose SHRINK, a training-free method that partially reduces sink-aligned components across visible keys during generation. On nine benchmarks under sampled reasoning, it improves mean accuracy by 5.1 and 2.7 percentage points on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with smaller gains on the other two main models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Gemma-3-4B. Beyond SHRINK, rescaling sink-aligned key components can replace the attention operations of two existing attention-steering methods, GIFT and ACG, with comparable accuracy on hallucination benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示VLM中sink-key方向可调节对图像与问题token的注意力，并提出免训练方法SHRINK，通过部分削减可见key中与sink对齐的分量提升推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注VLMs中少数sink token为何吸引大量注意力，但尚不清楚sink-key方向如何影响对图像token与问题token的注意力分配。作者希望弄清这一机制，并将其转化为可控的注意力调节手段。
AI.method: 在四个VLM上做探针实验：放大正的sink对齐分量会普遍提升注意力，放大负分量则降低注意力，且效应可延续到后续层，从而把原生sink key作为超出其自身位置的注意力控制参照。基于此提出SHRINK：免训练方法，在生成过程中对可见key中与sink对齐的分量做部分削减（重缩放）。
AI.result: 在九项benchmark的sampled reasoning设置下，SHRINK使LLaVA-OneVision-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-3B平均准确率分别提升5.1与2.7个百分点，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与Gemma-3-4B上增益较小。此外，重缩放sink对齐key分量可在幻觉基准上以相当准确率替代GIFT与ACG两种注意力引导方法的注意力操作。
AI.conclusion: sink-key方向是跨位置控制注意力的有效参照；简单的sink对齐分量重缩放既是提升推理性能的免训练手段，也可作为统一的注意力引导算子，替代部分已有方法的核心操作。

title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
summary: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). Then we propose a novel Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) scheme to protect the binary weights at very low overhead. This scheme exploits the invariance of Transformers to permutations in the rows and columns to group the critical weights and perform selective protection on those weights. Simulation results show that PIES can recover most of the performance loss caused by bit errors at BERs as high as 10%, at an overhead significantly lower than traditional error correction schemes. These results confirm the feasibility of running binary Transformers using approximate memory with aggressive voltage scaling on resource-limited low power edge devices. The code for PIES is released on github (https://github.com/YangZhutian/binary-transformer-prefix-repair).

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了二值化Transformer（以BERT为例）在近似存储器位错误下的可靠性，发现仅在高误码率（BER=5%~10%）时出现显著精度损失，并提出一种低开销的置换不变性选择性保护方案PIES。
AI.motivation: 量化（尤其是权重量化）可降低Transformer的存储、计算与功耗开销，近似存储器能进一步降功耗但会引入位错误。已有二值Transformer研究多关注任务性能，缺乏对存储器错误下可靠运行的系统研究。
AI.method: 以BERT为案例评估二值Transformer的可靠性；提出Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective（PIES）方案，利用Transformer对行列置换的不变性，将关键权重分组并进行选择性保护，以极低开销实现防护。
AI.result: 仿真显示，PIES在BER高达10%时仍能恢复大部分由位错误导致的性能损失，且开销显著低于传统纠错方案。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实了在资源受限的低功耗边缘设备上，使用带激进电压缩放（aggressive voltage scaling）的近似存储器运行二值Transformer的可行性；代码已开源。

title: Radar-Native Control Barrier Functions: Doppler Range Rate as a Measured Barrier Derivative
summary: Safe control around dynamic obstacles requires information about both distance and relative motion. Range-based filters commonly reconstruct the required range rate from successive range measurements or from obstacle-state estimators, which can introduce estimator delay or sensitivity to range noise when obstacle motion changes. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measures radial relative velocity directly through Doppler. We use this measurement as the derivative of an ego-centered range control barrier function (CBF) and obtain a closed-form filter on the robot's forward velocity. A measurement margin constructed from sensor error bounds accounts for errors in range, Doppler, ego velocity, and bearing. In 508 paired encounters within the platform's retreat capability, direct Doppler produces two buffer incursions, compared with 15 for a constant-acceleration and 25 for a constant-velocity Kalman filter. On a Unitree Go1, the controller stops at $0.777 \pm 0.015$ m against the predicted $0.758$ m and reacts to a farther approaching object while a nearer static return remains. The guarantee covers the longitudinal range channel under bounded measurement errors and continuously available detections. Direct Doppler removes the need to reconstruct range rate in the safety loop, reducing the delay between a change in obstacle motion and its effect on the safety command.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出直接利用FMCW雷达多普勒测量获得径向相对速度，作为以机器人为中心的距离控制障碍函数（CBF）的导数，从而构造机器人前向速度的闭式安全滤波器，避免了对距离求导或状态估计带来的延迟与噪声敏感问题。
AI.motivation: 动态障碍物下的安全控制同时需要距离与相对运动信息。传统的基于测距的滤波器通常由连续距离测量差分或依赖障碍物状态估计器来重建距离变化率，这会在障碍物运动变化时引入估计器延迟或对测距噪声敏感。
AI.method: 以FMCW雷达多普勒直接测得径向相对速度，将其作为自车中心距离CBF的导数，推导出关于机器人前向速度的闭式滤波器；并由传感器误差界（距离、多普勒、自车速度、方位角）构造测量裕度以补偿误差。在Unitree Go1上进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 在平台后退能力范围内的508次配对遭遇中，直接多普勒方案仅出现2次缓冲区侵入，而恒加速度卡尔曼滤波为15次、恒速度卡尔曼滤波为25次。在Unitree Go1上，控制器在0.777 ± 0.015 m处停止（预测值0.758 m），并能在存在更近的静态回波时对更远处接近的物体作出反应。
AI.conclusion: 在测量误差有界且检测持续可用的条件下，该安全保证覆盖纵向距离通道。直接多普勒消除了在安全回路中重建距离变化率的需求，从而减小了障碍物运动变化到安全指令生效之间的延迟。

title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
summary: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜在空间不确定性估计器 Latent Uncertainty 及传播方法 LProp，用隐表示携带不确定性信息并在新证据下更新继承的答案分布，无需额外轨迹采样；在多类任务上多数指标优于基线，且在全部8种传播设置中平均推理token消耗最低。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在下游传递中间判断时若不带不确定性，后续决策会把暂定假设当作事实；有效的不确定性传播需既保留可纠错的信息、又能随新证据更新继承信念。但标量分数丢失修正所需信息，而详细描述与反思机制带来额外开销，二者存在张力。
AI.method: 提出 Latent Uncertainty：在隐空间中估计不确定性，以紧凑潜在表示保留与不确定性相关的信息，避免冗长文本描述。在此基础上提出 LProp（Latent Uncertainty Propagation）：利用潜在表示与新证据修正继承的答案分布，无需额外轨迹采样。评估覆盖多项选择、是/否、开放式问答与数学推理任务，并辅以匹配特征消融实验。
AI.result: 所提方法在多数指标上优于基线；LProp 在全部8种传播设置中取得最低平均推理token用量。匹配特征消融显示，相比仅使用答案概率或更大模型容量，继承的潜在内容能更好地提升错误恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 隐空间不确定性表示可兼顾信息保真与低开销，是实现高效、可修正的不确定性传播的有效途径；继承的潜在内容本身（而非答案概率或模型容量）是错误恢复的关键来源。

title: ORGANIC3D: Grounding 3D CT Vision Language Models in Organ Level Image Text Coupling
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in 3D computed tomography (CT) classification, but high accuracy does not reflect whether their predictions rely on the correct anatomical evidence. We introduce ORGANIC3D, a framework for evaluating and improving organ level image text alignment through controlled anatomical interventions. Our benchmark assesses 12 vision encoder checkpoints and 7 generative VLMs using matched patient comparisons, organ erasure, lesion replacement, and laterality perturbations, revealing substantial alignment failures even among top performing models. To learn organ level image text correspondence, ORGANIC3D aligns each finding sentence with the anatomy aware image features and trains on edited scans to anchor this alignment in the organ's image evidence. We further extend this framework to generative VLMs, promoting evidence dependent question answering and report generation. Trained exclusively on public data, ORGANIC3D achieves SOTA classification AUROC on CTRATE, Merlin, and the heldout RADChestCT dataset and reaches 77% laterality accuracy, compared with at most 66% for prior models. Its generative VLM matches or exceeds all evaluated publicly released VLMs on visual question answering, achieves the highest report accuracy, and retracts 96 to 99% of target organ findings after organ removal, versus a maximum of 69% for other models. Together, these results establish ORGANIC3D as a framework for testing whether 3D CT vision language models ground their predictions in anatomical evidence and for improving organ level alignment alongside predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出ORGANIC3D框架，通过可控解剖干预评估并提升3D CT视觉语言模型的器官级图文对齐，在分类、VQA与报告生成上均取得SOTA且显著提升证据依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在3D CT分类上准确率高，但高准确率无法反映预测是否依赖正确的解剖证据，即模型可能缺乏器官级图文对齐与证据依赖性。
AI.method: 构建基准：使用匹配患者对照、器官擦除、病灶替换与左右侧扰动，评估12个视觉编码器检查点和7个生成式VLM。学习方法：将每条结论文本与解剖感知图像特征对齐，并在编辑后的扫描上训练以锚定对齐；进一步扩展至生成式VLM，促进证据依赖的问答与报告生成，仅用公开数据训练。
AI.result: 在CTRATE、Merlin及留出集RADChestCT上取得SOTA分类AUROC；左右侧准确率77%（此前模型最多66%）；生成式VLM在VQA上与所有已评估公开VLM持平或更优，报告准确率最高；器官移除后撤回96–99%的目标器官结论（其他模型最多69%）。
AI.conclusion: ORGANIC3D可作为检验3D CT VLM是否基于解剖证据进行预测的框架，并能在保持预测精度的同时提升器官级对齐。

title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE-MAS框架，从正常协作执行模式中学习并在状态变化、消息传递、任务依赖三个层面检测偏差，结合来源感知的归因定位根因执行要素，并选择最小干预实现修复。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统（MAS）防护主要做智能体级异常检测；当故障源于智能体间的交互（消息交换、任务依赖）时，这种粒度不足，且检测到的异常未必揭示真实来源。
AI.method: 从良性轨迹中学习正常协作执行模式；在智能体状态变化、消息转换、任务依赖演化三个层面检测偏离；通过来源感知归因（source-aware attribution）识别应负责的执行要素；选取最小干预以恢复协作，同时保留任务关键能力。
AI.result: 在五个MAS基准上，根因定位准确率提升60.2%，任务恢复性能相对强基线MAS防护方法取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、交互层面的诊断与修复优于智能体级异常检测，能更准确地将异常追溯到真实来源并以最小代价恢复多智能体协作。

title: Finetuning VLAs for Dexterous Manipulation: The Right Checkpoint Is All You Need
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Dexterous Manipulation at CoRL 2026
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated strong manipulation capabilities. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. In this work, we study how to best adapt VLAs to dexterous hands by pairing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL). Using $π_{0.5}$ and a LEAP hand, we evaluate five fine-tuning recipes across two simulation tasks using only a handful of demonstrations. Our empirical analysis yields three key insights: (1) SFT success is poorly correlated with post-DSRL success, meaning the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most effective to steer; (2) freezing the vision-language model (VLM) and tuning only the action expert produces the most steerable policy for both training and out-of-distribution placements; and (3) low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the least steerable approach. Consequently, we recommend an adaptation recipe that freezes the VLM, fully trains the action expert, and eschews SFT rollout success as a checkpoint selection metric.

AI.tldr: 该文研究如何将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型有效适配到多指灵巧手。作者在 π₀.₅ 与 LEAP 手平台上，用少量示教数据对比五种微调方案（结合SFT与扩散引导强化学习DSRL），发现SFT成功率与DSRL后成功率相关性弱、冻结VLM仅训练动作专家最易被引导、LoRA最不易引导，据此给出适配建议。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型操控能力强，但多数操控数据集基于平行夹爪，多指灵巧手遥操作数据采集困难，导致VLA难以迁移到灵巧手；因此需要明确在有少量示教的条件下，如何最佳地适配VLAs到灵巧手。
AI.method: 在 π₀.₅ 模型与 LEAP 灵巧手平台上，仅使用少量示教数据，在两个仿真任务中评估五种"监督微调（SFT）+ 扩散引导强化学习（DSRL）"微调配方，比较不同模块（VLM、动作专家）训练/冻结策略及LoRA等参数高效方法对后续DSRL可引导性的影响。
AI.result: 三点实证结论：(1) SFT成功率与DSRL后的成功率相关性差，最佳SFT检查点往往不是最易被引导的；(2) 冻结视觉-语言模型、仅微调动作专家，在训练分布与分布外摆放条件下都得到最易被引导的策略；(3) LoRA是最不易被引导的方案。
AI.conclusion: 推荐适配配方：冻结VLM、全量训练动作专家，并放弃以SFT rollout成功率作为检查点选择指标。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Clarification for Multi-Agent Food Assistance
summary: Food insecurity creates a pressing need for guidance that helps households find usable food resources and assess food choices in light of their circumstances. Such guidance must connect eligibility requirements, practical access constraints, and dietary needs rather than return isolated listings or generic nutritional advice. Multi-agent food assistants can coordinate these tasks, with uncertainty indicating when clarification or verification is needed before a recommendation. However, uncertainty can be lost across agent handoffs, allowing tentative interpretations to propagate as facts and obscuring opportunities for correction. Moreover, confidence that a service requirement has been interpreted correctly is not confidence that a recommendation satisfies the user's needs; local confidence cannot simply be reused as downstream reliability. We introduce an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework that preserves shared premise identities and replays consistent interpretations across dependent agents. Each receiver exposes admissible decisions and remaining evidence obligations, so question relevance reflects both decision changes and missing support. Information questions and user-confirmable fallback adjustments are evaluated together with their anticipated follow-up interactions under shared budgets. This structure connects clarification to jointly supported plans for resource navigation, nutritional reasoning, and supply-side planning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理时的"接收方条件化"澄清框架，用于多智能体食物助手：通过保留共享前提标识并在依赖智能体间重放一致的解读，将歧义澄清与决策变化及缺失证据绑定，从而避免不确定性在智能体交接中丢失，并支撑资源导航、营养推理与供给侧规划联合支撑的方案。
AI.motivation: 食物不安全家庭需要能同时衔接资格条件、实际获取约束与饮食需求的可操作指导，而非孤立清单或泛化营养建议。多智能体助手可协调这些任务，但存在两个核心问题：(1) 不确定性在智能体交接中易丢失，试探性解读被当作事实传播，错失纠错机会；(2) 对服务要求解读正确的置信度并不等于推荐满足用户需求的置信度，局部置信度不能直接复用为下游可靠性。
AI.method: 引入推理时、接收方条件化的澄清框架：每个接收方显式给出可采纳决策集合与剩余证据义务，使问题相关性同时反映"决策是否改变"与"支持是否缺失"；在依赖智能体间保留共享前提的身份标识并重放一致解读；在共享预算下联合评估信息性问题与用户可确认的兜底调整及其预期后续交互。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；所述结果为机制性/结构性结论：澄清问题可依据决策敏感性与证据缺口进行排序选择，不确定性在交接链中可追溯且不被误当作事实，兜底调整与后续交互可在统一预算下共同优化。
AI.conclusion: 将澄清机制与联合支撑的方案生成相连接，为资源导航、营养推理和供给侧规划提供一致的解读基础；强调澄清应以接收方决策需求为条件，而非依赖可传递的局部置信度。

title: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
summary: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $π^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LMSA：一种无需训练的逐层自适应稀疏注意力，用logit方差作为每层"均值缺失对数质量"的无行代理指标，将注意力层划分为扩散层（用共享hub键的采样估计，保持无偏）与匹配层（保持精确），在低冗余场景与多视图下兼顾精度与效率。
AI.motivation: VGGT一次前向即可从未标定图像重建相机与几何，但全局注意力随视图数二次增长。现有免训练加速器通过稀疏化注意力在冗余视频上表现良好，却在视图间共享几何很少时损失位姿精度。作者指出原因是：均匀稀疏近似难以同时保留两类跨视图信息——扩散层聚合分布上下文，匹配层依赖查询特定的交互且注意力质量很小。
AI.method: 1) 用逐层统计量度量"用均值token替代所遗漏的对数质量"，其无行（row-free）代理为logit方差，据此为每层选择估计器；2) 扩散层使用共享的、重要性采样的hub键，并引入对数权重使softmax分子与分母无偏；3) 匹配层保持精确计算，实验表明任何激进的稀疏化都会损失精度。
AI.result: 在13个未见过的低冗余场景、32视图下，LMSA与稠密注意力相差1.4 AUC@5，优于AVGGT（10.3）与SAF3R（4.5）；与同期GPA-VGGT差异不显著，仅有对AVGGT的优势通过两项场景级检验。100视图下差距1.9 AUC@5，而聚合器运行速度快2.0×。事后用该统计量选择GPA-VGGT所保护的层，可提升1.2 AUC@5，仅增加5% FLOPs。未经调参迁移到π³上优于AVGGT，但离稠密精度更远。
AI.conclusion: 跨视图注意力应按层功能区分处理：扩散层可安全稀疏化并用无偏估计补偿，匹配层必须保持精确；logit方差作为轻量代理能有效指导层选择，并可作为通用事后工具改进已有加速方法。

title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

AI.tldr: QDA 是一个由 LLM 智能体驱动的量化方案自动设计系统，通过快速评估（基于隐藏推理轨迹上的 KL 散度，分钟级）和快速构建（统一的、相互兼容且跨架构的 PTQ 方法库），在多轮迭代中为每个模型与精度自动搜索最优后训练量化配方。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化是低成本部署大模型的标准手段，但最优量化配方随模型与精度而变化，专家需为每个新模型重新设计，耗时且常次优。理论上 LLM 智能体可通过“构建—评估”多轮迭代改进配方（轮数越多越好），但存在两大瓶颈：其一，评估一个量化推理模型需数十 GPU 小时；其二，融合不同代码库的方法需人工移植到新架构。
AI.method: QDA 让智能体为每个模型与精度设计量化配方。为加速评估：用候选模型相对原始模型在智能体未见过的推理轨迹上的输出 KL 散度作代理指标，数分钟内完成打分；仅对潜力候选再用长文本生成做验证，以捕捉重复循环等失效模式。为加速构建：提供公共 PTQ 方法库，各方法彼此兼容，并兼容新模型架构。
AI.result: 在四个推理模型上，QDA 相对最强公开配方平均提升准确率：W4A16 +0.9、W4A8 +1.4、W3A16 +2.2 个百分点，每次搜索仅用 64 GPU 小时。在 320B 参数的 MoE 模型 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 NVFP4 W4A4 设置下，恢复 FP8 模型 98.3% 的准确率，优于最佳厂商 checkpoint 的 96.9%。所有 QDA checkpoint 均可在现有服务内核上运行，无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 以智能体替代专家进行量化配方设计是可行且高效的：KL 代理评估加长生成复核的双层评估、以及统一兼容的 PTQ 方法库，使多轮迭代搜索在可接受算力下显著超越人工配方与厂商 checkpoint，且不引入推理开销。作者将开源该库、评估器与运行框架。

title: Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models
summary: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.

AI.tldr: 提出"重叠(overlap)"指标，度量潜空间对安全滤波器的保守性影响，并用其比较三种安全滤波器设计。
AI.motivation: 基于世界模型潜表示的安全滤波器经共形校准后仍可能拒绝大量安全动作，但缺乏量化潜空间导致保守性的指标，难以比较不同设计。
AI.method: 将相似潜表示与动作分组为"单元(cell)"，定义单元内安全转移占比为overlap；证明overlap是此类滤波器在数据中不放过任何不安全转移时，所必须拒绝的安全转移的最小比例；再结合共形校准对三种设计（潜空间上训练分类器、世界模型自身、独立编码器）进行对比。
AI.result: 在视觉导航任务中，独立编码器的overlap最低；在相同共形水平下，其滤波器拒绝安全动作最少，使规划器达成的目标数最多。
AI.conclusion: overlap是刻画潜表示保守性的通用度量，可用于选择安全滤波器设计；独立编码器在实践中表现最优。

title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
summary: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $τ^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $τ^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $τ^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).

AI.tldr: ARISE 提出一种从自身失败中迭代演化记忆的智能体架构，不更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑，通过微记忆→宏观规则的整合与留出验证筛选，在 14 个企业工作流域上平均提升 10.9pp（SOP-Bench）与 5.8pp（τ²-bench），并优于 GEPA。
AI.motivation: 企业级 LLM 智能体运行在动态环境中：基础模型快速迭代、工作流频繁更新、部署需同时满足准确性与成本约束。传统做法（改模型权重、改提示、改工作流）迭代成本高且难以适配快速变化，因此需要一种低成本、可持续自适应的机制。
AI.method: ARISE（Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation）记忆架构：1）由模型自身或教师模型对失败轨迹进行归因并提出修正；2）将修正存为可检索的微记忆（micro memory）；3）将微记忆整合为宏观规则（macro rules）；4）仅在留出集准确率上升时接受规则更新。整个过程不修改模型权重、工具与工作流逻辑。评估覆盖 SOP-Bench 与 τ²-bench 的 14 个企业工作流域、5 个模型，并与 GEPA 对比。
AI.result: ARISE-Teacher（以 Claude Opus 4.6 做归因与整合）在 SOP-Bench 上较基线提升 10.9pp，在 τ²-bench 上提升 5.8pp；相较 GEPA 在 τ²-bench 领先 4.5pp、SOP-Bench 领先 1.4pp。使用部署模型自身作归因的 ARISE-Self 在 SOP-Bench 仍提升 10.0pp。ARISE-Teacher 模型调用次数减少 4.0%、输出 token 减少 5.2%，单任务成本基本持平（-1.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆为载体、失败驱动、带留出验证门控的自我改进，是替代权重微调与工作流重设计的实用路径，且不引入额外部署成本；教师归因效果更佳，但自归因版本仍具显著收益，说明该架构对归因质量有一定鲁棒性。

title: DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics
summary: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑潜空间规划中"嵌入距离=场景到目标的距离"这一隐含假设，并用仿真验证其不成立；随后提出受腹侧/背侧视觉通路启发的 DOCK 表示，学习与实测物理位移一致的物体表示，作为规划代价显著优于冻结特征距离与掩膜几何。
AI.motivation: 潜空间规划器通过比较预测未来图像与目标图像的嵌入来选择动作，默认嵌入空间中的距离能反映场景与目标的接近程度。作者希望检验该假设是否成立，并指出冻结视觉编码器可能把表征重心放在背景与机器人上，而非被操作物体。
AI.method: 用仿真器执行的真实未来帧做剖析，排除预测误差干扰；测试六个冻结的 DINO 与 V-JEPA 编码器。提出 DOCK，借鉴腹侧（what）与背侧（where/how）通路，分三部分：从 patch 特征池化得到物体 token（what）；学习空间标尺使读出坐标之差等于实测位移（where）；在物体 token 上学习动力学预测器（how）。利用"被抓取物体随夹爪运动"这一性质，用关节角正运动学得到物体位移代理，无需标注；从 21 个仿真厨房场景中 9,951 条持物搬运轨迹挖掘 404K 位移对进行训练。
AI.result: 冻结编码器的特征距离与物体到目标距离的秩相关最高仅 0.11，而物体掩膜质心可达 0.87；特征距离主要由背景与机器人 patch 主导，读出更擅长捕获机械臂而非物体。作为规划代价，DOCK 在 21 个任务中的 15 个成功放置物体，与直接读取真实物体位置的 oracle 相当；掩膜几何为 10，冻结特征距离为 9。在可见未见过机械臂时仍解决最多任务，且排序能力可零样本迁移到含未见物体实例与类别的留出布局。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉特征的距离并不天然度量任务进展，物体中心且与物理运动对齐的表示更适合作为规划代价。DOCK 以自监督的位移代理训练，在仿真中接近 oracle，并具备对未见机械臂、物体实例与布局的泛化能力。

title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even when the student and teacher are far apart. Across language model post-training settings, we demonstrate the implications of these theoretical findings for which OPD objective is preferable, highlighting the importance of accounting for the interplay between the student, teacher, and task at hand.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上分析 on-policy distillation（OPD）中目标函数选择（序列级 vs. 词元级、前向 KL vs. 其他 f-散度）如何决定词元优先次序与优化效率，揭示序列级 OPD 的"未来一致性偏差"与反向学习顺序，并证明前向 KL 具有良态的优化景观，而 reverse KL 等可能出现梯度消失。
AI.motivation: OPD 在实践中被广泛采用，使用时必须选择在序列级还是词元级施加蒸馏、以及最小化哪种散度；但究竟哪种 OPD 目标适用于何种情景，缺乏形式化理解。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 理论分析：刻画不同 OPD 目标（序列级/词元级、前向 KL 与其他 f-散度）如何决定词元的优先次序、学习顺序与效率；分析目标函数景观对基于梯度的优化可行性；并结合语言模型后训练场景进行实证验证。
AI.result: （1）序列级 OPD 存在"未来一致性偏差"（future agreement bias），而短视的词元级目标可避免该偏差；该偏差导致反向学习顺序——序列级 OPD 先匹配教师模型在较后词元位置上的分布，而在更早位置可能偏好教师在彼处概率极低的词元，往往不理想。（2）散度选择显著影响 OPD 对梯度优化的适应性：前向 KL 具有良态的目标景观，而 reverse KL 等其他 f-散度即使学生与教师差距很大时也可能出现梯度消失。（3）在多种后训练设置中展示了上述结论对 OPD 目标选择偏好的含义。
AI.conclusion: OPD 目标的选择需考虑学生模型、教师模型与具体任务之间的相互作用；前向 KL 在优化可行性上更具优势，词元级目标可规避序列级目标的偏差，因此实际中应依据任务情景谨慎权衡 OPD 目标。

title: ExecGap: Exploiting Command-Execution Gap for Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation and show strong promise for real-world deployment, making adversarial robustness critical for reliable robot operation. Existing adversarial attacks on VLA-controlled robots mainly optimize prediction-level discrepancies or rollout-level deviations to disrupt manipulation. However, they rarely account for the fact that VLA-predicted commands are not executed directly, but must be realized through downstream control and robot embodiment. In this paper, we propose ExecGap, an adversarial patch attack framework that exploits this command-execution gap to expose embodiment-specific execution vulnerabilities. Specifically, ExecGap biases VLA-predicted task-space commands toward low-executability directions, which are estimated from kinematic inefficiency and dynamic weak actuation. This induces execution degradation, where the predicted command becomes difficult to realize effectively, thereby impairing task completion. Extensive simulation experiments across multiple VLA policies show that ExecGap induces larger command-execution mismatch and weaker realized execution than existing patch attacks. Real-robot experiments further validate that the deployed patch can induce execution degradation on physical platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出ExecGap对抗补丁攻击框架，利用"命令-执行差距"使VLA模型输出的任务空间指令偏向低可执行性方向，从而诱发执行退化、破坏操作任务。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中日益普及，对抗鲁棒性对真实部署至关重要。现有针对VLA机器人的对抗攻击主要优化预测层偏差或rollout层偏差，却忽略了VLA预测的命令并不直接执行，而需经下游控制与机器人本体实现这一事实。
AI.method: ExecGap是一种对抗补丁攻击框架：从运动学低效性与动力学弱驱动两方面估计"低可执行性方向"，并据此偏置VLA预测的任务空间命令，使预测指令难以被有效实现，从而制造命令-执行不匹配并诱发执行退化。
AI.result: 在多种VLA策略上的大量仿真实验表明，ExecGap相比现有补丁攻击能造成更大的命令-执行不匹配与更弱的实际执行效果；真机实验进一步验证部署的补丁可在物理平台上诱发执行退化。
AI.conclusion: 利用命令-执行差距可揭示本体相关的执行脆弱性，为VLA机器人对抗鲁棒性研究提供了新视角，并说明执行层漏洞在真实部署中确实可被利用。

title: RefinementGuard: Counterexample-Directed Semantic Qualification for Hidden Agent-Tool Execution
summary: Tool runtimes can lower an agent-selected operation into a hidden parallel graph, reducing latency and context while risking semantic mistranslation. We introduce RefinementGuard: translation validation for hidden, effectful agent-tool lowerings, coupled to artifact-bound, fail-closed runtime admission. Qualification compares a candidate graph with an independent reference on isolated state using explicit parent-operation obligations. We evaluate two repository-level contracts, bug localization and patch validation, on controlled repositories. Among 100 activated, non-equivalent development/qualification faults adjudicated by one human, parent-semantic validation rejects 49/100 (operator-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]). The objective is selective admission, not maximum mutation rejection: exact equality rejects 100/100 faults but also all 60 valid variants, whereas obligation-based validation accepts 60/60; its 51 residual misses identify concrete specification gaps. On a frozen disjoint input split, the held-out B2-B3 result is localization-only because 21 patch mutants fail structurally; B3 rejects 38/56 localization defects. In a controlled asynchronous-delay regime, the localization serial/guarded median-latency ratio is 4.50x, and hidden execution exposes 74.3% less parent-visible context than visible execution. Patch validation shows no demonstrated speedup; zero-delay runs expose overhead. End-to-end qualification thus detects lower-layer misses while preserving localization's parallelism.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RefinementGuard，用翻译验证（translation validation）加产物绑定、失败关闭（fail-closed）的运行时准入，来校验 agent 工具调用被下译为隐藏并行图时的语义正确性；在定位任务上拒绝 38/56 缺陷，并保留 4.50× 的延迟收益与 74.3% 的上下文削减。
AI.motivation: 工具运行时会把 agent 选定的操作下译为隐藏的并行执行图，从而降低延迟与上下文开销，但存在语义误译风险；作者关注的是“是否应当准入某个候选下译”这一选择性准入问题，而非最大程度地拒绝变异体。
AI.method: RefinementGuard 在隔离状态上把候选图与独立参考实现对比，依据显式的父操作义务（parent-operation obligations）进行资格判定；结合产物绑定、失败关闭的运行时准入。评测两类仓库级契约（缺陷定位、补丁验证），在受控仓库、100 个人工裁定的已激活非等价故障上进行，并做冻结的不相交输入划分与受控异步延迟实验。
AI.result: 父语义验证拒绝 49/100 故障（算子簇 bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]）；精确等值拒绝 100/100 故障但误拒全部 60 个合法变体，基于义务的验证接受 60/60。留出集 B2-B3 仅能做定位（21 个补丁变异体结构性失败），B3 拒绝 38/56 定位缺陷。异步延迟下定位任务串行/守卫中位延迟比 4.50×，隐藏执行减少 74.3% 父可见上下文；补丁验证未显示加速，零延迟运行暴露额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 端到端资格验证能在保留定位任务并行性的同时检出下层遗漏，51 个残余漏检指出了具体的规约缺口；选择性准入被证明是优于精确等值的实用折中，但性能收益具有任务依赖性（定位有收益、补丁验证无加速）。

title: ExiST: Existence-Aware Self-Training for Semi-Supervised Multi-Organ Segmentation
summary: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation should learn more than a dozen organs from a handful of labeled scans, and the smallest organs occupy less than one percent of the foreground. We identify a failure mode of self-training that is specific to this regime. When a teacher misses a small organ in a scan, every voxel of that organ receives the confident pseudo-label background, and the student is trained toward the organ absence. Repeated over many scans, this loop extinguishes tail organs. In a pilot study, removing the gallbladder from the pseudo-labels reduced its Dice on AMOS from 36.5 to 1.0. We argue that a missing organ should be treated as unresolved rather than absent and propose Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST). It builds pseudo-labels by leave-one-out consensus of independently trained networks, screens them with a quality gate on validation scans, and infers, per scan and per organ, whether the organ was found. For every unresolved organ, the background voxels of that scan receive the set-valued target, trained with a marginal cross-entropy that accepts either answer and a Dice term that skips uncertain voxels. We show that this loss never pushes a candidate organ toward absence and never favors one member of the set, which leaves the decision to labeled evidence. ExiST outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods and reaches 77.1 mean Dice on Synapse with 20% labeled scans and 75.9 on AMOS with 5% labeled scans.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出半监督多器官分割中自训练存在"小器官被伪标签误标为背景而逐步消亡"的失效模式，提出将缺失器官视为"未确定"而非"不存在"的 Existence-aware Self-Training（ExiST）。
AI.motivation: 半监督多器官分割需从少量标注扫描中学习十余个器官，其中最小器官占前景不足 1%。作者识别出该场景下自训练的特定失效模式：当教师网络在某扫描中漏检小器官时，该器官所有体素都被赋予高置信度的背景伪标签，学生网络因此被训练为"该器官不存在"；在多次扫描上重复该循环，尾部小器官会被逐步"熄火"。试点实验中，将胆囊从伪标签中删除使其在 AMOS 上的 Dice 从 36.5 降至 1.0。
AI.method: 提出 ExiST：（1）通过独立训练网络的留一法（leave-one-out）共识构建伪标签；（2）用验证扫描上的质量门控筛选伪标签；（3）逐扫描、逐器官推断该器官是否"被找到"。对每个未确定器官，将该扫描中对应背景体素赋为集合值目标，用边际交叉熵（接受任一答案）与跳过不确定体素的 Dice 项联合训练。
AI.result: 理论性质上，该损失既不会把候选器官推向"不存在"，也不会偏好集合中任一成员，从而把判定交由有标注证据。实验上，ExiST 优于当前最先进方法：在 Synapse 上用 20% 标注扫描达到 77.1 平均 Dice，在 AMOS 上用 5% 标注扫描达到 75.9。
AI.conclusion: 自训练中的"漏检即背景"是半监督多器官分割中尾部小器官退化的关键成因；将缺失器官建模为未确定状态并配以兼容集合值目标的损失，可有效防止器官消亡，并在低标注比例下取得领先性能。

title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève Update
summary: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. A forgetting factor lets the method track drifting distributions, and a sample-size-invariant embedding keeps outputs comparable across time. Experiments show agreement with Roseland to round-off on stationary data, and accuracy that exceeds equal-memory Roseland by an order of magnitude on long streams. On drifting data, we observe large gains from forgetting with a window matched to the drift.

AI.tldr: 论文提出增量式 Roseland（iRoseland），用核化的序列 Karhunen–Loève（SKL）方案对逐个增长的地标亲和矩阵做 SVD 增量更新，实现单遍、有限内存、状态与已处理点数无关的谱嵌入，并可跟踪漂移分布。
AI.motivation: 原始 Roseland 通过度归一化的“数据-地标”核矩阵的 SVD 计算扩散映射风格的谱嵌入，代价远低于完整扩散映射，但它要求所有数据一次性到齐，无法处理流式或大规模连续到达的数据。
AI.method: 将地标亲和表示为一个按行增长的矩阵，用核化 SKL 方案增量更新其 SVD；度校正通过对参考平均核行做一阶展开近似，使地标侧特征基每步只需一次“地标×地标”特征分解即可恢复；加入遗忘因子以跟踪漂移分布，并采用样本量不变的嵌入使不同时刻输出可比。
AI.result: 在平稳数据上与 Roseland 一致到舍入误差量级；在长流数据上，精度比同等内存预算的 Roseland 高一个数量级；在漂移数据上，使用与漂移匹配的窗口时遗忘机制带来显著增益。
AI.conclusion: iRoseland 将 Roseland 扩展到在线/流式场景，保持单遍与有界内存，并具备漂移跟踪能力，是把地标扩散映射实用化的有效增量方案。

title: Improving While Deployed: Learning Proactive End-to-End Driving from Imperfect Human Takeover Data
summary: Once deployed on vehicles, end-to-end driving models continuously encounter challenging scenarios, generating valuable human takeover data that capture both model outputs and human behaviors. However, human interventions are often imperfect, as drivers may intervene too late or unnecessarily. Consequently, direct imitation can reinforce late responses or discourage otherwise appropriate maneuvers. To address this challenge, we propose an offline post-training framework that transforms imperfect takeover data into proactive supervision. We first construct diverse trajectory candidates by augmenting the plans of the deployed model and shifting recorded human corrective maneuvers earlier in time. We then train a scene-conditioned trajectory scorer to rank these candidates using expert demonstrations and unpaired preference signals from takeover logs. Using this scorer, we selectively replace pre-takeover training targets with higher-scoring candidates while retaining the original targets in normal driving scenarios. Finally, we distill the resulting targets into the driving model without changing its inference architecture. In closed-loop evaluations using real-world scenarios reconstructed with 4D Gaussian splatting, our method achieves the highest overall success rate, outperforming the deployed model, direct imitation learning and trajectory post-optimization. These results highlight a practical path toward efficient updates of deployed driving models using existing fleet logs.

AI.tldr: 提出离线后训练框架，将不完美的人工接管数据转化为主动监督，通过场景条件轨迹评分器筛选并替换训练目标，再蒸馏回端到端驾驶模型，提升闭环成功率。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶模型部署后会遇到挑战性场景并产生宝贵的人工接管数据，但驾驶员接管往往不完美（过晚或不必要），直接模仿会强化迟滞响应或抑制原本合理的操作，因此需要一种方法把不完美的接管数据转化为有效监督。
AI.method: 1）通过增强已部署模型的规划并对记录的人工纠正动作在时间上提前平移，构建多样化轨迹候选；2）训练场景条件轨迹评分器，利用专家示范与接管日志中的非配对偏好信号对候选排序；3）用该评分器选择性替换接管前训练目标为更高分候选，正常驾驶场景保留原目标；4）将目标蒸馏进驾驶模型，不改变推理架构。
AI.result: 在基于4D高斯泼溅重建的真实场景闭环评测中，方法取得最高总体成功率，优于已部署模型、直接模仿学习和轨迹后优化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一条利用现有车队日志高效更新已部署驾驶模型的实用路径。

title: Searching the Pareto Front: Multi-Objective Retrieval for Heterogeneous Scientific Modalities
summary: In cosmology, surveys span different sky regions and wavelength ranges, resulting in uneven modality coverage across observational datasets. Such heterogeneity can be addressed through either multimodal foundation models (FMs), which learn shared embedding spaces, or independently learned modality embeddings combined via late fusion. We investigate whether the latter provides an adaptive alternative to FM-based scientific retrieval. We evaluate this approach on a galaxy retrieval task spanning diverse modalities--history of star formation, spectra of light emitted, and multi-wavelength observations from two telescopes--comparing an FM baseline with separately trained embeddings fused through multi-objective optimization based on Pareto optimality. We find that the FM baseline achieves strong embedding-space proximity, but our method preserves modality-specific distance structure that allows scientists to inspect which physical signals drive similarity. Our method also achieves improved fidelity in raw-data space: across six measured properties, its nearest neighbor is 8% closer to the query on average than that retrieved by kNN in the FM embedding space (spread 0.128 vs. 0.139). These results suggest that multi-objective retrieval can surface astrophysically coherent candidates that single-objective search alone may overlook.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了多模态基础模型（FM）与"独立训练模态嵌入+基于帕累托最优的多目标融合"两种方案在天文学星系检索任务中的表现，发现后者虽在嵌入空间邻近性上不及FM，但能保留模态特定的距离结构并提升原始数据空间的检索保真度。
AI.motivation: 宇宙学巡天覆盖不同天区与波段，导致观测数据集存在模态覆盖不均衡的问题。现有做法或采用学习共享嵌入空间的多模态基础模型，或采用独立学习模态嵌入再做晚期融合，但后者能否作为FM科学检索的自适应替代方案尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在跨多种模态（恒星形成历史、发射光谱、两台望远镜的多波段观测）的星系检索任务上，将FM基线与分别训练、再通过基于帕累托最优的多目标优化进行融合的嵌入进行对比评估。
AI.result: FM基线在嵌入空间邻近性上表现强；所提方法保留了模态特定的距离结构，便于科学家检查是哪些物理信号驱动相似性；在原始数据空间保真度更优——六项测量属性上，其最近邻平均比FM嵌入空间kNN检索结果近8%（分布范围0.128 vs. 0.139）。
AI.conclusion: 多目标检索能够呈现天体物理上更一致的候选样本，是单目标搜索可能遗漏的，表明晚期融合的多目标方案可作为FM检索的自适应补充。

title: GRAFT: Graph-Regularized Prototype Fields for Realistic Test-Time Adaptation of VLMs
summary: Unlabeled test data can improve the zero-shot classifier of a vision-language model, yet transductive and test-time adaptation methods often fall below the zero-shot baseline when only a few vocabulary classes are present in a batch or when streams are correlated. We trace this failure to a shared design: every class owns independent parameters estimated from its own samples, so absent or rare classes are left at biased text anchors or fitted to foreign samples. We propose Graph-Regularized Anchor-displacement Field Transduction (GRAFT), which models the adapted prototypes as text anchors plus a displacement field that is partially pooled over a semantic class graph through a Gaussian Markov random field prior, together with an explicit class-presence model. Inference is closed-form and gradient-free on cached features. Anchor-only shrinkage and a single global shift are the two extreme settings of the prior; absent classes are provably harmonic extensions of the present ones, and the pooling strength can be chosen by empirical Bayes. Under the realistic batch and online protocols on eleven benchmarks and four ImageNet shifts, GRAFT improves over the zero-shot model in every setting and over anchor-based transduction where few classes are present.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GRAFT方法：将适配后的类原型建模为"文本锚点+位移场"，通过高斯马尔可夫随机场先验在语义类图上对位移做部分池化，并联合显式的类存在性模型；推理为闭式、无梯度，无类缺失时退化为调和延拓，池化强度由经验贝叶斯选取。在11个基准与4种ImageNet shift上均优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有转导式与测试时适配方法在批次内仅含少量词表类别、或数据流存在相关性时，效果常低于零样本基线。作者将失败归因于共同设计缺陷：每个类拥有从自身样本独立估计的参数，导致缺失类或稀有类停留在有偏的文本锚点上，或被外来样本错误拟合。
AI.method: 提出图正则化锚点位移场转导（GRAFT）：适配原型 = 文本锚点 + 位移场；位移通过高斯马尔可夫随机场先验在语义类图上部分池化，并引入显式类存在性模型。推理在缓存特征上进行，闭式求解、无需梯度；锚点单独收缩与单一全局平移是同一先验的两个极端情形，缺失类可证明为存在类的调和延拓，池化强度用经验贝叶斯选择。
AI.result: 在贴近实际的批次协议与在线协议下，于11个基准和4种ImageNet分布偏移上，GRAFT在所有设置中均优于零样本模型；在仅有少量类别出现的场景下优于基于锚点的转导方法。
AI.conclusion: 将类原型参数化为一类语义图上的部分池化位移场，可在类别缺失与相关数据流条件下稳健地改进视觉-语言模型零样本分类，且保持闭式、无梯度的轻量推理。

title: Stability Does Not Mirror Plasticity: A Module-Level View of Declarative and Procedural Learning in Transformers
summary: Plasticity and stability in continual learning are typically studied at the entire-model level and in a task-agnostic manner, yet prior work has reported divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by cognitive distinctions between declarative and procedural memory, we instead study how plasticity and stability vary across transformer modules and task types. In a controlled synthetic environment with clean measurement, we show a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability, however, does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. Targeted module reset-and-recovery experiments explain this asymmetry: plasticity tracks which module is best suited to a task's primary computation or storage, whereas stability depends on all ways the existing capability relies on that module, including access to information stored in other modules. Experiments on a realistic model and tasks broadly echo these asymmetric dynamics. Overall, our work shows that plasticity and stability depend on different aspects of a module's functional role, offering a task-dependent, module-level perspective on continual learning.

AI.tldr: 论文在模块层面、任务类型层面研究持续学习中的可塑性与稳定性，发现二者存在"双分离"：可塑性取决于模块是否最适配任务的主要计算/存储，而稳定性取决于既有能力对该模块的全部依赖方式（含对其他模块信息的访问），因此可塑性高的模块不一定稳定性差。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多在整模型层面、任务无关地考察可塑性与稳定性，不同设置下结论相互矛盾。作者受认知科学中"陈述性记忆 vs 程序性记忆"区分的启发，主张应区分transformer内部不同模块以及不同任务类型来重新审视这一权衡。
AI.method: 构建可控、测量干净的合成环境（synthetic environment），按任务类型（程序性任务、陈述性记忆任务）测量各transformer模块（QK、VO投影与MLP）的可塑性；再通过针对性的模块"重置—恢复"（reset-and-recovery）实验，量化各模块被更新或重置时对既有能力的破坏程度，以刻画稳定性；同时在更接近真实设置的模型与任务上做验证。
AI.result: 呈现双分离：程序性任务中QK与VO投影最具可塑性，陈述性记忆任务中MLP最具可塑性。稳定性并不简单镜像可塑性——学习新程序时更新QK可保留过半已存陈述性记忆，更新MLP保留明显更少，更新VO约损失五分之四。模块重置—恢复实验解释了该不对称性。真实模型与任务上的实验大体复现了这种不对称动态。
AI.conclusion: 可塑性与稳定性依赖模块功能角色的不同侧面：前者对应模块是否最适配任务的核心计算或存储，后者对应既有能力对该模块的所有依赖路径。由此提出一个任务相关、模块粒度的持续学习视角。

title: RecallFlow: Episodic Memory as the Source Distribution of Generative Robot Policies
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching policies have become a standard choice for visuomotor imitation learning, owing to their ability to model multimodal action distributions. In memory-dependent manipulation, the robot must act on information that is no longer visible. Existing methods feed the observation history to the policy as an additional condition, while action generation still starts from Gaussian noise. However, the policy must then pick out the relevant target from a long and redundant history, leading to spurious correlations and unreliable decisions as the memory load grows. Additionally, the initial noise carries no information about what the robot has seen, leaving generation without guidance toward the remembered target. To address these issues, we propose RecallFlow, a flow-policy framework that builds the source distribution from episodic memory. Recall-Relocalization relates the memory to the current view through a few recall slots, so that the source reflects where the remembered targets are now.
