title: Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients for Stable Feature Attribution
comment: 36 pages, 19 figures, 27 tables, including the appendix
summary: Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to interpret neural networks, yet imperceptible input perturbations can drastically alter their attribution maps while leaving model predictions unchanged. We introduce Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients (ERIG), a path-based attribution method that intrinsically attenuates gradient irregularities along the integration path using maximum-entropy softmax weighting with temperature parameter $τ$. We quantify the effect of the entropy-regularized weighting on attribution stability by using the Lipschitz properties of the model and its gradients. We decompose the attribution change under an input perturbation into a model-response term, whose bound is $τ$-independent, and a weight-variation term, whose bound decreases at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/(2τ))$. Their ratio $R(τ)$ characterizes the trade-off between gradient information and attribution stability. We further add a new dimension to attribution evaluation by adapting classical noise estimators into two metrics, LINV-C and LINV-P, that quantify attribution noise. Across eleven CNN and Transformer backbones on ImageNet and Oxford-IIIT Pet datasets, our experiments show that, relative to the next-best method, ERIG remains comparable on ranking-based fidelity metrics while improving localization by approximately 24% and attribution stability by approximately 47-fold on average, reaching up to four orders of magnitude improvement over IG, all at negligible additional computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出熵正则化积分梯度（ERIG），沿积分路径用带温度τ的最大熵softmax加权抑制梯度不规则性，从Lipschitz角度证明其归因稳定性界按O(1/(2τ))下降，并在11个CNN/Transformer骨干上实现定位约+24%、稳定性约47倍（对IG最高四个数量级）提升。
AI.motivation: IG等基于路径的归因方法虽被广泛用于解释神经网络，但对输入施加不可感知的扰动即可在模型预测不变的情况下显著改变其归因图，即归因稳定性差。作者希望从方法内部（积分路径加权方式）而非后处理角度直接提升归因稳定性，并给出可量化的理论刻画与新评价指标。
AI.method: 1) 提出ERIG：在积分路径上引入带温度参数τ的最大熵softmax加权，本质上平滑路径上的梯度不规则性；2) 利用模型及其梯度的Lipschitz性质，将扰动下的归因变化分解为模型响应项（界与τ无关）与权重变化项（界按O(1/(2τ))下降），并用比值R(τ)刻画梯度信息与归因稳定性之间的权衡；3) 将经典噪声估计器改造为LINV-C与LINV-P两个归因噪声度量，新增归因评价维度。
AI.result: 在ImageNet与Oxford-IIIT Pet数据集上的11个CNN与Transformer骨干上：相较次优方法，ERIG在基于排序的保真度指标上相当，定位性能平均提升约24%，归因稳定性平均提升约47倍，相对IG最高可达四个数量级，且额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过熵正则化路径加权可在几乎不损失保真度的前提下显著提升归因稳定性和定位能力；理论上的Lipschitz界与R(τ)权衡为稳定性提供了原则性解释，LINV-C/LINV-P补充了归因噪声的评价维度，方法具跨架构、跨数据集通用性。

title: Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation
summary: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.

AI.tldr: 提出ROMUX，用未标定、未知的外置（离机）相机为机器人构建以机器人为中心的障碍地图，实现无需标定与微调的跨视角导航。
AI.motivation: 外置相机（wall/ceiling-mounted）视场宽、遮挡少，优于机器人自载相机；但既有方法要求预先已知相机位姿与内参，标定耗时、需专业人员，且相机移动或换房间就须重做。作者希望消除这一依赖。
AI.method: 定义两类要求：uncalibrated（不输入位姿与内参）与unknown（训练时不针对特定相机拟合，部署前无需微调）。在大规模仿真数据上训练跨视角Transformer，将外置图像token直接映射为度量的、以机器人为中心的障碍地图，且图像token不以相机信息为条件；再在预测地图上用PPO训练小型策略，朝机器人坐标系下的目标点导航。
AI.result: 仿真中每回合随机化相机设置下，成功率与机器人自载相机PPO策略持平；支持单相机与多相机部分视野；使用位置与朝向变化的相机，零样本迁移到真实机器人，并在多种房间布局中生效。
AI.conclusion: 表明外置相机可在完全免标定、免相机先验、免部署微调的条件下用于机器人导航感知，为替代机载感知提供了可行路径；局限在于仍需仿真大规模训练数据，地图精度依赖预测的度量一致性。

title: RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop
summary: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

AI.tldr: RoboBuilder 是一个让编码智能体协同设计机器人硬件与程序的基准：智能体用标准部件、电机和自定义3D打印件设计机器人，凡通过仿真验证的设计都会被真实搭建并在物理赛道上测试。
AI.motivation: 论文追问 AI 智能体能否设计出在真实世界中工作的机器人。纯仿真不足以为凭：在公开部件数据下，15 个初始通过仿真的设计无一能通过真实赛道，因此需要建立"仿真→实机"闭环评测基准。
AI.method: 智能体需共同设计硬件与程序（标准部件＋电机＋自定义3D打印件），仿真通过即实物搭建并在真实赛道测试。智能体通过主动请求测量数据与观看真实运行视频来学习仿真器特性。实验覆盖4个前沿编码智能体、3个难度等级下的10个障碍，共12,774个不同机器人的16,427次仿真，以及约240小时内搭建的135台实体机器人。
AI.result: 智能体几乎解决了全部简单障碍，并发明了搜索基线未能触及的机构；但在更高难度、需单一机器人跨越所有障碍、以及真实世界中表现欠佳——所有难度下仿真通过率仅66%在现实中成立。闭环反馈有效：观看真实失败视频后，智能体重新设计机器人、有时还修正其仿真器，消除了72%的1级和2级失败。
AI.conclusion: RoboBuilder 提供了衡量"智能体工程化真实机器"进展的量化基准，表明闭环的实机反馈对缩小仿真—现实差距至关重要。

title: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at WSDM 2027 Findings
summary: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. While prior work has applied quantization for efficient MoE inference at the edge, we point out that in MoE-based VLMs, the modality-specific characteristics of visual and text tokens further impact expert quantization. To address this issue, we present MoMoVL, a modality-aware adaptive compression framework for MoE-based VLMs that brings vision-language inference within reach of on-device resource budgets. Motivated by our empirical findings on modality-induced disparities across experts, MoMoVL jointly exploits the per-expert activation profile and per-modality quantization sensitivity to guide bit-width assignment. Experimental results show that MoMoVL improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines and reduces memory footprint by up to 15.44% with a modest drop in accuracy over its uniform-precision baseline. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/sco-edge/MoMoVL.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoMoVL——面向 MoE 视觉语言模型（VLM）的模态感知自适应压缩框架，联合利用逐专家激活轮廓与逐模态量化敏感度来分配比特宽度，在精度-压缩权衡上优于现有混合精度基线，内存最多降低 15.44%。
AI.motivation: 端侧智能体网页场景需要隐私保护强、低延迟的 VLM；MoE 架构虽计算高效但多专家带来大内存开销，边缘设备部署困难。混合精度量化适合 MoE 的结构稀疏性与重要性不均衡，但既有工作忽略了 MoE-VLM 中视觉与文本 token 的模态特性对专家量化的额外影响。
AI.method: 基于关于模态导致的专家间差异的实证发现，MoMoVL 构建模态感知的自适应压缩：同时考虑每个专家的激活分布特征（per-expert activation profile）与每种模态的量化敏感度（per-modality quantization sensitivity），据此联合指导比特宽度分配。
AI.result: 相比 SOTA 混合精度基线，MoMoVL 改善了精度-压缩权衡；相对均匀精度基线，内存占用最多减少 15.44%，且精度仅有小幅下降。代码与数据已开源。
AI.conclusion: 模态感知是 MoE-VLM 量化的关键维度，将其与专家级激活信息结合可有效把视觉-语言推理纳入端侧资源预算，为边缘端 MoE 多模态模型部署提供实用压缩方案。

title: JEPA as a Transferable Optimizer: Learning and Understanding Black-Box Optimization from Reward-Agnostic Pretraining
summary: Black-box optimization evaluates candidates through simulations, rollouts, or experiments, often without gradients. Learned optimizers are usually judged by whether they outperform existing methods. We ask a complementary question: what information does a learned optimizer use from its search history? We introduce JEPA-PS (JEPA Policy Search), based on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. It is pretrained on random rollouts using parameter vectors and scalar returns. Its latent-prediction objective predicts the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than its reward or gradient, allowing us to examine what was tried and how well it performed. At test time, JEPA-PS reads a short evaluation history and proposes a candidate in one forward pass, without task descriptions, reward shaping, or test-time gradients. We evaluate it on 15 control environments against 12 optimizers, including evolutionary methods, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and an LLM optimizer. JEPA-PS is competitive with tuned classical baselines and outperforms the LLM optimizer by more than 2x on Swimmer at 71x lower per-step cost. It also transfers zero-shot to environments excluded from pretraining. Null-model comparisons and decoder-training ablations indicate that its latent representation carries information beyond simple history statistics; every trained decoder variant performs worse than the default frozen representation. Our main finding is that the history JEPA-PS uses depends on the task. On smooth landscapes it uses the full trajectory, whereas on rugged landscapes the best-seen point carries nearly all the signal. This memory requirement has a weak positive correlation with fitness-distance correlation (FDC; r=0.112, n=7), while an independent reward-ordering sensitivity probe does not corroborate the relationship (r=-0.024, n=7). Code: https://github.com/mdebnath22/jepa-props.

AI.tldr: 提出 JEPA-PS：基于联合嵌入预测架构的黑盒优化器，用参数向量与标量回报预训练，隐空间预测轨迹下一点，一次前向给出候选解；在15个控制环境对比12种优化器具竞争力，且其使用的历史信息随地形平滑度变化。
AI.motivation: 以往对学习型优化器的评价多停留在"是否优于现有方法"，本文转而提出互补性问题：学习型优化器究竟从其搜索历史中提取了哪些信息。
AI.method: 构建 JEPA-PS，在随机 rollout 上以参数向量和标量回报预训练；隐空间预测目标为优化轨迹的下一个点，而非奖励或梯度。测试时仅读入短评估历史，一次前向传播提出候选，无需任务描述、奖励塑形或测试时梯度。在15个控制环境中与12种优化器（进化方法、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES、LLM 优化器）比较，并做零样本迁移、零模型对照与解码器训练消融。
AI.result: 与调优的经典基线相当；在 Swimmer 上优于 LLM 优化器2倍以上，单步成本低71倍；可零样本迁移至预训练未包含的环境；零模型对照与解码器消融表明隐表示含有超出简单历史统计的信息，所有可训练解码器变体均劣于默认冻结表示。历史依赖与任务相关：平滑地形用完整轨迹，崎岖地形中最优已见点几乎承载全部信号；该记忆需求与 FDC 弱正相关（r=0.112, n=7），但独立奖励排序敏感度探针未佐证（r=-0.024, n=7）。
AI.conclusion: 学习型优化器所依赖的历史信息是任务依赖的，且并非简单统计量；隐空间轨迹预测是一种低成本、可迁移且具可解释性的黑盒优化范式，但记忆需求与地形指标的关联证据尚不稳健。

title: Scalable Iterative Multi-Agent Path Finding under Turn Constraints
summary: Large-scale multi-mobile-robot systems require fast and reliable path planning under realistic motion constraints. Multi-Agent Path Finding with turn actions (MAPF$_T$) explicitly models orientation changes and turn-induced delays, but these constraints increase the computational burden of search-based methods. Priority-inheritance-based planning offers a highly scalable alternative, yet directly extending it to MAPF$_T$ is nontrivial because turn actions break the immediate node-vacation assumption underlying conventional priority inheritance. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PIBT$^*_T$, an efficient iterative solver for MAPF$_T$. PIBT$^*_T$ advances scalable multi-agent coordination by preserving the lightweight single-timestep planning mechanism of Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT), while introducing dedicated mechanisms to handle turn-induced dependencies, local deadlocks, livelock, and inefficient repeated pushing. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks show that PIBT$^*_T$ achieves high success rates and strong scalability, solving instances with up to 1000 agents within seconds. For realistic engineering environments, Action Dependency Graph (ADG)-based execution simulation and a flexible manufacturing system case study show that turn-aware planning better reflects robot execution and reduces actual makespan compared with classical MAPF planning. Experiments with TurtleBot4 robots further validate the practical feasibility of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PIBT$^*_T$，一种面向带转向动作的多智能体路径规划（MAPF$_T$）的高效迭代求解器，在保留 PIBT 轻量单步规划机制的同时，引入处理转向依赖、局部死锁、活锁与低效重复推挤的专门机制，可在数秒内求解上千智能体实例。
AI.motivation: 大规模多移动机器人系统需要在真实运动约束下进行快速可靠的路径规划。MAPF$_T$ 显式建模朝向变化与转向延迟，但这些约束加大了基于搜索方法的计算负担。基于优先级继承的规划具备高度可扩展性，但直接扩展到 MAPF$_T$ 并不平凡，因为转向动作破坏了传统优先级继承所依赖的"节点即时腾空"假设。
AI.method: 提出 PIBT$^*_T$ 迭代求解器：保留 Priority Inheritance with Backtracking（PIBT）的轻量单时间步规划机制，并引入针对转向引发依赖、局部死锁、活锁以及低效重复推挤的专门处理机制。
AI.result: 在标准 MAPF 基准上取得高成功率与强可扩展性，数秒内求解多达 1000 个智能体的实例；基于 Action Dependency Graph（ADG）的执行仿真与柔性制造系统案例表明，转向感知规划更贴合机器人实际执行并降低实际 makespan；TurtleBot4 机器人实验进一步验证了方法的实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: PIBT$^*_T$ 在保持优先级继承类方法可扩展性的同时有效处理了转向约束，兼顾仿真与实际机器人平台，说明转向感知规划在真实工程环境中优于经典 MAPF 规划。

title: Asking but Missing: Decision Coverage in Natural-Language Data Querying
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to translate natural language questions about structured data into executable programs. A fundamental challenge is recognizing when a question admits multiple computational interpretations and identifying the decisions needed to resolve them. We investigate whether language models recognize these unresolved decisions before generating code, or silently adopt assumptions that may lead to incorrect results. We refer to the latter behavior as Underspecified Decision Completion (UDC). To distinguish different causes of UDC, we introduce Grounded Code Generation (GCG), a diagnostic protocol that separates the identification of unresolved decisions, their resolution using evidence, and their translation into executable code. By examining each stage separately, we can determine where the decisions responsible for incorrect results were first missed or mishandled. We evaluate this framework on BIRD-Pandas with twelve models. The results show that answering clarification questions consistently improves execution accuracy, yet substantial errors remain. Our findings suggest that the main difficulty lies not in answering clarification questions, but in recognizing which questions need to be asked in the first place.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型在将结构化数据自然语言问题转为可执行程序前，是否意识到问题存在多种计算解释，提出"欠规范决策补全"(UDC)概念及"接地代码生成"(GCG)诊断协议，发现主要难点在于模型难以识别需要澄清的问题本身。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于将自然语言问题翻译为可执行程序，核心挑战是识别问题的多义/多计算解释及其消歧决策；需探究模型是在生成代码前意识到这些未决决策，还是静默做出可能致错的假设。
AI.method: 提出GCG诊断协议，将流程拆分为三步：识别未决决策、基于证据消歧、翻译为可执行代码；分阶段考察可定位错误结果的决策首次被遗漏或误处理的环节。在BIRD-Pandas数据集上评测12个模型。
AI.result: 回答澄清问题可稳定提升执行准确率，但仍有大量错误残留；说明主要困难不在于回答澄清问题，而在于识别哪些问题需要被提出。
AI.conclusion: UDC是LLM结构化数据代码生成的关键失效模式；瓶颈在于"提问意识"(识别未决决策)而非"回答能力"，提示未来工作应聚焦于歧义/欠规范检测而非仅优化消歧或代码生成。

title: What Do Learned 3D Models Add to Localization from Posed References?
summary: Localizing a query from a few posed reference images avoids building a 3D point map. We ask what the camera predictions of learned 3D models add to geometric estimation from the same references, and where failures arise. Across eight learned models and variants and five test sets, we compare reference budgets, swap pose components, and intervene on the references a model sees. At fine pose-error thresholds, geometric estimation with one additional reference is significantly more accurate than every model on two references on Cambridge and NAVER B1 and never significantly worse, alone or as a fallback behind a shared acceptance gate; with the same three references, the more accurate approach depends on the scene. The gain from the learned translation magnitude depends on reference selection: it improves seven of the eight models on 12-Scenes with the spread-out pairs we select, but none of the five we test with the two top-ranked retrieved references. Where retrieval also returns references from other locations, at NAVER Gangnam Station, models fail at different stages. A robust alignment brings Pi3X and MapAnything within 3.3 pp of adding references as needed. In controlled tests, aligning on the nearby references largely restores VGGT, Pi3X and MapAnything but not Depth Anything 3, and pose-conditioned Pi3X recovers only if the far poses are masked and left out of its input-pose normalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了学习式3D模型与几何估计方法在少参考图像定位任务中的表现，分析学习模型对几何估计的增益来源及失效环节。
AI.motivation: 仅用少量带位姿参考图像进行查询定位可避免构建3D点云地图，但学习式3D模型的相机预测相对于传统几何估计究竟带来何种增量、在何种条件下失效，尚缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 在八个学习模型及其变体、五个测试集上，比较不同参考图像预算、交换位姿分量（旋转/平移）、并对模型可见的参考图像进行干预；同时考察检索参考、鲁棒对齐与位姿归一化等环节的影响。
AI.result: 在细粒度位姿误差阈值下，增加一张参考图像的几何估计在Cambridge与NAVER B1上显著优于所有使用两张参考的模型，且单独使用或作为共享接受门控后的回退方案均从不显著变差；三张参考时更优方法依场景而定。学习式平移幅值的收益依赖参考选择：在12-Scenes上自选分散图像对可提升八个模型中的七个，而使用两个排名最高的检索参考时五个测试模型均无提升。在NAVER Gangnam Station存在跨地点检索参考时，各模型在不同阶段失效；鲁棒对齐使Pi3X与MapAnything与"按需增加参考"的差距缩小至3.3个百分点以内。受控实验显示，在邻近参考上对齐可大幅恢复VGGT、Pi3X与MapAnything，但无法恢复Depth Anything 3；位姿条件化的Pi3X仅当远距离位姿被掩蔽且不参与输入位姿归一化时才能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 学习式3D模型的相机预测并未在少参考定位中稳定超越几何估计；其增益高度依赖参考图像选择与对齐方式，失效可通过鲁棒对齐、位姿掩蔽与归一化处理得到部分缓解。

title: Label-Free Role-Aware Segmentation of Classroom Recordings: Recovering the Teacher from Transferable Structure
comment: Accepted at the AAAI track is IAAI (Innovative Applications of AI)
summary:
How much the teacher talks and when are among the most informative and costly-to-measure signals of teaching. Yet, classroom audio is among the most sensitive data an AI system can process: recordings capture minors and fall under GDPR, preventing raw audio from leaving the recording device. We present a teacher-student segmentation pipeline designed to meet exactly this constraint: label-free at inference, running on a recording device, and requiring no per-session calibration. The pipeline chains a lightweight voice activity detector, compactly pretrained speaker embeddings, agglomerative clustering, and a small logistic regression that assigns the teacher role based on session-relative structure rather than voice identity. We show that our structural cue transfers across classrooms, languages, and acoustic conditions.
  In leave-one-teacher-out cross-validation on 292 recordings from 63 teachers across English and German corpora, our pipeline achieves teacher F1 of 0.81 and 0.87, respectively, outperforming both enrollment-based baselines and a 30-second supervised enrollment ceiling. On a commodity smartphone, its performance matches pyannote, a strong neural diarization tool, while running 4.8x faster at comparable peak memory at a real-time factor of ~0.18. We also find that transcribing filtered audio only marginally increases teacher's word error rate from $0.26$ to 0.28. Residual failures concentrate where teacher and student voices are not acoustically separable. However, we show how to flag these sessions label-free at inference so that they can be routed to human review, enabling selective, privacy-preserving deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向课堂录音设备的师生语音分割流水线，推理阶段无需标注、无需逐场校准，在英德两语料上教师F1达0.81/0.87，并在手机端以约4.8倍速度匹配pyannote性能。
AI.motivation: 教师说话时长与时机是教学中最具信息量但测量成本最高的信号；然而课堂音频高度敏感（涉及未成年人、受GDPR约束），原始音频不能离开录音设备，因此需要设备端、免标注、免校准的师生分割方案。
AI.method: 流水线依次串联：轻量语音活动检测（VAD）、紧凑预训练的说话人嵌入、凝聚层次聚类，以及一个小型逻辑回归，基于会话相对结构（而非声纹身份）指派教师角色；另设计无标签的失效会话标记机制以支持人工复核路由。
AI.result: 在63位教师、292段录音的留一教师交叉验证中，英语/德语教师F1分别为0.81与0.87，优于基于注册（enrollment）的基线及30秒有监督注册上限；商品手机端性能匹配pyannote，速度提升4.8倍，峰值内存相当，实时因子约0.18；仅对过滤音频转写使教师词错误率从0.26微增至0.28。
AI.conclusion: 结构化线索可跨教室、语言与声学条件迁移，实现隐私保护的选择性部署；残余失败集中于师生声音声学不可分的场景，可通过无标签标记在推理时路由至人工复核。

title: ReLoco: Unified Humanoid Locomotion and Fall Recovery via Behavior-Conditioned Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid robots must recover from falls and resume commanded motion to sustain locomotion. Learning these behaviors in one policy requires supervision that accommodates both upright movement and ground-contact recovery. We present ReLoco, a framework that uses behavior-conditioned adversarial motion priors to learn locomotion, get-up from arbitrary fallen postures, and command resumption within one proprioceptive policy. During training, robot posture selects the expert pool and conditions a shared discriminator with two behavior-specific outputs. Task rewards and shared regularization support command tracking and recovery, while temporary assistance facilitates exploration. A simulation-based refinement stage supplies robot-executed motion references for this supervision. Ablations examine conditional supervision, output separation, and reference quality under matched settings. At a common training iteration, the full policy achieves $96.80\%$ independent get-up success and $96.96\%$ push-recovery success, including command resumption. Its torso planar velocity root-mean-square error is $0.1266$~m/s, $14.7\%$ lower than the conditional single-output variant, with similar joint-angle discrepancy measured by dynamic time warping. Deployment on the 64.5-kg Tiangong~3.0 humanoid demonstrates walking, running, get-up, and locomotion resumption after falls using one proprioceptive actor, without controller switching or on-robot policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReLoco 框架，用行为条件化的对抗运动先验在单一本体感知策略中统一学习行走/奔跑、任意跌倒姿态起身与指令恢复。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人需在跌倒后自主起身并恢复指令运动以维持持续行走；在同一策略中同时学习直立运动与地面接触恢复，需要能兼容两类行为的监督信号，而常规运动先验难以覆盖起身这类非周期、接触丰富的动作。
AI.method: 以机器人姿态选择专家池，并用姿态条件化一个共享判别器的两个行为专属输出；结合任务奖励与共享正则化支持指令跟踪与恢复，辅以临时辅助机制促进探索；通过基于仿真的细化阶段生成机器人实际执行的运动参考用于监督。消融对比条件监督、输出分离与参考质量（在同等设置下）。
AI.result: 同一训练迭代下，完整策略实现 96.80% 独立起身成功率与 96.96% 推倒恢复成功率（含指令恢复）；躯干平面速度 RMSE 为 0.1266 m/s，较条件化单输出变体降低 14.7%，DTW 关节角偏差相近。在 64.5 kg 天工 3.0 人形机器人上以单一本体感知 actor 实现行走、奔跑、起身及跌倒后运动恢复，无需控制器切换或机上策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 行为条件化的对抗运动先验配合共享判别器多输出设计，可实现单一策略下运动与跌倒恢复的统一学习，并在真实人形平台上零微调部署。

title: Risk-Controlled Correction for Frozen Multimodal Models under Missing Modalities
summary: A deployed multimodal predictor may face missing modalities after its weights can no longer be changed. This raises a question that training-time repair does not answer: what part of the resulting error is still correctable from the information that remains? We show that this part is characterized by the Bayes gap, the difference between the model's prediction and the Bayes prediction given the observed modalities. For cross-entropy and squared error, excess risk measures this gap in the geometry of the loss; ambiguity in the observed modalities cannot be removed. Thus, a badly degraded prediction is not necessarily a correctable one. Estimating the Bayes prediction normally requires labels. However, when a model observing more modalities is conditionally correct, averaging its outputs conditional on the remaining modalities recovers this target without retrieval labels; with the same fixed blend and neighbors, it is no worse in expected cross-entropy or Brier risk than averaging hard labels. Some such assumption is unavoidable: otherwise the target is not identifiable from unlabeled data alone. GUARD (Gated Utility-Aware Recalibration for Deployment) leaves the deployed predictor unchanged. It estimates a candidate correction by retrieval, learns from deployment-matched labeled data when correction is likely to help, and calibrates a threshold on a held-out split by conformal risk control. Under exchangeability, the marginal probability that GUARD applies a correction whose loss increase exceeds a prescribed tolerance is bounded by a preset level, regardless of the learned score. In controlled experiments, correction gain follows headroom rather than raw error; across nine frozen model-dataset pairs spanning six domains, GUARD retains most of blanket correction's gain within harm budgets that blanket correction often exceeds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"贝叶斯间隙"来刻画模型在模态缺失后错误中仍然可纠正的部分，并给出无需检索标签的贝叶斯预测估计方法，进而提出部署后校准框架 GUARD：不改动原模型权重，通过检索估计候选修正、基于部署匹配数据学习"何时修正有益"、并用共形风险控制设定阈值，在九组冻结模型-数据集对上将修正带来的损害控制在预算内。
AI.motivation: 已部署的多模态预测器在权重冻结后可能遭遇模态缺失，而训练阶段的修复手段无法解决该问题。因此需要回答：在剩余可观测信息下，最终误差中有多大比例仍是理论上可纠正的？同时需要一种不重训练、且能约束修正风险的部署期方案。
AI.method: 1）以贝叶斯间隙（模型预测与给定已观测模态下的贝叶斯预测之差）刻画可纠正误差，对交叉熵与平方误差，超额风险以损失几何度量该间隙；2）证明当观测更多模态的模型条件正确时，对其输出按剩余模态条件平均可在无检索标签下恢复贝叶斯预测目标，且在同一固定混合权重与近邻下，其交叉熵或 Brier 风险的期望不劣于对硬标签取平均；并说明该可识别性假设不可避免；3）提出 GUARD（Gated Utility-Aware Recalibration for Deployment），保持原预测器不变，通过检索估计候选修正，用部署匹配的带标签数据学习修正是否有益，并在留出集上用共形风险控制校准门控阈值。
AI.result: 在可交换性假设下，无论学习到的打分函数如何，GUARD 施加"损失增量超过给定容差"的修正的边际概率被预设水平所界。受控实验中，修正收益取决于可纠正余量（headroom）而非原始误差大小；在跨六个域、九组冻结模型-数据集对上，GUARD 在整体修正（blanket correction）常会超出的损害预算内，保留了其大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: 误差严重退化不等于误差可纠正，可纠正上界由贝叶斯间隙决定；部署期应做"有选择的修正"而非全量修正。GUARD 提供了一种不改权重、带风险保证的门控式重校准方案，在保证损害预算的前提下获取大部分可用增益。

title: A Hardware-Aware Comprehensive Study of Edge Vision Deployment with A Unified Hardware-Model-Runtime Mapping Framework
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has driven the deployment of computer vision directly on resource-constrained edge devices. However, the extreme heterogeneity of edge hardware architectures poses major challenges in selecting and designing suitable vision models. This survey bridges the gap between edge hardware constraints, model architectures, and deployment software toolchains. We establish a comprehensive taxonomy classifying edge hardware into three distinct tiers: mid-range devices (GPUs and dedicated NPUs or TPUs), dedicated embedded MPU or SoC processors, and microcontrollers (MCUs). We aggregate and analyze multi-source benchmark results for image classification and object detection across the computing spectrum, spanning from tens of watts down to milliwatt-scale bare-metal MCUs. Based on these empirical findings, we propose a two-tiered hardware-to-model mapping framework that provides concrete model selection matrices across performance priorities (Speed, Balanced, Accuracy) and actionable architectural design principles (peak SRAM budgeting, resolution-first scaling, and algorithm-compiler co-design). Finally, we highlight critical deployment challenges including toolchain fragmentation, operator incompatibility, and Vision Transformer feasibility, and outline promising future research directions in on-device adaptation and sustainable Edge AI.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理边缘硬件约束、视觉模型架构与部署软件工具链之间的关系，建立三层硬件分类法并汇总多源基准，提出两层“硬件—模型”映射框架，给出面向速度/均衡/精度优先级的模型选择矩阵与架构设计原则。
AI.motivation: 深度学习推动计算机视觉部署到资源受限的边缘设备，但边缘硬件架构极度异构，导致难以选择合适的视觉模型并指导模型设计；现有研究缺乏对硬件约束、模型架构与部署工具链三者的系统性整合分析。
AI.method: 1) 构建边缘硬件的三层分类体系：中端设备（GPU、专用NPU/TPU）、嵌入式MPU/SoC处理器、微控制器（MCU）；2) 跨计算谱系（数十瓦至毫瓦级裸机MCU）聚合与分析图像分类与目标检测的多源基准结果；3) 基于实证发现提出两层“硬件—模型”映射框架。
AI.result: 给出跨性能优先级（Speed、Balanced、Accuracy）的具体模型选择矩阵，以及可操作的架构设计原则：峰值SRAM预算管理、分辨率优先的缩放策略、算法—编译器协同设计；并指出工具链碎片化、算子不兼容、ViT可行性等关键部署挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为边缘视觉模型的选型与设计提供了以实证数据为支撑的系统性框架，弥合硬件、模型与工具链之间的鸿沟，并展望端侧自适应与可持续Edge AI等未来研究方向。

title: Error accumulation in reverse diffusion with an imperfect score: beyond path-space analyses
summary:
Diffusion modeling is a popular method of sampling from a complex, high-dimensional distribution $p$ using learned approximations of its (noised) score functions. Generating a single sample requires simulating the reverse diffusion process, which requires many queries to the learned scores. Thus, a priori, the learning errors can easily compound. Indeed, in existing theoretical analyses, the sampling error (as measured in total variation distance to $p$) accumulates polynomially with the horizon of the stochastic process. This is a consequence of bounding the error of the output law by the error of the law of the entire reverse diffusion path.
  In this paper, we demonstrate that by circumventing the "path-space" analysis, the error accumulation of the diffusion sampler can be mitigated when $p$ satisfies a Poincaré inequality. Moreover, we achieve this result as a special case of a broader framework that applies to any distribution $p$, but relaxes the error metric from total variation distance to a weaker metric capturing all sample statistics that do not "witness" the multimodality of $p$.
  We then zoom out from analyzing the diffusion sampler to the information-theoretic question: given a learned score with some error bound, how accurately can we identify $p$? We show that, for any given bound on the Poincaré constant of $p$, the diffusion sampler already nearly achieves optimal total variation error.

AI.tldr: 该文绕开“路径空间”分析，证明在p满足Poincaré不等式时扩散采样的误差累积可被抑制，并给出更一般的框架；进一步从信息论角度证明该采样器在给定Poincaré常数界下已近乎达到最优的TV误差。
AI.motivation: 扩散采样需多次查询学习到的（加噪）score，先验上学习误差易累积。现有理论分析通过用整条反向扩散路径的律误差来界定输出律误差，导致TV采样误差随过程时域多项式增长。作者希望消除这种因路径空间分析带来的悲观误差累积。
AI.method: 1) 规避path-space分析，直接分析输出律与目标分布p的差异；在p满足Poincaré不等式时证明误差累积可被缓解。2) 将结论作为更一般框架的特例：对任意p成立，但把误差度量从TV松弛为一种较弱度量，该度量刻画所有不“见证”p多模态性的样本统计量。3) 进一步转向信息论问题：给定具有误差界的学习score，能多准确地识别p；并以Poincaré常数的给定上界为条件，论证扩散采样器TV误差的近最优性（下界/极小极大论证）。
AI.result: 在Poincaré不等式条件下，扩散采样的误差不再随时域多项式累积；一般框架给出对任意p成立的弱度量保证；信息论分析表明对任意给定的Poincaré常数界，扩散采样器已近乎达到最优的总变差误差。
AI.conclusion: 路径空间式误差界定过于保守；通过直接分析输出律可显著改进扩散采样的理论保证，且该保证在Poincaré常数受限的分布类上接近信息论极限，说明扩散采样在该设定下的TV误差率本质上不可再显著改进。

title: GTI: Grounding Task Intent Throughout Long-Horizon VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate local actions from visual observations, language, and robot state, but long-horizon manipulation requires the global task intent to remain grounded in the currently executable context. We propose GTI (Grounding Task Intent), which uses the current observation and execution history to localize the active subtask and its execution phase. For the same local subtask, GTI generates two phase-dependent visual targets: an interaction/contact state and a local completion state. The local language instruction and the corresponding phase-specific visual target jointly condition the VLA, specifying both what to do now and what state should be reached at the current phase. During execution, anomaly monitoring and local recovery re-establish an intent-consistent execution context through rollback, re-observation, and phase re-evaluation after persistent deviation. We evaluate GTI on RoboCasa365, VLA-Arena Horizon-Long, and real-world PiPER tasks. Relative to matched Global-FT baselines, GR00T success on seen composite RoboCasa365 tasks increases from 14.6%/12.1% to 31.8%/20.4% under ID/OOD evaluation. On VLA-Arena, GTI+$π_{0.5}$ reaches 47.6% overall success versus 45.2% for an adapted ForeAct baseline, with gains of 5.2/6.0 percentage points on the harder L1/L2 tasks. In the three real-robot task experiments, mean full-task success increases from 21.7% to 59.2%. The results indicate that persistent semantic intent localization and phase-conditioned visual grounding improve multi-stage execution, while failure-triggered local recovery provides additional deployment-time support.

AI.tldr: 提出GTI（Grounding Task Intent），利用当前观测与执行历史定位"当前活跃子任务及其执行阶段"，为同一子任务生成两个阶段相关的视觉目标（交互/接触态与局部完成态），与局部语言指令共同条件化VLA；并在执行中做异常监测与局部回滚恢复。在RoboCasa365、VLA-Arena Horizon-Long与真实PiPER任务上显著提升长程多阶段操作成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型仅由视觉观测、语言和机器人状态生成本地动作，缺乏全局任务意图在"当前可执行上下文"中的落地，导致长程多阶段操作中意图漂移、阶段错位。需要显式地将全局意图持续对齐到当前可执行状态。
AI.method: 1) 以当前观测与执行历史为输入，做语义意图定位，识别活跃子任务及其执行阶段；2) 对每个子任务生成两个阶段相关视觉目标：交互/接触态与局部完成态；3) 局部语言指令+对应阶段视觉目标联合条件化VLA，同时规定"现在做什么"与"该阶段应达到的状态"（阶段条件化的视觉grounding）；4) 执行期异常监测，持续偏差时通过回滚、重观测、阶段重评估进行局部恢复，重建意图一致的执行上下文。
AI.result: RoboCasa365已见组合任务上，GR00T基线在ID/OOD下为14.6%/12.1%，GTI提升至31.8%/20.4%；VLA-Arena上GTI+π0.5整体成功率47.6% vs 适配版ForeAct 45.2%，在更难的L1/L2任务上分别提升5.2/6.0个百分点；三个真实机器人任务上平均全任务成功率由21.7%升至59.2%。
AI.conclusion: 持续的语义意图定位与阶段条件化视觉grounding能有效改善多阶段长程执行；失败触发的局部恢复为实际部署提供额外支持。两类机制互补：前者提升执行质量，后者提升部署鲁棒性。

title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
summary: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping. These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. A leader agent coordinates the proposals, and a Nash bargaining rule selects updates that balance progress across dimensions. Humans design the exam, review candidate changes and revise the curriculum between stages. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, EVA-RSI improves motion evaluation, with the largest gain on smoothness, and the gains carry over to defect types never seen during the run. On the dynamics subsets of public benchmarks, our evaluator achieves the highest observed scores among 21 tested models. As an RL reward, it increases generated motion and earns human preference. A data-selection pipeline incorporating it also increases motion.

AI.tldr: EVA-RSI 是一个多智能体框架，在"无显式验证器"和"多维度权衡"两大约束下，将递归自我改进（RSI）引入视频评估器训练：用受控编辑构造固定代理考试提供免标注监督，用 LLM 智能体提案 + 领导者协调 + 纳什议价规则实现多维度平衡更新，显著提升运动评估能力并迁移到生成端。
AI.motivation: 视频生成中的评估器常遗漏运动缺陷，限制了生成质量。RSI 在数学与代码领域因存在显式验证器、且优化目标单一而成效显著；但视频评估既缺少可靠验证器（无客观真值可直接核验），又需同时判断物理合理性、平滑性、动态性等多维目标，维度间存在此消彼长的权衡。因此需要研究在这两个约束下如何实现 RSI。
AI.method: 1) 构造固定代理考试：对视频施加受控编辑（如时间反转、丢帧）得到编辑定义的目标，从而无需人工标注即可获得监督信号；2) 用少量人工标注真实视频作为锚点，将该考试对齐人类判断；3) 每个评估维度配置一个 LLM 智能体提出改进方案，由 leader 智能体统一协调；4) 采用纳什议价（Nash bargaining）规则筛选更新，使各维度进步保持均衡；5) 人类参与设计考卷、审核候选改动并在阶段间修订课程（curriculum）。基座模型为 Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.result: EVA-RSI 提升了运动评估能力，其中平滑性维度增益最大；增益可迁移至训练过程中未曾出现的缺陷类型。在公开基准的 dynamics 子集上，该评估器在 21 个受测模型中取得最高观测分数。作为 RL 奖励使用时，可增加生成视频的运动幅度并赢得人类偏好；将其纳入数据筛选流程同样能提升生成运动的幅度。
AI.conclusion: EVA-RSI 表明，在缺乏显式验证器且存在多维度冲突的条件下，借助"受控编辑构造的代理考试 + 多智能体提案与纳什议价协调 + 人类在环课程设计"可实现视频评估器的递归自我改进，且改进具有跨缺陷类型的泛化性与向下游生成任务的可迁移性，为视频生成模型提供了有效的过程奖励与数据筛选工具。

title: CoScan: Multi-Scale Content-Adaptive Space-Filling Scans for Causal State-Space Image Restoration
summary: Selective state-space models (SSMs) have recently shown strong potential for efficient image restoration. A central difficulty, however, is that a 2D feature map typically needs to be linearized into a 1D token sequence for causal state-space updates, making restoration performance highly sensitive to the imposed scan order. Existing deterministic scans follow space-filling principles but remain fixed and content-agnostic, and can yield fragmented or semantically inconsistent contexts under degradations. We propose \textbf{CoScan}, a \textbf{co}ntent-adaptive \textbf{scan}-order design for causal vision SSMs. CoScan learns image-dependent space-filling traversals via differentiable proxy supervision driven by \textbf{scan-quality objectives} that \textit{encourage short-range coherence and causal predictability, while preserving spatial adjacency}. To support hierarchical restoration backbones, we introduce an \textbf{efficient multi-scale scan construction by coarsening a fine-level minimum spanning tree}, producing coherent scans across feature resolutions. In addition, a \textbf{frequency-guided start selection strategy} is designed to \textit{place informative structures early in the sequence prefix to strengthen causal context formation}. Plugged into existing Mamba-based backbones, CoScan yields consistent improvements across several restoration benchmarks with minimal overhead and shows promising results on high-level vision tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/dongw22/CoScan

AI.tldr: CoScan：面向因果视觉状态空间模型的内容自适应扫描顺序设计，通过可微分代理监督学习图像相关的空间填充遍历，并配合多尺度扫描构建与频率引导起点选择，在多个复原基准上以极小开销取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 选择性状态空间模型（SSM）在高效图像复原上潜力显著，但2D特征图必须线性化为1D token序列以进行因果状态更新，导致复原性能对扫描顺序高度敏感。现有确定性扫描遵循空间填充原则，却是固定且与内容无关的，在退化条件下会产生碎片化或语义不一致的上下文。
AI.method: 提出CoScan内容自适应扫描顺序：1）通过可微分代理监督学习图像相关的空间填充遍历，由扫描质量目标驱动（鼓励短程连贯性与因果可预测性，同时保持空间邻接）；2）为支持层级复原骨干，通过粗化细层最小生成树实现高效多尺度扫描构建，在不同特征分辨率上生成连贯扫描；3）设计频率引导的起点选择策略，将信息性结构置于序列前缀以强化因果上下文形成。
AI.result: 嵌入现有基于Mamba的骨干网络后，CoScan在多个复原基准上取得一致提升，开销极小，并在高层视觉任务上显示出有前景的结果。
AI.conclusion: 扫描顺序是因果视觉SSM的关键但此前被静态设定的自由度；以内容自适应、多尺度一致、前缀信息优先的方式学习扫描顺序，可低成本、可插拔地提升复原及更广泛视觉任务性能。

title: EEG2MCU: Sensing-to-Execution Co-Design for Wearable EEG Inference
comment: 7 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at DATE 2027
summary: Wearable EEG inference is constrained not only by model size, but also by the channel-dependent sensing front end that must process high-dimensional inputs before compact downstream computation. We present EEG2MCU, a sensing-to-execution co-design framework that treats electrode count as a hardware design variable through task-aware montage selection. EEG2MCU retains a compact time-frequency representation and generates only the INT8 regions required by each first-layer tile, avoiding full input materialization. Halo reuse and access-aware placement across Flash, SRAM, and tightly coupled memory further reduce redundant generation and data movement. On a Cortex-M7 MCU, EEG2MCU reduces peak SRAM by 11.38x relative to the baseline, including a 1.71x reduction from the 62-to-19 electrode montage, while reducing latency by 2.57x and energy by 2.48x. It retains 94-96% of full-montage accuracy, demonstrating practical high-dimensional EEG inference under tight embedded-resource constraints.

AI.tldr: EEG2MCU 是一个从"感知前端"到"执行后端"协同设计的可穿戴脑电推理框架，将电极数量视为硬件设计变量，通过任务感知的导联选择、紧凑时频表示、按需 INT8 区域生成以及多级存储的 halo 复用与放置优化，在 Cortex-M7 上显著降低峰值 SRAM、延迟与能耗，同时保持全导联精度的大部分水平。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 EEG 推理的瓶颈不仅在于模型规模，还在于与通道数相关的前端感知环节：高维输入必须在紧凑的下游计算之前完成处理。现有工作多聚焦模型压缩，忽略了电极数量／导联配置这一硬件级设计变量及输入数据物化带来的存储与搬运开销。
AI.method: 提出 EEG2MCU 感知—执行协同设计框架：(1) 以任务感知的导联选择（montage selection）把电极数作为硬件设计变量，将 62 导联裁剪至 19 导联；(2) 采用紧凑时频表示作为输入形式；(3) 仅按首层每个 tile 的需要生成对应 INT8 区域，避免完整输入物化；(4) 通过 halo 复用与感知访问的 Flash/SRAM/TCM 分层放置，减少重复生成与数据搬移。
AI.result: 在 Cortex-M7 MCU 上，相较基线峰值 SRAM 降低 11.38×（其中 1.71× 来自 62→19 导联的降维），延迟降低 2.57×，能耗降低 2.48×；精度保持全导联方案的 94–96%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将导联选择纳入软硬件协同设计并结合按需数据生成与存储层次优化，可在严苛的嵌入式资源约束下实现高维 EEG 的实用化推理。

title: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

AI.tldr: 提出分层视觉语言导航框架VLN-AR，通过解耦多模态推理与底层控制、3DGS自动数据生成、三阶段渐进训练、记忆感知认知智能体与机载优化，实现无人机长程可行导航并获7.1x-9.4x加速。
AI.motivation: 无人机需在严格机载约束下完成语义推理、智能决策与长程导航，而现有基础模型驱动方法受限于3D数据可得性、轨迹可行性、长程推理能力及复杂环境下的计算效率。
AI.method: 1) 分层VLN框架：将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，结构化预测3D位姿指令与导航意图并转换为动态可行动作；2) 基于3D高斯泼溅的全自动流水线，生成可扩展的逼真无人机导航数据以缓解数据稀缺与域差异；3) 三阶段渐进训练策略，依次增强语言落地、场景推理与复杂导航；4) 轻量级认知智能体，通过记忆感知的任务分解提升长程推理；5) 机载优化：token稀疏化与模型轻量化。
AI.result: 机载优化实现7.1x-9.4x加速且保持高导航性能；仿真与真实无人机导航实验中相较现有方法均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: VLN-AR通过分层解耦架构、自动化3DGS数据生成与渐进训练、记忆感知任务分解及机载效率优化，有效缓解数据、轨迹可行性、长程推理与算力瓶颈，验证了资源受限无人机平台上的长程自主导航可行性。

title: Evaluating invariance training with certified answer-changing controls in neural graph algorithms
summary: Invariance training aims to make neural algorithmic reasoners robust to answer-preserving input changes and is judged by accuracy and by how rarely such edits change predictions. We ask whether this evaluation detects lost sensitivity to answer-changing edits on minimum spanning trees of synthetic graphs, where both directions can be certified. Attaching a subgraph through one bridge provably preserves every original label. Attaching it through two edges, oracle-selected to change a label, and lowering one weight inside the graph serve as answer-changing controls; a response is a changed prediction on an edge whose label changes. A reproduced graph transformer (GDT) within its published accuracy range changes a provably fixed label on 53.3-65.9% of the 64-vertex graphs it solves exactly after a 64-vertex bridge attachment; removing the connecting edge changes little. With 16-vertex graphs and attachments, three invariance objectives lower GDT violations from 2.91% to 0.52-2.02% of pairs at essentially unchanged accuracy. Training also lowers the response to two-edge attachments from 97.6% to 66.0-79.0%, while the response to in-base weight edits stays near 99.5%. At 64 vertices accuracy also falls, but on 16-vertex bases only the attachment control reveals the loss. A message-passing network loses some attachment response at small penalty weights but gains little invariance. Running the conventionally trained GDT on each biconnected block separately removes all observed violations and keeps accuracy and both responses, so the task does not force the trade-off. Sensitivity checks for trained invariance should include certified answer-changing edits that attach material as the training edits do.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑"不变性训练"的评估仅看答案保持型编辑是否足够，发现经不变性训练后的图变换器在可证明会改变标签的编辑（桥接附加子图、基图内降权）上敏感度下降，即隐性的过度不变性。
AI.motivation: 现有不变性训练以准确率和答案保持型编辑下预测的稳定率作为评判标准，作者怀疑这种单向评估无法察觉模型对"答案改变型"编辑的敏感度损失。最小生成树任务上两个方向（保标签/改标签）都可被证明，因此适合作为可验证的试验台。
AI.method: 构造两类可证明的编辑：(1) 通过单条桥边附加子图——可证明保持所有原标签（答案保持型）；(2) 通过两条边附加子图（由 oracle 选取以改变某条边标签）及在基图内降低一个权重——作为答案改变型对照。以"标签变化边上预测是否改变"定义为响应。复现图变换器 GDT，并在三种不变性目标下训练比较；另做小惩罚权重下的消息传递网络对照，以及按双连通块分别推理的诊断实验。
AI.result: 在准确率区间内的 GDT，对 64 顶点图上精确求解的实例，经 64 顶点桥接附加后有 53.3–65.9% 的可证明固定标签被改变，去除连接边影响不大。16 顶点基图下，三种不变性目标把违反率从 2.91% 降至 0.52–2.02% 对偶，准确率基本不变；但对双边形附加的响应从 97.6% 降至 66.0–79.0%，而对基图内降权的响应仍近 99.5%。64 顶点时准确率也下降，而 16 顶点基图上只有"附加型"对照能暴露敏感度损失。消息传递网络在小惩罚权重下丢失部分附加响应却几乎未获得不变性。按双连通块分别运行常规训练 GDT 可消除全部观测到的违反，同时保持准确率和两种响应。
AI.conclusion: 不变性训练以牺牲对答案改变型编辑的敏感度为代价，而该代价在常规评估中被隐藏；且该权衡并非任务本身所强制（分块推理即可兼顾）。建议对经不变性训练的模型加入"以训练同款方式附加材料、但可证明改变标签"的编辑作为敏感度检验。

title: Do 3D Point Representations Encode Architectural Functions? Probing Supervised and Pretrained Models on Urban Facades
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Semantic labels say what a building element is, not what it does: two identical-looking windows on one facade may be operable or fixed, a column may carry load or only decorate. We ask whether 3D point representations encode such architectural function. On 22 mobile-LiDAR buildings with 15 functional attributes per element, we hold out entire buildings and compare hand-crafted descriptors, networks trained from scratch and frozen self-supervised point transformers. Descriptors and frozen features are read by the same linear layer. No network trained from scratch, from PointNet to a 108M-parameter PTv3, clearly exceeds the descriptors (0.610 mAP on functionally ambiguous elements), whereas frozen Utonia reaches 0.732. Random-weight controls of the same architectures (0.649 and 0.652) attribute the gain to pretraining (Utonia: +0.080, 95% building interval [+0.035, +0.124]). Pretrained features improve at every tested number of labelled buildings while descriptors and random features plateau, and, in the configurations we tested, fine-tuning erodes the benefit: at today's data scale, function is better read from pretrained representations than learned from scratch.

AI.tldr: 该文检验3D点表示是否编码构件的"功能"属性（如可开启/固定、承重/装饰）。在22栋移动LiDAR建筑、每构件15个功能属性的跨建筑留出设置下，手写描述子与从零训练的网络（含108M参数PTv3）均约0.610 mAP，而冻结的Utonia自监督特征达0.732；随机权重对照证明增益来自预训练而非架构容量。
AI.motivation: 语义标签只说明构件"是什么"（窗、柱），不说明"做什么"（可开启或固定、承重或装饰）。作者要回答：现有3D点表示（描述子、从零训练的监督网络、自监督点Transformer）是否隐式编码这种建筑功能信息。
AI.method: 数据为22栋移动LiDAR采集建筑，每构件标注15个功能属性；评估采用整栋留出（cross-building）协议以检验泛化。对比三类表示：手写几何描述子、从零训练的网络（PointNet至108M参数PTv3）、冻结的自监督点Transformer（如Utonia）。所有特征接入同一线性探针层；并设置同架构随机权重对照以分离"预训练"与"架构容量"的贡献；进一步分析标注建筑数量对性能的影响及微调的效果。
AI.result: 在功能歧义构件上，手写描述子0.610 mAP，从零训练网络（PointNet至PTv3）均未明显超越；冻结Utonia达0.732。随机权重对照为0.649与0.652，故增益归因于预训练：Utonia为+0.080，95%建筑区间[+0.035, +0.124]。预训练特征在所有测试的标注建筑数量下均随数据增加而提升，而描述子与随机特征提前饱和；在所测配置中微调反而削弱收益。
AI.conclusion: 在当今数据规模下，建筑功能属性更适合从预训练表示中"读出"，而非从零"学习"。自监督点表示已蕴含语义标签之外的建筑功能信息，线性探针加冻结特征的范式在跨建筑泛化与数据效率上优于端到端监督训练，且微调可能破坏这种功能结构。

title: Agent Verifiers in Counterfactual Analysis: A Pilot Study Benchmarking Agentic Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Agents can expand the covariate space of randomized experiments by retrieving fast-moving local context missed by slow-changing survey baseline covariates, helping characterize who benefits most from an intervention. Verifying such covariates is difficult: individual treatment effects are unobserved, retrieval leakage can pull post-treatment information into nominally pretreatment summaries, and encoder leakage can inject post-treatment pretraining knowledge into representations even after temporal filtering of inputs. Guided by a two-channel information bound separating summary provenance from encoder weights, we propose a three-layer benchmark protocol: (i) retrieval admissibility via pre-treatment date filtering; (ii) heterogeneity validation scored rank-weighted average treatment effects (RATEs); and (iii) encoder admissibility checked with chronologically vintaged encoders, future-fact probes, and weight perturbations. Across 11 datasets anchored by Uganda's Youth Opportunities Program, we compare session-isolated retrieval (sandboxed, bounded-budget agent runs per study) against a persistent workspace teammate (xAI's GrokBot) that builds one date-verified corpus per study while blinded to outcomes. The workspace teammate yields higher mean RATE ratios in 6/11 datasets for text alone and 7 for combined features, though paired tests show neither workflow universally dominates. Even on fixed retrieved text, encoder choice significantly shifts heterogeneity signal. Chronologically vintaged probes show no clear evidence of weight leakage, but single-record adapter perturbation analyses show that memorized future facts, once present, persist until injected noise degrades model output. Temporal filtering of retrieval is necessary but insufficient: verifying agent-generated covariates requires jointly examining source provenance, out-of-sample treatment-effect signal, and encoder weights.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个三层基准协议（检索可采性、异质性验证、编码器可采性），用于检验"智能体检索的协变量"能否可信地刻画干预效应的异质性，并在11个数据集上比较了两种智能体工作流与不同编码器选择的影响。
AI.motivation: 随机实验的协变量空间受限于更新缓慢的调查基线数据，智能体可通过检索快速变化的本地语境来扩展协变量空间，从而刻画"谁最受益"。但此类协变量难以验证：个体处理效应不可观测、检索泄漏可能把处理后信息带入名义上的处理前摘要、编码器泄漏可能在时间过滤后仍注入处理后预训练知识。因此需要一个系统性的验证协议。
AI.method: 以"摘要来源—编码器权重"双通道信息界为指导，构建三层基准协议：(i) 通过处理前日期过滤检验检索可采性；(ii) 用秩加权平均处理效应（RATE）验证异质性信号；(iii) 用按时间分版的编码器、未来事实探针与权重扰动检验编码器可采性。在11个数据集（以乌干达Youth Opportunities Program为锚点）上，对比"会话隔离检索"（每个研究独立沙箱、预算受限的智能体运行）与"持久工作区队友"（xAI的GrokBot，在盲于结果的情况下为每项研究构建经日期核验的语料）。
AI.result: 工作区队友在11个数据集中有6个（纯文本）和7个（组合特征）取得更高的平均RATE比值，但配对检验显示两种工作流均无普遍优势；即使固定检索文本，编码器选择也显著改变异质性信号；按时间分版的探针未发现明确的权重泄漏证据，但单记录适配器扰动分析显示，被记忆的未来事实一旦出现便会持续存在，直至注入噪声使模型输出退化。
AI.conclusion: 检索的时间过滤是必要的但不充分：验证智能体生成的协变量必须同时检查来源可追溯性、样本外处理效应信号与编码器权重。

title: Emo-H2A: Driving a Facial Robot Directly from LLM Hidden States at Token Rate
summary: Diverse, semantically synchronized, and low-latency facial expressions are essential for human-robot interaction. While large language models (LLMs) have endowed anthropomorphic robots with fluent speech, facial expression still struggles to follow the conversation. Motivated by this gap, we present Emo-H2A (hidden-to-actuation), a paradigm that drives a facial robot directly from LLM hidden states during autoregressive decoding. Without a separate emotion label, expression stays continuous and context-sensitive, and the face moves with the unfolding reply. We instantiate this paradigm as EmoManifold, a training-free method that extracts a valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinate from each hidden state, projects it, and drives the face at token granularity. The readout is checked on six language models, and the same projection drives our 29-degree-of-freedom (DoF) facial robot. When driven by this projection, the face shifts its expression in the matching direction on 87.5% of within-reply valence transitions, whereas holding a single label for the whole reply leaves directional tracking near the 50% chance level, and first moves in 0.96s rather than waiting 10-26s for the reply to finish and a turn-level label to return.

AI.tldr: 提出 Emo-H2A 范式与免训练的 EmoManifold 方法，直接从 LLM 解码时的隐状态驱动面部机器人表情，实现连续、上下文敏感、低延迟的表达。
AI.motivation: 人机交互需要多样、语义同步且低延迟的面部表情。LLM 已让人形机器人语音流畅，但表情仍难以随对话同步变化；传统做法依赖独立的回合级情感标签，导致表情割裂且滞后。
AI.method: Emo-H2A（hidden-to-actuation）：在自回归解码过程中直接以 LLM 隐状态驱动面部机器人，无需单独情感标签。具体实例 EmoManifold：对每个隐状态提取效价-唤醒-支配（VAD）坐标并投影，以 token 粒度驱动 29 自由度面部机器人；读出头在六个语言模型上验证。
AI.result: 在回复内效价转换中，87.5% 的情况下表情朝匹配方向变化；而整段回复沿用单一标签时，方向跟踪接近 50% 随机水平。表情首次动作耗时 0.96s，而回合级标签需等待回复结束（10–26s）才能返回。
AI.conclusion: 隐状态可直接作为连续情感信号源，实现免训练、token 级、上下文敏感的面部表情驱动，显著优于回合级标签方案；该方法跨模型可迁移，并为低延迟情感化人机交互提供新范式。

title: Training-Free Domain Generation for One-Shot Federated Learning with Server-Side Pre-trained Diffusion Models
summary: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) has attracted increasing attention for its ability to substantially reduce communication overhead by limiting client-server interaction to a single communication round. Nevertheless, this limited interaction makes learning from heterogeneous client distributions challenging. Diffusion-based OSFL approaches seek to address this challenge by synthesizing data that approximate client distributions. However, existing diffusion-based approaches often impose substantial computational costs on clients and lack effective visual guidance to generate data aligned with client distributions. To address these limitations, we propose FedDoG, a training-free Domain Generation framework that leverages server-side pre-trained diffusion models to synthesize data aligned with client domains. FedDoG extracts compact domain representations using a frozen image encoder, substantially reducing client-side computational and communication costs. These representations are incorporated into the diffusion model through a pre-trained image-conditioning adapter, thereby providing explicit visual guidance for domain generation. To further improve the quality of synthetic data, FedDoG adapts the strength of visual conditioning according to domain concentration and filters generated samples based on class consistency and predictive entropy. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that FedDoG generates higher-quality synthetic images and outperforms existing OSFL baselines in classification accuracy. Meanwhile, FedDoG reduces client upload and computation time by 99.9% and 91.5%, respectively. The code is available at https://github.com/YXTong17/FedDoG.

AI.tldr: 提出FedDoG：一种无需训练的域生成框架，利用服务端预训练扩散模型与紧凑域表征，为单轮联邦学习合成与客户端域对齐的数据。
AI.motivation: 单轮联邦学习（OSFL）仅一次通信虽降低开销，但难以应对客户端分布异构；现有扩散式OSFL方法在客户端计算开销大、且缺乏有效视觉引导以生成与客户端分布对齐的数据。
AI.method: 1）用冻结图像编码器在客户端提取紧凑域表征，降低客户端计算与通信成本；2）通过预训练图像条件适配器将域表征注入服务端预训练扩散模型，提供显式视觉引导；3）依据域集中度自适应调节视觉条件强度；4）按类一致性与预测熵过滤合成样本。整个流程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，FedDoG生成的合成图像质量更高，分类准确率优于现有OSFL基线；客户端上传量与计算时间分别降低99.9%和91.5%。
AI.conclusion: 在服务端以训练无关方式复用预训练扩散模型 + 紧凑域表征，是提升OSFL异构数据性能同时大幅降低客户端开销的有效路径。

title: GTA: Generative Tower of Agents for Scalable Holonic Scene Generation
summary: Scalable world modeling requires coordinating scene-wide goals with fine-grained objects and dynamic characters under limited time and context budgets. We introduce GTA (Generative Tower of Agents), which represents every unit at every level of an adaptive scene hierarchy as a holon, both a self-contained construction task and a composable scene unit. Parallel agents recursively plan the hierarchy top-down, generate assets, and assemble and refine them bottom-up. Uniform interfaces carry scene-wide requirements down the hierarchy, guiding local construction so that each holon fits into the larger one. GTA accelerates scalable world modeling through high-throughput parallel execution while preserving well-structured layouts and fine-grained asset details. GTA then populates the assembled environments with dynamic human characters whose appearance and motion are guided by the scene, yielding realized 4D worlds. Project page: https://zt-zeng-tao.github.io/GTA/

AI.tldr: 提出GTA（生成式智能体塔），将自适应场景层级中每层每个单元表示为“holon”（既是独立构建任务又是可组合场景单元），通过并行智能体自顶向下递归规划、生成资产，再自底向上组装与精修，最终填充由场景引导外观与运动的动态人物，生成完整的4D世界。
AI.motivation: 可扩展世界建模需要在有限时间与上下文预算下，协调场景级全局目标与细粒度物体、动态角色，现有方法难以兼顾结构化布局与细节保真。
AI.method: 1）引入holon表示，使每个层级单元既为自包含构建任务又为可组合场景单元；2）并行智能体自顶向下递归规划层级、生成资产；3）自底向上组装与精修；4）通过统一接口将场景级需求沿层级下传，指导局部构建以保证嵌套一致性；5）在组装环境中填充外观与运动受场景引导的动态人物。
AI.result: 通过高吞吐并行执行加速可扩展世界建模，同时保持良好结构化的布局与细粒度资产细节，并产出包含动态人物的实化4D世界。
AI.conclusion: GTA以holon递归层级与并行智能体双向（自顶向下规划、自底向上组装）流程，统一了全局约束与局部细节，为高效、可扩展的4D世界生成提供了可行框架。

title: What Interpolators Store and What They Express: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Benign Overfitting and Label-Free Model Selection
summary: Overparameterized learners can fit noisy training labels perfectly and still predict well, which neither classical complexity measures nor information-theoretic generalization bounds explain. We develop an information-theoretic framework that separates two things an interpolating learner does with its sample: storage, the information the trained model retains about its training labels, and expression, the information about the sample that reaches its predictions at fresh inputs. We first characterize the ideal model: for a loss l, the least complex l-sufficient representation is the Bayes act, whose entropy is the minimal sufficient complexity; this generalizes, and corrects, an earlier "lossless maximal compression" view of boosting. We then show that every interpolator stores exactly nH(Y|X) bits of label noise, so storage, and bounds built on it (including CMI bounds), cannot tell interpolators apart. Expression can: excess risk is bounded above and below by the expressed information V, the entropy over training samples of the prediction at an input, plus a modal-bias term, exactly so for binary labels. Benign overfitting is therefore vanishing expression, a picture that covers nearest-neighbour rules, averaging, minimum-norm least squares and double descent, and that links V to classical bias-variance decompositions and to model disagreement. Finally, V gives a model-selection criterion that needs no held-out labels. Among overparameterized learners on 15 noisy datasets, V estimated from two disjoint halves has 60% less regret than holdout validation at the same cost and matches 5-fold cross-validation at a quarter of its cost; at matched cost it also beats selection by conditional mutual information. We characterize when it fails and give remedies. Code: https://github.com/nnikolaou/GLMC

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息论框架，将插值学习器对样本的处理拆分为"存储"(storage，模型保留的训练标签信息)与"表达"(expression，影响新输入预测的样本信息)，证明所有插值器存储的标签噪声信息均为 nH(Y|X)，故基于存储的界(含CMI界)无法区分插值器；而表达信息 V 能上下界约束超额风险，良性过拟合即表达信息趋于消失，并据此给出无需留出标签的模型选择准则。
AI.motivation: 过参数化学习器能完美拟合噪声标签却仍泛化良好，经典复杂度度量与信息论泛化界均无法解释这一"良性过拟合"现象；已有工作(如boosting的"无损最大压缩"观点)对充分表示的刻画也不准确，需要更精细的信息论工具区分不同插值器的泛化行为。
AI.method: (1) 定义存储与表达两类信息；(2) 刻画理想模型：对损失 l，最小复杂的 l-充分表示为 Bayes act，其熵即最小充分复杂度，推广并修正"无损最大压缩"观点；(3) 证明任意插值器存储恰为 nH(Y|X) 比特标签噪声；(4) 用表达信息 V(训练样本上预测的熵)加众数偏置项给出超额风险的上下界(二分类为精确等式)；(5) 将 V 与偏差-方差分解、模型分歧联系，并以两半数据估计 V 作为模型选择准则。
AI.result: 存储量对所有插值器相同，无法区分模型；表达信息可区分：良性过拟合对应 V 趋于零，覆盖最近邻、平均法、最小范数最小二乘与双下降现象。模型选择实验中，在15个带噪数据集上，用两个不相交半样本估计的 V 在同等成本下比留出验证后悔值低60%，以四分之一成本达到5折交叉验证效果，同等成本下优于条件互信息选择；并刻画了失效情形与补救措施。
AI.conclusion: 泛化能力的关键不在于模型存储了多少标签信息，而在于表达了多少样本信息；V 提供了理论上与风险直接挂钩、实践上高效且无需留出标签的模型选择准则。

title: Facet-SLAM: Real-Time Triangle Splatting SLAM
summary: Dense SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian splatting build maps that render photorealistically, but their surface geometry is poor, and obtaining a mesh requires extraction or fusion stages. Triangle splatting avoids this with surface primitives whose vertices can be triangulated directly into a connected mesh, yet SLAM with this representation has so far relied on photometric tracking, which is too slow for localization at sensor rate. We present Facet-SLAM, the first real-time triangle splatting SLAM system for RGB-D cameras. Fast geometric registration is the natural alternative, but it is not sufficient alone, since the mapper's optimization displaces triangles from the observed surface and makes them unreliable registration targets. We therefore separate the two roles: the tracker sets each triangle's centroid from fused depth and registers frames to these centroids by GICP, while the mapper is restricted to non-translating updates via a change of variables. Our system achieves competitive tracking accuracy at around 100 FPS on a desktop GPU and runs at sensor rate on a Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with the photometric approach, it is over 20 times faster, matches rendering quality, and improves surface accuracy, reducing the chamfer distance of the Delaunay mesh on Replica from 1.55 to 0.86 cm. We will release the implementation at https://github.com/edward62740/Facet-SLAM.

AI.tldr: Facet-SLAM 是首个面向 RGB-D 相机的实时三角形 splatting SLAM 系统，通过将"跟踪"与"建图"的角色分离，在桌面 GPU 上实现约 100 FPS、在 Jetson AGX Orin 上达到传感器帧率的跟踪，渲染质量与光度法相当且曲面精度更优。
AI.motivation: 基于 3D Gaussian splatting 的稠密 SLAM 虽能逼真渲染，但表面几何质量差，且生成 mesh 需额外提取或融合步骤；Triangle splatting 可直接三角化出连通网格，但现有 SLAM 工作依赖光度跟踪，速度过慢，无法在传感器帧率下完成定位。几何配准虽快，却因建图优化会把三角形从观测表面移开而单独使用不可靠。
AI.method: 核心是解耦跟踪与建图的角色：跟踪器利用融合深度设定每个三角形的质心，并用 GICP 将当前帧配准到这些质心；建图器通过变量替换（change of variables）被限制为不改变平移的更新，从而保持质心作为可靠配准目标。
AI.result: 在桌面 GPU 上以约 100 FPS 达到有竞争力的跟踪精度，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 上以传感器帧率运行；相比光度方法速度提升 20 倍以上，渲染质量相当，并提升表面精度，将 Replica 上 Delaunay 网格的 chamfer 距离从 1.55 cm 降至 0.86 cm。
AI.conclusion: Facet-SLAM 证明了在三角形 splatting 表示下，几何配准结合质心解耦策略能够兼顾实时性、渲染质量与几何精度，为具备直接网格输出的实时 SLAM 提供了可行方案，代码将开源。

title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
summary: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an objective calibrated to match online impact, and careful context engineering. In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint. Its best model increases search volume by 0.23\% in an A/B test of large scale. Several improvements were architectural changes the team had never tried, drawn from the broader industry and literature, suggesting that MLE agents can explore regions of the design space that human intuition overlooks. We find that the design of the harness around the model matters: intuition suggests that a stronger underlying model is enough, but in our experience, the design of the loop around it is just as critical. More broadly, our work shows that autonomous agents can do real machine-learning engineering in industry-scale systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建"人在环上（human-on-the-loop）"的机器学习工程师（MLE）智能体，在工业级大规模搜索排序模型上自动完成假设提出、代码实现、训练与评估，并验证其在真实A/B测试中可带来搜索量提升。
AI.motivation: 传统大规模排序/推荐模型迭代流程缓慢繁琐，高度依赖工程师直觉与经验；现有LLM智能体多停留在benchmark或小规模代理任务，能否胜任工业级系统的真实ML工程尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建由工程师保留目标设计、搜索方向与最终模型审核权的human-on-the-loop MLE智能体闭环；针对三大障碍分别采用并行训练跑、与线上影响对齐的目标函数、以及精细的上下文工程（context engineering）。
AI.result: 单次campaign完成1,097个候选实验并接受325个，接受率29.6%（此前不同目标与搜索约束下为15.6%）；最优模型在大规模A/B测试中使搜索量提升0.23%；部分改进为团队从未尝试过的架构改动，源自更广泛业界与文献。
AI.conclusion: 自主智能体可在工业规模系统中完成真实的ML工程工作；围绕模型的harness/loop设计与其底层模型强度同等关键，智能体可探索人类直觉忽视的设计空间区域。

title: GaussLearner: 3D Gaussian Primitives as Self-Regulating Continual Learners
summary: Continual learning of 3D Gaussian fields aims to maintain faithful reconstructions of the evolving world. However, directly fine-tuning an existing Gaussian field on new observations can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously reconstructed content. To address this challenge, existing methods employ selective local optimization, replay, or parameter regularization, yet still struggle to balance adaptation to scene changes with preservation of still-valid content. Our key insight is to view 3D Gaussian primitives themselves as self-regulating continual learners. Based on this insight, we introduce GaussLearner, which equips each Gaussian with a closed continual-learning loop connecting observation, self-regulation, and adaptation at the primitive level. At each novel state, GaussLearner first attributes pixel-wise inconsistencies in current observations to their contributing Gaussians. Each Gaussian then self-regulates through a learning weight that balances current observations against cross-state reliability. This weight governs both Gaussian parameter adaptation and optimizer memory refresh. As current inconsistencies are resolved, the adaptation outcome renews each Gaussian's reliability for future states. The resulting field is a globally coupled population of locally self-regulating learners. Across scenes from CL-Splats, WAT, and our CL-3D dataset, GaussLearner improves average PSNR by 3.41 dB over the strongest baseline. On CL-3D, it achieves the best reconstruction quality on both changed and unchanged views.

AI.tldr: 将3D高斯图元视为可自我调节的持续学习单元，为每个高斯构建"观测—自调节—适应"闭环，从而在适应场景变化的同时保留仍然有效的内容。
AI.motivation: 在持续学习3D高斯场时，直接在新观测上微调已有高斯场会导致对已重建内容的灾难性遗忘。现有方法（选择性局部优化、回放、参数正则化）仍难以在适应场景变化与保留仍有效内容之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出GaussLearner：在每个新状态，先将当前观测中的逐像素不一致归因到贡献该像素的高斯图元；每个高斯通过一个学习权重进行自调节，该权重在当前观测与跨状态可靠性之间权衡，并同时控制高斯参数更新与优化器记忆刷新；随着不一致被消解，适应结果反过来更新该高斯对未来状态的可靠性。最终场由大量局部自调节的学习者构成，并形成全局耦合。
AI.result: 在CL-Splats、WAT及自建CL-3D数据集的各场景上，平均PSNR相比最强基线提升3.41 dB；在CL-3D上，于变化视角与未变化视角均取得最佳重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 图元级闭环自调节机制能有效缓解持续学习3D高斯场中的灾难性遗忘，实现场景适应性与历史内容保持的良好平衡，验证了"高斯图元即持续学习器"这一视角的有效性。

title: FairPGT: Partitioned Graph Transformers for Dual-Level Fair Graph Clustering
comment: Under review. 36 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/SiamakGhodsi/FairPGT
summary: Clustering on attributed graphs can produce demographically biased clusters, particularly when communities align with protected groups. Graph transformers can amplify this bias through same-group attention, while global attention limits scalability. We propose FairPGT, a partitioned graph transformer for fair graph clustering. FairPGT restricts attention to METIS partitions and connects them through routing tokens, which divides the quadratic cost of attention by the number of partitions. A graph-aware self-training target guides clustering, with a provably bounded deviation from the standard DEC target. Fairness is imposed at two levels: a mutual-information term promotes demographic parity in cluster assignments, while a normalized cross-group attention ratio (nCGAR) guides attention toward group neutrality through self-distillation. We prove that the nCGAR correction moves attention toward neutrality and establish a condition preventing overshooting. Across seven benchmarks, FairPGT achieves the best clustering performance and statistical parity on the three largest graphs (Credit, Pokec-n, Pokec-z), with a statistical-parity gap approximately ten times lower than DMoN, and is Pareto-dominated on only one dataset. On controlled stochastic block models, FairPGT attains 97% of the derived upper bound on NMI for exactly fair clustering when communities and protected groups coincide. These graphs further show that, under strong alignment, assignment-level fairness alone makes the attention group-heterophilous, whereas attention-level fairness alone improves neutrality without ensuring fair clusters. Code for reproducibility is available at https://github.com/SiamakGhodsi/FairPGT.

AI.tldr: FairPGT 是一个分区式图 Transformer，在将注意力限制在 METIS 分区内以降低计算复杂度的同时，通过分配层面的互信息约束与注意力层面的归一化跨组注意力比（nCGAR）自蒸馏，实现兼顾聚类质量与人口统计公平性的属性图聚类。
AI.motivation: 属性图聚类易产生人口统计偏向的簇，尤其当社区与受保护群体高度重合时；图 Transformer 的同类注意力会放大该偏差，而全局注意力又难以扩展。
AI.method: 1）将注意力限制在 METIS 分区内，并通过路由 token 连接各分区，把注意力的二次代价按分区数摊分；2）采用图感知的自训练目标引导聚类，并证明其与标准 DEC 目标的偏差有界；3）双层公平约束：互信息项促进簇分配上的人口统计均等，nCGAR 通过自蒸馏引导注意力趋于群体中立；4）理论证明 nCGAR 修正使注意力趋向中立，并给出防止过冲的条件。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，FairPGT 在三个最大图（Credit、Pokec-n、Pokec-z）上取得最佳聚类性能与统计均等，统计均等差距约为 DMoN 的十分之一，仅在单个数据集上被帕累托支配；在受控随机块模型中，当社区与受保护群体完全重合时，其 NMI 达到所推导的精确公平聚类上界的 97%。
AI.conclusion: 强对齐条件下，仅有分配层面的公平会使注意力呈群体异配性，而仅有注意力层面的公平能提升中立性却不足以保证公平簇，说明双层约束缺一不可。

title: Effects of Locomotion and Viewpoint Control on Immersive Robot Telepresence for Navigation and Inspection
summary: In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 在VR遥操作四足机器人穿越实体迷宫并采集墙面标记的任务中，2×2被试内实验（摇杆 vs 全向跑步机移动；摇杆 vs 头动视角控制）表明：头动视角控制显著优于摇杆视角控制；摇杆移动+头动视角客观绩效最佳，跑步机移动+头动视角体验折中最佳；视角控制方式是更强区分因素，移动方式仍影响客观与体验权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人遥操作界面多用手持输入同时完成移动与视角控制，导致转向、观察与检查之间的注意力分配冲突。研究旨在检验两种移动方式与两种视角控制方式的组合对导航+检查任务绩效与主观体验的影响。
AI.method: 被试内2×2设计，17名参与者佩戴VR头显，遥操作四足机器人穿越实体迷宫，同时定位并拍摄墙面标记作为视觉证据。自变量为移动方式（摇杆 vs 全向跑步机）与视角控制（摇杆 vs 头动引导）。采用混合效应模型分析完成时间、碰墙代价、工作负荷、临场感、可用性、技术接受度与心流；并对相机切换、云台视角使用等策略做探索性分析。
AI.result: 头动视角控制在完成速度、碰墙代价、工作负荷及临场感、可用性、技术接受度、心流上均优于摇杆视角控制。客观绩效最佳为摇杆移动+头动视角；体验综合最优为跑步机移动+头动视角。头动控制减少相机切换、更多依赖云台视角、形成更稳定的观察策略，尤其体现在碰墙持续时间上。各条件下目标采集率接近天花板，晕动症均较低。
AI.conclusion: 在该导航与检查复合任务中，视角控制方式是绩效与体验差异的主要来源，移动方式则决定客观与体验之间的权衡取舍；头动引导视角控制可作为提升遥操作界面效率与体验的优先设计方向。

title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
summary: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.

AI.tldr: Vanguard：一种免训练、基于截图的裁判模型，用于视觉-语言智能体的步级投机，使2B草稿模型在网页/移动/具身任务上达到甚至超过8B目标模型的准确率，同时大幅降低大模型调用比例。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言智能体每步动作前都需推理，逐步调用大模型带来难以部署的延迟与成本。已有步级投机依赖裁判判定草稿是否可用，但仅读文本的裁判无法判断该步是否与它所操作的屏幕界面相符；且小模型的少数样本有时能给出与大模型同样正确的步骤，且不总在同一批步骤上。
AI.method: 提出Vanguard：不改动草稿模型与目标模型，采用一个通用决策模型作为免训练裁判，在"看到截图"的条件下对每个候选步骤一次前向传播给出其正确的概率；若最佳候选超过校准阈值则采纳，否则由大模型重写该步。可与token级投机解码组合使用。
AI.result:
在web、mobile、embodied智能体上，2B草稿+Vanguard至少与8B目标同等准确，在Mind2Web和EB-ALFRED上显著更优，且目标模型仅需生成少数步骤；闭环回合完成数大幅提升；搭配另一家族的27B目标既更快又更准。Vanguard是所比较裁判中最准确的，其截图依赖在网页与移动任务上得到验证，校准阈值可迁移到未见网站，跨模型家族的增益随草稿相对目标的pass@4提升而增大；在数学任务上可匹配训练过的过程奖励模型。</result>

title: ACUS: An Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score for Incomplete-View CT
summary: Sparse-view and limited-arc computed tomography (CT) are commonly treated as projection completion: a network fills an unmeasured view, and the result is ranked by similarity to one ground-truth image. That score can be high even when the query angle is far from every acquired measurement, because a learned prior may invent anatomy the scan never constrained. Existing protocols therefore leave a basic question unanswered: how does predictive reliability change with distance from the acquired views? We propose the Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score (ACUS) to answer that question. ACUS is the Winkler interval score of a nominal 90% predictive interval on held-out projections, binned by distance to the nearest acquired view. It charges interval width and adds a large miss penalty when a held-out pixel falls outside the interval, so a narrow band helps only when coverage holds. We use collapse on acquired angles as a necessary consistency check on the predictor. On chest and dental cone-beam orbits, interval width grows with the angular gap. Empirical coverage ranges from 77% to 92%, and the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the point estimate falls as the width rises. Nearest-neighbor, interpolation, and point completion, each given one residual scale, have zero reported far coverage and incur outside-distance penalties. ACUS exposes gap-dependent overconfidence that a point-estimate PSNR alone does not measure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出角校准不确定性评分（ACUS），按"距最近已采集视角的角度距离"分箱，用名义90%预测区间的Winkler区间分数衡量稀疏视角/有限弧CT缺失投影预测的可靠性，揭示点估计PSNR无法反映的"随角度间隙增大而过自信"问题。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角与有限弧CT常被当作投影补全任务：网络填补未测视角，并用与单一真值图像的相似度（如PSNR）排名。但当查询角度远离所有已采集测量时，该分数仍可能很高，因为学习到的先验可能"捏造"扫描从未约束的解剖结构。现有评测协议未回答一个基本问题：预测可靠性如何随与已采集视角的距离变化？
AI.method: 提出ACUS：在留出投影上构建名义90%预测区间，按到最近已采集视角的角度距离分箱，计算Winkler区间分数——既惩罚区间宽度，又在留出像素落出区间时加大幅miss惩罚，从而"窄区间"只有在覆盖率成立时才算优。另以"已采集角度上的坍缩（collapse）"作为预测器的必要一致性检查。
AI.result: 在胸部与牙科锥束轨迹上，区间宽度随角度间隙增大而增大；经验覆盖率介于77%–92%；点估计的PSNR随区间宽度上升而下降。最近邻、插值与点补全三类方法（各给一个残差尺度）报告的远端覆盖率为零，并招致超出距离惩罚。
AI.conclusion: ACUS能够暴露依赖角度间隙的过度自信——这是仅凭点估计PSNR所无法衡量的；应将角度距离纳入CT投影补全的评估体系。

title: Toaster: Nonlinear Memory from Cascaded Linear Memories and Target Propagation
summary: Recurrent memories let language models process long sequences with a fixed-size state. Linear memories such as DeltaNet and KDA store one matrix and take one delta-rule step per token. The product of a chunk of such steps has an exact WY form, so they train fast. Deep memories such as TTT-MLP and Titans store a small MLP, which can hold maps that no matrix can, but their update has no WY form. Toaster bridges the two by building on a known fact: a gradient step on a linear layer is a delta-rule write. It builds a two-layer nonlinear memory from two linear memories with an activation between them. We use target propagation to give the hidden memory its values by projecting the output error back through the second memory. Given a chunk's cross-layer signals, approximated once per chunk, each layer can then run on an unmodified delta-rule kernel. Our default runs this kernel on the output layer and updates the hidden layer once per chunk. Running it on both layers gives a better model in our ablation. At matched backbones and training-token budgets, Toaster has lower loss than KDA at all five tested sizes (0.2B-1.6B non-embedding parameters) on both C4 and PG19. Its C4 perplexity also matches or slightly improves on the attention baseline at every size. At 1.2B it is also below Titans. In a 3:1 hybrid with global attention, the Toaster hybrid has the lowest perplexity of the four hybrids tested, and it is 0.18 (C4) and 0.44 (PG19) below the attention baseline. At the largest size, Toaster's mean three-shot accuracy on 13 tasks is 51.84%, compared with 50.52% for KDA and 50.04% for Titans. In length extrapolation, Toaster's loss stays below KDA's up to 20K tokens (5x the training length). On the 145M backbone, at a hidden width matched to Titans' memory, Toaster takes at most 1.33x KDA's training-step time and is 2.8-5.5x faster than the tested Titans configurations at 32K context.

AI.tldr: Toaster 用"线性层的梯度步即 delta-rule 写入"这一事实，将两个线性记忆夹一层激活拼成两层非线性记忆，并用目标传播为隐藏记忆提供目标值，使每层都能跑未修改的 delta-rule 核，从而在保持线性记忆训练速度的同时获得深度记忆的表达能力。
AI.motivation: 线性记忆（DeltaNet、KDA）以固定大小状态处理长序列且因 chunk 内乘积有精确 WY 形式而训练快，但单矩阵容量有限；深度记忆（TTT-MLP、Titans）存小 MLP，能表示矩阵无法承载的映射，却因更新无 WY 形式而训练慢。作者希望兼得二者之长。
AI.method: 构建两层非线性记忆：以两个线性记忆中间夹一个激活函数。利用目标传播把输出误差经第二层记忆反投影，为隐藏记忆生成目标值；每个 chunk 仅近似一次跨层信号，之后各层独立运行未修改的 delta-rule 核。默认配置为输出层跑 delta-rule 核、隐藏层每 chunk 更新一次；消融显示两层都跑核效果更好。
AI.result: 在匹配骨干与训练 token 预算下，0.2B–1.6B（非嵌入参数）五个规模上 C4 与 PG19 的 loss 均低于 KDA；C4 困惑度各规模持平或略优于 attention 基线；1.2B 时低于 Titans。与全局注意力做 3:1 混合时，四种混合中困惑度最低，比 attention 基线低 0.18（C4）和 0.44（PG19）。最大规模下 13 任务三 shot 平均准确率 51.84%，对比 KDA 50.52%、Titans 50.04%。长度外推中 20K token（5 倍训练长度）内 loss 仍低于 KDA。145M 骨干上，在与 Titans 记忆对齐的隐藏宽度下，训练步时最多为 KDA 的 1.33 倍，32K 上下文下比所测 Titans 配置快 2.8–5.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Toaster 通过"线性层梯度步 = delta-rule 写入"的等价性，用目标传播解耦跨层依赖，实现了兼具深度记忆表达力与线性记忆训练效率的循环记忆，在困惑度、下游准确率、长度外推与训练速度上全面优于 KDA/Titans 类基线，并与注意力混合后进一步提升。

title: 3DTouch: A Tactile-aware VLA Model with 3D Geometric Relations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: In contact-rich dexterous manipulation, occlusion by the fingers and interacting objects obscures local geometry, preventing visual observations from fully capturing contact locations. Visually similar scenes may also differ subtly in the relative positions of interacting objects, leading to different contact states. We propose 3DTouch, a tactile-geometric conditioning approach for vision-language-action (VLA) models. 3DTouch constructs a shared 3D visuo-tactile representation by expressing RGB-D scene points and dense five-finger tactile measurements in the robot-base frame, preserving each taxel's spatial location and force vector. Hand-object and object-object relations derived from hand landmarks and pose-aligned reconstructed surfaces explicitly describe the relative arrangement of interacting entities. Together, these representations condition the VLA action expert on spatially localized contact forces and relative surface geometry, providing explicit cues for contact adjustment and object alignment. We evaluate 3DTouch on five real-world contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks using a UR7e robot arm equipped with an XHand dexterous hand. 3DTouch improves the average success rate by 42 percentage points over the corresponding VLA baseline and by 20 percentage points over the strongest evaluated alternative. Ablation studies reveal the complementary benefits of scene geometry and spatial tactile feedback, with further gains from shared spatial grounding and explicit geometric relations.

AI.tldr: 3DTouch 提出一种面向视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的触觉-几何联合条件化方法，将RGB-D点云与五指密集触觉测量统一表达在机器人基座坐标系下构成共享3D视觉-触觉表征，并显式编码手-物、物-物几何关系，用于富接触灵巧操作。
AI.motivation: 富接触灵巧操作中，手指与交互物体的遮挡使局部几何不可见，纯视觉观测无法完整刻画接触位置；且视觉上相似场景在物体相对位姿上可能存在细微差异，导致接触状态不同。因此需要显式引入空间定位的触觉力与相对表面几何信息。
AI.method: 构建共享3D视觉-触觉表征：将RGB-D场景点与五指密集触觉测量统一表达在机器人基座坐标系中，保留每个taxel的空间位置与力矢量；基于手部关键点与位姿对齐的重建表面推导手-物、物-物关系，显式描述交互实体的相对排布；以上表征共同条件化VLA的动作专家模块。
AI.result: 在UR7e机械臂配XHand灵巧手的五个真实世界富接触灵巧操作任务上评估：平均成功率较对应VLA基线提升42个百分点，较最强对比方法提升20个百分点。消融实验表明场景几何与空间触觉反馈具有互补收益，共享空间grounding与显式几何关系带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 将空间定位的三维触觉与场景几何以统一坐标系方式注入VLA，可为接触调整与物体对齐提供显式线索，显著提升富接触灵巧操作的成功率，且各表征组件贡献互补。

title: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
summary: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information.
