Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.

AI.tldr: MyoECG是一种跨模态表征学习框架，将心脏磁共振（CMR）的结构与功能知识蒸馏进标准12导联心电图，实现仅凭ECG的心肌病检测与亚型分类，并在大规模多中心数据、读者研究及遗传学分析中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在人群尺度进行精准心肌表型分析受限于CMR的成本与可及性；ECG广泛可得但仅反映电生理信息而非结构与功能信息。因此需将CMR知识迁移到ECG上。
AI.method: 构建跨模态表征学习框架MyoECG，在UK Biobank及一家三级心血管中心的45,241对配对的ECG-CMR检查上预训练，将CMR结构与功能知识蒸馏到ECG表征中；随后在来自7个独立数据集、超过180万份ECG上进行开发与验证。
AI.result: 在内外部数据集（患病率0.2%–54.7%）上，MyoECG优于五个预训练ECG基础模型，心肌病检测AUROC为0.800–0.974；六名心内科医师读者研究中，辅助MyoECG使平均敏感度提升0.109（95% CI 0.041–0.175，P=0.009）、特异度提升0.056（95% CI 0.004–0.108，P=0.040）；41,128名UK Biobank参与者中，MyoECG评分与心肌病（rg=0.409）及扩张型心肌病（rg=0.371）存在遗传相关，在四个位点（含NFIA、KCNQ1区域）有全基因组关联，并与69种与心肌应激、细胞黏附、血管生物学及代谢相关的循环蛋白相关；调整27项实测CMR性状后相关性降至不显著（rg=0.131，P=0.143）。
AI.conclusion: MyoECG为CMR知情的心肌病评估提供了可扩展路径，并提供了一种将知识从资源密集型影像迁移到广泛可部署生理信号的策略；遗传学结果支持该评分捕捉的是CMR衍生信息而非数据集特异性捷径。

title: Detect What You Need: Chain-of-Causal Reasoning for 3D Intent Grounding
summary: Accurately matching human intentions in 3D space is an important goal of artificial intelligence. Recently, 3D Intention Grounding (3D-IG) has emerged, aiming to localize target 3D objects given a natural-language intent. Unlike conventional visual grounding with descriptive referring expressions, 3D-IG intents are abstract and non-descriptive, making object localization substantially more challenging. This requires inferring latent functional requirements from non-descriptive intents and aligning them with object-level 3D representations. However, existing methods largely rely on implicit intent-object matching, leading to logical gaps and limited interpretability, robustness, and generalization. To address these challenges, we propose Chain-of-Causal Reasoning (CoCR), a causality-inspired functional dependency reasoning framework that explicitly bridges abstract intentions and candidate objects through intermediate functional requirements. Specifically, CoCR progressively decomposes complex intents into ordered functional requirements, thereby forming an explicit intent-function-object reasoning chain that links abstract intentions to object suitability. Building on this chain, we construct a causality-inspired functional dependency graph to model requirement-attribute relationships and introduce a causal-visual alignment module that aligns function-aware representations with the geometric-semantic features of 3D point clouds, enabling bidirectional verification between structured functional reasoning and visual evidence. Extensive experiments on 3D Intention Grounding and 3D Visual Grounding demonstrate that our method enhances intent-aware object localization. Our code is available at https://2490o.github.io/CoCR.

AI.tldr: 提出Chain-of-Causal Reasoning（CoCR）框架，通过显式的"意图-功能-物体"推理链与因果启发的功能依赖图，将抽象意图与3D点云物体表征对齐，提升3D意图定位的性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 3D意图定位（3D-IG）中的意图是抽象、非描述性的，需要从意图中推断潜在功能需求并与物体级3D表征对齐，难度远高于传统描述性指代表达的视觉定位。现有方法主要依赖隐式的意图-物体匹配，存在逻辑断层，可解释性、鲁棒性与泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 1）渐进式将复杂意图分解为有序功能需求，构建显式的意图-功能-物体推理链；2）在该链基础上构建因果启发的功能依赖图，建模需求-属性关系；3）引入因果-视觉对齐模块，将功能感知表征与3D点云的几何-语义特征对齐，实现结构化功能推理与视觉证据的双向验证。
AI.result: 在3D Intention Grounding与3D Visual Grounding两类任务上的大量实验表明，该方法增强了意图感知的物体定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 以因果启发的功能依赖推理显式桥接抽象意图与候选物体，可有效缓解隐式匹配带来的逻辑断层问题，提升3D意图定位的可解释性、鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

AI.tldr: 提出 Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD)，用自然语言通信替代教师 logits 作为蒸馏媒介，让小型学生模型自主学习何时向黑盒教师求助，并将成功的师生交互作为特权参考监督学生自主 rollout，结合任务奖励强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: on-policy distillation (OPD) 是提升语言模型智能体长程任务能力的有效范式，但传统形式依赖教师 logits，而纯文本黑盒模型无法提供 logits，限制了其应用。
AI.method: COPD 以自然语言通信为蒸馏介质：学生模型在任务执行中自主决定何时咨询黑盒教师，并以开放式自然语言构造请求，无需预定义问题模板或干预调度；成功的师生交互被保留为特权参考（privileged references），通过 on-policy self-distillation 监督新的、无顾问参与的学生 rollout，并与任务奖励强化学习联合优化。
AI.result: 在 CAMG-II 上，COPD 取得的增益是最强黑盒 OPD 基线的 2.46 倍；通过通信学到的能力可泛化到 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-Bench Pro V2，在无顾问访问条件下提升任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言通信可作为无需 logits 的黑盒蒸馏有效媒介，且所习得能力可迁移至未见基准，使学生模型在部署时无需教师即可受益。

title: CoRA-VTLA: Contact-Guided Attention and Queryable Response Memory for Tactile Post-Training
summary: In precision manipulation, small errors in alignment or force can cause jamming or deformation, making contact feedback essential for adapting pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models to these tasks. A single tactile observation leaves the response to recent actions ambiguous. Direct tactile fusion during post-training can also disperse the action expert's visual attention and reduce the share it allocates to contact regions. To address these challenges, CoRA-VTLA augments pretrained VLAs with lightweight tactile modules. A queryable action-response memory retrieves recent contact responses so that the action expert can combine them with immediate tactile feedback. Contact-guided gaze supervision concentrates the visual attention of the tactile semantic token on image regions corresponding to fingertip contact. CoRA-VTLA achieves 73.33% mean success across three MuJoCo tasks, compared with 50% for direct tactile fusion with the same sensor inputs. It also achieves 67% success on an optical-tactile task from the public UniVTAC benchmark and 66.7% mean success across three real-robot tasks. These results show that tactile post-training helps pretrained VLAs adjust to changing contact.

AI.tldr: CoRA-VTLA：为预训练VLA模型增加轻量触觉模块，通过可查询动作-响应记忆与接触引导注视监督，提升精密操作中的接触适应能力，在MuJoCo、UniVTAC及真机任务上显著优于直接触觉融合。
AI.motivation: 精密操作中微小对准或力误差会导致卡滞或形变，接触反馈对将预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适配到此类任务至关重要。但单次触觉观测难以消解近期动作所产生响应的歧义；且在后训练阶段直接融合触觉会分散动作专家的视觉注意力，降低其对接触区域的注意力分配。
AI.method: 提出CoRA-VTLA：在预训练VLA上附加轻量触觉模块。1）可查询的动作-响应记忆：检索近期接触响应，使动作专家能将历史接触响应与即时触觉反馈结合；2）接触引导注视监督：将触觉语义token的视觉注意力集中于指尖接触对应的图像区域。
AI.result: 在三个MuJoCo任务上平均成功率达73.33%，而相同传感器输入下直接触觉融合仅为50%；在公开UniVTAC基准的光学触觉任务上成功率为67%；在三个真机任务上平均成功率66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉后训练可帮助预训练VLA模型适应不断变化的接触条件，所提记忆检索与接触引导注意力机制是有效关键。

title: Can you make models believe false facts in the prompt?
summary: Making LLMs believe false facts is useful for alignment evaluations and for building model organisms. Previous work explored doing so with Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF). But SDF requires fine-tuning one new model for each set of injected false beliefs. To enable larger scale SDF-powered alignment evaluations, we attempt to produce a single model that believes any fact placed in a <facts> tag in the prompt. To do so, we explore doing prompt-conditioned SDF: fine-tuning a model on synthetic documents covering thousands of facts, with each document conditioned on a fact presented in the prompt. We evaluate how deeply the model believes the facts provided in the prompt using evaluations from prior work and a new Jacobian lens evaluation. We find that the belief depth on unseen facts scales roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts, making this a cheap, promising avenue for making models believe false facts, though preliminary experiments on applying it to alignment audits on the small model we studied showed negative results due to these small models often already acting as if they believed facts provided in regular honeypot system prompts. Using RL to reduce the rate at which models verbalize following a false fact in the prompt, on top of prompt-conditioned SDF, generalizes to held-out evals and almost matches SDF on some evaluations. But training against one of our metrics for belief depth makes it harder to trust those evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"提示条件化 SDF"：在覆盖数千条事实的合成文档上微调单一模型，使其相信提示 `<facts>` 标签中给出的任意事实，从而避免为每组注入信念单独训练模型。实验表明，对未见事实的信念深度随训练事实数大致呈对数线性增长；叠加 RL 抑制"口头承认受提示影响"可泛化至留出评测，但在部分评测上训练目标本身会削弱评测可信度。
AI.motivation: 让 LLM 相信虚假事实（false facts）对对齐评测与构建 model organisms 有价值。已有 Synthetic Document Finetuning（SDF）需为每一组注入的虚假信念重新微调一个模型，成本高、难以支撑大规模对齐评测。因此动机是：训练一个模型，能相信提示中 `<facts>` 标签内任意给定的事实。
AI.method: 采用 prompt-conditioned SDF：在覆盖数千条事实的合成文档上微调模型，每条文档均以提示中给出的一条事实为条件。信念深度（belief depth）用既有工作提出的评测指标，以及新提出的 Jacobian lens 评测来度量。此外，在 prompt-conditioned SDF 之上用 RL 降低模型"口头承认遵循提示中虚假事实"的比率。
AI.result: 1) 未见事实上的信念深度随训练事实数大致呈对数线性（log-linear）增长，说明该方法成本低、有前景；2) 用于小型模型的对齐审计初步实验为负面结果，原因是这些模型在常规 honeypot 系统提示下本已表现得像是相信提示中的事实；3) 叠加 RL 后，抑制口头化的效果可泛化到留出评测，在部分评测上几乎追平 SDF；4) 针对某一信念深度指标进行训练会损害该指标作为评测的可信度。
AI.conclusion: Prompt-conditioned SDF 是一种低成本、可扩展的让模型相信任意提示事实的途径，信念深度随训练事实数对数线性扩展；但用于对齐审计时在小模型上暂未见收益（存在天花板效应），且以评测指标为训练目标会引发指标可信性问题。

title: GramStatTexNet: Efficient, Interpretable, and Neuro-Inspired Texture Analysis-by-Synthesis
summary: Deep networks achieve high realism in texture synthesis but often rely on opaque, over-parameterized representations that have limited direct connection to biological vision. Neuroscience-informed pyramid models are interpretable, compact, and biologically inspired, but rely on small, hand-curated statistics sets that are difficult to generalize or extend. We introduce GramStatTexNet, a hybrid analysis-by-synthesis framework that combines the multi-scale Gabor filter structure of classical models with the flexibility of Gramian-based correlations, organized into structured filter families. This structured representation enables analyses that are challenging for deep-feature methods: each statistic carries a named filter-family identity, allowing us to decompose synthesis fidelity into per-family contributions and to learn an interpretable, low-dimensional embedding that preserves perceptual texture content. We compare our framework to classical and deep texture-synthesis baselines across diverse texture categories, and on multiple perceptual metrics, highlighting the compactness and interpretability advantages of this hybrid representation, alongside competitive synthesis quality. This same framework extends naturally to peripheral textures via spatial pooling, and to dynamic textures using a spatiotemporal filter bank. GramStatTexNet provides a unified, interpretable framework for analyzing and modeling visual information with natural extensions across space, time, and eccentricity. Project page: https://vdutell.github.io/gstn

AI.tldr: 提出 GramStatTexNet：将经典多尺度 Gabor 金字塔与 Gramian 相关性统计结合的分析-合成混合框架，实现可解释、紧凑的纹理合成与表征学习。
AI.motivation: 深度网络纹理合成真实感强，但表征不透明、过参数化，与生物视觉联系弱；神经科学启发的金字塔模型虽可解释、紧凑，却依赖小型手工构造的统计量集，难以泛化与扩展。
AI.method: 混合分析-合成框架：保留经典模型的多尺度 Gabor 滤波器结构，引入 Gramian 相关性统计以增强灵活性，并将统计量组织为结构化滤波器族（每组统计量带具名滤波器族身份）。据此可按滤波器族分解合成保真度，并学习保持感知纹理内容的低维可解释嵌入；通过空间池化扩展至外周纹理，通过时空滤波器组扩展至动态纹理。
AI.result: 在多种纹理类别上与经典及深度纹理合成基线比较，在多项感知指标上展现出紧凑性与可解释性优势，同时合成质量具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GramStatTexNet 为分析与建模视觉信息提供了统一、可解释的框架，可自然扩展至空间、时间与偏心度维度。

title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
summary: Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on slow-updating channels only. We test STRM on Sudoku-Extreme, PPBench and Maze-Hard with the same data, parameters and compute as TRM: we improve over TRM by $3.8$ points on Sudoku-Extreme and $8.4$ points on PPBench and match it on Maze-Hard. On ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, STRM improves over the published TRM results by $5.4$ and $0.5$ points. We will release our code upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 提出STRM，用单一状态与统一更新的极简递归结构替代TRM的嵌套双层循环递归，在不损失泛化的前提下提升训练速度与最终性能。
AI.motivation: TRM（tiny recursive model，HRM的简化版）在数独、迷宫最短路等谜题类任务上实验表现优异，但其递归机制复杂：包含高层与低层状态、嵌套循环递归，以及随所处循环位置不同而变化的输入输出签名的网络调用。这些复杂机制主要用于避免记忆化与过拟合，导致实现与理解成本高。
AI.method: STRM仅保留单个状态和统一更新形式；关键设计为：对状态采用可变速率、训练时加抖动（jitter）的指数移动更新（EMA），并且仅在慢更新通道上读出解。在Sudoku-Extreme、PPBench、Maze-Hard上以与TRM相同的数据、参数量和计算量进行对比，并额外在ARC-AGI-1/2上与已发表的TRM结果比较。
AI.result: 相对TRM：Sudoku-Extreme提升3.8分，PPBench提升8.4分，Maze-Hard持平；在ARC-AGI-1与ARC-AGI-2上分别超过已发表TRM结果5.4分与0.5分。
AI.conclusion: 更简单的单一状态递归设计并不牺牲泛化能力，反而加快训练并取得更好最终性能；训练时抖动速率的多速率EMA更新与慢通道读出是使简化递归可行的核心。

title: LaST1.0: A Unified Latent World-Action Model with Control-Centric SpatioTemporal Reasoning
summary: World-Action Models couple action learning with future prediction, enabling robotic policies to capture environmental dynamics for robust control. However, prevailing methods take a reconstruction-oriented approach to model future videos, allocating substantial capacity to appearance details that are incidental to control. In this work, we reformulate world modeling for manipulation as control-centric future prediction in latent space, and present LaST1.0, a unified latent World-Action Model. Rather than modeling an observation-complete video future, LaST1.0 predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets derived from future wrist views, focusing the supervision on the evolving robot-object interactions required for fine-grained manipulation. To better support this control-centric paradigm, LaST1.0 revisits the visual input interface and attention mechanism of its unified architecture. It adopts a vision-encoder-free design with a lightweight patch embedder, exposing fine-grained visual cues directly to the backbone, and introduces LaST-Attention for structured spatiotemporal interactions across modalities. Evaluations across two robot embodiments, five challenging manipulation tasks, and three simulation benchmarks---RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus---demonstrate that LaST1.0 achieves state-of-the-art success rates and generalizes to novel scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of control-centric latent world modeling for robust manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LaST1.0，一个统一的潜在 World-Action Model，将操作任务的世界建模重构为潜空间中控制导向的未来预测：不重建完整未来视频，而是预测由未来手腕视角得到的紧凑、几何感知的潜在目标，并配合无视觉编码器设计与 LaST-Attention，在多个仿真基准与真机上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 World-Action Model 多以"重建"方式建模未来视频，将大量模型容量耗费在与控制无关的外观细节上，监督信号与控制目标不匹配；同时细粒度操作真正需要的是机器人-物体交互的演化信息，而非观测完整（observation-complete）的视频未来。
AI.method: 1) 将操作世界建模重构为潜空间中的控制导向未来预测，预测源自未来手腕视角的紧凑、几何感知潜在目标，使监督聚焦于机器人-物体交互演化；2) 重访统一架构的视觉输入接口：采用无视觉编码器（vision-encoder-free）设计，用轻量 patch embedder 将细粒度视觉线索直接输入骨干；3) 提出 LaST-Attention，实现跨模态的结构化时空交互。
AI.result: 在两种机器人本体、五项挑战性操作任务以及三个仿真基准（RLBench、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus）上评估，LaST1.0 取得 SOTA 成功率，并能泛化到新场景。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了控制导向的潜在世界建模范式对鲁棒操作的有效性，表明以交互相关潜在表征为监督目标、并配合适配的输入接口与注意力设计，是替代重建式世界建模的可行路径。

title: GLIDE: Scalable and Event-Aware Inductive Forecasting over Evolving Logistics Graphs
summary: Accurate forecasting of order volume at scale-effect hotspots (SEHs), spatially coherent groups of logistics flows that serve as distributed optimization units for real-time many-to-one dispatch, is a prerequisite for efficient order pooling in on-demand food delivery (OFD) platforms such as Meituan. However, real-world logistics networks present unique challenges that render standard spatiotemporal prediction model ineffective. (i) Dynamic Topology: Unlike static road networks, logistics graphs are ephemeral, with hotspot emerging and vanishing continuously; (ii) Scale--Volume Heterogeneity: Graph sizes vary from $10^2$ to $10^4$, while zero-inflated, long-tailed volumes create computational bottlenecks and bias predictions toward inactivity; and (iii) Event-Driven Disruption: Exogenous events (holidays, weather, academic calendars) induce systematic demand shifts that purely data-driven backbones cannot anticipate. In this paper, we present GLIDE, a production-ready framework that models evolving logistics graphs in a scalable latent space while adapting to heterogeneous demand regimes and event-driven shifts. GLIDE introduces a Graph-Guided Latent Aggregation mechanism, which dynamically projects varying physical subgraphs into a fixed-size, semantically stable latent space via a differentiable sparse assignment...

AI.tldr: GLIDE：面向即时配送（OFD）平台规模效应热点（SEH）订单量预测的生产级框架，通过图引导潜在聚合将动态物流图映射到固定尺寸语义稳定的潜在空间，并适配异构需求与事件驱动漂移。
AI.motivation: 规模效应热点是实时多对一调度中分布式优化的基本单元，其订单量准确预测是订单汇聚（order pooling）的前提。但真实物流网络带来三大挑战：(i) 动态拓扑——热点不断涌现与消失，图结构短时有效；(ii) 规模—体量异质性——图规模从10^2到10^4变化，且订单量零膨胀、长尾，导致计算瓶颈与向不活跃的预测偏置；(iii) 事件驱动扰动——节假日、天气、学期日历等外生事件引起系统性需求漂移，纯数据驱动主干无法预见。
AI.method: 提出GLIDE框架：核心为图引导潜在聚合机制（Graph-Guided Latent Aggregation），借助可微稀疏分配（differentiable sparse assignment）将规模各异的物理子图动态投影到固定大小、语义稳定的潜在空间；并针对异构需求区间与事件驱动漂移进行适配（摘要其余部分被截断，具体模块未完整给出）。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；仅说明该框架为面向生产环境的（production-ready）方案，可在大规模潜空间中建模演化物流图并适应异构需求与事件冲击。
AI.conclusion: GLIDE以"固定尺寸潜在空间+可微稀疏分配"化解动态拓扑与规模异质性带来的可扩展性难题，并以事件感知适配应对需求漂移，为美团等OFD平台的SEH订单量预测提供了可落地的建模思路。

title: Mean Curvature Minimizing Foliations Of A Vector Field
summary: Streamline patterns are ubiquitous in nature. Prominent examples include white matter fibre tracts in the mammalian brain and arrangements of elongated cells, such as cardiomyocytes in the heart wall. It has been posited that such organisations foliate into locally smooth surfaces to optimise function. However, the recovery of these foliations from a single vector field aligned with the local orientation of the underlying sheets remains an open problem. We address this challenge by introducing a mathematical model of a sheet and developing an algorithm for sheet inference, from measurements of the oriented structures. Given an input vector field, our model estimates a second vector field that is orthonormal to it, while also requiring the Lie bracket of the two to vanish. To balance sheet likelihood against low surface area, we also reduce the mean curvature of the recovered local surface. We compute the first variation of an associated energy and provide a numerical method which admits an efficient, parallel implementation for sheet estimation. We demonstrate our approach on both synthetic and biological examples, motivated by applications to medical imaging. These include white matter fibre tracts from a brain atlas and confocal microscopy images of cleared heart wall tissue. For the latter we are able to reconstruct sheets aligned with local cardiomyocyte directions at unprecedented (micrometre) scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从单个与局部片层方向对齐的矢量场中恢复"片状叶理（foliation）"的数学模型与推断算法，可用于脑白质纤维束与心肌细胞片层的高精度重建。
AI.motivation: 自然界中流线型（streamline）结构普遍存在，如哺乳动物脑白质纤维束、心肌细胞排列等，普遍认为这些结构形成局部光滑曲面以优化功能。然而，如何仅由与局部片层取向一致的单一切向矢量场恢复其叶理结构，仍是一个开放问题，尤其在医学影像应用中缺乏有效手段。
AI.method: 1）建立"片层（sheet）"的数学模型，并提出从取向结构测量中推断片层的算法；2）给定输入矢量场，估计与其正交的第二个矢量场，并要求二者的李括号为零（Frobenius 可积条件），从而保证叶理的存在；3）在似然项与低表面积之间做权衡，引入均值曲率正则化以降低恢复曲面的弯曲程度；4）计算相关能量的第一变分，给出可高效并行实现的数值方法。
AI.result: 在合成数据与生物数据上验证了方法：包括脑图谱中的白质纤维束，以及透明化心脏壁组织的共聚焦显微图像；对后者，能够以空前的微米级尺度重建与局部心肌细胞方向对齐的片层结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过李括号消失约束与曲率正则化的结合，可从单矢量场可靠推断局部光滑片层叶理，数值方法支持并行加速，并已证明其在医学影像（白质纤维束追踪、心肌微观结构重建）中的实用价值。

title: Variable Length Diffuse Everything: Arbitrary Length Generative Modeling on Arbitrary State Spaces
summary: Diffusion and flow-based generative models have achieved remarkable results across diverse applications, but most assume data of fixed-dimension/length. Meanwhile, real-world problems such as layout generation often involve variable-length, multimodal data, such as continuous bounding box coordinates paired with discrete types. Existing methods typically address variable length by padding data to a fixed size or by introducing specialized objectives to model lengths explicitly, adding complexity and limiting generality. We propose Variable Length Diffuse Everything (VL-DE), a simple and general framework for variable-length multimodal generation on arbitrary state spaces. Instead of padding, VL-DE handles variable length through an insertion-based mechanism grounded in a principled theoretical framework, yielding a tractable training objective. In addition, by utilizing the fact that VL-DE is based on a generator with an additive form, we develop a higher-order sampler by appropriately handling the time dependence. Extensive experiments on layout and molecule generation demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: VL-DE：基于插入机制的变长多模态扩散/流生成框架
AI.motivation: 扩散与流式生成模型在多种任务上表现优异，但大多假设数据维度/长度固定。真实场景（如布局生成）常涉及变长、多模态数据（连续包围盒坐标＋离散类别）。现有方法或通过填充到固定长度，或引入专门目标显式建模长度，增加复杂度且损害通用性。
AI.method: 提出 VL-DE（Variable Length Diffuse Everything）：用插入式机制替代填充处理变长，并建立有理论支撑的框架以导出可处理的训练目标；适用于任意状态空间的多模态生成。进一步利用 VL-DE 生成器具有可加形式的特点，恰当处理时间依赖性，设计高阶采样器。
AI.result: 在布局生成与分子生成任务上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VL-DE 提供了一个简单、通用的变长多模态生成框架，避免了填充与额外长度建模目标的复杂性，且天然支持高阶采样，具备良好通用性与实用性。

title: Modelling the human-exoskeleton interaction interface - Benchmarking MuJoCo's deformable model
summary: The human-exoskeleton interaction interface, consisting of the exoskeleton attachment and the underlying human soft tissue, can affect the transfer of assistance. MuJoCo's \textit{flexcomp} has been previously used to model the soft tissue, but its accuracy has not been benchmarked against a finite element model. We benchmarked the \textit{flexcomp} Saint Venant-Kirchhoff (StVK) and Stable Neo-Hookean (SNH) models against COMSOL's Yeoh model in three cases: \textit{case 1}) spherical indentation, \textit{case 2}) compression, and \textit{case 3}) compression of a thigh. We compared force and strain energy as a function of indentation depth, hysteresis and computation time. MuJoCo's models capture force trends with a correlation of 0.97-0.99, but showed a stiffer response, which could be attributed to the volumetric locking of the linear finite elements. The MuJoCo models systematically underestimated hysteresis as MuJoCo's Rayleigh damping could not substitute a viscoelastic model. Moreover, MuJoCo's computational advantage was speed dependent: it was 2-2.5 times faster for spherical indentation, but COMSOL was faster for the other cases, which have more degrees of freedom and contacts. Although MuJoCo's \textit{flexcomp} offers a combination of soft-tissue modelling and multibody dynamics, the limitations regarding the stiffening and hysteresis should be addressed to be used for the analysis of the human-exoskeleton interaction interface.

AI.tldr: 本文将MuJoCo的flexcomp软体模型（StVK与SNH）与COMSOL的Yeoh有限元模型进行基准对比，在球形压痕、压缩及大腿压缩三种工况下比较力、应变能、滞回与计算时间，指出MuJoCo模型存在偏硬与滞回低估问题。
AI.motivation: 人-外骨骼交互界面由外骨骼绑缚件与皮下软组织构成，会影响助力传递；MuJoCo的flexcomp虽已被用于软组织建模，但其精度从未与有限元模型进行过基准验证，缺乏可信度依据。
AI.method: 建立三种工况：case 1球形压痕、case 2压缩、case 3大腿压缩。以COMSOL的Yeoh超弹性模型为基准，对比MuJoCo flexcomp的StVK与Stable Neo-Hookean（SNH）模型在力—压痕深度关系、应变能、滞回及计算时间上的表现。
AI.result: MuJoCo模型能捕捉力趋势，相关系数达0.97–0.99，但响应偏硬，可能归因于线性有限元的体积锁定；因Rayleigh阻尼无法替代粘弹性模型，系统性地低估滞回。计算优势依赖工况：球形压痕下快2–2.5倍，但在自由度与接触更多的其他工况下COMSOL更快。
AI.conclusion: MuJoCo的flexcomp虽兼具软组织建模与多体动力学能力，但在刚度偏硬与滞回不足方面的局限需加以解决，才能用于人-外骨骼交互界面分析。

title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
summary: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. We explicitly relate the proposal to assurance cases, contracts, and skill-library maintenance rather than claiming novelty for their ingredients. A falsifiable longitudinal evaluation would compare WRC-guided policies with strong version-aware baselines at matched coverage, utility, and review cost. This paper contributes a formalized problem statement, testable design obligations, and reporting protocol, not an implemented verifier, empirical superiority result, or proof of universal agent safety.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有理由的复用主张"(WRC)作为前瞻性信任的单元,并通过"理由保持的证据迁移"(WPET)规范化上下文变化后历史证据的可采性判定,给出形式化问题陈述与可检验设计义务,而非实现或实证结果。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能"昨天成功"不等于"今天可正当复用":测试仅覆盖可观测契约条款、缺乏结果判据、评估可能继承同一错误规范,且权限与依赖会在验证与调用之间变化。因此需要重新界定前瞻性信任的恰当单元。
AI.method: 提出WRC作为可废止、主张特定的授权,绑定版本化技能、目标上下文、证据、假设与已识别反驳条件;并以WPET作为判定上下文变化后哪些历史证据仍可采信的纪律,区分"证据可采性"与"所支持安全/有效性主张之真",给出条件性保持结果及其边界,规定三值适用性与非对称上下文迁移判断,并分析来源依赖与策略失效性变更对授权的影响。
AI.result: 论文明确将提案与保证案例、契约、技能库维护等已有工作相对照,不主张其构成要素的新颖性;提出可在匹配覆盖率、效用与评审成本条件下,将WRC引导策略与强版本感知基线进行可证伪的纵向评测设计。核心产出为形式化问题陈述、可检验设计义务与报告协议。
AI.conclusion: 论文定位为立场/框架性工作,不提供已实现的验证器、实证优越性结果或通用智能体安全证明;其价值在于为技能复用授权提供可反驳、可操作的形式化框架与评测规范。

title: Keep the Reasoning, Read the Image: On-Demand Visual KV for Multi-Turn Reasoning VLMs
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) think for thousands of tokens before they answer, and retention policies keep the KV cache affordable by pruning it as the reasoning grows. We find that this pruning sacrifices the image in multi-turn conversations: the image and the reasoning share one budget, so the growing reasoning crowds the visual entries out. A chart question that loses 8 points to the full cache when asked first loses 24 points when asked after a round of reasoning. Protecting a small visual reserve from eviction recovers most of this loss, while adding the same slots to the shared budget recovers considerably less. The image therefore lacks protection, not capacity. Based on this finding, we propose ShelfKV, a training-free method that works on top of existing retention policies. It keeps every visual entry in CPU memory and, at each decoding step, swaps the visual entries that the current query scores highest into the attention slots of the text entries it scores lowest. The image is never evicted, yet it occupies attention slots only while it is read. We evaluate ShelfKV on four benchmarks, three of them conversational, with two retention policies and two reasoning VLMs. In conversations, it improves the strongest existing policy, DBTrimKV, by up to 20.3 points at matched GPU memory, and still leads by 8.7 points when DBTrimKV uses twice the memory. It also consistently outperforms a fixed visual reserve of matched GPU memory in these settings, without hurting accuracy on standalone questions. These results show that the image should be protected from the reasoning but read only on demand.

AI.tldr: 推理型VLM的KV cache剪枝会让图像信息被日益增长的推理内容挤出预算，多轮对话中视觉信息受损严重；为此提出免训练方法ShelfKV，将全部视觉条目常驻CPU内存，按需换入GPU注意力槽位，在同等显存下显著优于现有保留策略。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM需生成数千token的思考过程，保留策略（retention policy）通过剪枝KV cache控制显存开销，但图像与推理共享同一预算，扩张的推理内容会挤占视觉条目。作者观察到：一道图表题在首轮提问时相比完整缓存掉8分，在一轮推理后再问则掉24分。这说明图像缺失的是"保护"而非"容量"。
AI.method: ShelfKV为免训练方法，叠加于现有保留策略之上：将所有视觉条目保存在CPU内存中（永不驱逐）；每个解码步，按当前查询对视觉条目的打分排序，将高分视觉条目换入其打分最低的文本条目所占的注意力槽位。即图像仅在"被读取"时占用注意力槽位，实现按需加载。
AI.result: 在四个基准（其中三个为对话场景）、两种保留策略与两种推理VLM上进行评测。对话场景下，在同等GPU显存时将最强基线DBTrimKV最高提升20.3分；即便DBTrimKV使用两倍显存，仍领先8.7分；在相同显存预算下持续优于固定视觉保留区方案，且不影响单轮独立问题的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 图像信息应当免于被推理内容驱逐，但仅在需要时才被读取；"保护图像 + 按需读取"的设计可有效缓解多轮推理对话中的视觉信息丢失，并提升显存效率。

title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
summary: Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model's own judgment and the user's reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and $τ^2$-bench. We compare the true outcome, the user's stated verdict and the model's own judgment with a separate, frozen "feedback sense" that reads the user's reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ($τ^2$-bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.

AI.tldr: 研究端侧小模型（Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B + LoRA）能否每晚从"被判为可接受的尝试"中持续自学。实验比较真实结果、用户明示评价与模型自我判断三种信号，并引入三种"反馈感知"（feedback sense）判断器。结果显示：自我判断型学习先升后衰；能为礼貌性放弃识别失败的感知可接近 oracle 两周，但会因高质量样本稀少在 60 天内退化；当用户看不到结果时，感知虽"读懂"反应，却把 80% 由客户致谢的失败误判为成功。失败样本在训练集中占比可预测最终表现（ρ = -0.81）。
AI.motivation: 设备端小模型希望实现"隔夜持续学习"，即每天从自身工作记录中自我改进。但缺乏真实结果标签（true outcome）时，必须由某种判据决定哪些尝试值得学习；模型自我评判与用户反应信号均不可靠。论文旨在量化不同反馈信号来源对长期自我改进的影响与失败机理。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B 为基座并挂载 LoRA，每晚用"判据接受的尝试"做微调，在 WebShop 与 τ²-bench 上运行最长一年、共 127 条 "lives"（独立训练轨迹）。对比三类信号：真实结果、用户明示 verdict、模型自我判断；另构建三种版本、独立冻结的 "feedback sense" 来解读用户反应（含"礼貌性放弃误判为成功"型与"先判断用户是否给出明确 verdict"的 discernment 型）。另做 97 lives 的相关性分析，检验训练集中失败样本占比与最终表现的关系。
AI.result: (1) 仅靠自我判断：性能先提升后衰减，一年内明显退化，与是否使用适配器无关。(2) 把礼貌性放弃当作成功的感知：5 条 lives 中崩溃 3 条。(3) 以辨别力为先的感知：5 条中 4 条在两周内接近 oracle，随后因"干净但稀少"的课程样本而衰减，至第 60 天退至自我判断水平。(4) 用户看不到结果时（τ²-bench），感知能正确解读反应，但其 80% 的训练样本是"客户已致谢的失败"。(5) 97 条 lives 中，失败尝试在课程中的占比可预测最终表现，Spearman ρ = -0.81。
AI.conclusion: 在本实验中，"从用户处学习"仅在两个条件下成立：判据能有效过滤失败样本，且用户可观察到真实结果。当课程样本高度偏斜（失败被误判为成功）时，持续自学不仅无益，还可能使模型决策面变窄（narrow）。结论强调反馈感知设计的核心在于辨别力而非礼貌性/顺从性，并提示失败样本比例可作为持续学习稳定性的预警指标。

title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
summary: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. World action models (WAMs) have emerged as effective language-conditioned manipulation policies, but are pretrained for robot arms and sample slowly. WAM-Policy turns one WAM into a quadrupedal loco-manipulation policy via two stages. The first, Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration, adapts the arm-centric WAM to quadrupeds and distills the transferred policy into a student with one video and two action steps by on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). This student, however, is bounded by its teacher, which only imitates demonstrations. The second stage, Task-Specific Improvement and Merging, therefore tunes the teacher by reinforcement learning (RL) and merges the slow specialists into one few-step student by multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD). On QLM-Bench, ten simulated tasks with 1,000 demonstrations synthesized without teleoperation, the transferred policy reaches 77.0%, and the OPSD student keeps 76.7% while sampling 14 times faster. Task-specific RL and M-OPD lift it to 85.0%. We also deploy the OPSD student on a real Unitree Go2 Air. WAM-Policy thus achieves a stronger quadrupedal policy at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: WAM-Policy 通过两阶段方法将面向机械臂的世界动作模型（WAM）迁移为四足机器人语言条件化运动-操作策略，在保持性能的同时将推理速度提升约14倍，并在真实 Unitree Go2 Air 上部署。
AI.motivation: 无臂四足机器人可三足行走、用前腿操作（loco-manipulation），但现有策略均不支持语言指令；而世界动作模型（WAM）虽是有效的语言条件操作策略，却只为机械臂预训练且采样慢。因此需要将 WAM 迁移到四足形态，并解决推理效率与性能上限问题。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：①跨形态策略适应与加速（Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration）——将机械臂中心的 WAM 适配到四足机器人，并用在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）把迁移后的策略蒸馏为仅需1个视频步与2个动作步的学生模型；②任务特定改进与合并（Task-Specific Improvement and Merging）——用强化学习（RL）微调教师以突破仅模仿演示的局限，再通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（M-OPD）将多个慢速专家合并为单一少步学生。
AI.result: 在 QLM-Bench（10个仿真任务，1000条无需遥操作合成的演示）上：迁移策略达77.0%，OPSD 学生保持76.7% 且采样快14倍；任务特定 RL 与 M-OPD 进一步提升至85.0%。OPSD 学生亦部署于真实 Unitree Go2 Air。
AI.conclusion: WAM-Policy 以极小推理开销获得更强的四足运动-操作策略，验证了跨形态迁移+自蒸馏+RL 改进+多教师合并这一路线的有效性，并具备真机可用性。

title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
summary: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. Relative to baselines, GPT-6-sol improves answer accuracy on ViewSpatial and MMSI by 50.39% and 23.07%, respectively; Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 47.50% and 25.22% on these benchmarks. This provides a unified route from fragmented spatial clues to traceable, derivable answers.

AI.tldr: 提出Space-X空间推理框架，通过Execution Agent与Control Agent的协同自演化循环，构建完整、连续的证据链，在多个基准上显著提升工具增强型智能体的空间推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强型智能体在空间推理中缺乏明确的取证目标，在组合输出时存在物体语义与参考系语义不一致的问题，并且难以判断证据是否充分，因此单纯增加工具数量或调用次数并不能可靠地提升推理质量。
AI.method: Space-X由两个智能体组成闭环：Execution Agent基于角色特定记忆，针对每个问题完成证据的获取、关联与充分性判断；Control Agent从执行轨迹中诊断证据链断裂点，并联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织与决策规则。该循环使能力演化与证据使用相互促进——证据需求引导能力发展，可用结果引导行动选择。
AI.result: 在多个基准与四个基座模型上均取得增益。相较基线，GPT-6-sol在ViewSpatial和MMSI上的答案准确率分别提升50.39%和23.07%；Gemini-3.8-Flash在这两个基准上分别提升47.50%和25.22%。
AI.conclusion: Space-X提供了一条从碎片化空间线索到可追溯、可推导答案的统一路径，表明以证据链完整性为目标的自我演化机制比单纯扩充工具更有效。

title: DetectViT: Test-time Backdoor Detection for Vision Transformers via Inter-Head Attention Discrepancy
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) now underpin the visual encoders of most multimodal models, but this success comes at a cost: relying on third-party pretrained checkpoints leaves these systems open to backdoor attacks. Existing test-time detection methods rely on either the predicted label or intermediate embeddings, limiting their applicability across diverse tasks and incurring substantial computational overhead. In this work, we study how backdoor triggers affect the multi-head attention mechanism of ViTs and identify two distinct anomalous patterns: $\textit{complete attention hijacking}$, causing the attention to exhibit abnormally high inter-head spatial overlap, and $\textit{partial attention hijacking}$, causing an abnormally large variance in the concentration of the attention distribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{DetectViT}$, a test-time backdoor detection method that requires neither training data, model outputs, nor any prior knowledge of the trigger. DetectViT quantifies the two hijacking phenomena via an inter-head consistency score and an inter-head entropy variance score, with thresholds estimated from a small out-of-distribution (OOD) calibration set drawn from an arbitrary source. Across four representative attacks, diverse architectures (DeiT, CLIP, and LLaVA), and downstream tasks (image classification and captioning), DetectViT substantially outperforms all baselines with as few as 64--128 OOD calibration samples, achieving a true positive rate of $100\%$ and a false positive rate of $0.17\%$ on BadCLIP. Notably, it introduces negligible additional overhead by relying solely on attention weights already computed during inference. Code is available at: https://github.com/siquanhuang/DetectViT.

AI.tldr: 提出 DetectViT：一种仅依赖注意力权重、无需训练数据与模型输出的 ViT 测试时后门检测方法，通过"注意力头间一致性分数"与"头间熵方差分数"刻画注意力劫持现象，在极少 OOD 校准样本下取得极高检测性能。
AI.motivation: ViT 已成为多模态模型视觉编码器的主流，但依赖第三方预训练权重带来后门风险。现有测试时检测方法依赖预测标签或中间嵌入，跨任务适用性差且计算开销大，亟需一种与任务/输出无关、低成本、无需先验触发知识的检测方案。
AI.method: 1) 机理分析：研究后门触发器对多头注意力的影响，发现两类异常模式——完全注意力劫持（头间空间重叠度异常高）与部分注意力劫持（注意力分布集中度方差异常大）；2) 检测设计：用头间一致性分数与头间熵方差分数对上述现象量化，阈值由任意来源的小规模 OOD 校准集估计；3) 检测时仅复用推理过程中已计算的注意力权重，无需训练数据、模型输出与触发器先验。
AI.result: 在四类代表性攻击、DeiT/CLIP/LLaVA 多种架构、图像分类与图像描述等下游任务上全面优于基线；仅需 64–128 个 OOD 校准样本；BadCLIP 上达到 100% TPR 与 0.17% FPR；额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 注意力层面的头间一致性/熵方差可作为 ViT 后门检测的有效且通用的判别信号，DetectViT 具备跨架构、跨任务、低样本、低开销的实用性，适合作为多模态系统中视觉编码器的即插即用防护模块。

title: HypoLoop: Revising Weight-Editing Plans from Scientific Feedback
summary: Scientific experiments continually reveal prediction errors. Effective updates depend on which parameters change and which errors drive the correction. We introduce HypoLoop, a family of native weight-editing methods that connects these choices to experimental feedback. Fixed, numerically adaptive, and LLM-guided policies produce editing plans; numerical solvers compute weight patches, and internal validation selects the deployed predictor. Successive observations and validation records support revisions to editable locations and fitting rules. Experiments cover 22 scientific tasks and both DeepSeek and Claude. On Burgers, reallocating a matched parameter budget reduces error by 58.80% and 47.72% relative to fixed locations. On DIODE, positive-residual weighting reduces absolute relative error (AbsRel) by 13.35% in internal cross-validation, with the same 33 editable coordinates. Revising the complete plan across rounds lowers final AbsRel by 10.59% relative to keeping the initial plan fixed. SpaceNet7 and Make3D connect accepted edits to improved spatial predictions. These results show how experimental evidence can shape the update problem itself. Code: https://github.com/limengran98/HypoLoop.

AI.tldr: 提出HypoLoop系列原生权重编辑方法，将"改哪些参数、由哪些误差驱动校正"与实验反馈相连，在22个科学任务上显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 科学实验不断暴露预测误差，而有效更新取决于两件事：哪些参数需要改变、哪些误差应驱动校正。现有方法将这两项选择视为预设超参，未与实验反馈形成闭环。
AI.method: 构建HypoLoop原生权重编辑框架：由固定、数值自适应、LLM引导三类策略生成编辑计划；数值求解器计算权重补丁；内部验证选择最终部署的预测器；并利用连续的观测与验证记录迭代修改可编辑位置与拟合规则。
AI.result: 覆盖22个科学任务，在DeepSeek与Claude上验证。Burgers任务中，等量参数预算重分配使误差相对固定位置降低58.80%与47.72%；DIODE上正残差加权在同一33个可编辑坐标下使AbsRel降低13.35%；跨轮修订完整计划比固定初始计划使最终AbsRel再降10.59%；SpaceNet7与Make3D显示被接受的编辑可改善空间预测。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据可以反过来塑造更新问题本身的定义，即"编辑位置+拟合规则"应作为随反馈演化的变量而非静态设定；该闭环范式在科学预测的误差修正上具有一致收益。

title: JEPA Dots: Dual-Latent World Model for Language-Guided Robot Control
summary: Predictive world models for language-guided robot control face a fundamental conditioning challenge: instructions should influence action selection without altering the predicted consequences of fixed actions under identical observations. To address this challenge, we introduce JEPA Dots (Dynamics-Oriented Task Separation), a compact dual-latent framework that jointly learns visual dynamics and language-guided control through separate dynamics and task representations. Language-conditioned task features guide a flow-matching policy, while masked attention restricts world prediction to instruction-independent dynamics history and supplied actions. In closed-loop evaluation on 40 trained LIBERO tasks, JEPA Dots achieves 84.9% overall success with approximately 39.1M parameters, compared with the published 78.7% of NanoVLA-S with 161.0M parameters under a different evaluation protocol. In the reference experiment, JEPA Dots also improves overall success from 76.0% for our task-ID-conditioned adaptation baseline to 84.9%, with LIBERO-Goal success increasing from 67.1% to 88.5%. Instruction-switching experiments further confirm that task representations and policy outputs respond to language changes, while dynamics representations and world predictions remain invariant under fixed observations and supplied actions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JEPA Dots（Dynamics-Oriented Task Separation，面向动力学的任务分离），一种紧凑的双潜变量框架，通过分离的动力学表征与任务表征联合学习视觉动力学与语言引导控制，以解决语言条件对世界模型预测的条件化混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 语言引导机器人控制中的预测式世界模型面临一个根本性的条件化挑战：指令应影响动作选择，但在相同观测下不应改变固定动作所导致的预测后果。现有方法往往将任务信息与动力学信息耦合在同一表征中，导致语言输入污染世界预测。
AI.method: 设计双潜变量结构：语言条件的任务特征驱动流匹配（flow-matching）策略；同时通过掩码注意力（masked attention）将世界预测限制在与指令无关的动力学历史及给定动作上，从而在架构层面强制任务与动力学的解耦。
AI.result: 在 40 个已训练 LIBERO 任务的闭环评测中，JEPA Dots 以约 39.1M 参数量取得 84.9% 总体成功率；作为对照，NanoVLA-S 在 161.0M 参数下公布结果为 78.7%（评测协议不同）。在参考实验中，相对任务 ID 条件化基线将总体成功率从 76.0% 提升至 84.9%，LIBERO-Goal 从 67.1% 提升至 88.5%。指令切换实验验证：任务表征与策略输出随语言变化，而动力学表征与世界预测在固定观测与给定动作下保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分离动力学与任务表征，JEPA Dots 在显著更小的参数规模下实现了更强的控制性能，并实证达成了"指令影响动作但不影响动力学预测"的条件化目标，验证了任务—动力学解耦设计的有效性与可解释性。

title: Test-Time Symmetrization: Scaling Laws for Model-Agnostic Learning under Structure
summary: Test-time compute has emerged as a powerful way to improve the accuracy of language models at inference time, with scaling laws quantifying how accuracy improves with additional forward passes. Existing scaling laws, however, focus on repeated sampling from a fixed prompt, even though many tasks admit multiple equivalent representations of the same underlying problem. A graph does not depend on how its nodes are numbered, and a program does not depend on the names of its variables, yet language models can change their answers under such rewritings. In this paper, we study test-time symmetrization, which uses forward passes on rewritings of the input and aggregates the resulting answers over the group $G$ of rewritings. We prove that no amount of sampling and repeated decoding from a single representation can replace rewriting, while only $O(\log |G|)$ random rewritings suffice to recover the information provided by all $|G|$ rewritings. The same set of $O(\log |G|)$ rewritings provides simultaneous approximation across models, decoding rules, and sampled reasoning traces, and the logarithmic scaling is optimal in general. We validate the theory with experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-14B, with chain-of-thought reasoning, on graph reasoning, logical deduction, and multiple-choice question answering. At the same number of forward passes, spending them on rewritings of the input is substantially more accurate than spending them on repeated sampling from the original prompt whenever the model's answer depends on how the input is written, and the number of rewritings needed grows only logarithmically with the number of possible rewritings, as the theory predicts. Our results provide a principled way to enforce symmetries at inference time when they cannot be built into the model, which we call model-agnostic symmetrization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"测试时对称化"：用输入重写（如节点重编号、变量重命名）上的前向计算替代重复采样，证明存在单表示采样无法替代重写的情形，且仅需 O(log|G|) 次随机重写即可恢复全部 |G| 次重写的信息，并给出实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时计算缩放律主要针对固定提示的重复采样，但许多任务存在等价表示（图与节点编号无关、程序与变量名无关），而语言模型在这些重写下答案会变化。因此需要量化重写多样性相对于重复采样的收益，并寻找高效的重写数量。
AI.method: 将输入重写集合建模为群 G。理论方面：(1) 证明单表示的任意采样与重复解码无法替代重写；(2) 证明 O(log|G|) 次随机重写即可恢复全部 |G| 次重写提供的信息，并证明该对数缩放一般最优；(3) 证明同一组 O(log|G|) 重写可同时适用于多个模型、解码规则与采样推理轨迹。实践方面：对重写后的输入做前向计算，并按群聚合答案（模型无关对称化）。实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4-mini、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B，采用思维链推理，任务包括图推理、逻辑演绎与多项选择问答。
AI.result: 在相同前向计算次数下，将预算用于输入重写而非原提示重复采样，在模型答案受输入写法影响时准确率显著更高；所需重写数随可能重写总数仅呈对数增长，与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 重写带来的多样性优于重复采样，且只需对数级重写即可逼近全群聚合效果，为无法在模型中内建对称性时提供了推理阶段的原理化方案——模型无关对称化。

title: When accuracy hides risk: risk-controlled confirmation of the critical view of safety under expert disagreement
summary: Automated assessment of the critical view of safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy has advanced rapidly, but a deployed check must decide, before the first clip, whether to confirm CVS. The standard rule calibrates a threshold so that false confirmations are rare on average. We show that this rule concentrates its errors on disputed videos, which one of three expert raters judged sufficient, and that the failure is structural. When reference labels are votes of a panel sampled from a larger expert pool, the rule that maximizes sensitivity at a fixed average false-confirmation rate also maximizes false confirmation of disputed videos, and for recognizers that recover expert judgement with less noise this rate rises with accuracy. We propose certified confirmation, a risk-controlled monitoring rule whose threshold is selected by multiple testing so that, with probability at least 1 - δ, false confirmation is at most α overall, among disputed videos, within vendor and country groups, and before CVS is visible, using disputed labels only to calibrate. In a pre-specified, hash-locked evaluation on the 300 test videos (18 countries) of the SAGES CVS Challenge, standard calibration falsely confirmed 8 of 39 disputed videos (0.21; one-sided p = 0.037 against α = 0.10), whereas certified confirmation confirmed 2 (one-sided 95% upper bound 0.15). On development data, protection held for vendor and country groups left out of calibration. The cost was confirming 10% rather than 35% of sufficient videos on time. Average accuracy hides this risk; disputed cases must be protected explicitly.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示：在CVS自动判定中，按"平均假确认率"校准阈值的标准规则会把错误系统性地集中在专家意见有争议的视频上，且该失效是结构性的。作者提出"certified confirmation"，用多重检验选阈值实现风险受控监测，在SAGES 300例测试集上把争议视频假确认从8/39降至2/39，代价是及时确认充分视频的比例从35%降至10%。
AI.motivation: 腹腔镜胆囊切除术中CVS评估已高度自动化，但部署时必须在放置第一个夹子前决定是否确认CVS。标准做法是校准阈值使平均假确认率很低，然而当参考标签来自专家小组投票、部分视频本身存在专家分歧时，这种平均意义上的控制可能掩盖高风险子群体（争议视频）上的系统性失效。作者希望论证该失效并非调参问题而是结构性现象，并提出显式保护争议病例的判定规则。
AI.method: 1) 形式化分析：将参考标签视为从更大专家组中抽样的投票，证明在固定平均假确认率下最大化灵敏度的规则，同时会最大化争议视频的假确认率；且识别器越准确（对专家判断噪声恢复越好），该率反而上升。2) 提出certified confirmation：一种风险受控的监测规则，通过多重检验选择阈值，使得以至少1−δ的概率，假确认在总体上、争议视频内、供应商与国家分组内、以及CVS不可见之前均不超过α；争议标签仅用于校准。3) 在SAGES CVS Challenge的300例测试视频（18国）上进行预注册、哈希锁定的评估，并用开发集考察留出供应商/国家分组的保护泛化。
AI.result: 测试集上标准校准在39个争议视频中假确认8个（0.21；单侧p=0.037，对α=0.10显著超标）；certified confirmation仅假确认2个（单侧95%上界0.15）。开发集上，对未参与校准的供应商与国家分组保护依然成立。代价是及时确认"充分"视频的比例由35%降至10%。
AI.conclusion: 平均准确率掩盖了争议病例上的集中风险，争议样本必须被显式保护；certified confirmation以可接受的灵敏度损失换取可证明的风险控制，为临床部署提供了更可靠的确认策略。

title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI Foundations for Power Grids: From Models to Deployment at Scale (AI4PowerGrids), Sydney, Australia
summary: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估物理约束损失、多电网训练与扰动式数据增强对三类图神经网络潮流模型跨规模零样本迁移（小电网→500节点未知电网）的影响，发现物理信息损失优于纯监督目标，边属性扰动增强可提升迁移最多54.6%，而随机线路/发电机丢包效果不稳定。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源并网、极端天气与数据中心负荷使电力系统运行不确定性增加，传统潮流求解器在大规模场景下的可靠性受挑战；机器学习代理模型是有潜力的替代方案，但大电网训练数据生成成本过高，因此小电网训练模型必须依赖分布外泛化能力，而现有模型缺乏该能力。
AI.method: 面向三类基于图神经网络的潮流模型，在从小系统迁移到更大的、未见过的500节点系统的零样本迁移设定下，系统对比三类干预：物理信息（physics-informed）损失、多电网（multi-grid）训练、基于扰动的数据增强（尤其是边属性扰动），并考察随机线路/发电机丢包（dropout）增强。
AI.result: (1) 物理信息损失相对纯监督目标改善迁移；(2) 在较小系统上多电网训练与最佳单电网训练相当，但无法弥合与目标电网训练的差距；(3) 边属性扰动增强使迁移性能最高提升54.6%；(4) 随机线路/发电机丢包未带来一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 在训练数据难以获取的大电网场景中，物理信息损失与针对边属性的扰动式增强是提升GNN潮流代理模型跨规模零样本迁移的有效手段，而多电网训练与拓扑丢包增强的收益有限；这为低成本部署可扩展潮流代理模型提供了实践指导。

title: SemPhys: Semantic-Physical Co-Learning for Humanoid Motion Generation via Differentiable World Models
summary: In human-robot collaboration, natural language lets people direct a humanoid's whole-body movements without programming joint trajectories. A common approach generates a kinematic reference from an instruction and relies on a tracking controller to execute it. However, as the controller maintains balance under contact constraints, the executed motion can depart from the reference in ways that change the action it conveys. Our central insight is that semantic alignment must be evaluated directly on the complete motion the robot physically executes. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{SemPhys}, a framework that trains motion generators using semantic feedback from simulated executions. A differentiable world model and a fixed tracking controller predict a short segment of a recorded execution. SemPhys inserts this prediction at its original position, scores the complete trajectory against the instruction, and backpropagates through the predicted segment. A paired anchoring loss stabilizes adaptation by keeping each generated reference close to its counterpart from the initial generator. On BONES-SEED, SemPhys largely preserves instruction retrieval accuracy from reference to execution and achieves the highest retrieval accuracy on executed motions among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: SemPhys 是一个利用仿真执行反馈进行语义对齐训练的人形机器人全身动作生成框架，通过可微世界模型与固定跟踪控制器预测执行片段，直接在完整执行轨迹上计算语义得分并回传梯度，在 BONES-SEED 上显著缩小参考动作与执行动作之间的语义差距。
AI.motivation: 现有方法先用指令生成运动学参考轨迹，再由跟踪控制器执行；但控制器在接触约束下维持平衡时会使实际执行动作偏离参考，从而改变动作所传达的语义。因此语义对齐应在机器人真实执行的完整动作上直接评估，而非仅停留在参考轨迹层面。
AI.method: SemPhys 使用来自仿真执行的语义反馈训练运动生成器。具体地，利用一个可微世界模型与一个固定的跟踪控制器预测一段已录制执行的短片段；将该预测片段插回其在完整轨迹中的原始位置，对整条轨迹与指令做语义打分，并通过预测片段反向传播梯度。此外引入配对锚定损失（paired anchoring loss），约束生成的参考轨迹贴近初始生成器的对应输出，以稳定适应过程。
AI.result: 在 BONES-SEED 数据集上，SemPhys 基本保持了从参考动作到执行动作的指令检索准确率，并在所评估方法中于执行动作上取得最高的检索准确率。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐应以可执行动作为评估与优化对象；通过可微执行预测与整段轨迹语义评分，可在不修改跟踪控制器的前提下有效提升执行层语义一致性，配对锚定损失保证了训练稳定性。

title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
summary: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

AI.tldr: 一家全球性银行创新实验室对10个Agentic AI平台在3类金融业务场景、9个能力维度上开展"bakeoff"式评估：平台可稳定分为三个梯队，但维度间Cronbach's α=0.98、8/9维度与总分的秩相关≥0.93，显示存在明显光环效应——演示式打分更多测量"呈现能力"而非"真实能力"；据此提出"先门控后打分"的四层评估协议。
AI.motivation: 企业采购Agentic AI平台的速度远超其可测量速度：公开基准只在固定脚手架中评测模型，而企业实际采购的是编排、记忆、治理与工具层占主导的集成平台，且主要依赖厂商演示做决策，缺乏可靠的企业级评估方法。
AI.method: 由跨职能专家组对10个平台（开源框架、商业产品、超大规模云生态）在对手方信用风险、RAG、流程自动化三类工作负载上，按9个能力维度评分；进行替代权重下的稳健性检验、维度内部一致性（Cronbach's α）与维度-总分秩相关分析等二次统计。
AI.result: 评分将平台稳定分层为三个梯队且对权重方案稳健，并揭示被聚合分数掩盖的工作负载特异优势；但α=0.98、8/9维度与总分秩相关≥0.93，表明维度区分度不足、存在光环效应。
AI.conclusion: 演示式评估尚属"结构化判断"而非"测量"。提出含能力层、执行可靠性、治理门控、业务价值四层的"先门控后打分"协议，辅以重复运行估计的轨迹级可靠性指标、自主性就绪量表与可复现协议，并明确现有证据边界及受控测试台需补充的要素。

title: ROBIN++: Unified Copyright Protection and Tamper Localization for Diffusion Models via Dual-Domain Synergistic Watermarking
summary: Digital watermarking provides a promising solution for verifying the provenance and integrity of generated content. However, existing methods often suffer from an inherent trade-off between copyright robustness and localization sensitivity due to the entanglement of conflicting signals within a single domain. In this paper, we propose ROBIN++, a paradigm that shifts from single-domain entanglement to a Dual-Domain Synergistic design. Our key insight is to explicitly decouple robustness and fragility during injection by assigning them to distinct domains, while re-coupling them for mutual reinforcement during verification. Specifically, we introduce an Adversarial Optimization Algorithm to inject a frequency-domain copyright watermark during generation, maximizing extraction robustness without visual artifacts. Complementarily, a Content-Aware Perturbation generator is integrated into the latent space to inject the spatial-domain localization watermark, ensuring sensitivity to spatial tampering with minimal interference to the copyright watermark. During verification, we propose a dual-branch synergistic detector that facilitates Frequency-to-Spatial Synergy, where robust spectral priors act as global anchors for local anomaly detection. Conversely, a Spatial-to-Frequency Refinement strategy is employed to rectify corrupted latent features using predicted tamper masks. Extensive experiments show that ROBIN++ significantly outperforms existing approaches in both copyright recovery and tamper localization accuracy, effectively mitigating the long-standing trade-off between the two tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Hannah1102/ROBIN.

AI.tldr: 提出ROBIN++，用“双域协同”替代单域纠缠：频域注入版权水印、空间域注入定位水印，验证时双分支协同，缓解鲁棒性与定位敏感性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有数字水印方法在单一域内混合冲突信号，导致版权鲁棒性与篡改定位敏感性之间存在固有折衷。
AI.method: 注入阶段显式解耦：用对抗优化算法在生成过程中注入频域版权水印以最大化提取鲁棒性且无视觉伪影；用内容感知扰动生成器在潜空间注入空间域定位水印，对空间篡改敏感且对版权水印干扰小。验证阶段再耦合：双分支协同检测器实现频域到空间协同（鲁棒频谱先验作全局锚点引导局部异常检测），并用篡改掩码预测进行空间到频域细化，修正受损潜特征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ROBIN++在版权恢复与篡改定位准确率上均显著优于现有方法，有效缓解二者的长期权衡。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 双域解耦注入+协同验证的范式可同时提升水印鲁棒性与篡改定位精度，为生成内容溯源与完整性验证提供新思路。

title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
summary: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. The resulting readout is globally optimal for the rank-constrained receiver objective and preserves at least as much response energy as spectral truncation under the diagonal metric. RASA also introduces spectral-reference aggregation, which removes the personalized initialization offset while retaining the locally learned increment. Experiments on DomainNet-100, NICO++, GLUE, and SuperNI demonstrate RASA's effectiveness across methods under resource, task, and data heterogeneity. In particular, RASA improves DomainNet-100 accuracy by 3.23 percentage points with FlexLoRA and achieves gains of up to 8.33 ROUGE-L points on seen SuperNI tasks and 4.37 on unseen tasks with modest overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出RASA插件框架，用接收端加权响应的无中心PCA替代谱截断进行LoRA聚合更新分发，实现rank约束下的全局最优读回。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦LoRA方法按奇异方向能量大小截断聚合更新以适配各客户端rank预算，但重构矩阵最优的方向未必对接收端输入响应最优，低能量方向可能对该客户端更重要；作者形式化了该错配并证明矩阵最优截断的响应误差可比同rank的其它读回任意大。
AI.method: RASA利用紧凑的对角输入二阶矩，对接收端加权后的更新响应做无中心PCA，得到rank约束接收端目标下的全局最优读回，并理论上保证在对角度量下保留的响应能量不少于谱截断；同时提出谱参考聚合，去除个性化初始化偏置、仅保留本地学习增量。
AI.result: 在DomainNet-100、NICO++、GLUE、SuperNI上验证了在资源、任务与数据异构下的有效性：配合FlexLoRA使DomainNet-100准确率提升3.23个百分点；SuperNI已见任务ROUGE-L最高提升8.33、未见任务提升4.37，开销可控。
AI.conclusion: 接收端感知的子空间读回优于能量式谱截断，可作为即插即用组件提升异构联邦LoRA微调效果，且附加开销小。

title: Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms?
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on The Action Gap (TAG 2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=b7wZqqQzON
summary: VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task's closed-loop episodes, against the original word's 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens' vectors with the other landmark's (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. Hiding the landmark tokens from the action generator after the connector still lowers completion for the synonyms that fall short. Finetuning on diversified landmark words repairs that one task's completion for synonyms absent from finetuning; finetuning on the original instructions does not. Training only the connector on the diversified words suffices, as does copying the connector of a policy fully finetuned on them into one finetuned on the original instructions. An open-loop score on starting frames misses that weights outside the connector also carry part of the repair. For now, on this evidence, robustness to rewording should be judged in closed loop, with actions executed, intervening on both sides of the connector, scoring choice and completion separately.

AI.tldr: 论文以 GR00T N1.7 为对象，在 LIBERO-Spatial 两个仅差地标词的闭环任务上做因果干预，发现 VLA 策略对改写指令的失败发生在连接器两侧，需分离评估"选择"与"完成"，且鲁棒性应闭环判定。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略对指令改写（近义词、生造词）敏感，但仅看成功率无法区分"选错物体"还是"选对但没做完"，也无法定位策略内部应在何处干预。作者希望建立可定位、可分解的评估范式，理解改写鲁棒性的表征来源与可修复性。
AI.method: 在 GR00T N1.7 上选取两个仅地标词不同的 LIBERO-Spatial 闭环任务；使用训练外同义词与生造词测试；在 VLM 与动作生成器之间的连接器前后做 token 向量粘贴（地标、指令其余部分、图像 token 单独与两两组合）与地标 token 遮蔽；再用多样化地标词微调、仅训练连接器、跨策略替换连接器、以及基于起始帧的开环评分进行对照分析。
AI.result: 同义词使 67.6% 的闭环回合完成（原词为 100%）；生造词不改变选择而训练外同义词会“照名字去拿”。连接器前粘贴地标向量几乎使所有回合换碗；连接器后单独粘贴地标/其余指令/图像 token 很少改变选择，但任意两个同时粘贴即可；连接器后遮蔽地标 token 仍降低同义词完成率。多样化词微调可修复同义词完成率，原词微调不行；仅训练连接器即足够，且可将该连接器复制到原词微调策略中。开环起始帧评分漏掉了连接器外部权重所承担的部分修复。
AI.conclusion: 改写鲁棒性应在闭环（真实执行动作）中评估，干预需覆盖连接器两侧，并分别打分"选择"与"完成"；连接器是必要但非全部的修复载体，开环指标不足以替代闭环诊断。

title: Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving
summary: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过反事实分析构建物体相关性的因果参考，在8万余个合成驾驶场景上评估注意力作为自动驾驶中物体相关性估计的有效性，发现注意力反映的是相关性而非因果性，且在复杂场景下精度下降。
AI.motivation: 注意力机制被广泛用于估计自动驾驶中周围物体的重要性并解释决策，但其能否捕捉单个输入元素对模型输出的因果影响一直存在争议（尤以NLP领域讨论居多）。作者希望把这一讨论引入自动驾驶领域，检验注意力对"物体对驾驶的影响"的估计准确度。
AI.method: 以基于PlanT 2.0（一种面向物体级规划的先进Transformer模型）的自动驾驶系统为对象，在超过80,000个合成驾驶场景中，将多种基于注意力的相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析得到的因果参考进行比较。
AI.result: 注意力给出的是相关性而非因果性的物体相关性指示；基于注意力的方法不能稳定识别出所有相关物体，且常把对驾驶几乎无影响的物体误判为相关；注意力在简单单车道直道场景中能有效识别相关物体，但在多车道道路、交叉口等复杂场景中准确率明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 注意力作为物体相关性的代理存在局限，需要能够准确刻画单个物体对驾驶的因果影响、并将其与相关性关联区分开的新方法。

title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline.

AI.tldr: Sightline 提出"验证窗口应与草稿器视野等长"的投机解码策略，配合足够宽的草稿树，在文本生成 SVG、图像生成 SVG 等任务上成为最快的无损解码器。
AI.motivation: SVG 生成模型逐 token 自回归写出图形代码，绘制速度慢；投机解码可无损加速，而块式草稿器一次可猜多个 token。作者观察到在 SVG 任务上，很多轮次会接受整块草稿、仅在验证窗口边界处终止，即"失败极少且成簇"，且块内深处仍保持较高准确率，说明现有验证窗口长度利用不足。
AI.method: 提出游程（run-length）恒等式与三个命题，从理论上说明：当候选足够宽时，延长验证窗口直至草稿器视野（horizon）可带来收益。据此设计 Sightline：验证窗口长度等于草稿器视野，草稿树宽度足以填满该窗口。
AI.result: 在 MMSVG、MMSVG-2M、SArena 六个基准上，覆盖 text-to-SVG 与 image-to-SVG、三个模型：所有设置下 Sightline 均为最快的无损解码器；在 SArena 上即使各解码器共享同一循环控制仍最快；在另外四个家族的六个模型（输出 SVG 代码、压缩 SVG token 或 Lottie JSON）上几乎全部领先。分析表明领先来自短窗口被截断的轮次，且无循环与含循环内容均有效；投机解码还使"按渲染结果采样"更省时，且优于按似然选择。
AI.conclusion: 矢量图形上的投机解码应"看到多远就验证多远"（verify as far as the drafter sees）。代码与数据见 https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/Sightline。

title: Interpreting Timestamp Permutations in Dynamic Link Prediction
comment: 5 pages total (ACM sigconf format). Companion code and trained models: https://github.com/karpovilia/tgn
summary: Timestamp permutations are used to test whether dynamic link predictors exploit temporal information, but a performance gap can reflect changes in training, evaluation history, or both. We separate these effects with a crossed diagnostic and measure input exposure: whether altered histories actually change the predictor's inputs. On MOOC, TCL trained with binary cross-entropy gains approximately eight pairwise-accuracy points from original-chronology training under either evaluation history, while changing history at fixed weights gives only 0.03 points. The small history contrast reflects unchanged inputs for 68.37% of queries, stable rankings for most others, and cancellation of gains and losses. Under original evaluation history, suppressing explicit time encoding reduces the training contrast from 8.03 to 3.64 points, a paired reduction of 4.39 points (95% interval [3.68, 5.09]) across six seeds. DyGFormer shows corresponding training and history contrasts of 22.34 and 0.38 points across two seeds, despite greater exposure. Partial history permutations further separate nominal intervention strength, input changes, and aggregate accuracy. These comparisons turn a single permutation gap into interpretable statements about training conditions and model responses, while leaving the internal mechanisms of temporal learning open.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"交叉诊断"(crossed diagnostic)框架，将时间戳置换实验中观察到的性能差距分解为"训练效应"与"评估历史效应"，并引入"输入暴露"(input exposure)指标衡量历史改变是否真正改变了预测器输入。在MOOC数据上，TCL(二元交叉熵训练)从原始时序训练中获得约8个成对准确率百分点的增益，而固定权重下改变历史仅带来0.03点，说明差距主要来自训练条件而非评估历史；约68.37%的查询输入未改变、其余排序稳定及增益损失相互抵消解释了历史对比之小。
AI.motivation: 时间戳置换常被用来检验动态链路预测器是否利用了时间信息，但单一的性能差距无法区分其来源：是训练过程发生了变化、评估所依据的历史发生了变化，还是两者兼有。这种归因上的模糊性使得置换实验结果难以被解释为对模型时间学习能力的证据，因此需要一个能把混杂效应分离出来的诊断方法。
AI.method: 设计交叉诊断实验：对"训练历史"与"评估历史"两个因素进行交叉组合，从而分别估计训练对比(train contrast)与历史对比(history contrast)。同时定义输入暴露度量，直接检验被改动的历史是否实际改变了预测器的输入。进一步通过抑制显式时间编码、以及对历史做部分置换，将名义干预强度、输入改变程度与聚合准确率三者分离。在MOOC与DyGFormer等设置上进行多随机种子实验并给出配对置信区间。
AI.result: MOOC上TCL的8点增益在两种评估历史下都成立，固定权重改变历史仅0.03点；历史对比小可归因于68.37%查询输入不变、多数其余查询排序稳定以及增益与损失抵消。原始评估历史下，抑制显式时间编码使训练对比从8.03降至3.64点，配对下降4.39点(95%区间[3.68,5.09]，六个种子)。DyGFormer在两个种子下训练对比与历史对比分别为22.34与0.38点，尽管其输入暴露更高。部分历史置换进一步区分了名义干预强度、输入变化与聚合准确率。
AI.conclusion: 交叉诊断把单一置换差距转化为关于训练条件与模型响应的可解释陈述，并揭示了训练效应占主导、评估历史效应微弱的结论，同时指出输入暴露是解释历史对比的关键中介量。作者明确保留了时间学习内部机制的开放性，该框架不解释模型内部如何编码时间，仅提供行为层面的归因工具。

title: Lost Between Mind, Model Collaboration, and Motion: Understanding and Measuring Cross-Model Action Misalignment in Commercial Robots
summary: Embodied robots increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to interpret user intent and coordinate with robot-specific action models for physical interaction. This multi-model pipeline creates a critical semantic boundary across mind, model collaboration, and motion: semantic consistency may break between what the large model understands, how the small action model translates that understanding into executable commands, and what physical actions the robot ultimately performs. As a security consequence, commercial robots may execute unintended physical actions even when user inputs contain no explicit action commands. To measure this problem, we develop TARS, a black-box framework that explores the command-reasoning-action pipeline and automatically discovers and validates unintended physical behaviors. We evaluate TARS on four commercial robots across 44 experimental settings, conducting 133,400 executions. TARS uncovers widespread cross-model action misalignment and achieves up to 94% verified action coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出黑盒框架TARS，用于探测具身机器人"命令—推理—动作"流水线中跨模型的语义不一致，并自动发现与验证非预期物理行为。
AI.motivation: 具身机器人依赖LLM理解用户意图，再由机器人专用小动作模型转化为可执行指令，形成多模型流水线。该流水线在"心智理解—模型协作—运动执行"之间存在关键语义边界，语义一致性可能在三个环节间断裂，导致即使输入不含显式动作命令，商业机器人也会执行非预期的物理动作，构成安全风险。
AI.method: 开发TARS黑盒框架，沿命令—推理—动作链路进行探索，自动发现并验证非预期物理行为；在4款商业机器人、44种实验设置下开展评估，共执行133,400次。
AI.result: TARS揭示出普遍存在的跨模型动作错位（cross-model action misalignment），验证动作覆盖率最高达94%。
AI.conclusion: 多模型语义边界是具身机器人现实且广泛存在的安全隐患，TARS可作为黑盒自动化审计手段有效度量并验证该问题。

title: 3D GameDev Arena: Benchmarking Coding Agents That Plan, Build, and Playtest extreme Long-Horizon Browser Games
summary: Coding agents now resolve repository issues and generate compact playable games, but whether they can build a large 3D game from scratch remains open. Such games tightly couple mechanics, scenes, assets, and interaction logic, and their quality rests on player enjoyment, which existing benchmarks rarely assess. Thus, we introduce 3D GameDev Arena, a first extreme long-horizon benchmark of 108 from-scratch game-development tasks across 14 genres. Given only a text specification and UI/UX reference images, a fully automated plan--implement--test--repair pipeline builds each task into a self-contained browser game. Runs average $\sim$1,000 LLM calls ; the longest uses 14,407 calls, 2.13B tokens, and 608 assets. Evaluation spans (1) objective code-level functional acceptance against the game specification, (2) agent-based QA and playtesting of 3D presentation and playability, and (3) blind pairwise Bradley-Terry human preference in a public arena. The preliminary findings indicate that long-horizon 3D game development remains far from solved, and code-level correctness alone does not dictate player preference. The public arena is hosted online.

AI.tldr: 提出3D GameDev Arena——首个面向从零开发3D游戏的超长周期基准，含14类108个任务，通过全自动plan–implement–test–repair流水线生成浏览器游戏，并从代码级功能验收、智能体QA与试玩、公开竞技场人类盲测偏好三个维度评估。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体已能修复仓库issue、生成小型可玩游戏，但能否从零构建大型3D游戏尚不明确；此类游戏强耦合机制、场景、资产与交互逻辑，且质量取决于玩家体验，而现有基准很少评估可玩性与玩家偏好。
AI.method: 构建108个从零游戏开发任务、覆盖14种类型的超长周期基准；仅给文本规格与UI/UX参考图，由全自动plan–implement–test–repair流水线生成自包含浏览器游戏；评估含三部分：(1)依据游戏规格的客观代码级功能验收，(2)针对3D表现与可玩性的智能体QA与试玩，(3)公开竞技场中的盲测两两Bradley-Terry人类偏好评估。
AI.result: 单次运行平均约1,000次LLM调用，最长任务达14,407次调用、2.13B tokens、608个资产；初步结果显示长周期3D游戏开发仍远未解决，且代码级正确性本身并不决定玩家偏好。
AI.conclusion: 3D游戏从零开发对现有智能体仍是开放难题；功能正确性与玩家体验之间存在错位，需同时以代码级验收和人类偏好评估衡量能力；竞技场已在线公开。

title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
summary: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PReMind-Bench诊断基准与PReMind两阶段强化学习框架，用于训练个性化视觉语言助手将可见危险与用户个人记忆（过敏、疾病、行动限制）结合，联合成功率从12.9%提升至28.6%。
AI.motivation: 个性化视觉语言助手需同时识别画面中的物理危险并调用相关用户个人上下文，才能给出恰当建议。现有模型往往满足其中一项却失败于另一项；仅针对安全性或仅针对个性化训练都会留下联合成功率的缺口，且缺乏能分解评估这一能力的诊断性基准。
AI.method: 构建PReMind-Bench基准，覆盖多样危险与个人记忆条件，分别度量记忆访问、视觉定位、正确弃答与危险响应，并在相互依赖样本上评估联合成功。提出PReMind两阶段强化学习框架，融合按需调用与强制调用（始终检索记忆）两种交互方式，联合训练基于视觉证据的记忆使用与危险响应能力。
AI.result: 在4B规模下，PReMind在相互依赖集合上将联合成功率由基线的12.9%提升至28.6%，并在主测试集上改善危险响应恰当性与正确弃答率。联合成功增益在强制调用设置下、以及在三个Phase II随机种子下由第二位LLM评判时均保持；这些种子的平均值显示，在未见危险类别上联合成功率同样提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，评估与训练个人助理时需将其视觉证据与相关用户上下文显式连接；分离式能力评测与联合强化训练是弥补"安全—个性化"双重需求缺口的关键。

title: When Normal-Only Updates Are Not Enough: Test-Time Adaptation in Reconstruction-Based Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Normal operating conditions can evolve after deployment, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) of time-series anomaly detectors using incoming data. Yet the same stream may contain anomalies, so TTA with online updates must decide which test samples should be used for adaptation. This leaves a more basic question: even if updates are restricted to samples labeled as normal in the benchmark, does TTA reliably improve anomaly detection? We study this question with a controlled intervention that replaces the practical update selector with a rule that uses only samples labeled as normal in the benchmark, while keeping the rest of the online adaptation procedure unchanged. Across nine benchmark families, four optimizer configurations, and five random seeds, we obtain three main findings: (1) using only samples labeled as normal in the benchmark does not reliably improve detection; (2) practical TTA failures exhibit two distinct responses to this intervention, with 63 of 180 settings recovering a clear detection gain while 90 still show no clear detection gain; and (3) the updates reduce their immediate reconstruction objective across the evaluated settings, yet these reductions do not consistently lead to better anomaly ranking. Both failure patterns persist across alternative practical adaptation variants and modest perturbations of the benchmark labels. Together, these findings show that improving sample selection alone is not a complete solution to reconstruction-based TSAD TTA.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控干预实验证明：即使把TTA的在线更新样本限制为基准中标注为正常的样本，基于重构的时序异常检测TTA仍不能可靠提升检测性能。
AI.motivation: 实际部署后运行条件会漂移，促使对时序异常检测器做测试时自适应（TTA）；但同一数据流中可能含异常，因此需决定哪些样本参与更新。作者想回答更基础的问题：即便仅用基准标注为正常的样本做更新，TTA是否可靠地改善异常检测？
AI.method: 设计受控干预：将实际的更新样本选择器替换为仅使用基准中标注为正常样本的规则，其余在线自适应流程保持不变；在9个基准族、4种优化器配置、5个随机种子（共180个设置）上评估，并考察多种实际TTA变体与标签轻微扰动下的稳健性。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 仅用标注为正常的样本并不能可靠提升检测；(2) 失败设置呈两种响应——180个设置中63个恢复出明显增益，90个仍无明确增益；(3) 各设置下更新确实降低了即时重构目标，但该下降未稳定转化为更好的异常排序；这两种失败模式在变体与标签扰动下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 仅改进样本选择并非重构式时序异常检测TTA的完整解决方案；重构目标降低与异常排序改善之间存在脱节，是TTA失效的关键症结。

title: Asymmetric Decomposition for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Unassigned Agents
summary: Robots without assigned tasks may obstruct active robots, while routing them to designated parking locations can cause unnecessary travel. This article proposes flow-oracle conflict-based search (FOCBS) for Multi-Agent Path Finding with unassigned agents (MAPF-UA). FOCBS searches over assigned-agent paths using conflict-based search (CBS) and routes targetless unassigned agents through a min-cost flow oracle. When the selected assigned-agent paths leave unassigned agents no collision-free paths, flow-conflict branching converts min-cut blockers into assigned-agent constraints, which guide the search without excluding optimal solutions. A batched zero-cost warm start accelerates the oracle, and start-avoiding tie-breaking reduces unassigned-agent movement. For feasible instances on finite graphs, we prove termination and global minimization of assigned-agent sum of service time, measured by last-arrival times. Unassigned-agent movement is minimized conditional on the selected assigned-agent paths, without a global lexicographic optimality guarantee. Benchmark experiments show that FOCBS scales well with the number of unassigned agents, and ablation studies show that, compared with discarding non-completable assigned-agent paths, flow-conflict branching solves substantially more instances while retaining optimality. Simulation and physical-robot experiments demonstrate plan executability, with laboratory tests reducing fleet travel by 40.8% relative to the parking-based coordination baseline. The source code and related resources are available at https://github.com/Chin-hsi/focbs

AI.tldr: 提出FOCBS算法求解含未分配智能体的多智能体路径规划（MAPF-UA），用CBS搜索已分配智能体路径、用最小费用流oracle为无目标未分配智能体规划路径，并证明有限图上终止性与服务时间总和全局最优。
AI.motivation: 未分配任务的机器人会阻塞在役机器人，而将其统一调度至固定停车位又会引入不必要行驶。已有MAPF方法缺乏对"空闲/未分配智能体"的显式建模与高效联合优化。
AI.method: FOCBS在已分配智能体路径空间上运行冲突基搜索（CBS）；目标less的未分配智能体通过最小费用流oracle求解路径。当所选的已分配路径使未分配智能体无无碰撞可行路径时，采用"流冲突分支"：将最小割阻塞者转化为已分配智能体约束，从而不排除最优解。另设计批量零成本热启动加速oracle，并用规避起点的tie-breaking减少未分配智能体移动。
