AI.result: 对有限图上的可行实例，证明算法终止且已分配智能体服务时间总和（以最后到达时刻度量）全局最小；未分配智能体移动量在给定已分配路径下最小化，但无全局字典序最优保证。基准实验显示FOCBS对未分配智能体数量扩展性良好；消融实验表明，相较丢弃不可完成的已分配路径，流冲突分支在保持最优性的同时可求解显著更多实例。仿真与实机实验验证了方案可执行性，实验室测试相较停车式协调基线降低车队总行程40.8%。
AI.conclusion: FOCBS为MAPF-UA提供了兼具有最优性保证与良好扩展性的求解框架，流冲突分支是其求解能力的关键，实机结果验证了实用价值；代码已开源。

title: Recurrent Domain Incremental Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
summary: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide strong representations for downstream classification tasks. Yet adapting a TSFM under changing operating conditions remains challenging. A model must improve on each newly observed condition without sacrificing conditions it has already learned, often from only a small labeled calibration set and without knowing the operating condition at inference time. We find that this difficulty has an important geometric structure. Under an operating-condition shift, the embedding space of a TSFM does not move uniformly: some local regions change substantially, while others remain nearly unchanged. Consequently, a global adaptation can unnecessarily move embeddings that were already correctly classified. To address this, we propose the novel PACT (Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport). PACT partitions the frozen source embedding space into local charts and learns lightweight residual transports for the regions affected by each new condition. An explicit identity path is always retained, and a learned gate softly selects among the identity and accumulated transports for each input. The pretrained TSFM encoder, classifier head, and previously learned transports remain fixed. With only 5% labeled calibration data per arriving condition and no condition identity at test time, PACT maintains an average macro-F1 above 0.95 across a four-condition bearing-fault stream. Under homogeneous tasks and label spaces, similar retention-adaptation behavior is observed across public benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Sachithx/PACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACT（Piecewise Adaptation via Chart Transport），利用 TSFM 嵌入空间的非均匀几何结构，将冻结的源嵌入空间划分为局部图卡，并为受新工况影响的区域学习轻量残差传输，从而在持续工况变化下兼顾适应与保持。
AI.motivation: 预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）可为下游分类提供强表征，但在工况变化下持续适应仍困难：模型需在仅有少量标注校准集、且推理时不知工况身份的条件下，对新工况提升而不遗忘已学工况。作者发现该困难具有几何结构——工况偏移下嵌入空间并非整体均匀移动，部分局部区域显著变化、其余几乎不变，因此全局适应会不必要地扰动原本已正确分类的嵌入。
AI.method: PACT 将冻结的源嵌入空间划分为若干局部图卡（charts），仅针对受各新工况影响的区域学习轻量残差传输（residual transports）；始终保留显式恒等路径，并用学习到的门控（gate）对每个输入在恒等路径与累积传输之间做软选择；预训练 TSFM 编码器、分类头及先前学到的传输均保持冻结。
AI.result: 在每个新到工况仅使用 5% 标注校准数据、且测试时无工况身份信息的设定下，PACT 在四工况轴承故障流上平均 macro-F1 保持高于 0.95；在同质任务与标签空间的公开基准上也观察到类似的“保持—适应”行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于嵌入空间局部非均匀变化的几何洞察，PACT 以“图卡划分 + 残差传输 + 门控选择 + 编码器冻结”的机制实现了参数高效且不遗忘的持续工况适应，在低标注、未知工况身份条件下表现出色的保持与适应性能。

title: SWIFT: Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely Action for Asynchronous Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving scenes keep changing during model computation, making both observation freshness and action-delivery time central to world-action planning. To retain rich generative world priors in autonomous driving without stalling real-time control, we present SWIFT (Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely action), a deployment-oriented asynchronous world-action system that moves world updates off the observation-to-action critical path. On a background GPU, a slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span that covers both the update interval and background world computation. On a foreground GPU, a lightweight freshness carrier encodes current surround-view images into a gated key/value bank at every step, letting a fast Action DiT combine live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without waiting. On open-loop NAVSIM, SWIFT reaches 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms per decision with a trajectory scorer; on closed-loop Bench2Drive, it achieves an 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency. SWIFT further transfers to the Waymo E2E hidden test (8.0050 Rater Feedback Score) and nuScenes (0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate). Across all four benchmarks, SWIFT achieves the best results among compared world-action methods, establishing a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: SWIFT 是一个面向部署的异步 world-action 系统，将世界模型更新移出"观测→动作"关键路径：后台 GPU 上用慢速 Video DiT 流式生成只读预测世界上下文，前台 GPU 上用轻量 freshness carrier 每步编码环视图像为门控 KV bank，使快速 Action DiT 无需等待即可融合实时视觉反馈与最新完成的世界上下文。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶场景在模型计算过程中持续变化，观测新鲜度与动作下发时延成为 world-action 规划的核心。若保留丰富的生成式世界先验，常规做法会拖慢实时控制；若追求实时性又牺牲世界模型能力。作者希望在不牺牲世界先验的前提下满足实时控制需求。
AI.method: 1) 异步双 GPU 架构：后台 GPU 运行慢速 Video DiT，将环视历史流式转为只读预测世界上下文；2) 预测跨度（predictive span）训练覆盖更新间隔与后台世界计算时间，保证上下文在动作时刻仍然有效；3) 前台 GPU 的轻量 freshness carrier 每步把当前环视图像编码为门控 key/value bank；4) 快速 Action DiT 将实时视觉反馈与最新完成的世界上下文结合，无需等待后台更新。
AI.result: 开环 NAVSIM：94.2 PDMS，单次决策 198.4 ms（含轨迹打分器）；闭环 Bench2Drive：80.30 Driving Score，前台延迟 109.9 ms；迁移至 Waymo E2E 隐藏测试：8.0050 Rater Feedback Score；nuScenes：平均终点误差 0.54 m，平均碰撞率 0.03%。四个基准上均为对比 world-action 方法中的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过在系统层面解耦"世界模型更新"与"动作生成"，SWIFT 在不牺牲生成式世界先验的情况下实现了实时控制，取得有利的精度-延迟权衡，并展现出跨数据集（NAVSIM、Bench2Drive、Waymo、nuScenes）的良好泛化性。

title: A Systematic Analysis of a Small Optimal Subspace for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: $n$-DAS $\subset \mathbb{R}^p$
comment: 57 pages, 17 figures, 7 tables. In the title, n-DAS denotes an optimizer of order n restricted to the dominant aligned subspace (DAS): 1-DAS for first-order and 2-DAS for second-order methods
summary: The search for a low-dimensional subspace that governs neural network training has been a persistent goal in optimization. Yet subspaces defined by Hessian eigenvalue magnitude, such as the dominant/bulk decomposition underlying Dom-SGD and Bulk-SGD, have repeatedly failed to capture where optimization takes place, and adaptive Krylov-based alternatives built on energy-fraction thresholds show promise but still struggle at lower eigenmodes. We argue this failure is structural: the directions of highest curvature are not, in general, the directions along which training moves. We introduce the dominant aligned subspace (DAS), constructed from a full eigendecomposition of the Hessian but selected by gradient alignment rather than eigenvalue magnitude, as a tool for understanding optimization dynamics and a foundation for designing methods that exploit them. To expose this structure under the hardest conditions, we use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) as a testbed: differential operators from the parabolic, elliptic, and hyperbolic classes induce severely ill-conditioned, anisotropic loss landscapes. Across Poisson, heat, wave, and viscous Burgers benchmarks DAS-restricted training with a line search matches full-space training even where the projected Hessian remains ill-conditioned, showing empirically that convergence does not require all Hessian eigendirections but only a low-dimensional, gradient-aligned subset. We extend the analysis to Gauss-Newton within the DAS and discuss what this structure implies for future subspace-aware optimizers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主导对齐子空间"(DAS)：用Hessian全特征分解得到特征方向，但按梯度对齐度而非特征值大小筛选，用以刻画神经网络训练真正发生的低维子空间。
AI.motivation: 寻找支配训练的低维子空间是优化领域的长期目标，但基于Hessian特征值幅度的子空间（Dom-SGD、Bulk-SGD的主导/体部分解）反复无法捕捉优化实际发生的位置；基于能量分数阈值的自适应Krylov方法虽有前景，却在低阶特征模态上表现不佳。作者主张这种失败是结构性的：曲率最大的方向一般并非训练移动的方向。
AI.method: 构造DAS：对Hessian做全特征分解，以梯度对齐度（而非特征值幅度）作为选取准则，将其作为理解优化动力学的工具及设计新方法的基础。为在最严苛条件下暴露该结构，采用物理信息神经网络(PINN)作为测试平台——抛物型、椭圆型、双曲型微分算子诱导出严重病态、各向异性的损失曲面；并在DAS内进一步推广到Gauss-Newton分析。
AI.result: 在Poisson、热传导、波动与粘性Burgers基准上，采用线搜索的DAS受限训练达到与全空间训练相当的效果，即便投影后的Hessian仍然病态；这从经验上表明收敛无需全部Hessian特征方向，而只需一个低维、与梯度对齐的子集。
AI.conclusion: 收敛所需的仅是低维梯度对齐子集而非全部特征方向，特征值大小导向的子空间选取存在结构性缺陷；该结论为未来子空间感知优化器的设计提供了依据与方向。

title: Ego2X: Contact-aware Transfer from Egocentric Human Data to Any Robot
summary: Embodied models depend on real interaction data, yet collecting it on physical robots is slow and labor-intensive. Recent ego-to-robot pipelines retarget first-person view human videos to robot data via transferring hand and arm motion. They judge fidelity mainly by visual appearance. However, trajectories often fail in terms of physics: fingers hover beside objects, and grippers close on empty space. We argue that how the object moves and the contacts that drive the motion count. Thus, we present Ego2X, an object-centric framework that converts monocular egocentric video into physically executable robot data across dexterous hands and parallel grippers. Ego2X centers on CORE (Contact-centric Object-interaction REpresentation), which records each contact on the object by its surface anchor, as well as relative force, grasp mode, and interaction state. Throughout the pipeline, CORE corrects hand-object drift via object-relative constraints, steers inverse kinematics toward contacts the robot must realize, and preserves held objects during arm erasure and robot compositing. On HOT3D, contact-driven correction reduces in-contact hand depth error by 33.7%, while on EgoDex, contact-driven retargeting realizes 62.9% of annotated contacts, surpassing the official HuRo pipeline (27.9%). In RoboTwin 2.0, post-training X-VLA on Ego2X episodes alone, without simulator demonstrations, raises task success rate from 40.5% zero-shot to 67.0% across 200 paired scenes. We will publicly release our conversion pipeline and CORE-annotated dataset for dexterous hands and parallel grippers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego2X，一个以物体为中心的框架，将单目第一人称视频转换为可在灵巧手与平行夹爪上物理执行的真机数据。其核心表示 CORE 在物体表面锚点上记录接触及相对力、抓取模式与交互状态，用于校正手-物漂移、引导逆运动学并保持持物一致性。实验表明该方法显著降低接触深度误差、提升接触实现率，并能在无仿真示教下通过后训练提升下游任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 具身模型依赖真实交互数据，而真机采集慢且成本高。现有的"第一人称视频→机器人数据"重定向流程仅以视觉外观评估保真度，导致轨迹在物理层面不可行：手指悬在物体旁、夹爪在空处闭合。作者主张应关注物体如何运动以及驱动运动的接触关系。
AI.method: 提出 Ego2X 物体中心框架，核心是接触中心物体交互表示 CORE：以物体表面锚点记录每次接触，并附带相对力、抓取模式与交互状态。在流程中，CORE 通过物体相对约束纠正手-物漂移，引导逆运动学朝向机器人必须实现的接触，并在手臂擦除与机器人合成过程中保持被持物体一致。覆盖灵巧手与平行夹爪。
AI.result: HOT3D 上接触驱动校正将接触状态下手部深度误差降低 33.7%；EgoDex 上接触驱动重定向实现 62.9% 的标注接触，超过官方 HuRo 流程的 27.9%；RoboTwin 2.0 中仅在 Ego2X 生成片段上后训练 X-VLA（不使用仿真示教），在 200 个配对场景上将任务成功率从零样本 40.5% 提升至 67.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以接触与物体运动为核心的表示能有效弥补外观导向重定向的物理缺陷，生成可执行的机器人数据并直接支撑策略学习。作者将公开转换流程及面向灵巧手与平行夹爪的 CORE 标注数据集。

title: Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Embodied Graph, a relational state abstraction that supports structured dynamics modeling and long-horizon imagination, and the Relational World Model (RWM), which performs imagination directly over graph states. RWM consists of (i) a Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor that filters redundant details and maintains graph memory through online updates, and (ii) an Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model that learns node-wise latent dynamics while capturing inter-node dependencies. The imagined graph states provide predictions of action consequences to guide decision-making. Experiments on Minecraft and Crafter demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM in embodied environments. Notably, in Minecraft, RWM is the only method that obtains diamonds within the given budget. Experiments on web interaction further illustrate the applicability of relational state prediction to the decision making process of web agents.

AI.tldr: 提出以关系图状态抽象为基础的 Relational World Model（RWM），在稀疏图状态上进行想象式规划，缓解长时程任务中冗余像素信息与误差累积问题，在 Minecraft、Crafter 与网页交互任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 具身与网页环境中的长时程任务具有长决策序列与延迟反馈，世界模型通过潜在动力学做想象式规划是可行路径；但现有方法仅依赖稠密的像素级观测，迫使模型吸收冗余信息，同时忽视任务相关实体间的关系，导致小误差在长时程想象滚动中累积并逐渐破坏预测。
AI.method: 提出 Embodied Graph 这一关系型状态抽象，支持结构化动力学建模与长时程想象；并构建 Relational World Model（RWM），直接在图上进行想象。RWM 包含：(i) Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor，过滤冗余细节并通过在线更新维护图记忆；(ii) Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model，学习节点级潜在动力学并捕捉节点间依赖关系。想象得到的图状态用于预测动作后果以指导决策。
AI.result: 在 Minecraft 与 Crafter 的具身环境中实验表明 RWM 有效；在 Minecraft 中，RWM 是唯一在给定预算内获得钻石的方法。网页交互实验进一步说明关系型状态预测可应用于网页智能体的决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 以稀疏关系图状态替代稠密像素观测作为世界模型的想象空间，可有效抑制冗余信息与误差累积，实现可靠的长时程想象与规划，并具备向具身与网页两类决策场景推广的适用性。

title: Mapping the Design Space of Feature Sampling for Optical Flow
summary: The computation of correlation features is crucial for optical flow estimation. Existing methods (e.g., RAFT) perform fixed-radius lookups on a cost volume, yielding a set of correlation features for each position; alternatively, WAFT performs single-point feature indexing, yielding one correlation feature vector per position. None of them designs a suitable correlation feature sampling scheme for each position according to regional characteristics. Our insight is that not every position requires the same sampling scheme. Applying an identical sampling scheme to every position is either redundant or insufficient and ignores the specific characteristics of the corresponding region. This paper rethinks the design of feature sampling and investigates the following question: should the support of feature sampling---i.e., the extent and directions over which evidence is aggregated---be learned separately for each query position? To study this question, we propose SAGE (Sampling with Anisotropic Gaussian Expectation). This method replaces single-point sampling with a per-pixel anisotropic Gaussian expectation on a fixed candidate grid centered on the current optical flow estimate. A positive-definite precision matrix controls the scale, anisotropy, and orientation of the sampling support, with single-point sampling included as its limiting case. Consequently, the sampling support becomes an explicit and analyzable design variable and provides a principled way to analyze how directional feature aggregation affects correspondence learning. Extensive experiments show that SAGE, while adding only 1.5% multiply-accumulate operations (MACs), effectively improves zero-shot cross-dataset generalization. When trained only on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings, SAGE reduces the end-point error (EPE) by 24.2% and 16.4% on Sintel clean and final, and reduces KITTI F1-epe and F1-all by 7.2% and 11.6%.

AI.tldr: SAGE：用逐像素各向异性高斯期望替代固定半径/单点相关采样，将采样支撑域（尺度、各向异性、方向）作为可学习、可分析的显式设计变量，仅增1.5% MACs即显著提升光流零样本跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有光流方法（如RAFT）在代价体上做固定半径查找，或WAFT做单点索引，对所有位置采用同一采样方案。作者认为不同位置的区域特性不同，统一采样要么冗余要么不足，且忽略了对应区域的具体特征，因此需要研究：特征采样的支撑域（聚合证据的范围与方向）是否应针对每个查询位置单独学习。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Sampling with Anisotropic Gaussian Expectation）：以当前光流估计为中心构造固定候选网格，将单点采样替换为逐像素各向异性高斯期望；由正定精度矩阵控制采样支撑的尺度、各向异性与方向，单点采样作为其极限情形。由此采样支撑成为显式且可分析的设计变量，为分析方向性特征聚合如何影响对应学习提供原则性途径。
AI.result: 仅增加1.5% MACs，有效提升零样本跨数据集泛化。仅在FlyingChairs与FlyingThings训练时：Sintel clean/final的EPE分别下降24.2%和16.4%；KITTI F1-epe与F1-all分别下降7.2%和11.6%。
AI.conclusion: 逐位置学习各向异性采样支撑域是有效且低开销的设计，验证了统一采样方案并非最优，为相关特征采样提供了可解释、可推广的新范式。

title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
comment: 87 pages, 43 figures, including appendices and the NeurIPS paper checklist
summary: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TabBioMed，一个包含 94 个精选公开生物医学表格数据集的规模化基准，覆盖 EHR、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学与系统生物学；通过标准化且数据集感知的预处理与评估框架统一分类、回归和多目标任务，基准测试了 23 个模型，发现基础模型族级性能最强但优势依赖数据机制，树模型与调优 MLP 在推理/训练成本约束下仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 机器学习在生物医学预测上进展迅速，但结构化生物医学数据的评估仍高度碎片化，尤其是高维、大样本、含缺失值和类别不平衡的数据集缺乏统一、可复现的比较标准，导致模型选择缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 构建 TabBioMed：精选 94 个公开生物医学表格数据集，覆盖 8 大领域；设计标准化、数据集感知（dataset-aware）的预处理与评估框架，统一分类、回归与多目标任务；在统一数据划分下基准测试 23 个模型，包括经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构与表格基础模型，并进行族级与机制依赖的对比分析。
AI.result: 表格基础模型在族级平均预测性能上最强；但其增益具有机制依赖性（regime-dependent），树模型与调优多层感知机仍具高度竞争力，在推理时或训练成本受限场景下往往占优。整体表明最优模型选择取决于数据机制、任务类型与计算预算。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学表格学习强烈依赖上下文，不存在普适最优模型；TabBioMed 开源发布精选数据集与划分、预处理代码、基线模型与结果，为实际模型选择与未来方法开发提供可复现基准（https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed）。

title: BiPathCPG: A Novel Load-Sharing Design Architecture for Compound Planetary Gearboxes
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://deepak-kapa.github.io/PancakeActuator/ Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuators are widely used in legged robots due to their low reflected inertia, high backdrivability, and high torque density, commonly employing planetary or cycloidal gearboxes. Single-stage planetary gearboxes offer high efficiency but limited torque density; multi-stage designs improve torque density at the cost of efficiency; and cycloidal gearboxes provide high stiffness but suffer from torque ripple. Compound Planetary Gearboxes (CPG) offer a compromise, but conventional designs result in increased actuator width, mass, and reduced torsional stiffness in 3D-printed actuators. This paper proposes the BiPath Compound Planetary Gearbox (BiPathCPG), a novel architecture that introduces an idle second-stage sun gear and load-sharing second-stage planets within the otherwise unused space of a conventional CPG to simultaneously improve stiffness, reduce actuator width, and reduce mass. An optimization framework computes BiPathCPG parameters for a given motor and target gear ratio. The architecture is validated through a 3D-printed proof-of-concept actuator design, benchmarked against a conventional CPG using custom-built test rigs. The BiPathCPG achieves a torsional stiffness of 1394 Nm/rad, a 1.70x improvement over the conventional CPG, with a 32% reduction in backlash, 25 g lower mass, and approximately 6.4 mm reduction in axial width, while achieving a peak stall torque of 36.49 Nm.

AI.tldr: 提出BiPathCPG（双路径复合行星齿轮箱）架构，在传统CPG未利用空间内引入惰性二级太阳轮与均载二级行星轮，同时提升刚度、减小轴向宽度与质量。
AI.motivation: QDD执行器常用行星/摆线减速器：单级行星效率高但扭矩密度低，多级行星提升扭矩密度却损失效率，摆线减速器刚度高但存在转矩脉动；复合行星齿轮箱（CPG）是折中方案，但传统设计在3D打印执行器中导致宽度、质量增加与扭转刚度下降。
AI.method: 提出BiPathCPG架构，利用传统CPG的闲置空间布置惰性二级太阳轮与均载（load-sharing）二级行星轮，形成双路径功率传递；并建立优化框架，针对给定电机与目标速比计算BiPathCPG参数；通过3D打印原理样机与自建试验台，与传统CPG进行对比基准测试。
AI.result: 扭转刚度1394 Nm/rad，为传统CPG的1.70倍；回差降低32%；质量减轻25 g；轴向宽度约减少6.4 mm；峰值堵转扭矩36.49 Nm。
AI.conclusion: BiPathCPG可在不牺牲扭矩输出的前提下同步改善刚度、回差、质量与轴向尺寸，为3D打印QDD执行器提供了一种可行的复合行星减速方案；后续需在更高负载与实际制造精度下进一步验证。

title: Fast Bayesian Methods for Uncertainty Quantification in Sparse AI Evaluation
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 AI Measurement Science Workshop
summary: Estimating how an AI system will perform on a new benchmark need not require another large model. We use public evaluation counts to choose a weak Beta prior, then update it exactly from at most 31 revealed outcomes. The predictor uses no item semantics, pretrained weights, or inference API. Its single online evaluation in the AIMS competition returned a team-reported Brier ALC of 0.188477, a 24.6% reduction from the constant-0.5 reference. The complete submission is 7,754 bytes; a server microbenchmark measures 12.71 microseconds per prediction with 31 matching labels. We describe how source evaluations are compressed into 301 prior means and show why a concentration of two lets new evidence rapidly determine the prediction. The resulting posterior gives exact uncertainty about the modelled success rate without numerical integration or neural inference. A public evaluation covers 79 system-benchmark pairs and eight seeds, reaching Brier ALC 0.200250 for the submitted method. Accompanying code and sufficient statistics reconstruct the fitted prior byte for byte and replay all 632 evaluation trajectories. The result demonstrates how much predictive value a compact Bayesian model can extract from sparse target feedback at very low online cost.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种极轻量的贝叶斯预测器：用公开评测计数构造弱Beta先验（浓度2），再用至多31个已揭示结果精确更新后验，无需条目语义、预训练权重或推理API，即在AIMS竞赛中取得Brier ALC 0.188477（较0.5基准降低24.6%）。
AI.motivation: 预测AI系统在新基准上的表现通常依赖大模型与推理API，成本高。作者希望验证：在极少在线反馈（≤31个标签）与极低计算/存储预算下，紧凑贝叶斯模型能否提取足够预测价值。
AI.method: 以公开评测计数压缩为301个先验均值，构造弱Beta先验（浓度取2），随后由已揭示结果按共轭Beta-二项精确更新；不做数值积分与神经推理，不使用条目语义或预训练权重。提交文件仅7,754字节。
AI.result: AIMS竞赛唯一一次在线评测Brier ALC=0.188477，较常数0.5基准降24.6%；服务器微基准每预测12.71微秒（31个匹配标签）。公开评测覆盖79个系统-基准对、8个随机种子，Brier ALC=0.200250。代码与充分统计量可逐字节重构先验并复现全部632条评测轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 弱先验+精确共轭更新可在稀疏目标反馈下以极低在线成本提供带精确不确定性的成功概率预测，说明紧凑贝叶斯模型具有可观预测价值，且结果完全可复现。

title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 Round 2. 20 pages, 7 figures
summary: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TOGBench——一个面向航空影像中微小目标（车辆、舰船、飞机等仅占数像素）生成保真度的定量、目标级评测基准，并给出两种训练/推理阶段的简单技术以提升布局到图像生成器渲染小目标的能力。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型已能合成逼真图像，但航空影像以微小目标为主，现有生成模型对小目标的表现显著劣于大目标；而以往生成评测侧重提示词遵循度或人类偏好，忽视了小目标是否被忠实渲染，这一缺陷被长期忽视。
AI.method: 构建TOGBench：一个定量、目标级的基准，用于评测航空影像中微小目标生成的保真度；同时提出两种训练期/推理期技术，改进布局到图像（layout-to-image）生成器渲染小目标的能力。
AI.result: 所提出的两种技术在TOGBench上提升了布局到图像生成器渲染小目标的性能。
AI.conclusion: 评测应转向目标级、小目标保真度维度；TOGBench为航空微小目标生成提供了量化标准，所提简单技术可有效改善现有生成器在该任务上的表现。

title: CAFE-AQI: Coverage-Aware Day-Ahead AQI Forecasting with Early Warning and Conformal Uncertainty in Bangladesh
summary: Next-day air quality forecasting often assumes city records are equally complete and independent. However, an audit of a large Bangladesh dataset revealed a sharp coverage expansion after August 2022 and showed that 103 city labels correspond to only 61 unique AQI trajectories. To address these issues, this paper presents CAFE-AQI, a coverage-aware framework for forecasting next-day maximum AQI. It also estimates the probability of Unhealthy-or-worse conditions (AQI >= 151). Data were divided chronologically into training (2022-2023), calibration (2024), and testing (2025). To prevent duplicate records from dominating training and evaluation, identical trajectories were weighted. The framework combines temporal and pollutant features with a five-neighbor spatial context. It also includes a class-balanced warning head and risk-conditional conformal calibration aimed at providing early warnings and prediction intervals. Evaluation on the duplicate-balanced 2025 data gave an MAE of 9.76, an RMSE of 15.04, and an R-squared value of 0.910 for CAFE-AQI. Its MAE was 3.63 AQI lower than persistence (95% CI: 3.49-3.76), with lower errors in each of the 61 trajectory groups. For unhealthy-air warnings, the F1-score was 0.908 and the AUROC was 0.982. The nominal 90% intervals covered 92.09% of observations. When an entire spatial block was excluded from training, the MAE remained 10.66, showing that the lightweight model transferred reasonably well to unseen locations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CAFE-AQI，一个覆盖感知的次日最大AQI预测框架，解决孟加拉国数据中城市标签重复（103个城市标签仅对应61条唯一AQI轨迹）与覆盖率突变问题，并提供不健康预警与预测区间。
AI.motivation: 次日空气质量预测通常假设城市记录完整且相互独立。但对孟加拉国大规模数据集的审计发现：2022年8月后覆盖范围急剧扩张，且103个城市标签实际仅对应61条唯一AQI轨迹，重复轨迹会主导训练与评估，导致模型评估失真。
AI.method: 按时间顺序划分训练集（2022—2023）、校准集（2024）和测试集（2025）；对完全相同的轨迹进行加权以抑制重复记录的影响；融合时间特征与污染物特征，并加入五近邻空间上下文；构建类别平衡的预警头，以及风险条件式保形校准（risk-conditional conformal calibration）以输出早预警和预测区间。
AI.result: 在去重平衡后的2025年数据上，MAE为9.76、RMSE为15.04、R²为0.910；MAE较持续性基线低3.63（95% CI: 3.49–3.76），且在全部61个轨迹组中误差均更低。不健康预警的F1为0.908、AUROC为0.982；名义90%区间实际覆盖92.09%。整块空间区域从训练中剔除后MAE仍为10.66。
AI.conclusion: 数据审计揭示的标签冗余与覆盖漂移是AQI预测中被忽视的关键偏差来源，去重加权与覆盖感知设计可显著提升评估可信度；CAFE-AQI以轻量模型在预测精度、极端事件预警、区间校准与空间迁移方面均表现稳健。

title: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
comment: Submitted to ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.

AI.tldr: 本文对Qwen、InternVL、LLaVA-OneVision三类通用视觉语言模型在三个机器人场景（HuRoN、Pal Robotics、CrowdBot）中预测机器人故障/不安全状态的能力进行实证评估，结合视频与里程计数据，考察安全/潜在不安全/不安全三分类性能、不确定性量化及其与性能的关系。
AI.motivation: VLM具备视觉信息处理与上下文推理能力，理论上适合在机器人故障发生前进行预测，但支持这一说法的实证证据仍然有限，需要系统性的经验评估来验证其可行性与适用配置。
AI.method: 构建跨三个机器人案例（HuRoN、Pal Robotics、CrowdBot）的实证评估框架；选取Qwen、InternVL、LLaVA-OneVision三种VLM；同时输入视频数据与里程计（robot-state）数据；将场景分类为安全、潜在不安全、不安全，实现早期预警（不安全事件发生前）；采用多种指标量化不确定性，并分析不确定性与预测性能之间的关系；消融机器人状态信息与时间历史的影响。
AI.result: Qwen在整体分类与预测可靠性上表现最强；InternVL在若干配置下展现出更强的早期预警能力；机器人状态信息与时间历史的作用依赖于具体模型与评估目标，并非一致正收益。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM可用于机器人早期安全监控，但最优配置取决于优先目标——是安全状态判定的准确性、置信度与不确定性的可靠性，还是不安全事件前的及时预警。

title: GALA: Gallery-Level Alignment for Real-Life Vision Decoding from EEG
summary: Neural decoding of visual experience from electroencephalography (EEG) has achieved strong performance in intra-subject settings, but current methods fail to generalize across individuals: on the standard 200-way benchmark THINGS-EEG-2, top-1 accuracy drops from above 80% within subjects to about 32% for an unseen subject. Adapting a pre-trained encoder to new subjects and sessions typically requires labeled data, a bottleneck whose collection time severely limits practical device deployment. In a practical Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), however, the possible outcomes are known in advance and form a gallery of candidates, and the unlabeled EEG of the user accumulates as soon as the device is used. We propose a new setting, incremental transductive calibration, in which the decoder is calibrated regularly on all the unlabeled EEG received so far and on the known gallery, without any labels. This setting is closer to the conditions of a deployed BCI than the zero-shot and batch evaluations in current use. We evaluate it with a protocol in which queries arrive one at a time, with unknown and possibly unequal frequencies, and each query is decoded before it is used for calibration. In this setting, we introduce GALA : GAllery-Level Alignment, a label-free calibration method which registers the unlabeled EEG embeddings onto the gallery through shrinkage whitening, hubness correction and a Sinkhorn--Procrustes alignment with query frequencies estimated from the buffer, updated after every query. On THINGS-EEG-2, with a gallery of 200 images, it raises the top-1 accuracy on a new subject from 28% to 67% over 53 minutes of use. Across 60 evaluation settings that vary the gallery size, the query frequencies and the number of repetitions averaged per query, GALA is the most accurate label-free method in every setting, 6.6 points above the best competing method on average at the end of the stream.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出增量直推校准（incremental transductive calibration）新设定，并给出无标签校准方法 GALA：通过收缩白化、hubness 校正与基于频次估计的 Sinkhorn–Procrustes 对齐，将新被试 EEG 嵌入配准到已知图像库。在 THINGS-EEG-2（200 类库）上，新被试 53 分钟内 top-1 从 28% 提升至 67%，并在 60 种评测设置下均为最优无标签方法。
AI.motivation: EEG 视觉解码在被试内表现优异，但跨被试泛化很差（THINGS-EEG-2 上从 >80% 降至约 32%）。适配新被试/新会话通常需要标注数据，而标注采集耗时，制约 BCI 设备落地。实际部署中候选结果（图像库）是先验已知的，且设备使用后无标签 EEG 会持续累积，因此现有零样本/批量评测方式与实际条件不符。
AI.method: 提出"增量直推校准"设定：解码器定期在所有已累积的无标签 EEG 与已知候选库上校准；评测协议为查询逐条到达、频次未知且可能不均衡、每条查询须先解码后加入校准。方法 GALA（Gallery-Level Alignment）为无标签校准：对无标签 EEG 嵌入做收缩白化（shrinkage whitening）、hubness 校正，以及利用缓冲区估计查询频次的 Sinkhorn–Procrustes 对齐，将嵌入配准到候选库，并在每条查询后更新。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG-2（200 类候选库）上，新被试 top-1 在 53 分钟使用中由 28% 提升至 67%。在改变候选库大小、查询频次分布、每条查询平均重复次数的 60 种设置下，GALA 在每种设置中均为最准确的无标签方法，流结束时平均比最佳对比方法高 6.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的直推式增量校准可显著缩小跨被试 EEG 解码的性能差距，且更贴近实际部署的 BCI 条件；GALA 在多种设置下的一致优越性表明，将已知候选库作为先验、把累积无标签数据用于在线配准，是跨被试脑解码的可行且有效路径。

title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReflectScene，一个由 MLLM 引导的闭环扩散框架，用于文本条件 3D 室内场景生成，在去噪过程中动态评估并修正物体布局。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散方法主要依赖静态文本条件，无法随生成过程演化地评估场景，也难以将语义差异转化为可执行的物体级修正；而基于 MLLM 的事后精修与去噪过程解耦，可能破坏场景连贯性。
AI.method: 包含三个组件：(1) 层次化先验锚定的场景理解，用冻结的多模态大模型将结构化布局与多视角视觉证据对齐，解读物体级上下文与全局语义；(2) MLLM 引导的语义奖励评估，将 MLLM 对候选修正的诊断与评分蒸馏为轻量奖励预测器，降低计算开销地做修正决策；(3) 决策条件化的轨迹一致扩散，通过瞬态条件与持久干净估计投影将选定修正注入去噪过程，在修正目标物体布局的同时保持非目标布局不变。
AI.result: 在 3D-FRONT 数据集上实验表明，功能一致性与语义对齐得到提升，同时保持了有竞争力的生成质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 将 MLLM 语义反馈闭环嵌入扩散去噪，并以奖励预测器和轨迹一致的条件注入实现高效、连贯的物体级布局修正，是一种有效的文本条件 3D 场景生成方案。

title: Online State-Representation Adaptation under Synthetic Interaction-Cue Remapping
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code and synthetic data are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24329690
summary: When cues change what they predict, continuing to update a learned mapping may help an agent choose the appropriate action. We tested this in a one-step synthetic task by comparing a logistic state predictor that continued to learn from state labels with the same predictor frozen at transfer. We evaluated ten conditions in six held-out environments, with 1,296 paired runs per condition and 1,296,000 transfer records in total. Late action accuracy was 93.39% with online updates and 64.63% with frozen coefficients, a paired difference of 28.76 [8.73, 53.19] percentage points (95% environment-bootstrap interval). A direct policy reached 95.65% using the same predictions with a different action threshold. A contextual bandit reached 94.23% and earned more cumulative utility than the adaptive predictor. The bandit used the reward of its chosen action, which in this task reveals the true state when combined with that action. Weights based on development history lowered cumulative utility relative to neutral weights (difference -3.45 [-4.48, -2.43]). The adaptive predictor outperformed its frozen counterpart in late accuracy in each of the six test environments. The other comparisons show how the choice of action threshold and the information available in feedback affect what can be attributed to online adaptation.

AI.tldr: 在单步合成任务中,持续在线更新的logistic状态预测器在迁移后晚期的动作准确率为93.39%,显著高于冻结系数版本的64.63%(配对差28.76个百分点),且在全部6个留出环境中均成立;但基于同一预测、仅调整动作阈值的直接策略(95.65%)和利用动作奖励反馈的情境bandit(94.23%,累计效用更高)表现更优,说明在线自适应的贡献受动作阈值选择与反馈信息量影响。
AI.motivation: 当线索与所预测对象之间的关系发生变化时,智能体继续更新已学到的映射可能有助于选择恰当动作。作者希望明确"在线自适应"本身能带来多少收益,并厘清这一收益与动作阈值设定、反馈中可用信息之间的混淆关系。
AI.method: 构建单步合成任务,对比两类logistic状态预测器:(1)在迁移后继续从状态标签中在线学习;(2)在迁移时冻结系数。共评估10种条件、6个留出环境,每条件1,296次配对运行,合计1,296,000条迁移记录;采用环境bootstrap给出95%区间。另设两个对照:使用相同预测但改变动作阈值的直接策略,以及使用所选动作奖励的情境bandit;并比较基于开发历史权重与中性权重的效用差异。
AI.result: 晚期动作准确率:在线更新93.39%,冻结系数64.63%,配对差28.76 [8.73, 53.19]个百分点。直接策略在相同预测下以不同动作阈值达到95.65%;情境bandit达94.23%,且累计效用高于自适应预测器(该任务中,所选动作的奖励与动作结合即可揭示真实状态)。基于开发历史的权重使累计效用低于中性权重(差-3.45 [-4.48, -2.43])。自适应预测器在全部6个测试环境中晚期准确率均优于冻结版本。
AI.conclusion: 在线持续更新对迁移后的动作准确率有一致且稳健的正向作用,但该比较并非"自适应最优"的证据:阈值设定与反馈中隐含的状态信息可解释相当部分性能差距。因此,归因于"在线自适应"的收益须在上述混淆因素受控的前提下解读。

title: BEV-Diffusion: Camera-Only Traversability Navigation with BEV Memory and Efficient Cross-Robot Adaptation
summary: Robot navigation requires both an understanding of the scene and an efficient adaptation to new robots, yet current methods rely on expensive LiDAR sensors, long mapping and modular pipelines. We present BEV-Diffusion, a camera-only model that learns a bird's-eye view (BEV) traversability map, its uncertainty and the path in a single network. A frozen DINOv2 backbone encodes consecutive RGB frames, which inverse perspective mapping and Bayesian fusion lift into the BEV, and a ranking loss keeps outdoor traversability graded rather than binary, separating asphalt from grass (median 0.94 vs. 0.75). On this map, a transformer denoiser generates polar waypoints in a few DDIM steps, and uncertainty-aware guidance refines the path and ends it where the map is no longer reliable. At deployment, a metric BEV memory keeps obstacles after they leave the camera view and warm starts each sample from the previous, ego-motion compensated path. Because the planner jointly learns the path, the map, and its uncertainty, it selects routes through terrain it can confidently traverse. In an unseen courtyard, a wheeled-legged robot autonomously traveled 120 m, completing 96% of the route without intervention, compared with 75-88% for the baselines. Even under low-light conditions after sunset, the proposed model completed the route without requiring any intervention. Retraining only the BEV head, about 3% of the parameters, adapts the model to a small legged robot in 2.3 min. Indoors, the memory gets this robot out of maze-like traps: it retains 62-66% of the nearby out-of-view obstacles, against at most 3% for the baselines, and the robot achieves 67-100% task progress, compared with 20-40% for the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用相机的 BEV-Diffusion 模型，在单一网络中联合学习 BEV 可通行性地图、其不确定性以及极坐标路径点，并在真实机器人上验证了高成功率导航与快速跨机器人适配。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人导航方法依赖昂贵 LiDAR、建图耗时长、模块化管线复杂，且难以快速适配新机器人平台；同时需要同时具备场景理解能力与高效适应性。
AI.method: 冻结 DINOv2 编码连续 RGB 帧，经逆透视映射与贝叶斯融合提升至 BEV；用排序损失使户外可通行性保持分级（非二值）；Transformer 去噪器经少量 DDIM 步生成极坐标路径点，并以不确定性感知引导优化路径、在不可靠处终止；部署时使用度量 BEV 记忆保留离开视野的障碍，并用自运动补偿的上一帧路径热启动；仅重训 BEV head（约 3% 参数）即可适配新机器人。
AI.result: 未见庭院中轮腿机器人自主行进 120 m，96% 路线无干预完成（基线 75–88%）；日落后低照度下仍无需干预完成路线；小型腿式机器人仅需 2.3 min 微调即完成适配；室内迷宫类陷阱中保留 62–66% 视野外近处障碍（基线≤3%），任务进度 67–100%（基线 20–40%）；分级可通行性区分沥青与草地中位数 0.94 vs 0.75。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习路径、地图与不确定性使规划器倾向于选择可高置信通行的地形；该相机-only 方案兼顾性能、鲁棒性与跨平台适配效率。

title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
summary: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. A controller trained through supervised fine-tuning integrates these records with target responses, evaluator verdicts, and remaining budget to retain the workflow, refine instructions, restructure collaboration, or lock further editing. This design connects feedback to explicit changes in subsequent execution while allowing a useful organization to continue without repeated controller intervention. The evaluation protocol covers HarmBench with three execution backbones and two target models, together with component ablations, dataset transfer, and evaluator checks. Across the six executor-target configurations, L2C improves ASR over EvoSynth by 1.4 to 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean online tokens by 35.6% to 37.3%. L2C connects adaptive collaboration to the resource requirements of automated security evaluation.

AI.tldr: L2C是一个LLM引导的框架，为每个红队测试用例演化可执行的多智能体工作流：用带版本的图表示智能体职责、执行依赖与输入绑定，并由经SFT训练的控制器根据目标模型响应、评估判定与剩余预算决定保留、精修、重构或锁定工作流。
AI.motivation: 自动化红队测试对发现LLM安全失效至关重要，但其可扩展性取决于发现失败所需消耗的资源。多智能体系统虽能互补能力，却因重复规划、冗余交互和低效信息路由导致协调成本高昂；且目标模型的响应只反映测试结果，并不能指出应改变哪一项协作决策，反馈难以落地为具体改进。
AI.method: 提出Learning to Coordinate (L2C)：以版本化图表示智能体职责、执行依赖和输入绑定，并为每个图关联实际投递与产生的信息记录；控制器经监督微调训练，将上述记录与目标响应、评估器判定及剩余预算结合，选择保留工作流、精修指令、重构协作结构或锁定编辑；使有用组织可持续运行而无需反复控制器介入。评估覆盖HarmBench、三种执行后端与两个目标模型，并含组件消融、数据集迁移与评估器校验。
AI.result: 在六种执行器—目标模型配置下，L2C相较EvoSynth将ASR提升1.4至4.5个百分点，同时将平均在线token消耗降低35.6%至37.3%。
AI.conclusion: L2C将自适应协作与自动化安全评估的资源需求相连接，在提升攻击成功率的同时显著降低推理开销，为可扩展的红队测试提供高效协调方案。

title: Temporal Image Representations for Mouse Dynamics Authentication
summary: Mouse dynamics authentication has traditionally relied on handcrafted features or time-series representations that capture both spatial and temporal characteristics of mouse movements. More recent approaches have modeled mouse data as images, enabling the use of powerful pretrained computer vision models. However, prior work primarily focuses on spatial-only representations where the cursor coordinates are plotted as a trajectory image. These representations discard the temporal characteristics which can help discriminate users. In this work, we propose image representations that incorporate speed and velocity information for mouse dynamics authentication. We investigate two mouse data representations, a XYPlot representation that intuitively shows the path of movement, and a Pairwise Distance (PWD) representation that utilizes the entire image canvas to encode relationships between mouse events. Both representations are evaluated under both location-aware and location-free settings using pretrained 2D-CNN and ViT architectures. We found that the incorporation of temporal information improved performance over spatial representations alone, and that the location-aware variants generally outperformed the location-free. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on two datasets, Balabit and TWOS, and extend our evaluation to two other datasets. We found that in general, location-aware PWD with temporal encoding combined with the 2D-CNN architecture provided the best results, with mean EERs of 5.21% and 12.70% on the Balabit Test-1 and Test-2 sets, respectively, 4.94% on TWOS, 6.16% on ChaoShen, and 0.59% on DFL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在鼠标动态认证中引入速度/速率信息的图像表示，包括XYPlot与Pairwise Distance (PWD) 两种表示，并在location-aware与location-free设置下用预训练2D-CNN与ViT评估，取得多数据集SOTA。
AI.motivation: 已有方法将鼠标数据转为轨迹图像以便使用预训练视觉模型，但多为仅空间表示，丢弃了有助于区分用户的时间（动态）特征。
AI.method: 构建融合速度与速度矢量的图像表示：XYPlot（直观显示运动路径）与PWD（利用整个画布编码鼠标事件间关系）；两种表示分别在location-aware与location-free设置下，用预训练2D-CNN与ViT分类架构进行评估。
AI.result: 引入时间信息优于纯空间表示；location-aware变体总体优于location-free；在Balabit与TWOS上达SOTA并扩展到ChaoShen与DFL。最佳组合为location-aware PWD+时间编码+2D-CNN，EER分别为Balabit Test-1 5.21%、Test-2 12.70%、TWOS 4.94%、ChaoShen 6.16%、DFL 0.59%。
AI.conclusion: 融合时间信息的图像表示可有效提升鼠标动态认证性能，location-aware PWD配2D-CNN为最优方案，并具备跨数据集的良好泛化性。

title: Beyond Cross-Modal Reconstruction: Participant-Level Evaluation of sEMG-Kinematic Coupling in Post-Stroke Gait
summary: Accurate cross-modal reconstruction is often treated as evidence of physiological coupling, although it may simply reflect temporal patterns shared across participants. We tested whether frozen bidirectional models captured subject-specific neuromuscular coupling between electromyographic activity and gait kinematics in 82 held-out able-bodied and 43 post-stroke participants. Complete source-modality removal and cross-participant source substitution, along with a cycle-position-age-sex template baseline, were applied. Learned bilateral asymmetry was also compared with transparent waveform and derivative asymmetry for predicting Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) scores in the case of repeated nested cross-validation. Complete source removal increased reconstruction RMSE by 6.90% for electromyography-to-kinematics and 11.38% in the reverse direction. In contrast, cross-participant substitution increased RMSE by only 1.68% and 1.67%, respectively, while the template reduced RMSE by 2.89% and 0.55%. For POMA prediction, walking speed, age, and sex achieved an MAE of 3.693, compared with 4.229 and 4.427 after adding absolute and signed learned asymmetry, respectively. In all of the 20 repeated evaluations, all asymmetry representations performed worse than the covariate baseline. No localized learned feature remained significant after covariate adjustment and false-discovery-rate correction. The model mainly relied on shared gait-phase patterns, with no clear subject-specific coupling or added clinical value. Participant-level controls are therefore needed before reconstruction accuracy is treated as evidence of individualized physiology.

AI.tldr: 冻结的双向跨模态模型在肌电-步态运动学重建中的高精度主要源于被试间共享的步态相位模式，而非个体化神经肌肉耦合；学习到的双侧不对称性在临床预测上也不优于简单协变量基线。
AI.motivation: 跨模态重建精度常被当作生理耦合的证据，但这种精度可能只是被试间共享的时间模式造成的假象，缺乏被试水平的对照检验。作者因此要检验冻结的双向模型是否真正捕捉到被试特异的神经肌肉耦合。
AI.method: 在82名健康对照与43名卒中后被试的留出数据上测试冻结的双向肌电—步态运动学模型，施加完全源模态移除、跨被试源替换，以及基于周期位置-年龄-性别的模板基线；并将学习到的双侧不对称性与透明的波形/导数不对称性比较，在重复嵌套交叉验证下预测POMA评分。
AI.result: 完全移除源模态使重建RMSE在肌电→运动学方向升高6.90%、反向升高11.38%；跨被试替换仅升高1.68%和1.67%，模板基线反而使RMSE降低2.89%和0.55%。POMA预测中，步速、年龄、性别基线MAE为3.693，加入绝对值和带符号学习不对称性后分别为4.229和4.427；20次重复评估中所有不对称表示均劣于协变量基线，协变量校正与FDR校正后无局部学习特征显著。
AI.conclusion: 模型主要依赖共享的步态相位模式，未体现出明确的被试特异耦合或附加临床价值；在将重建精度视为个体化生理证据前，必须引入被试水平的对照检验。

title: Efficient World-Model Planning via Physics-Guided Search Distillation
summary: World models support autonomous driving by evaluating candidate trajectories through predicted future scene evolution. However, accurate future prediction does not ensure road-compliant execution; when all candidates violate road boundaries, re-ranking cannot select a feasible trajectory. We propose Physics-Guided Search Distillation (PGSD), a single-view planning framework that combines future representations and execution feedback for verified beyond-pool repair through three components: (1) Execution-Aware Selection checks ego-vehicle road compliance under simulated execution and selects the highest-scoring feasible trajectory; (2) a Clearance-Aware Search Teacher generates beyond-pool corrections and selects demonstrations with larger minimum road-boundary clearance during execution to buffer imitation errors; and (3) a Future-Conditioned Repair Student predicts one correction from rewarder features and execution feedback for single-rollout verification. The pretrained planner and rewarder remain frozen; no future scenes are generated online. On NAVSIM v1, single-view PGSD achieves 90.97 PDMS, exceeding all compared prior single-view planners and retaining 73.2% of the search teacher's PDMS gain over execution-aware selection. On NAVSIM v2 navhard, it reaches 38.96 EPDMS, improving on WorldDrive by 11.24 points (40.5%). The student replaces up to ten search rollouts with a single verification rollout per repair trigger. HUGSIM Hard examples provide qualitative evidence of zero-shot transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出Physics-Guided Search Distillation（PGSD）单视图规划框架，将未来表征与执行反馈结合，实现"池外修复"的可验证轨迹修正，在NAVSIM v1取得90.97 PDMS、NAVSIM v2 navhard取得38.96 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: 世界模型能通过预测未来场景演化来评估候选轨迹，但"预测准确"并不等于"满足道路合规"；当所有候选轨迹都违反道路边界时，仅靠重排序（re-ranking）无法选出可行轨迹，存在候选池内无可行解的结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 三组件框架：(1) Execution-Aware Selection：在仿真执行下检查自车道路合规性，选出得分最高的可行轨迹；(2) Clearance-Aware Search Teacher：生成池外修正并挑选执行过程中最小道路边界余量更大的示范，以缓冲模仿误差；(3) Future-Conditioned Repair Student：基于rewarder特征与执行反馈预测单一修正，实现单次rollout验证。预训练规划器与rewarder保持冻结，在线不生成未来场景。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1单视图下PGSD达90.97 PDMS，超过所有对比的单视图规划器，并保留搜索教师相对执行感知选择PDMS增益的73.2%；NAVSIM v2 navhard达38.96 EPDMS，较WorldDrive提升11.24点（40.5%）；每次修复触发时，学生模型以单次验证rollout替代最多十次搜索rollout；HUGSIM Hard样例提供零样本迁移的定性证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行反馈与余量感知搜索教师蒸馏，可将推理期的搜索能力压缩为单次验证的学生模型，在不生成未来场景、不微调规划器与rewarder的前提下，兼顾合规性、性能与推理效率，并展现跨仿真器零样本迁移潜力。

title: From Points to Trajectories: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment for Physical Events
summary: Advancing physical artificial intelligence (Physical AI) requires moving beyond static object recognition to ground how real-world mechanics (e.g., impact, friction, and force transfer) unfold over time. While multimodal aligners seek to capture these interactions by matching multi-sensor streams, prevailing architectures compress each temporal sequence into a single pooled embedding. We show that this paradigm fails on twin events: distinct physical executions recorded under identical task conditions. Collapsing the temporal dimension averages out transient cross-modal dynamics, effectively reducing physical event alignment to static scene recognition. Formally, we prove that as sequence length increases, any temporally pooled representation converges to the stationary recording condition. Consequently, as windows grow, no choice of loss function or embedding geometry can disambiguate twin events from pooled features alone. Instead, we show that physical events are uniquely identified by the event gap, namely the instantaneous, synchronous co-fluctuations across modalities that are erased by pooling and accumulate only along unpooled trajectories. To recover this signal, we introduce CounterPoint, a lightweight plug-in module that strips out each modality's temporal mean to score frame-level cross-modal agreement. Integrated across four state-of-the-art (SOTA) multimodal aligners, CounterPoint shifts representations from coarse condition matching to fine-grained physical event alignment, consistently outperforming existing temporal alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 现有跨模态对齐器将时间序列池化为单一嵌入，导致"孪生物理事件"无法区分；作者证明了池化表示随序列长度增加收敛于稳态记录条件，并提出即插即用模块 CounterPoint，通过去除各模态时间均值、在帧级打分跨模态一致性来恢复"事件间隙"信号，在四个SOTA对齐器上均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: Physical AI 需要从静态物体识别转向对真实世界力学过程（碰撞、摩擦、力传递）随时间演化的建模。多模态对齐器试图通过匹配多传感器流来捕捉这些交互，但主流架构把每条时间序列压缩成单一池化嵌入，从而丢失了跨模态的瞬态动态；在相同任务条件下采集的不同物理执行（孪生事件）上，这种范式失效，物理事件对齐退化为静态场景识别。
AI.method: 1) 形式化论证：证明随序列长度增加，任意时间池化表示都收敛到稳态记录条件，因此在池化特征上无论选择何种损失函数或嵌入几何都无法区分孪生事件。2) 提出物理事件由"事件间隙"（event gap）唯一标识，即跨模态瞬时同步共波动，该信号被池化抹除、只能沿未池化轨迹累积。3) 设计 CounterPoint：轻量即插即用模块，剥离每个模态的时间均值以消除稳态条件成分，继而在帧级评估跨模态一致性得分。
AI.result: CounterPoint 集成到四个SOTA多模态对齐器中，将表示从粗粒度条件匹配推向细粒度物理事件对齐，并一致优于现有的时间对齐方法。
AI.conclusion: 时间池化在原理上限制了物理事件的可辨识性，跨模态瞬态同步共波动才是事件级对齐的关键信号；以去除时间均值、帧级跨模态一致性打分的轻量模块即可有效利用该信号，为Physical AI提供可插拔的改进路径。

title: MobileWeave: Program-First Synthesis of Dependency-Linked Tasks for Training Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Native mobile GUI agents require large-scale training trajectories covering both individual app functions and multi-goal workflows within and across apps, which makes automatic task synthesis a promising way to scale training data. Existing synthesis pipelines, however, produce each task as free-form text, leaving implicit how its subgoals depend on one another. This matters because composition is a skill in its own right: a policy may complete each subtask of a workflow on its own, yet fail to chain these subtasks into the complete workflow. We present MobileWeave, which instead synthesizes every task as an executable program derived from the app implementations of a controllable simulator. MobileWeave abstracts each app into a typed capability graph with semantic types shared across apps, composes atomic programs into single- and cross-app composite programs through explicit value and object dependencies, and verifies each program by native execution, deriving both its instruction and its completion check from the same program. Trained on teacher trajectories collected for these tasks and on recovery supervision at the policy's own stalls, MobileWeave-8B improves its base model by 26.7 points on MobileGym and by 8.6, 21.3, and 17.6 points on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld, with comparable gains at 4B. Beyond these gains, we find that composition is learnable from task structure: explicit dependencies between subgoals act as a training signal that teaches a policy to compose skills it already masters. We release data, model, and code at https://maxxnotmarx.github.io/MobileWeave/ .

AI.tldr: MobileWeave将每个移动GUI任务合成为源自可控模拟器应用实现的可执行程序，通过类型化能力图与显式依赖组合原子程序并原生执行验证，训练出的MobileWeave-8B在MobileGym提升26.7分，在AndroidWorld/AndroidLab/MobileWorld分别提升8.6/21.3/17.6分。
AI.motivation: 原生移动GUI智能体需要覆盖单应用功能与跨应用多目标工作流的大规模轨迹数据，自动任务合成是扩展训练数据的有前景途径。但现有合成流水线把任务生成为自由文本，子目标之间的依赖关系被隐式化；而"组合"本身是一种独立能力——策略能单独完成各子任务，却可能无法把它们串成完整工作流。
AI.method: MobileWeave把每个应用抽象为带语义类型（跨应用共享）的类型化能力图；通过显式的取值依赖与对象依赖，将原子程序组合成单应用与跨应用复合程序；每个任务以可执行程序形式从可控模拟器的应用实现中派生，并经原生执行验证，指令与完成校验均从同一程序导出。训练数据为这些任务的教师轨迹，并在策略自身卡壳处加入恢复监督。
AI.result: MobileWeave-8B相对基座模型在MobileGym上提升26.7分，在AndroidWorld、AndroidLab、MobileWorld上分别提升8.6、21.3、17.6分；4B规模下取得相当增益。数据、模型与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 组合能力可从任务结构中学习：子目标间的显式依赖作为一种训练信号，能教会策略组合其已掌握的技能；程序化、可验证的任务合成是扩展移动GUI智能体训练数据的有效范式。

title: A Rank-One Bypass of Fixed Linear Erasure
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (poster). 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Linear concept erasure can make a target unreadable to a specified family of linear classifiers applied to a model's current internal features. In an open-weight release, however, an attacker can modify the layers that produce those features. We study a fixed affine erasure layer whose upstream model is allowed to change. If the layer transmits even one direction visible to an allowed downstream classifier, the attacker can write a target score into that direction and carry it through the layer. We show that this condition is also necessary, and that for a nonconstant linear target score the required change is a rank-one affine update. Across six CIFAR-10 class-pair tasks, the route restores nearly all pre-erasure target performance and can leave a deployed benign linear head's scores unchanged to numerical tolerance. We then price the attack: with eight target labels and 2,000 unlabelled calibration examples, a 10% mean relative feature edit yields 79.8% test accuracy, which is 91.2% of the fitted score's gain over chance; tighter edit limits sharply reduce success. Linear guardedness therefore remains a valid guarantee about the current representation, but it is not by itself a tamper-resistance guarantee for an editable open-weight model.

AI.tldr: 线性概念擦除只对当前表征有效：若擦除层仍传递任一被下游线性分类器可见的方向，攻击者可通过秩一仿射更新上游模型，将目标分数写入该方向并穿层而过，从而在开放权重场景中恢复被擦除的能力。
AI.motivation: 线性概念擦除（linear concept erasure）通常被理解为使目标概念对指定线性分类器族不可读，但在开放权重发布场景中，攻击者可修改产生该特征的网络层。因此需要研究：固定一个仿射擦除层、允许上游模型变化时，擦除保证是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为"固定仿射擦除层 + 可修改上游模型"。分析擦除层是否传递任一被允许的下游线性分类器可见的方向；若存在这样的方向，攻击者可把目标分数写入该方向并使其穿过擦除层。进一步证明该条件同时是必要条件，且对非恒定线性目标分数，所需改动为秩一仿射更新（rank-one affine update）。在 CIFAR-10 的六个类对任务上验证，并进行攻击代价量化：8 个目标标签、2000 个无标注校准样本，测量不同编辑预算下的成功率。
AI.result: 六个 CIFAR-10 类对任务中，该路由方式几乎完全恢复擦除前的目标性能，且可使部署的良性线性头的分数在数值容差内保持不变；在 8 个目标标签与 2000 个无标注校准样本条件下，10% 的平均相对特征编辑达到 79.8% 测试准确率，相当于拟合分数相对随机水平的增益的 91.2%；更严格的编辑限制会显著降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: 线性防护性（linear guardedness）仍是关于当前表征的有效保证，但本身并不构成针对可编辑开放权重模型的抗篡改保证；发布开放权重时需重新审视擦除机制的安全假设。

title: Dual-Actuation Emulation of Scaled Relative Orbital Dynamics on a Free-Flyer
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo); to appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Ground-based free-flyer testbeds reproduce the planar motion of a free-floating spacecraft using air bearings, but not the relative dynamics of spacecraft in orbit. We present a dual-actuation architecture that physically emulates Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics on an open-source free-flyer. Two model predictive controllers run in parallel: one drives the solenoid thrusters with an orbital dynamics model, representing the spacecraft under test; the other drives bidirectional propellers that physically apply the orbital accelerations, continuously updating its reference to account for thruster-induced velocity changes. A dynamic similitude maps the orbital scenario onto the limited floor area and actuation rates of the testbed, letting the spacecraft controller run directly at orbital scale. We validate the architecture on hardware and against a high-fidelity orbital simulation, where the orbital accelerations instead arise naturally, both driven by the identical spacecraft controller. Their agreement indicates that the testbed reproduces the relative orbital motion the controller would encounter in flight.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双驱动架构，在开源气浮自由飞行器上物理复现Clohessy-Wiltshire（CW）相对轨道动力学，并通过硬件实验与高保真轨道仿真对比验证其一致性。
AI.motivation: 地面气浮自由飞行器试验台只能复现自由漂浮航天器的平面运动，无法复现轨道中航天器的相对动力学（如CW方程描述的相对运动），导致控制算法难以在地面按轨道尺度直接验证。
AI.method: 设计双驱动架构：两个模型预测控制器并行运行，一个基于轨道动力学模型驱动电磁阀推力器以代表被测航天器，另一个驱动双向螺旋桨物理施加轨道加速度，并持续更新参考以补偿推力器引起的速度变化；采用动态相似变换将轨道场景映射到有限的台面面积与执行器速率上，使航天器控制器可直接按轨道尺度运行。
AI.result: 在硬件上验证该架构，并与高保真轨道仿真（轨道加速度自然产生、由同一航天器控制器驱动）对比，两者结果一致，表明试验台能够复现控制器在飞行中会遇到的相对轨道运动。
AI.conclusion: 该双驱动与动态相似方案有效弥合了地面气浮试验台与真实轨道相对动力学之间的差距，可在硬件在环条件下按轨道尺度验证航天器相对运动控制器。

title: FedE2E: One-Shot Federated Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Closed-Loop Evaluation
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing datasets. However, existing federated learning methods for autonomous driving typically require multi-round communication and lack closed-loop evaluation, while one-shot methods mainly focus on perception tasks. To address these limitations, we propose \method, a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving. It comprises multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation to distill knowledge from heterogeneous models. Closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive demonstrates the effectiveness of \method in both one-shot and multi-round federated learning. In the one-shot setting, it achieves a Driving Score of 55.85, which is 4.07 points higher than prior work. In the multi-round setting, it reaches 60.35 after five communication rounds, the best performance among all compared methods under the same number of communication rounds.

AI.tldr: 提出面向端到端自动驾驶的一次性联邦学习方法，通过多客户端校准、锚点特征对齐与逐token共识蒸馏，在Bench2Drive闭环评测中一次性设置DS达55.85（较先前工作+4.07），五轮多轮设置达60.35，均为同类最优。
AI.motivation: 现有面向自动驾驶的联邦学习方法多需多轮通信，且缺乏闭环评测；已有的一次性（one-shot）方法又主要局限于感知任务，未覆盖端到端驾驶决策。因此需要一种支持异构模型、可闭环评估的一次性联邦端到端自动驾驶方案。
AI.method: 方法由三部分构成：(1) 多客户端校准（multi-client calibration）；(2) 基于锚点的特征对齐（anchor-based feature alignment）；(3) 逐token共识蒸馏（token-wise consensus distillation），用于从异构模型中蒸馏知识，实现单轮通信下的聚合。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive闭环评测中验证有效性：一次性设置下驾驶得分（Driving Score）为55.85，较先前工作高4.07分；多轮设置下经5轮通信达到60.35，在相同通信轮数下优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为端到端自动驾驶提供了一种高效的一次性联邦学习范式，同时兼容多轮联邦训练，在闭环评测下取得领先性能，缓解了通信开销与异构模型聚合的矛盾。

title: Grounding Radiology Reports in 3D Chest CT: Results of the ReXGrounding Challenge
summary: Segmenting each reported finding in a radiology scan would allow findings to be measured and tracked over time and let AI systems generate reports that are verifiable, but so far AI models have performed poorly at this task. To advance this task, we organized the ReXGrounding Challenge at MICCAI 2026, the first challenge dedicated to it. Given a non-contrast chest CT scan and the set of findings from its report, participants trained models to produce the corresponding set of 3D segmentations. The challenge used 2,992 training and 200 validation scans from the ReXGroundingCT dataset, and evaluated methods on a held-out test set of 300 scans with 582 findings, exhaustively annotated by board-certified radiologists. In total, 48 teams from 15 countries made 760 submissions, and the best method reached a Dice of 0.375 and a hit rate of 0.77, matching agreement between two independent radiologist groups (Dice 0.32, hit rate 0.76, on a 50-scan subset). On the 100 scans of the pre-challenge benchmark, the winner reached a Dice of 0.390, against 0.285 for VoxTell, the best model before the challenge, which five of the six best teams fine-tuned. Non-focal findings remained far harder to segment than focal ones, instance F1 stayed below inter-reader agreement (0.34 vs. 0.47), and models sometimes segmented the right abnormality in the wrong location. Top methods thus match radiologist agreement in Dice, but non-focal findings, findings with multiple instances, and adherence to the anatomical location described in the text remain open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 MICCAI 2026 首届 ReXGrounding Challenge：给定平扫胸部 CT 与报告中的发现集合，要求模型输出对应的 3D 分割。48 支队伍提交 760 次，最佳方法 Dice 0.375、命中率 0.77，与两组独立放射科医师间一致性（Dice 0.32、命中率 0.76）相当；但在挑战前基准 100 例上 Dice 0.390（VoxTell 为 0.285）。非局灶性发现、多实例发现与解剖位置依从性仍为开放问题。
AI.motivation: 对影像报告中每条发现进行分割，可实现发现的测量与纵向追踪，并使 AI 生成的报告可核验。然而现有模型在该任务上表现较差，缺乏统一评测基准，因此需要组织专门挑战赛以推动该任务发展。
AI.method: 组织首个面向该任务的 ReXGrounding Challenge（MICCAI 2026）。任务设定为：输入平扫胸部 CT 与报告中提取的发现集合，输出对应的 3D 分割集合。数据来自 ReXGroundingCT：2,992 例训练、200 例验证，测试集为 300 例、582 条发现，由认证放射科医师穷尽标注。另设 100 例挑战前基准子集与 50 例子集用于双组医师一致性评估。
AI.result: 共 48 支队伍、15 个国家、760 次提交。最佳方法 Dice 0.375、命中率 0.77，与两组独立放射科医师间一致性（Dice 0.32、命中率 0.76）相当。挑战前基准上冠军 Dice 0.390，此前最佳模型 VoxTell 为 0.285（前六名中五支对其微调）。非局灶性发现显著更难；实例 F1 低于阅片者一致性（0.34 vs. 0.47）；模型偶发"部位正确、位置错误"的分割。
AI.conclusion: 顶尖方法在 Dice 上已达到放射科医师间一致性水平，但非局灶性发现、多实例发现以及文本所述解剖位置的依从性仍是未解决问题。

title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
summary: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.

AI.tldr: KRA是一种循环序列混合器，将可学习非线性特征与协方差引导的记忆更新相结合，通过递归岭回归存储关联，用内容相关的OU转移控制保留并恢复写入不确定性；具备精确时间核解释、与上下文长度无关的推理状态和显式伴随的并行训练。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力/递归记忆的更新多为固定的外积累加，缺乏对特征非线性和记忆协方差结构的自适应建模；希望构建一个有理论基础的、非线性且自适应的序列记忆机制，同时保持推理状态大小恒定与训练可并行。
AI.method: 递归岭回归存储键值关联，利用过去键之间的相关性决定新观测对记忆的修正；内容相关的Ornstein–Uhlenbeck转移控制记忆保留，并为未来写入恢复不确定性；采用与上下文长度无关的推理状态；通过关联块映射（associative block maps）和显式伴随实现并行训练并保持递归更新等价。
AI.result: 受控语言建模实验中，KRA在预测质量上优于注意力与循环基线；在自然联想召回上强于所评估的循环模型；并取得实用的分布式训练吞吐。理论层面给出了精确的时间核（temporal-kernel）解释。
AI.conclusion: KRA为非线性、自适应的序列记忆提供了有原理依据的基础框架，兼具理论可解释性、恒定大小的推理状态与可并行训练效率。

title: Worth Another Look:Constrained World-Model Planning for Visual Inspection
summary: Visual inspection in field robotics and environmental monitoring must localize multiple targets under strict compute and sensing caps. Exhaustive sweeps waste calls on absent classes, while myopic and search-free policies stumble over heterogeneous tariff cliffs or discard viewport edits whose value emerges only after re-querying. We formulate inspection over frozen detectors as neuro-symbolic observation planning under partial observability, decoupling a compact recurrent world model (WM) from exact symbolic feasibility and tariff rules. Receding-horizon beam search with online replanning jointly schedules class queries, crops, enhancements, and termination (stop), paired with slack-aware shadow pricing and legal fallback at larger budgets. Across eight terrestrial, optical, and sonar benchmarks, multi-step lookahead outperforms static schedules and search-free offline RL under tight budgets -- gaining up to 28.4 AP percentage points over static priority on RUOD and 15.1 on ARIS -- while dynamic pricing lifts large-budget performance on all eight domains at 11 ms planning cost. Ultimately, pairing lightweight learned dynamics with exact symbolic constraints turns frozen detectors into adaptive, budget-aware inspection agents without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文将冻结检测器上的视场巡检建模为部分可观测下的神经-符号观测规划，解耦紧凑循环世界模型与精确符号可行性/费用规则，用滚动时域束搜索与在线重规划联合调度类别查询、裁剪、增强与终止，实现预算感知的自适应巡检，无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 野外机器人与环境监测中的视觉巡检需在严格算力与感知预算下定位多目标。穷举扫描会把调用浪费在缺失类别上；短视策略或无搜索的离线策略难以应对异构费用"悬崖"，也会丢弃那些必须重新查询后才显现价值的视口编辑；现有做法难以在紧预算下权衡多步决策。
AI.method: 将冻结检测器上的巡检表述为部分可观测下的神经-符号观测规划：把紧凑的循环世界模型（学习动态）与精确的符号可行性和费用规则解耦；采用带在线重规划的滚动时域束搜索，联合调度类别查询、裁剪、增强和终止（stop）；结合松弛感知的影子定价，并给出大预算下的合法回退策略。
AI.result: 在八个地面、光学与声呐基准上，多步前瞻在紧预算下优于静态调度表与无搜索的离线 RL：在 RUOD 上相对静态优先级最多提升 28.4 AP 百分点，在 ARIS 上提升 15.1；动态定价在全部八个域上提升大预算性能，规划开销仅 11 ms。
AI.conclusion: 把轻量学习动态与精确符号约束相结合，可将冻结检测器转化为自适应、预算感知的巡检智能体，且无需重训练。

title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
comment: This is the accepted, prepublication version of a paper forthcoming in Computer Music Journal, MIT Press. Beyond routine editorial and typesetting amendments, the content remains subject to further revision before final publication
summary: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.

AI.tldr: 提出"agents乐团"框架，用参数化量子电路实现音乐智能体，通过与音乐环境的试错互动形成各异"心态"，在量子-经典混合回路中探索音乐决策空间，实现计算机辅助作曲与演奏。
AI.motivation: 现有AI音乐生成多依赖大规模数据训练与模仿，缺乏过程性、涌现式的创造力；同时量子计算在音乐创作中的应用尚待探索。作者希望让量子智能体通过交互而非模仿发展出个体化音乐人格，作为作曲家与演奏者的自适应音乐伙伴。
AI.method: 智能体以参数化量子电路实现，利用量子叠加与纠缠在量子-经典混合回路中进行试错学习。设计两类架构：原子式（分别处理音高与节奏）与整体式（将音高与时长作为统一音符事件处理）。通过可组合、可加权的音乐性奖励函数塑造不同"心态"。系统以MIDI编码音乐运行，支持交互模式与离线批处理模式，并在IBM量子硬件上验证。
AI.result: 智能体演化出各不相同的作曲行为（心态），并能将所学行为泛化到未见过的素材；在IBM量子硬件上的实验证实，现有量子计算机已可实现具有音乐意义的学习；系统在交互与离线批处理两种模式下均可运行。
AI.conclusion: 量子计算智能体应定位为自适应音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，各自通过互动发展音乐个性。该agents乐团为作曲家与演奏者提供涌现式、过程导向的音乐创造新途径，并随量子硬件进步构成可扩展的量子计算机辅助作曲基础。

title: On Demand, Not Uniformity: Adaptive Expert Orchestration for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to adapt to sequential instruction data while retaining previously acquired knowledge. While recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based methods mitigate forgetting by freezing historical experts and introducing new ones, they largely overlook the varying adaptation demands across tasks. Probing incoming tasks reveals pronounced heterogeneity in layer-wise gradient pressure and token-wise prediction difficulty. This observation highlights two unresolved decisions: where additional capacity is needed and how strongly new experts should contribute to individual tokens. To address both questions, we propose the Coverage-Calibrated Expert Injection and Residual Arbitration framework (CIRA-MoE), which derives expert acceptance margins via learnable threshold routing to serve as a unified coverage signal. Specifically, historical acceptance evidence guides the selective injection of new experts into insufficiently covered layers. Meanwhile, relative evidence between historical and current experts modulates token-wise residual contributions, coupled with arbitration-consistent regularization to promote expert specialization. Comprehensive experiments on UCIT and CoIN demonstrate that CIRA-MoE outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in MCIT.

AI.tldr: CIRA-MoE：面向多模态持续指令微调的覆盖校准专家注入与残差仲裁框架
AI.motivation: 现有基于MoE的MCIT方法通过冻结历史专家、新增专家缓解遗忘，但忽略了任务间适应需求的差异：任务间存在层级别梯度压力与token级预测难度的显著异质性，因此"何处需要额外容量"与"新专家应以多大强度作用于各token"两个问题未被解决。
AI.method: 提出CIRA-MoE。通过可学习阈值路由导出专家接受边际，作为统一覆盖信号：(1) 以历史接受证据指导在覆盖不足的层中选择性注入新专家；(2) 以历史与当前专家的相对证据调制token级残差贡献，并结合仲裁一致性正则促进专家特化。
AI.result: 在UCIT与CoIN基准上的综合实验表明，CIRA-MoE在MCIT任务上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的覆盖信号与token级残差仲裁可有效解决MoE式MCIT中的容量分配与贡献强度问题，实现更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡。

title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at KDD 2027, Applied Data Science (ADS) Track. This is the original submission version, prior to reviewer revisions
summary: Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all three tasks, reduces manual verification costs by 95%, and increases update frequency from weekly to hourly. These results demonstrate a practical and cost-effective industrial solution for road-network map updating.

AI.tldr: 提出PGU-Decoder统一解码框架，用一个模型同时完成路口内路网生成、汇入/分流检测与可行驶区域检测，并在中国360多个城市的路网自动更新中落地，质量分数超98%、人工核验成本降95%、更新频率由周级提升至小时级。
AI.motivation: 路网地图的及时更新对导航与自动驾驶至关重要，而路口内路网生成（拓扑）、汇入/汇出检测（几何）与可行驶区域检测（属性）三项任务若各自独立建模，会造成规则维护、质量保障和人工核验流程重复，推高运营成本，因此需要统一框架。
AI.method: PGU-Decoder由三部分组成：Prior Query Module（PQM）在路网几何的采样位置上构造点级先验查询，固定参考点在解码全程保持位置先验，使模型专注周边上下文；随后将点级表征聚合为实例级表征，并用Relational Graph Attention Network（RGAT）建模实例间依赖；最后由任务专用头分别输出三类预测。
AI.result: 在覆盖中国360多个城市的大规模自动化路网更新中，一致优于七个基线方法；部署于AutoNavi Map后，三项任务质量分数均超98%，人工核验成本降低95%，更新频率从每周提升至每小时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明以点级先验查询加实例级图注意力为核心的单解码器架构，可有效统一拓扑、几何与属性三类语义预测任务，并转化为可工业化落地的低成本路网更新方案。

title: High-Precision Docking of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots Through LiDAR and Vision Collaboration
summary: Precise docking requires a differential-drive robot to correct lateral offset through coupled rotation and translation within a short approach distance. We combine global navigation with terminal control using complementary LiDAR and visual observations. A line fitted to the cabinet front gives normal distance and heading. An AprilTag identifies the workstation; intersecting its center ray with the LiDAR plane determines tangential position. Taught observations define the docking reference and can cancel repeatable fixed biases under unchanged mounting and geometry. Lateral pre-alignment and continuous visual servoing coordinate the approach, with predictive stopping to account for low-speed actuation lag. Across two sessions using the same navigation and docking code at five workstations on Robot 2, all 111 tasks completed, including 101 on the first attempt. Relative to the taught observations, onboard longitudinal, lateral and heading residual root-mean-square values were 1.51 mm, 5.93 mm and 0.238 degrees, respectively. Joint acceptance within plus or minus 10 mm per position axis and plus or minus 1 degree heading was 96.4% (107/111), or 95.5% (106/111) with a plus or minus 0.5 degree heading limit.

AI.tldr: 提出激光雷达与视觉融合的末端对接方案，使差速轮机器人在短距离内通过耦合旋转-平移修正横向偏差，在5个工位的111次任务中全部完成，联合验收通过率96.4%。
AI.motivation: 差速驱动机器人在短接近距离内仅靠自身运动学难以精确修正横向偏移，同时低速执行器滞后会造成停车位置误差；需要一种可复用、可抵消固定系统偏差的高精度末端对接方法。
AI.method: 全局导航与末端控制相结合：用LiDAR拟合机柜前表面直线获得法向距离与航向角；用AprilTag识别工位，将其中心射线与激光扫描平面求交得到切向位置；以示教观测作为对接参考基准，在安装与几何不变条件下抵消可重复的固定偏差；采用横向预对准加连续视觉伺服协调接近，并用预测性停车补偿低速驱动滞后。
AI.result: 在同一导航与对接代码、Robot 2的5个工位、两个会期内共111次任务全部完成，其中101次一次成功。相对示教观测的机载纵向、横向与航向残差RMS分别为1.51 mm、5.93 mm、0.238°；各位置轴±10 mm、航向±1°的联合验收通过率为96.4%（107/111），航向限收紧至±0.5°时为95.5%（106/111）。
AI.conclusion: LiDAR-视觉互补观测配合示教参考与预测性停车，可在短距离内实现毫米级、亚度级的差速机器人重复对接精度，且通过率对航向容差较敏感，横向残差是主要误差来源。

title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
summary: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"全模态知识工程"（OmniKE）任务，发布含六项任务、1829个模型无关条目（覆盖五种模态3960个真实文件）的OmniKE-Bench基准，并提出KnowledgeClaw系统——构建全模态类型化超图、以闭环生命周期代理保持更新、按查询路由到所需粒度。在30个基线上六项任务全部第一，整体OKE得分55.9，超最强基线14.6。
AI.motivation: 知识工程已从chunk/图RAG发展到记忆代理、代理式KE与多模态KE，但"活"的知识库需同时满足全模态、闭环生命周期、多粒度应用三点；现有系统至多满足两点，且缺乏同时衡量三者的基准。
AI.method: 形式化OmniKE任务；构建OmniKE-Bench（六任务、1829个model-free条目、五模态3960个真实文件）；提出KnowledgeClaw：构建全模态类型化超图、闭环生命周期代理持续更新、按需粒度路由。
AI.result: 对比30个基线，六项任务均排名第一；整体OKE为55.9，较最强基线提升14.6。
AI.conclusion: OmniKE为动态知识库提供了统一形式化与评测标准；KnowledgeClaw验证了全模态超图+闭环生命周期+多粒度路由的联合设计有效，代码与数据已开源（github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw）。

title: HOForce: Motion and Force Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction Using a Single-View RGB-D Video
summary: Reconstructing hand-object interactions is an important task, and achieving it with a single camera makes large-scale capture practical but challenging due to heavy occlusions. We introduce HOForce to track hands and objects, and further recover interaction forces from single-view RGB-D video and known object properties. For two-hand manipulation, we jointly model fingertip forces of both hands and the contact forces between objects when two objects are presented. The reconstructed forces also improve motion tracking by giving pose constraints in the occluded regions. HOForce recovers hand and object motion more accurately on DexYCB and TACO and produces less hand-object penetration than interaction baselines on DexYCB. On our dataset of fingertip forces recorded with tactile sensors, HOForce reduces normal-force MAE by 24.5% relative to the strongest baseline. The recovered forces reproduce object motion in MuJoCo and transfer to other engines after adaptation.

AI.tldr: HOForce 从单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性中同时跟踪手与物体，并恢复交互力；重建的力反过来为遮挡区域提供位姿约束，提升运动跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 手-物交互重建重要，单相机便于大规模采集但因严重遮挡而困难；且现有工作多关注几何/运动，忽视接触力这一物理量。
AI.method: 联合建模双手指尖力；当存在两个物体时，同时建模物体间接触力；将重建力作为遮挡区域的位姿约束回馈运动跟踪；输入为单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性。
AI.result: 在 DexYCB、TACO 上手与物体运动更准确，DexYCB 上手-物穿透少于交互基线；在自带触觉传感器指尖力数据集上，法向力 MAE 相对最强基线降低 24.5%；恢复的力可在 MuJoCo 中复现物体运动，并经适配迁移到其他引擎。
AI.conclusion: 力与运动可相互增强，单目即可实现带力估计的手-物交互重建，并具备跨物理引擎的可迁移性。

title: OMNIS+: Semantic RAN Slicing and Quantization for Dynamic Split Neural Networks
summary: Edge computing enables resource-constrained devices to execute machine learning (ML) applications via task offloading, with radio access network (RAN) slicing playing a crucial role in provisioning joint communication and computing resources. However, existing RAN slicing frameworks rely on static computing models, limiting their ability to exploit dynamic semantic data representations enabled by modern neural architectures. To address this limitation, we propose OMNIS+, a semantic RAN slicing framework for multi-cell edge computing built upon a new generation of dynamic split neural models. OMNIS+ incorporates dynamic neural compression paired with adaptive quantization for task offloading, providing a versatile decision space across communication payload and compute dimensions. We leveraged a novel ``box'' quantization scheme that markedly enhances resilience to transmission bit errors across diverse compression rates. Considering partial system observability and distinct node objectives, we formulate two interdependent optimization problems: (i)~mobile devices (MDs) maximize inference accuracy under quality-of-service (QoS) and queue-stability constraints by jointly adapting dynamic split deep neural network (DNN) branches and cell association; and (ii)~each edge server (ES) allocates bandwidth, graphics processing unit (GPU) frequency, and modulation and coding scheme (MCS) to maximize the max--min inference accuracy among associated MDs under cell capacity limits. We solve these problems using a multi-agent distributed optimization framework, where MDs act as causal contextual multi-armed bandit (MAB) agents under backlog-aware Lyapunov control, while each ES executes resource allocation via block coordinate descent (BCD). Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, OMNIS+ reduces the QoS violation probability by up to 1.75 while achieving a better accuracy--violation trade-off.

AI.tldr: OMNIS+提出一种面向多小区边缘计算的语义化RAN切片框架，基于动态分割神经网络与自适应量化构建通信负载-计算维度上的灵活决策空间，并采用多智能体分布式优化（MD侧因果上下文MAB+Lyapunov控制，ES侧BCD资源分配）求解MD精度最大化与ES max-min精度公平两个耦合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAN切片框架依赖静态计算模型，无法利用现代神经架构提供的动态语义数据表示；同时边缘设备资源受限、系统部分可观测且各节点目标不一致。
AI.method: 1）引入新一代动态分割神经模型，结合动态神经压缩与自适应量化实现任务卸载，并设计"box"量化方案提升对传输比特错误的鲁棒性；2）建模两个相互依赖的优化问题：MD在QoS与队列稳定性约束下联合调整动态分割DNN分支与小区关联以最大化推理精度；ES在小区容量约束下分配带宽、GPU频率与MCS以最大化关联MD的max-min精度；3）MD作为带积压感知Lyapunov控制的因果上下文多臂老虎机智能体，ES执行BCD资源分配，构成多智能体分布式优化框架。
AI.result: 相较最先进基线，QoS违约概率最多降低1.75（倍），并获得更优的精度-违约权衡。
AI.conclusion: 语义化动态分割与量化赋能的RAN切片可有效提升多小区边缘ML任务卸载的精度与QoS鲁棒性。

title: TapTacTouch: Shape Completion from Sparse Tactile Contacts with Geometric Priors
summary: 3D object reconstruction is essential for robotic perception and manipulation, yet conventional approaches predominantly rely on visual observations that can be limited by occlusion or unavailable in visually constrained environments. In this work, we propose a vision-free, training-free, and category-agnostic framework for reconstructing 3D object meshes from sparse tactile contacts without relying on pretrained shape models. A 6-DoF robotic arm equipped with a 20-DoF multi-finger robotic hand collects tactile observations using 3x3 pressure sensor arrays mounted on the finger pads.
