The acquired tactile measurements are transformed into 3D contact constraints through robot kinematics and integrated into a multi-scale Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS). To address sparse and incomplete surface observations, the proposed method incorporates contact confidence weighting, weak pseudo-surface constraints, and an observation-driven geometric prior to preserve local surface geometry and provide structural guidance in unobserved regions. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve a Chamfer Distance (CD) of 1.610, an Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) of 7.738, and an F-Score of 95.00, with reconstruction completed in an average of 49.99 s per object. These results demonstrate that sparse tactile sensing can provide sufficient geometric information for continuous 3D object reconstruction without visual or semantic information.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需视觉、无需训练、类别无关的框架，仅用稀疏触觉接触重建3D物体网格。
AI.motivation: 机器人感知与操作依赖3D物体重建，但传统方法主要依赖视觉观测，易受遮挡限制，在视觉受限环境中不可用。
AI.method: 6-DoF机械臂+20-DoF多指手（指尖3x3压力传感阵列）采集触觉；经机器人运动学转化为3D接触约束，融入多尺度GPIS；引入接触置信度加权、弱伪表面约束与观测驱动几何先验，处理稀疏不完整观测。
AI.result: 六个真实物体实验：CD 1.610、EMD 7.738、F-Score 95.00，平均每物体重建耗时49.99 s。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏触觉传感可在无视觉、无语义信息条件下提供足够的几何信息，实现连续3D物体重建。

title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution
summary: Building autonomous agents that continually explore open worlds and acquire new capabilities through experience is a long-standing aspiration in artificial intelligence. Existing research often pursues lifelong learning within predefined tasks, curricula, or objectives, with self-improvement largely confined to individual agents. We introduce OpenKAGE, an agent-group evolution framework for open-ended lifelong learning. Within this framework, agents autonomously explore open worlds and continually acquire new capabilities by accumulating and reusing knowledge from their own interactions and the experience of others. OpenKAGE builds on two key mechanisms: (1) a two-layer knowledge representation, with a memory layer for situated memories and an experience layer for transferable experience and skills that retains the applicability conditions needed for reuse; and (2) a knowledge-sharing mechanism that semantically consolidates textual experience into a continuously evolving shared knowledge graph, while executable skills are shared verbatim. In Minecraft, OpenKAGE supports open-ended lifelong learning, enabling agent groups to sustain exploration and reach advanced technological milestones. Furthermore, the accumulated knowledge can be transferred to a newly initialized agent group on a different backbone model, improving its survival and exploration progress.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体群体演化框架OpenKAGE，通过双层知识表示与知识共享机制，实现开放世界中的开放式终身学习与能力持续获取。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在预定义任务、课程或目标内进行终身学习，自我改进基本局限于单个智能体，缺乏在开放世界中通过群体经验积累实现开放式终身学习的能力。
AI.method: OpenKAGE包含两大机制：(1) 双层知识表示——记忆层存储情境化记忆，经验层存储可迁移经验与技能，并保留重用所需适用条件；(2) 知识共享机制——将文本经验语义化地整合进持续演化的共享知识图谱，可执行技能则原样共享。
AI.result: 在Minecraft中，OpenKAGE支持开放式终身学习，使智能体群体持续探索并达到高级技术里程碑；累积知识可迁移至不同骨干模型上新初始化的智能体群体，提升其生存能力与探索进度。
AI.conclusion: 面向开放世界自主智能体的群体演化与知识共享是实现开放式终身学习的有效路径，且所学知识具备跨模型、跨群体的可迁移性。

title: Keep the Image in Mind: A Visual Board for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multi-step visual reasoning suffers when early visual misinterpretations persist as incorrect premises in subsequent reasoning. We argue that how visual evidence is represented during reasoning matters as much as how much of it is gathered. Rather than appending observations and inferences to an ever-growing dialogue, we introduce a Visual Board-centered harness that separates visual observations, uncertain interpretations, and derived reasoning within a structured, capacity-bounded, and revisable workspace. This separation makes each premise explicit and auditable, so that conflicts between what is seen and what is derived become detectable even by a text-only critic and can trigger targeted reinspection of the original image. Without task-specific training, our harness consistently outperforms standalone models across 4B, 8B, Qwen3-VL-Flash, and 32B configurations on Euclid30K, SolidGeo, and ChartQA bar charts, with gains of up to 11.68, 18.42, and 24.82 percentage points, respectively. Under identical tools, critic, and interaction limits, the structured Board outperforms shared free-form notes by 6.67 to 13.00 points and no-Board retries by 7.35 to 18.80 points while using 7.9\% to 38.2\% fewer tokens. Supervised fine-tuning on harness trajectories further improves direct answering and critic-free tool use, with positive transfer to chart reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉白板"(Visual Board)框架，将视觉观察、不确定解释与派生推理分离存放在结构化、容量受限、可修订的工作区中，使每个前提显式可审计，从而在多步视觉推理中检测冲突并触发定向重检，无需任务特定训练即可显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉推理中，早期的视觉误解会作为错误前提持续污染后续推理。作者认为，视觉证据在推理过程中的"表示方式"与"采集量"同样重要；而把观察与推断不断追加到无限增长的对话历史中的常规做法，会让前提隐式化、难以发现矛盾。
AI.method: 构建以 Visual Board 为中心的 agent harness：用结构化、容量受限且可修订的工作区，显式区分(a)视觉观察、(b)不确定解释、(c)派生推理三类条目；使每个前提可显式审计，让"所见"与"所推"之间的冲突即便对纯文本 critic 也可检测，并据此触发对原始图像的定向重检。方法不含任务特定训练，并额外用 harness 轨迹做监督微调。
AI.result: 在 Euclid30K、SolidGeo、ChartQA 条形图上，于 4B、8B、Qwen3-VL-Flash、32B 四档模型配置下均稳定优于独立模型，最大提升分别为 11.68、18.42、24.82 个百分点；在相同工具、critic 与交互预算下，结构化 Board 较共享自由笔记高 6.67–13.00 分，较无 Board 重试高 7.35–18.80 分，且 token 用量少 7.9%–38.2%。在 harness 轨迹上监督微调可进一步提升直接作答与无 critic 的工具使用能力，并对图表推理有正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据的结构化表示（而非单纯增加观察量）是提升多步视觉推理可靠性的关键；可审计、可修订的白板机制配合纯文本 critic 即可实现有效的自检与重检，且无需任务特定训练、token 更省，并可通过轨迹微调进一步内化。

title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning
summary: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现潜空间CoT推理到预设完整horizon会损害性能，提出用"建设性进展"刻画推理收益并自适应调整潜推理长度，在不重训LLM的前提下提升准确率最高7.2个百分点、减少计算最高29.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间推理器在推理时按预设的潜horizon运行，直觉上更长horizon应带来更多推理机会，但作者发现延长潜CoT至完整预设horizon反而可能降低推理性能；性能下降源于潜CoT的阶段化功能演化（前期形成前沿推理状态，后期主要重组已有候选并削弱正确候选支持），因此需要重新审视固定horizon的潜推理范式。
AI.method: 将潜CoT的推理收益刻画为"已实现建设性进展"与"剩余建设性进展"两部分，并实证验证：已实现进展越高当前准确率越高，剩余进展越多则继续潜CoT的未来增益越大。基于此提出一种轻量方法，在推理过程中估计剩余推理进展并据此自适应调整潜horizon。
AI.result: 在代表性潜CoT推理器与多个算术基准上，该方法将推理准确率提升最多7.2个百分点，同时减少最多29.0%的潜计算量，且无需重新训练LLM。
AI.conclusion: 固定horizon的潜CoT推理并非越长越好，其收益呈阶段性；通过估计剩余建设性进展实现自适应horizon，可同时提升效果与效率，为潜空间推理的动态计算分配提供了有效方向。

title: Neural Network-Based In-Contact Task Segmentation of Demonstrated Robot Motions via Hand Guiding
comment: Extended abstract, accepted and presented at the 1st German Robotics Conference (GRC 2025), Nuremberg, 13-15 March 2025; no official proceedings, not peer-reviewed; see also https://eref.uni-bayreuth.de/id/eprint/94264
summary: Intuitive robot programming approaches, such as Programming by Demonstration, enable non-experts to teach robots tasks through hand-guided demonstrations. However, for in-contact tasks requiring force control for parts of the motion, automated segmentation of motion types is crucial for improving usability. Considering the related work, this work proposes a neural network-based segmentation method categorizing motion into three fundamental types using input data of cartesian twists and wrenches at the end effector. We collect demonstration data using a 7-axis robot with a wrist-mounted force torque sensor and generate ground truth labeling by hand. While still in development, our research direction aims to enable non-experts to program in-contact tasks more intuitively.

AI.tldr: 提出基于神经网络的运动分割方法，利用末端笛卡尔twist与wrench数据将演示运动分为三类基本类型，服务于接触式任务的直观机器人编程。
AI.motivation: Programming by Demonstration 让非专家通过手把手演示教机器人任务，但对需要力控制的接触式任务，仍需自动分割运动类型以提升可用性。
AI.method: 以末端笛卡尔twist与wrench为输入，设计神经网络分割模型，将运动划分为三种基本类型；使用7轴机器人配腕部力/力矩传感器采集演示数据，并人工生成真值标签。
AI.result: 研究仍在开发中，摘要未报告定量结果；已建立数据采集与人工标注流程并给出方法框架。
AI.conclusion: 目标是使非专家能更直观地编程接触式任务，后续需完成模型验证与性能评估。

title: Benchmarking LLM abilities on postdoc-level natural science problems
summary: Scientific problems have no answer key, so evaluating an agent means deciding what counts as a better solution before any agent is run. Existing benchmarks either match a symbolic answer against a key or, where they require executable work, score it by unit tests, by a rubric, or by position on a competition leaderboard. None of these is the criterion by which a field decides that one published method beats another. STEMBench adopts that criterion directly. Each of its twelve research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics and neuroscience is scored by its own field's figure of merit, and each comes with two measured anchors: a submission that uses no domain knowledge, and an expert reference reproducing a published method, both obtained by running code shipped with the benchmark. The interval between them states how much of a problem is crossed by scientific insight rather than by engineering. Across eight frontier models, task-level wins and domain-level leadership dissociate: a model that wins five of the twelve tasks leads no domain mean. In the high-effort cross-model comparison, at least one model's mean score exceeds the expert anchor on seven of twelve tasks. The remaining five span uncertainty estimation, latent and causal inference, and cross-site clinical classification. Numerical scores and official-submission validity capture different aspects of performance and are reported separately. We release the tasks, graders, anchors and harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 STEMBench，用各学科自身的评价指标（figure of merit）来给 agent 的科学问题求解打分，并以“无领域知识基线”和“复现已发表方法的专家参考”作为两个实测锚点，衡量科学洞察相对于工程实现所跨越的问题比例。
AI.motivation: 科学问题没有标准答案，因此评价 agent 的核心难题在于：在运行任何 agent 之前就要确定"什么算更好的解"。现有基准要么比对符号答案，要么用单元测试、评分量表或竞赛排行榜位置来打分，这些都不是一个领域判定"某方法优于另一方法"所用的标准。
AI.method: STEMBench 直接采用领域自身的判据：包含 12 个来自高能物理、天体物理与神经科学的研究问题，每个问题由其所属领域的 figure of merit 评分；每题附带两个实测锚点——不使用任何领域知识的提交，以及复现某已发表方法的专家参考解，二者均由随基准发布的代码运行得到；两锚点之间的区间刻画了由科学洞察而非工程实现所跨越的部分。另将数值分数与官方提交合规性分开报告。
AI.result: 在八个前沿模型上，任务级获胜与领域级领先出现分离：某模型在 12 个任务中赢下 5 个，却未在任何领域均值上领先。在高投入的跨模型比较中，至少有一个模型的平均分在 12 个任务中的 7 个上超过专家锚点；其余 5 个任务涉及不确定性估计、潜变量与因果推断、跨站点临床分类。
AI.conclusion: 以学科自身判据加双锚点的方式评价科学 agent 是可行的，且能区分"科学洞察"与"工程实现"两类贡献；任务级与领域级表现不一致，说明单一聚合排名会掩盖能力结构差异。作者发布任务、评分器、锚点与运行框架。

title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. Target affinities are calibrated against these same-position references into right-tail Monte Carlo p-values, which are discrete super-uniform under a conditional exchangeability assumption. Calibrated screening and a high-recall semantic guard produce candidate tokens for deterministic visual deduplication and joint spatiotemporal budget allocation. To validate NullTok, we apply it to two representative MLLMs and conduct extensive experiments on a set of video benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness under a bounded visual token budget. For example, it achieves 65.81% and 68.85% on Video-MME using frozen LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones, respectively, at a cap of 64 full-frame equivalents (FFE), without subtitles or audio. These results outperform all evaluated baselines on Video-MME under the same budget for both backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/potato-kitty/NullTok.

AI.tldr: NullTok：一种免训练的长视频理解视觉token压缩方法，通过构建经验零分布校准查询-视觉块相关性，实现高召回的证据保留与联合时空预算分配。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中MLLM的视觉token数量庞大；现有帧选择与token剪枝两大范式简单串联时，帧级相关性估计的噪声会导致不可逆的证据丢失。
AI.method: 从查询特定证据的时空分布角度出发，对每帧每个patch用64个组匹配的无关控制查询构建经验零分布，刻画无目标证据时的期望得分；将目标亲和度对同位参考做校准，转化为右尾蒙特卡洛p值（条件可交换假设下呈离散超均匀分布）；再经校准筛选与高召回语义守卫产生候选token，进行确定性视觉去重与联合时空预算分配；全程免训练。
AI.result: 在固定视觉token预算下（64个全帧等价FFE，无字幕与音频），Video-MME上冻结LLaVA-Video-7B达65.81%，Qwen3-VL-8B达68.85%，在两个骨干上均优于同预算下所有评估基线。
AI.conclusion: 以零分布校准替代启发式相关性打分，可在避免证据不可逆丢失的前提下有效压缩长视频视觉token，NullTok在有限预算下具备通用性与有效性。

title: Algorithmic Market Making Can Lead to Rough Volatility Through the Order Book
summary: Existing work suggests that markets can show volatility with paths rougher than those of Brownian motion. In theory this can happen when the order flow is close to instability with memory that decays as a power law. However, it is not fully clear how such order flow could arise from the predominantly algorithmic market making that characterizes order book dynamics. We show one such consistent mechanism. We treat each market maker as a desk that uses a first-order gradient rule to move the distances of its orders from the mid price toward target distances provided by an unknown oracle. We assume that distinct desks do not act synchronously in time but act whenever new information relevant to their respective oracles arrives, which each desk samples over its own characteristic lookback horizon. Across all desks the rule therefore takes the form of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with information-driven (mini-batch) noise. In the continuum limit this update rule makes the volume of the order book follow a conservative stochastic partial differential equation (the Dean--Kawasaki equation) whose fluctuations drive the order flow. The distinct horizons of the desks further induce a persistent memory in the order flow that decays as a power law. Standard scaling arguments then lead to rough volatility. We confirm the key predictions of the model on simulated agents and on six months of Binance data with about 790 million orders. In liquid markets governed mainly by market makers, such as the perpetual futures of Binance, the order books are consistent with how our desks change the book.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个仅由算法做市驱动的微观机制，可从订单簿动态中内生地产生粗糙波动率。作者将每个做市商视为一个"交易台"，用一阶梯度规则把报单距中间价的距离调整到由未知"预言机"给出的目标距离；各交易台按各自特征回看窗口异步更新，整体等价于带信息驱动小批量噪声的随机梯度下降。取连续极限后，订单簿量满足保守型随机偏微分方程（Dean–Kawasaki方程），其涨落驱动订单流，不同回看horizon又诱发幂律衰减的持久记忆，标准标度论证遂给出粗糙波动率。模拟交易台与币安约7.9亿笔订单、六个月的实证结果均支持模型关键预测。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示市场波动率路径比布朗运动更粗糙；理论解释是订单流接近不稳定且记忆呈幂律衰减。但订单簿动态主要由算法做市主导，订单流如何从这类做市行为中产生尚不清楚，本文旨在给出一个自洽的微观机制。
AI.method: 将每个做市商建模为一个交易台，采用一阶梯度规则把报单与中间价的距离调整至未知预言机给出的目标距离；假设各交易台不同步，仅在与其预言机相关的新信息到达时行动，且各自按特征回看窗口采样。由此总体规则等价于带信息驱动（小批量）噪声的SGD；在连续极限下更新规则使订单簿量服从保守型SPDE（Dean–Kawasaki方程），其涨落驱动订单流；不同horizon诱导订单流呈幂律衰减持久记忆，再经标准标度论证导出粗糙波动率。用模拟agent与真实数据检验关键预测。
AI.result: 在模拟交易台上，以及币安约790 million笔订单、六个月的实证数据中，模型的关键预测均得到验证；在以做市商为主导的流动性市场（如币安永续合约）中，订单簿行为与"交易台改变订单簿"的机制一致。
AI.conclusion: 算法做市的异步、信息驱动梯度调整足以内生地产生保守型订单簿量波动与幂律记忆，进而导致粗糙波动率；该机制在模拟与大规模真实订单簿数据中均获支持。

title: ProbeShare: Probing a Few, Sharing Across Many for Fast World-Model Planning
summary: Visual planning with a frozen joint-embedding world model supports robotic reaching and object manipulation by evaluating candidate action sequences against an image goal before execution. Standard cross-entropy method (CEM) planners roll out every candidate independently through a billion-parameter predictor, even when nearby actions induce similar scene changes. This redundant computation grows with population size and search rounds, slowing closed-loop replanning. We observe that candidates within a planning step share an observation history and thus a common action-to-feature map. Based on this insight, we propose ProbeShare, which measures local responses with a few representative probes and reconstructs each candidate's feature grid through scene-conditioned, geometry-aware weighting. When promising candidates move beyond existing probe coverage, ProbeShare evaluates a new probe to rescore nearby candidates. Across four RoboCasa tasks, ProbeShare accelerates episode planning by 43.8--128.9 times over dense RoboJEPA and at least $14.2\times$ over competitive baselines, with greater mean goal progress in a matched-time comparison.

AI.tldr: ProbeShare 利用同一规划步内候选动作共享观测历史与动作-特征映射的洞察，用少量"探针"测量局部响应并通过场景条件、几何感知加权重建每个候选的特征网格，从而消除 CEM 规划中的冗余前向计算，在四个 RoboCasa 任务上实现最高约 129× 的规划加速。
AI.motivation: 基于冻结联合嵌入世界模型的视觉规划，需要在执行前用 CEM 评估候选动作序列是否达成图像目标。标准 CEM 需将每个候选独立通过十亿参数预测器前向传播，即使邻近动作引起的场景变化高度相似，导致计算随种群规模与搜索轮数线性增长，拖慢闭环重规划。
AI.method: 核心观察：同一规划步内的候选共享观测历史，因而共享同一动作到特征的映射。据此提出 ProbeShare：仅用少量代表性探针动作测量局部响应，再通过场景条件化、几何感知的加权方式为每个候选重建其特征网格；当高潜力候选超出已有探针覆盖范围时，仅评估一个新的探针来重新评分邻近候选，而非对全部候选逐一前向。
AI.result: 在四个 RoboCasa 任务上，ProbeShare 相较稠密的 RoboJEPA 将单回合规划加速 43.8–128.9 倍，相较竞争性基线加速至少 14.2 倍；在等时间对比下取得更高的平均目标完成进度。
AI.conclusion: 候选间特征响应的可共享性使世界模型规划中的大量前向计算成为冗余；以探针+重建替代逐候选评估，可在几乎不损失规划质量的前提下大幅提升闭环重规划效率，为实时机器人规划提供可行路径。

title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
summary:
AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy.
  We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. Following this observation, we show that by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy. Strikingly, this simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style task router, highlighting a practical path for deploying cost-aware coding agents in production without complex learned task routers and with minimal engineering complexity.

AI.tldr: 论文评估36个2024年以来发布的开源大/小模型在软件工程基准上的表现，发现小模型与大模型的精度差距高度集中在困难任务上；据此提出"先小模型、必要时升级到大模型"的级联式混合推理策略，在SWE-bench Verified上不损失精度即可降低最高33%的GPU小时成本、整体降低16.4%，且效果接近oracle式任务路由器。
AI.motivation: AI编程智能体是大模型最热门的应用之一，但智能体推理消耗海量GPU算力，损害其盈利能力和规模化可行性。作者希望验证：更小、更便宜的模型能否在不牺牲准确率的前提下削减这部分成本。
AI.method: 在软件工程基准上评测2024年以来发布的36个主流开源（open-weight）大、小模型；分析精度差距的结构分布（按任务难度分层）；据此设计混合推理/级联策略：先用小模型尝试，仅在需要时升级到大模型；并与oracle式任务路由器对比。
AI.result: 近期小模型正缩小与大模型的精度差距；差距高度集中于小模型难以解决的困难任务，而在简单与中等复杂度任务上精度表现优异；混合级联策略在SWE-bench Verified上实现最高33%的GPU小时成本下降、全部任务上16.4%的成本下降，且不损失精度；该简单级联几乎追平oracle式任务路由器。
AI.conclusion: 廉价的级联式混合推理为生产环境部署成本感知的编程智能体提供了实用路径，无需复杂的学习型任务路由器，工程复杂度极低。

title: Can AI Understand Indonesian Children's Book Illustrations? Compliance, Safety, and the Cultural Alignment Gap
comment: Accepted at Workshop on Computer Vision for Children (CV4CHL) at CVPR 2026 (Non-Proceeding Track)
summary: Children's book illustrations carry developmental, pedagogical, and cultural responsibilities that are often formally codified in guidelines. As AI systems begin entering children's publishing pipelines, both as evaluators and as generators, a natural question arises: can they reliably meet the structural, safety, and cultural standards required? We investigate this across three criteria: guideline compliance, safety, and cultural alignment, using Indonesia's Book Leveling Guideline as a government-issued evaluation framework with explicit visual criteria for four reading levels. To understand how well VLMs can identify and apply these guideline criteria, we first evaluate them on real published children's book pages and compare their assessments against a human baseline. To then examine whether AI-generated illustrations meet the same standards, we apply the VLM judge to images produced by two generation models and cross-check them against a subset of human illustrator raters. We find that VLMs are reliable on explicit criteria such as compliance and safety, but fall short on cultural alignment, systematically missing content that human raters flag as culturally inappropriate. AI-generated illustrations show the same blind spot: they satisfy structural and safety criteria but fail to capture implicit cultural details that human raters consistently identify.

AI.tldr: 本文以印尼政府发布的《图书分级指南》为评估框架，考察视觉语言模型（VLM）能否作为儿童绘本插画的评估者与生成者，可靠满足合规、安全与文化对齐三项标准。
AI.motivation: 儿童绘本插画承担发展、教育与文化责任，常被正式写入规范；随着AI系统进入童书出版流程（既作评估者又作生成者），其能否达到结构、安全与文化标准成为亟待验证的问题。
AI.method: 选取印尼《图书分级指南》中针对四个阅读级别的明确视觉标准，构建合规性、安全性、文化对齐三维评估。先在真实出版绘本页面上评测VLM，并与人类基线对比；再将VLM作为评审用于两个生成模型的输出图像，并与部分人类插画师评分交叉验证。
AI.result: VLM在合规与安全等显性标准上表现可靠，但在文化对齐上明显不足，系统性地漏检人类评审标记为文化不当的内容；AI生成插画呈现相同盲区——满足结构与安全标准，却遗漏人类评审一致识别的隐性文化细节。
AI.conclusion: VLM可作为显性标准（合规、安全）的可用评审，但尚不能胜任文化对齐判断，AI生成模型亦存在同类缺陷；进入童书出版流程需针对隐性文化维度补充人类监督与专门评测。

title: From Data to Valves: A Self-Learning, Production-Grade Edge Stack for Sustainable HVAC Control
summary: Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions alone, with a behaviour anchor and critic calibration terms, is scored by four model-free metrics and promoted by atomic hot-swap. (c) A change-point regression baseline held to ASHRAE Guideline 14 supplies the counterfactual against which savings are certified. On eighteen months of data from a hotel the forecaster converges from random weights within a week and reaches 0.37, 0.39 and 0.11 degree C MAE for air-handling, fresh-air and fan-coil units with no retraining event; on a different hotel the baseline reproduces a 46-day held-out period to within 0.07%. The RL agent has completed its in-simulator campaign and runs in shadow on 104 units; we report measured latency and memory of every service on a shared 15 GB device, the systems lessons of the campaign, and precisely what the evidence does and does not yet establish.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个部署在单台NVIDIA Jetson Orin网关（每栋建筑一台）的暖通空调（HVAC）学习控制生产栈：变压器编码器预测器、分布型SAC强化学习智能体与ASHRAE Guideline 14变更点回归基线三组件在设备端持续学习并自行验证效果；在酒店十八个月数据上预测器一周内从随机权重收敛、三类末端MAE为0.37/0.39/0.11 ℃，另一酒店基线46天留出期误差≤0.07%，RL智能体已完成仿真训练并在104台末端上影子运行。
AI.motivation: 学习型HVAC控制器大多停留在仿真器内；少数落地的方案通常在离线训练、部署后冻结、依赖云端重训，难以持续适配单栋建筑自身的运行数据，也缺乏对节能效果的可信自验证。
AI.method: (a) 紧凑型变压器编码器预测器：按设备组各一个，带学习到的机组嵌入，预测各空气侧末端的下一周期温度，采用前序学习（每5分钟周期一步梯度），并由五个独立门控限制任何异常读数的影响；(b) 分布型软演员-评论家（SAC）智能体：跨末端类型共享策略，将测量状态映射为冷冻水阀位，受不可被学习组件放松的结构性安全包络约束，第二代仅在设备端用已记录转移夜间训练，含行为锚定与评论家校准项，由四个无模型指标评分并以原子热切换晋升；(c) 遵循ASHRAE Guideline 14的变更点回归基线提供反事实，用于认证节能量。
AI.result: 酒店十八个月数据上，预测器在无重训事件的情况下于一周内从随机权重收敛，空气处理机组、新风机组与风机盘管的MAE分别为0.37、0.39、0.11 ℃；另一家酒店基线在46天留出期上复现误差在0.07%以内；RL智能体已完成仿真训练，并在104台末端上影子运行；同时报告了共享15 GB设备上各服务的实测时延与内存、以及系统性经验教训。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了多学习组件可在单一边缘网关上持续自学习并自验证的工程可行性，但证据目前仅支持预测精度与基线复现能力及影子运行表现，尚不足以支撑闭环RL的实际节能结论；论文明确界定了证据所能与尚不能确立的内容。

title: CommDreamer: Radio-Geometric World Models for Mapless Cellular-Connected UAV Trajectory Planning
summary: Reliable cellular connectivity and collision-free flight are essential for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations in low-altitude urban canyons, where dense 3D buildings obstruct flight clearance, shadow serving base stations, and create strong co-channel interference at street intersections. Existing planners either require prior 3D city meshes and channel knowledge maps unavailable onboard, or rely on model-free reinforcement learning with low sample efficiency and poor cross-city generalization. We propose CommDreamer, a mapless radio-geometric world model that fuses raw onboard 3D LiDAR scans, multicell cellular reports, and shift-invariant relative kinematics to jointly infer local obstacle clearance and directional signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) dynamics. Using a categorical recurrent state-space model, CommDreamer compresses multimodal measurement histories into a coordinate-invariant latent belief, enabling the UAV to foresee deep shadow zones and train a lightweight online policy purely via multi-step latent imagination without prior maps or antenna patterns. Zero-shot evaluations across unseen urban morphologies in our open-source ray-tracing simulator, AeroCity-RT, show that CommDreamer converges within 150 episodes where model-free reinforcement learning fails to complete flights, achieving 100.0% mission success with zero collisions while lifting median route SINR to 8.02 dB and cutting effective SINR outage by over 50% relative to radio-blind world-model and reactive LiDAR baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 CommDreamer——一种无地图的"无线-几何"世界模型，融合机载3D LiDAR、多小区蜂窝测量与平移不变相对运动学，用类别循环状态空间模型压缩多模态历史为坐标不变的隐信念，并通过多步隐空间想象在线训练轻量策略，实现城市峡谷中零碰撞、高SINR的UAV飞行。
AI.motivation: 低空城市峡谷中密集3D建筑遮挡飞行净空、遮蔽服务基站并在路口造成强同频干扰，可靠蜂窝连接与无碰撞飞行成为刚需。现有规划器要么依赖机载不可得的先验3D城市网格与信道知识地图，要么采用样本效率低、跨城市泛化差的免模型强化学习。
AI.method: CommDreamer由原始机载3D LiDAR扫描、多小区蜂窝上报与平移不变相对运动学共同驱动，联合推断局部障碍净空与方向性SINR动态；采用类别循环状态空间模型（categorical recurrent state-space model）将多模态量测历史压缩为坐标不变的隐信念，使UAV可预见深阴影区，并仅通过多步隐空间想象训练轻量在线策略，无需先验地图或天线方向图。
AI.result: 在开源射线追踪仿真器AeroCity-RT上对未见城市形态进行零样本评测：CommDreamer在150个回合内收敛（免模型RL无法完成飞行），任务成功率100.0%、碰撞为零；中位路径SINR提升至8.02 dB，相较无线盲世界模型与反应式LiDAR基线，有效SINR中断降低50%以上。
AI.conclusion: 无地图的多模态世界模型可替代先验地图与信道知识地图，在低空城市峡谷中同时保障通信质量与飞行安全，并具备良好的跨城市零样本泛化能力；配套开源仿真器AeroCity-RT为后续研究提供可复现基准。

title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
summary: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: https://github.com/unlayer-ai/automodel.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 automodel——一个可移植的"模型发现配方"式智能体技能（agent skill），将其提供给通用编程智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex）即可自动发现或改进模型，并在天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流与轮胎动力学等案例中成功产出新颖且具科学意义的模型。
AI.motivation: 模型发现（解析方程或神经架构）正从人工设计转向数据驱动自动化，但现有方法要么是穷举搜索、要么是 AlphaEvolve 等专用算法/领域特定流水线，通用性与可迁移性不足。作者由此提出：是否只需给通用编程智能体提供一套"模型发现方法论"，就足以完成模型发现与改进？
AI.method: 将模型发现方法论编码为一个可移植的智能体技能 automodel，挂载于商用通用编程智能体之上，以交互方式驱动模型搜索、拟合与改进；在五个跨学科案例（天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流、车辆轮胎动力学）中开展案例研究验证。
AI.result: 配备 automodel 的商用智能体在全部五个领域均成功识别出新颖且具有科学相关性的模型，表明无需领域专用自动化流水线亦可实现有效的模型发现。
AI.conclusion: 把模型发现方法论封装为可移植的智能体技能，可作为领域专用自动化发现流水线的一种简单、可交互、强大且广泛适用的替代方案；技能已开源。

title: Beyond Additive Composition: Interventional Modeling of State-Dependent Cross-Degradation Responses for Composite Image Restoration
summary: Composite image restoration aims to recover images corrupted by multiple coexisting degradations. Existing methods predominantly decompose composite corruptions into individual factors, relying on these isolated priors to guide restoration. However, coexisting degradations are inherently interdependent: the manifestation of one degradation dynamically shifts with the states of others, inducing non-additive interactions that factor-wise paradigms fail to capture. To bridge this gap, we formulate state-dependent cross-degradation responses and propose PROBE, an interventional framework that explicitly models how coexisting degradations influence one another. Specifically, we first construct unified degradation axes by aligning visual and textual degraded-clean offsets. Along these axes, a calibrated coordinate head estimates current degradation states, while bidirectional feature perturbations are injected to probe cross-coordinate responses under the current states. Contrasting these responses with corresponding intensity-matched single-degradation references quantifies intrinsic non-additive deviations, allowing the resulting response descriptors and state coordinates to jointly guide restoration. For comprehensive evaluation, we introduce SCD-15, a new benchmark covering all 15 nonempty combinations of four degradation factors at three severity levels. Experiments demonstrate that PROBE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the CDD-11, AWMM-100K, and SCD-15 composite restoration datasets using a compact model with modest GPU memory requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出PROBE干预式框架，显式建模复合退化间的状态依赖交叉响应，量化非加性偏差以指导图像复原，并构建SCD-15基准，在三个数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有复合图像复原方法将复合退化分解为单一因素并依赖孤立先验，忽略了共存退化间的相互依赖：某一退化的表现会随其他退化状态动态变化，产生因子分解范式无法刻画非加性交互。
AI.method: 1) 通过对齐视觉与文本的退化-干净偏移构建统一退化轴；2) 沿轴用校准坐标头估计当前退化状态；3) 注入双向特征扰动，探查当前状态下的跨坐标响应；4) 将响应与强度匹配的单一退化参考对比，量化内在非加性偏差；5) 由响应描述子与状态坐标联合指导复原；6) 构建SCD-15基准（4种退化因子全部15种非空组合×3个严重程度）。
AI.result: 在CDD-11、AWMM-100K及新提出的SCD-15复合复原数据集上均达到SOTA，且模型紧凑、GPU显存需求适中。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨退化状态依赖的非加性交互，比因子分解式孤立先验更有效；所提SCD-15为复合退化复原提供了系统性评测基准。

title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure; includes supplementary proofs and reproduction code
summary: Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[μ,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $χ\in[1,L/μ]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-μχ)/(2μL\sqrtχ)$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.

AI.tldr: 该文刻画了联合学习在给定条件数约束下可达到的最小最坏情形偏差，证明最优偏差率为 (L-μχ)/(2μL√χ)，并由小步长局部梯度下降与近端更新达到该界。
AI.motivation: 本地计算能改善联邦更新的条件数，但会引入偏差，使其不动点偏离全局极小点。作者希望量化在给定条件数上界下不可避免的最小最坏偏差，从而厘清"改善条件数"与"引入偏差"之间的最优权衡。
AI.method: 考虑强凸二次客户端目标，Hessian 特征值位于 [μ,L]，本地更新由一个共享的正谱滤波器表示；客户端异质性用全局极小点处的均方根梯度度量。在均匀代理条件数不超过 χ∈[1,L/μ] 的约束下，推导每单位异质性的精确最坏情形偏差。分析中将任意维度（含非交换 Hessian）的客户端群体归约为标量曲率上的分布，从而给出最优性证书与最坏情形构造。
AI.result: 得到精确的最坏情形偏差率 (L-μχ)/(2μL√χ)，并证明充分小步长的本地梯度下降与近端更新可达到该界；最坏情形构造至多需要三个标量客户端。此外，将尖锐的近端偏差界推广到二次型之外的平滑强凸目标，并量化了不精确本地求解带来的误差。
AI.conclusion: 本地计算带来的条件数改善存在精确且可达到的偏差下界，所提归约方法为分析联邦优化中的偏差-条件数权衡提供了紧致工具，并可扩展到一般平滑强凸目标与非精确本地求解情形。

title: Towards Vacuum-Assisted Robotic Needle Interventions: From Fluid Aspiration to Tissue Biopsy
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Robotic ultrasound-guided needle interventions have primarily focused on target localization and accurate needle placement, while the subsequent acquisition of diagnostic material remains comparatively underexplored. Moreover, pleural fluid aspiration and tissue biopsy are typically addressed as separate procedures, despite sharing common requirements for ultrasound guidance, safe access, and sample transport. This work presents a unified robotic framework for ultrasound-guided fluid and tissue extraction using a single vacuum-assisted end effector. The proposed system combines force controlled ultrasound scanning, semantic target identification, automated needle deployment, and procedure specific material acquisition. A coaxial needle assembly and shared pump assisted pathway enable direct pleural fluid aspiration, while controlled cannula actuation provides the additional cutting action required for solid-tissue acquisition. End-to-end evaluation using a Franka Emika Panda robot over 50 phantom trials achieved successful extraction in 23/25 pleural fluid aspiration trials (92\%) and 22/25 tissue acquisition trials (88\%). Following successful tissue-target access, acquisition and transport were completed in all 22 trials.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个统一的机器人框架，用单一真空辅助末端执行器完成超声引导下的胸腔积液抽吸与组织活检两类操作。系统集成力控超声扫描、语义目标识别、自动进针与术式特异性取材，采用同轴针组件与共享泵抽吸通路，并通过套管驱动实现切割动作。在Panda机器人上完成50次体模试验，抽液成功率92%（23/25），取材成功率88%（22/25），且在成功到达靶点后取材与转运均100%完成。
AI.motivation: 机器人超声引导针刺研究多聚焦于靶点定位与精准置针，对后续诊断样本获取关注不足；同时胸腔积液抽吸与组织活检虽在超声引导、安全入路和样本输送上有共性，却通常被作为两种独立术式分别处理。
AI.method: 构建统一硬件与算法框架：力控超声扫描、语义目标识别、自动进针、术式特异性取材；同轴针组件与共享泵辅助通路实现直接抽液，可控套管驱动提供实体组织取材所需附加切割动作。
AI.result: Franka Emika Panda机器人50次体模试验：胸腔积液抽吸23/25（92%）成功，组织取材22/25（88%）成功；在成功建立组织靶点入路的22次试验中，取材与转运全部完成。
AI.conclusion: 单一真空辅助末端执行器与共享通路设计可将抽液与活检整合为统一机器人平台，验证了"定位—进针—取材—转运"一体化流程的可行性，但样本量仅为体模试验，尚需离体与活体验证。

title: When Figures Disagree with Text: Evaluating Autonomous Visual Evidence Verification in Scientific Papers
summary: Scientific figures carry evidence for the claims that cite them, so reviewing a paper means checking that a figure agrees with the text, and not only describing what the figure shows. Benchmarks of figure-text verification typically hand the model the figure, the claim, or the knowledge that an inconsistency exists, which leaves untested whether a model can find the figure worth checking in a complete paper, relate a visual element to the claim it conflicts with, and recognize the conflict. We study this autonomous setting on 31 full manuscripts, each carrying a reviewer-documented figure-text inconsistency from PRISMM-Bench that is hidden from the model. Six multimodal models review each PDF under a neutral prompt, and we then add one input at a time to the same manuscripts. Of 1,445 open-ended reviews, 60.6% mention the flawed figure, yet a grading rubric accepts only 3.3% as diagnosing its contradiction; a blind audit finds the rubric lenient, so we read these as rubric-accepted rates and compare conditions rather than absolute values. In a separate controlled run, naming the figure, without stating that it is flawed, raises rubric-accepted diagnosis from 4.3% to 20.4%, while a consistency instruction and coarse visual cues do not. When the contradiction is visible only in the rendered figure, text-only review yields no accepted diagnosis, while review of the rendered pages with the figure named reaches 15.8%. A baseline that lets the model choose which figures to check, ranked by centrality, stays at 4.8%. Deciding what to verify is thus a large part of the difficulty, and the selection rule we tested does not resolve it. Multimodal document understanding should be evaluated on whether a model can propose what to verify, not only answer questions about a figure it is handed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自主图文核验"任务，让多模态模型在31篇完整手稿中自行发现并诊断被隐藏的图文矛盾；结果显示提及缺陷图的评论占60.6%，但被评分标准接受为真正诊断的仅3.3%，说明"决定核验什么"才是核心难点。
AI.motivation: 现有图文一致性/图文验证基准通常直接把图、被引用的论断、或"存在不一致"这一提示交给模型，因此模型能否在完整论文中自主定位值得核验的图、把视觉元素与被冲突的论断关联起来并识别冲突，尚未被检验。作者希望在被隐藏答案的真实审稿式场景下考察这种自主能力。
AI.method: 使用PRISMM-Bench中31篇带有审稿人记录图文不一致的完整手稿；六个多模态模型在中性提示下审阅每份PDF，随后在同样手稿上逐一追加单一输入（点名图、告知存在缺陷、一致性指令、粗粒度视觉线索等）；共得到1,445条开放式评论，用评分标准判定是否"诊断出矛盾"，并做盲审校验；另设受控实验比较"仅文本审阅"与"渲染页面审阅"、以及按中心性排序让模型自选核验对象的基线。
AI.result: 1,445条评论中60.6%提及了有缺陷的图，但仅3.3%被评分标准接受为诊断出矛盾；盲审认为评分标准偏宽松，故结果以"评分标准接受率"和条件间比较的方式解读。受控运行中，仅点名图而不告知其有缺陷，可将接受率从4.3%提升至20.4%，而一致性指令与粗粒度视觉线索无效。当矛盾只在渲染图中可见时，纯文本审阅的接受率为0，而点名图并审阅渲染页面可达15.8%。按中心性排序让模型自选核验对象的基线仅为4.8%。
AI.conclusion: "决定核验什么"是难度的重要来源，且所测试的选择规则未能解决该问题；多模态文档理解评测应关注模型能否主动提出应核验的内容，而不仅是回答针对已给定图的问题。

title: SixthView: A Benchmark for Hidden-View Reconstruction and 3D Assembly Reasoning
summary: Inferring the unseen side of a 3D assembly requires reasoning about part placement and occlusion. Different assemblies can match the observed views while producing different hidden views, leaving the target ambiguous. We introduce SixthView, a benchmark in which models predict a sixth orthographic view from five observed views and information about the component shapes. The benchmark contains 602 synthetic polycube assemblies with 2--10 parts and requires a dense grid of part labels for the missing view, allowing both exact-view and cell-level evaluation. For each item, we exhaustively verify that all legal assemblies consistent with the exact component geometry and observed label grids yield the same target view. With these inputs, the task tests symbolic assembly and coordinate reasoning. The image-only variants additionally require shape recovery from rendered views, where occlusion can make different 3D shapes look identical. We evaluate three vision-language models under four input conditions. Across 552 items with complete evaluations, exact-grid accuracy with images plus exact text ranges from 33.2% to 85.4%. Adding exact text to separate images improves accuracy by 19.7--63.0 percentage points, whereas adding images to exact text changes it by only $-0.5$ to $+2.1$ points. Separate image panels outperform a merged sheet by 6.7--11.1 points. The results show that performance depends strongly on access to exact symbolic information, with little further improvement from images once the geometry is specified. GitHub: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sixthview_benchmark

AI.tldr: SixthView 是首个从五视图+部件形状推断第六正交视图的基准，含602个合成 polycube 装配体，要求对缺失视图给出稠密部件标签网格；在552个完整评测项上，VLM 精确网格准确率为33.2%–85.4%，性能高度依赖精确符号输入，图像在几何已知后增益有限。
AI.motivation: 推断3D装配体不可见一侧需要推理部件摆放与遮挡。不同装配可能匹配观测视图却产生不同的隐藏视图，使目标存在歧义。作者因此构建可穷尽验证歧义性的基准，以检验模型的符号装配与坐标推理能力，并区分"形状恢复"与"装配推理"两类难点。
AI.method: 构建602个合成 polycube 装配体（2–10个部件），任务为从五个正交视图及部件形状信息预测第六视图，标注为稠密部件标签网格，支持精确视图与单元级两种评测。对每项穷尽枚举所有与精确部件几何及观测标签网格一致的合法装配，验证其目标视图唯一。另设仅图像变体以考察渲染视图中的形状恢复；在四种输入条件下评测三个视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 552个完整评测项中，图像+精确文本的精确网格准确率为33.2%–85.4%。在分离图像上加入精确文本提升19.7–63.0个百分点；反之在精确文本上加入图像仅变化−0.5至+2.1个百分点。分离图像面板比合并图板高6.7–11.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 性能强烈依赖精确符号信息的可获得性；几何被显式指定后，图像几乎不带来额外收益，说明当前VLM的瓶颈主要在从视觉中恢复精确3D结构而非装配推理本身。分离呈现视图优于拼接图板，提示输入组织方式对空间推理有实质影响。

title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
summary: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.

AI.tldr: 提出多专家回放策略蒸馏（MRPD）：无需环境采样，直接按各专家自身训练顺序回放其RL训练日志（含采样概率与奖励），在记录前缀上重算策略梯度并蒸馏最终专家分布，以约1/7的算力完成专家整合，并在推理、搜索、SQL三个长程智能体任务上优于在线RL与MOPD。
AI.motivation: 前沿后训练的常见范式是"每域训练一个RL专家，再用多教师on-policy蒸馏（MOPD）整合为单模型"。但MOPD代价高昂：学生需在每个环境中重新采样，每个采样token都要由专家打分，且学生继承最终专家的漂移（drift）。作者认为整合所需的信息其实已存在于专家RL训练过程中产生的带概率与奖励的轨迹里。
AI.method: MRPD回放专家训练日志：按各专家实际学习的顺序将轨迹回放给当前学生，在记录的每个前缀处重新计算策略梯度，并在该前缀上蒸馏最终专家的分布。由于沿专家自身的轨迹推进，训练-推理不匹配减少，学生保持在校度裁剪范围内，使回放虽源于off-policy数据却在整合全程近似on-policy。整个流程无需采样、不调用环境或奖励模型，仅由训练器单进程完成。
AI.result: 在推理、搜索、SQL三个长程智能体域上，MRPD得到最优学生模型，显著超过在线RL基线，并以远低于MOPD的成本超过同等专家训练出的MOPD。消融表明：回放轨迹本身贡献主要增益，策略梯度项与蒸馏项均有正向叠加；且日志的顺序比其数量或奖励更重要。
AI.conclusion: 专家整合的开销可通过复用训练日志大幅压缩（约1/7算力）。专家训练日志应被视为一种课程（curriculum）而非数据混合，其时间顺序本身携带关键监督信号。

title: Old Experience, New Lessons: Relabeling Autonomous Robot Rollouts in Interactive Imitation Learning
summary: Interactive imitation learning enables robots to learn from human interventions during deployment. These interactions naturally produce sparse human corrections and abundant autonomous robot experience without human action labels. Yet existing methods either leave this experience unused for action supervision or imitate historical robot actions, which can reinforce suboptimal behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Set-valued Relabeling of Autonomous experience (SeRA), a framework that learns from autonomous robot experience through set-valued supervision of policy relabels. Later policy checkpoints relabel this experience, and agreement across checkpoints filters the relabels. Since agreement does not guarantee correctness, SeRA constructs desired action sets around accepted relabels. Following Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), it trains an action-chunking diffusion policy to increase the probability of actions within these sets. A step-masked denoising loss combines accepted relabels with available human corrections in partially supervised chunks. Experiments across five simulated manipulation tasks in online and offline settings show that SeRA improves policy performance over SDP and outperforms baselines that imitate historical robot actions or exact relabels. On a real-robot tomato-picking task, SeRA achieves 80% success, compared with 40% for SDP, using the same human feedback and training budget. These results demonstrate that relabeled autonomous robot experience can complement human corrections to improve policy performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SeRA框架，用集合值监督方式对自主机器人经验进行重标注，与人类修正互补以提升策略性能。
AI.motivation: 交互式模仿学习中，人类修正稀疏而自主经验丰富但无动作标签；现有方法要么弃用这些经验，要么模仿历史机器人动作，可能强化次优行为。
AI.method: 利用后续策略检查点对自主经验重标注，以检查点间一致性筛选重标注；鉴于一致性不等于正确性，围绕被接受的重标注构造期望动作集合，遵循SDP训练动作分块扩散策略以提高集合内动作概率；在部分监督的动作块上采用步掩码去噪损失，融合被接受重标注与可用人类修正。
AI.result: 在五个仿真操作任务的在线与离线设置中，SeRA优于SDP及模仿历史机器人动作或精确重标注的基线；真实番茄采摘任务中成功率达80%，SDP为40%（相同人类反馈与训练预算）。
AI.conclusion: 重标注的自主机器人经验可补充人类修正，从而提升策略性能。

title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
summary:
Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls.
  Empirically, SCH improves long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost. In a controlled 150-task SWE-bench study, SCH's evidence recovery improves Pass@1 from $80.0\%$ to $86.9\%$ at essentially unchanged token use and execution time. In the complete-system comparison, SCH achieves 86.9% Pass@1 while using 43% fewer tokens and 41% less wall-clock time than the strongest baseline by task performance. Across models and benchmarks, SCH consistently reduces token use relative to full-history prompting while remaining competitive with or improving upon the evaluated baselines. Trajectory analysis confirms that SCH recovers evidence from substantially earlier parts of the interaction history rather than merely preserving a recent context window.

AI.tldr: 提出语义上下文交接（SCH），以“状态—证据分离”机制管理长程智能体上下文，在降低成本的同时提升任务通过率。
AI.motivation: 传统长程LLM智能体采用全历史提示，随执行推进历史不断增长，导致推理成本上升且可能降低准确率；现有“保留紧凑结论、删除早期观察”的方法会丢弃后续可能重新相关的证据。
AI.method: SCH的核心抽象为状态—证据分离：用紧凑的语义状态承载智能体当前的解释，而支撑性的动作—观察证据单独存储、可寻址，并在后续执行使其相关时重新进入上下文，且无需额外的摘要步骤或检索模型调用。
AI.result: 在150任务SWE-bench受控实验中，证据回收将Pass@1从80.0%提升至86.9%，token用量与执行时间基本不变；完整系统对比中达86.9% Pass@1，较最佳基线减少43% token与41%挂钟时间。跨模型、跨基准均能降低token使用并保持竞争力。轨迹分析显示SCH恢复的是交互历史中更早部分的证据，而非仅保留近期窗口。
AI.conclusion: 状态—证据分离是一种有效的长程上下文管理范式，可在不牺牲（甚至提升）性能的前提下显著削减上下文成本，并支持对远期证据的按需回溯。

title: ProxySearch: Decoupled Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models via Asymmetric Noise-Rank Transfer
summary: Noise search at inference time improves text-to-image diffusion but requires many multi-step teacher rollouts per query. Distilled few-step models are now routinely released, yet their potential as proxies inside noise search is uncharacterized. We measure proxy-teacher rank agreement across three distillation regimes and three backbones (DiT, MMDiT, UNet) and find a sharp asymmetry. On our main pool, closed-form image statistics transfer from the proxy to the teacher (Spearman $ρ$ up to 0.80), while learned semantic scorers do not ($ρ\le$ 0.12). Paired null controls trace this rank to the first denoising step for coarse statistics and to distillation for finer ones. We use the asymmetry for noise search under a joint constraint: a semantic reward specifies content, and a numeric target specifies image statistics. In PROXYSEARCH, the proxy filters candidates by statistical match in 1 step, and the teacher returns the survivor with the highest semantic reward. No weight trades one objective against the other. On FLUX-1024, PROXYSEARCH tightens the statistical target by 21-23% at the same number of teacher trajectories, with no detected loss on the optimized reward.

AI.tldr: 蒸馏少步扩散模型可作为噪声搜索中的"代理教师"，但其作为代理的可信度此前未被刻画。作者发现代理-教师在闭式图像统计上高度一致（Spearman ρ≤0.80），而在学习式语义打分器上几乎不一致（ρ≤0.12），并据此提出PROXYSEARCH：代理负责筛选统计匹配，教师只在幸存者上打分。
AI.motivation: 推理期噪声搜索能显著提升文本到图像扩散的生成质量，但每个查询需多次多步教师 rollout，计算代价极高。少步蒸馏模型已被普遍发布，若能用其充当代理可大幅降本，然而代理与教师在排序上的一致性（尤其在不同蒸馏范式与架构下）尚无系统刻画，导致无法安全地替代。
AI.method: 在3种蒸馏范式与3种骨干（DiT、MMDiT、UNet）上测量代理-教师排序一致性；用配对零假设对照（paired null controls）定位一致性来源（首步去噪 vs. 蒸馏过程）。基于发现的不对称性设计PROXYSEARCH：联合约束下，语义奖励指定内容、数值目标指定图像统计；代理以1步前向按统计匹配度过滤候选，教师对幸存者按语义奖励择优，两目标不做权重折中。
AI.result: 在主实验池上，闭式图像统计可由代理迁移至教师（Spearman ρ最高0.80），而学习式语义打分器不可迁移（ρ≤0.12）。配对对照显示：粗粒度统计的排序一致性源于第一步去噪，细粒度统计则源于蒸馏本身。在FLUX-1024上，相同教师轨迹数下PROXYSEARCH将统计目标误差收紧21–23%，且未检测到优化奖励上的损失。
AI.conclusion: 少步蒸馏模型的代理价值是"条件性"的：仅对闭式统计类信号可靠，对学习式语义奖励不可靠。将代理限定为统计筛选器、教师限定为语义裁决者，可在不牺牲奖励的前提下显著提升统计可控性与搜索效率，为低成本噪声搜索提供了可解释且无需权衡的设计原则。

title: FDM+: A Framework for Constrained Control of the 2D Radiative Transport Equation
summary: Applying the frozen diffusion model (FDM) [29] to the constrained control of the 2D radiative transport equation presents several challenges. These include the dimensional difference between control variables and state functions, the resolution mismatch between traditional numerical solvers and deep learning models, and solution non-uniqueness. To address these obstacles, we propose a novel approach, FDM+, which includes three key improvements. Firstly, a decoupled prediction architecture is introduced to address the dimensional heterogeneity. Secondly, an efficient parameterization strategy resolves the resolution mismatch. Meanwhile, we derive a total error bound to analyze how the parameterization error and the model estimation error jointly affect the performance. Thirdly, the conditional distribution learned by the diffusion model is leveraged to perform design space exploration for multi-solution problems. A series of numerical experiments demonstrate that FDM+ outperforms existing methods in reconstruction accuracy and design flexibility.

AI.tldr: 针对二维辐射传输方程约束控制问题，提出FDM+：解耦预测架构解决控制变量与状态函数维度不匹配，高效参数化策略解决传统数值求解器与深度模型分辨率失配，并利用扩散模型学到的条件分布处理解不唯一性；给出总误差界，实验显示重构精度与设计灵活性优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 将冻结扩散模型（FDM）用于二维辐射传输方程的约束控制存在三类障碍：(1) 控制变量与状态函数之间的维度差异；(2) 传统数值求解器与深度学习模型之间的分辨率失配；(3) 解的非唯一性。
AI.method: 提出FDM+，含三项改进：① 解耦预测架构，应对维度异构性；② 高效参数化策略，消除分辨率失配，并推导总误差界，分析参数化误差与模型估计误差对性能的联合影响；③ 利用扩散模型学到的条件分布进行多解问题的设计空间探索。
AI.result: 一系列数值实验表明，FDM+在重构精度和设计灵活性上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FDM+通过解耦预测、参数化与条件分布探索三项设计，有效克服了将冻结扩散模型应用于二维辐射传输方程约束控制的三大障碍，并具备误差理论保障。

title: QDD-MM: A Simple and Compact Open-Source Muscle Module with Quasi-Direct-Drive Motor for Tendon-driven Robots
comment: Accepted to IEEE-RAS Humanoids 2026, website - https://haraduka.github.io/qddmm/, youtube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=09xRhZO497k
summary: Tendon-driven robots, which actuate like biological muscles by using motors to wind wires, offer advantages such as variable stiffness and redundant actuation. Despite these advantages, musculoskeletal structures inherently involve a large number of diverse muscles, making it desirable to compactly modularize each muscle unit and flexibly accommodate diverse muscle arrangements. While various small muscle modules have been proposed to date, existing designs tend to be complex, difficult to maintain, and suffer from low backdrivability and limited actuation speed due to their high gear ratios. In this work, we propose QDD-MM, a muscle module that leverages recent advances in quasi-direct-drive motors to achieve a simpler and more compact structure with higher backdrivability and faster actuation than previous modules. By utilizing quasi-direct-drive motors, the module eliminates the need for dedicated force-sensing mechanisms, significantly simplifying the overall design, while also supporting flexible wire routing in multiple directions, various module-to-module connections, and even the use of the module body itself as a structural component. QDD-MM integrates these capabilities into a reusable muscle module, and its design is openly available at https://github.com/haraduka/qddmm. We developed tendon-driven robots with one joint and either two or three muscles, as well as a partial musculoskeletal humanoid, using the proposed QDD-MM and verified their effectiveness. We expect that this muscle module will democratize tendon-driven robotics and further accelerate progress in the field.

AI.tldr: 提出QDD-MM肌肉模块，基于准直驱电机实现简洁紧凑、高背驱性与高速度的腱驱动单元，并验证其在一/二/三肌肉关节机器人及部分肌骨人形上的有效性，设计开源。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动机器人具备变刚度与冗余驱动优势，但肌骨结构需大量多样化肌肉，要求肌肉单元紧凑模块化且能灵活适配多种布置。现有小型肌肉模块结构复杂、难维护，且因高减速比导致背驱性差、驱动速度受限。
AI.method: 利用准直驱（quasi-direct-drive, QDD）电机的进展设计肌肉模块QDD-MM：借助QDD电机取消专用力传感机构，从而简化整体结构；支持多方向柔性布线、多种模块间连接方式，并可将模块本体作为结构件；模块可复用，设计在GitHub开源。
AI.result: 研制了单关节、含两个或三个肌肉的腱驱动机器人，以及一个部分肌骨人形机器人，验证了所提模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: QDD-MM以更简单紧凑的结构实现更高背驱性与更快驱动，有望降低腱驱动技术门槛（democratize），推动该领域进展。

title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoE-Context：将上下文切分为块，每步用快速的“是/否”判定选择所需块，其余块压缩为一行摘要并保持可召回、不删除；在单一 KV cache 中以掩码方式隐藏未选块。笔记本上 Qwen3-1.7B 的合成查表任务中，仅呈现所需块使准确率从 93/120 升至 119/120，掩码与删除等效；模型自选块是薄弱环节（监督线性探针可提至 110/120，但不跨任务迁移），并给出撤销失败尝试与无新上下文运行子代理两种用法。
AI.motivation: 动机：AI 智能体在每一步都读取完整历史，而人类只保留当下所需信息、其余以粗略笔记形式留存待召。作者希望让语言模型的上下文管理更接近这种"按需调取"的方式，从而降低无关上下文干扰、提升推理准确性，并避免信息的不可逆丢失。
AI.method: 方法：将上下文切分为若干块；每步前用一个快速的二分类判定（yes/no pass）决定当前步需要哪些块，未选块压缩为一行笔记，可随时召回且不删除任何内容。实现上由同一模型先做选择再作答，运行于单一 KV cache 中，被隐藏的块通过掩码而非移除实现。此外，作者尝试用一个监督线性探针（写入空闲输出行）替代模型自身的块选择。
AI.result: 结果：在笔记本上使用 Qwen3-1.7B 与合成查表任务，仅展示所需块可将准确率由 93/120 提升至 119/120；掩码后的块与真正删除的块在效果上同样"隐藏"。模型自身的块选择是薄弱环节：监督线性探针将其准确率从 80/120 提升至 110/120，但简单关键词检索在该任务上表现完美，且探针无法迁移到第二个任务。
AI.conclusion: 结论：块级按需上下文（block switching）在单一 KV cache 上可行且能显著提升准确率，核心瓶颈在于"选块"本身而非缓存机制。作者公开报告了负面与有限结果（自选弱、探针不迁移），并提出两种低成本用法：撤销失败的尝试、以及在无需新建上下文的情况下运行子代理。

title: TRoPE: Topology-aware Relative Positional Encoding for 4D Generation
summary: Video-to-4D mesh generation has made substantial progress in recovering dynamic 3D geometry and motion from monocular videos. However, commonly used feed-forward approaches remain prone to sticking artifacts, where geodesically distant vertices move together incorrectly when they become spatially close. We attribute this failure to cross-part motion leakage: spatially nearby yet structurally distant vertices may retrieve similar motion information when motion decoding fails to distinguish spatial proximity from mesh connectivity. To address this issue, we introduce TRoPE, a topology-aware relative positional encoding that makes mesh connectivity explicit in the interaction between vertex queries and mesh-supported motion sources. TRoPE derives spectral features from the graph Laplacian and constructs pairwise topological relations from distances between multi-scale diffusion features, using these relations to modulate vertex--anchor attention through rotary phases. We further introduce a vertex-wise tail-risk objective that emphasizes persistently high-error vertices to explicitly suppress sticking artifacts. To better characterize and quantify these failures, we introduce MeshSticking-4D, a dedicated benchmark for this failure mode. Experiments on MeshSticking-4D show that TRoPE suppresses sticking artifacts while improving overall motion accuracy. Compared with the baseline, it reduces the worst-vertex error by 39.4% and lowers the separation failure rate from 49.35% to 34.90%. Additional evaluations on Motion-80 and Motion324-Subset show lower tail errors on diverse objects, while transfer to Mesh4D demonstrates applicability across backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频到4D网格生成中的"粘连伪影"问题，提出拓扑感知相对位置编码TRoPE与顶点级尾部风险目标，并构建MeshSticking-4D基准，将最差顶点误差降低39.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式视频到4D网格方法易产生粘连伪影：测地距离远但在空间中靠近的顶点被错误地赋予相同运动。作者将其归因于"跨部件运动泄漏"——运动解码无法区分空间邻近与网格连通性，导致结构上相距较远的顶点检索到相似运动信息。同时缺乏针对该失效模式的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出TRoPE（拓扑感知相对位置编码）：从图拉普拉斯中提取谱特征，基于多尺度扩散特征间距离构建成对拓扑关系，并通过旋转相位调制顶点—锚点注意力，使网格连通性在交互中显式化；同时引入顶点级尾部风险目标，重点惩罚持续高误差顶点；并构建专用基准MeshSticking-4D。
AI.result: 在MeshSticking-4D上，TRoPE在抑制粘连伪影的同时提升整体运动精度：相比基线，最差顶点误差降低39.4%，分离失败率由49.35%降至34.90%。在Motion-80与Motion324-Subset上对多样物体取得更低的尾部误差，迁移至Mesh4D表明其具备跨骨干网络的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将网格拓扑结构显式注入注意力交互并结合尾部风险优化，可有效缓解跨部件运动泄漏与粘连伪影；所提基准为该失效模式提供了量化评测手段，方法具备良好的泛化性与可移植性。

title: VESPA: Verifiable Symbolic Policy Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to prevent agents from taking actions that are dangerous or destructive to their environment. This is especially important for safety-critical domains, such as robotics or autonomous driving. Formal verification can be used to prove agent safety through safety constraints. However, in practice, many policies do violate safety constraints, and thus are verified to be unsafe. Since the goal is to obtain a safe policy, we would need to retrain a new policy from scratch and then verify it again until a candidate happens to pass. Both training and verification are usually not cheap, which makes this process inefficient. We introduce VESPA ($\textbf{VE}$rifiable $\textbf{S}$ymbolic $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{A}$daptation), a framework for targeted fine-tuning of decision tree policies. We show that using counterexamples for policy adaptation can make existing unsafe policies safe, or at least make considerable progress towards safety. Targeted fine-tuning of the existing policy on those counterexamples enables it to learn how to avoid violating safety constraints. We thus use the result of a formal verification as a training signal for fine-tuning. On CartPole, VESPA raises the mean number of verified safe steps from 63.8 to at least 92.7, reaching after two iterations what the same loop without counterexamples reaches after ten. On MountainCarContinuous, VESPA turns an unsafe policy into a safe policy in 53 of 60 runs. We conclude that counterexamples from a verifier are an effective training signal, which can be utilized to systematically improve the safety of policies. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VESPA-Submission/

AI.tldr: 提出VESPA框架，利用形式化验证器产生的反例作为训练信号，对已有的不安全决策树策略进行定向微调，使其变得可验证安全。
AI.motivation: 安全强化学习中策略常违反安全约束而被验证为不安全；传统做法是从头重训练并反复验证，训练与验证成本高、效率低。
AI.method: VESPA（可验证符号策略自适应）：对现有决策树策略做定向微调，将形式化验证输出的反例作为训练数据/训练信号，让策略学习规避违反安全约束的行为。
AI.result: CartPole上验证安全步数均值从63.8提升至至少92.7，两轮迭代即达到无正例循环十轮的效果；MountainCarContinuous上60次运行中53次将不安全策略转为安全策略。
AI.conclusion: 验证器的反例是有效的训练信号，可系统性地提升策略安全性，避免低效的从头重训练与重复验证。

title: Remote Teleoperation of Endovascular Robots: A Network Emulation Framework for Systematic Performance Evaluation
summary: Remote endovascular teleoperation requires network performance to be evaluated in relation to physical navigation and operator experience, while the effects of network degradation on the usability of remote endovascular systems remain insufficiently characterized from the perspective of clinical users. We developed a network emulation and benchmarking framework that combines an endovascular robot with data streaming. We conducted a user study involving eight clinicians from interventional neuroradiology and general interventional radiology and eight engineering students, who performed 480 navigation attempts across 15 network conditions. Communication performance and received video quality were assessed alongside navigation outcomes, confidence, workload and clinician rated acceptability. Under the most impaired combined condition, success was 78.1\%, compared with 93.8\% under the reference condition, and mean attempt time increased from 63.5 to 94.3\,s. At 5\% configured packet loss, 87.5\% of attempts succeeded, although all eight clinicians rated the condition unacceptable. Perceived video quality was associated with clinician confidence and acceptability, with mean within participant Spearman correlations of 0.72 and 0.78, respectively. Framework integration on a second robotic platform additionally supported successful remote navigation over a real network. Our framework provides a reusable basis that can help identify communication bottlenecks and assess their effects on navigation and clinician acceptance for endovascular intervention telesurgery tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个结合血管内机器人与数据流的网络仿真与基准测试框架，通过16名被试（8名临床医生、8名工科学生）在15种网络条件下完成480次导航任务，量化网络退化对远程血管内操作成功率、耗时、置信度与临床可接受性的影响。
AI.motivation: 远程血管内遥操作需要将网络性能与物理导航表现及操作者体验关联评估；而网络退化对系统可用性的影响，尚缺乏从临床使用者视角的系统刻画。
AI.method: 开发网络仿真与基准测试框架，将血管内机器人同数据流传输集成；招募介入神经放射学与普通介入放射学共8名临床医生及8名工科学生，在15种网络条件下进行480次导航尝试；同时测量通信性能、接收视频质量、导航结果、操作信心、工作负荷及临床医生评定的可接受性；并在第二套机器人平台上通过真实网络验证框架可迁移性。
AI.result: 最严重的组合退化条件下成功率为78.1%（参考条件93.8%），平均单次尝试时间由63.5 s增至94.3 s；配置5%丢包时成功率仍达87.5%，但8名临床医生均判定该条件不可接受；感知视频质量与临床医生信心及可接受性相关，被试内Spearman相关系数均值分别为0.72和0.78；框架在第二平台的真实网络中亦支持成功远程导航。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可复用的基础，用于识别通信瓶颈并评估其对血管内介入远程手术任务中导航表现与临床医生接受度的影响，说明仅以任务成功率衡量网络质量不足，需纳入临床可接受性与视频质量等体验指标。

title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
summary: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/thisissyu/cado.

AI.tldr: 提出 CaDO，一个"因果引擎引导的多智能体数据优化"框架，用于自动诊断与修复因果推理数据集，在 16/18 个设置中超越最强基线，下游准确率最高提升 9.1%。
AI.motivation: 高质量因果推理数据集对构建可靠因果理解模型至关重要，但现有数据集普遍存在标注错误与结构性失衡（查询类型覆盖不足、标签分布偏斜），导致模型预测有偏、泛化受限。因此需要一个可自动诊断并修复数据集缺陷的框架。
AI.method: 框架分三阶段：(1) 形式化——Formalizer Agent 将自然语言问题转换为形式化因果查询，减少语义偏差，使检索与验证更显式可操作；(2) 双层诊断——独立 Critic Agents 既做样本级错误识别，又分析查询类型覆盖与标签分布以检测数据集级结构失衡；(3) 修复与生成——采用基于形式因果语义的可复用修复算子纠正错误样本，并由 Explorer 与 Expander Agent 协作生成多样且语义一致的新样本。
AI.result: 在 18 个实验设置中的 16 个显著优于五种数据清洗基线中最强者，下游模型准确率最高提升 9.1%；CaDO 标记的样本中至少 95% 确为缺陷样本；在 CLadder 上，其误改正确标签的数量比基于 LLM 的判定器少 92.2%。
AI.conclusion: 以形式化因果语义为核心的多智能体"诊断—修复—扩充"闭环能有效提升因果推理数据集质量，兼具高缺陷召回精度与低误改率，代码与数据已开源。

title: What Right-Angle Corners Reveal About an Uncalibrated Camera: Convex Cones, Certified Bounds and Identifiability
summary: The corner of a box or a room, where three perpendicular edges meet, appears in an image as three segments meeting at a point. We ask what such junctions reveal about an uncalibrated camera's intrinsic parameters. Each junction is consistent with an explicit convex set of cameras; when only the focal length is unknown, this set is an interval in closed form. These sets are computed from the image alone, so calibrating from many junctions is a convex feasibility problem. Almost every junction bounds the focal length from below; we characterize when one also bounds it from above, and when many junctions determine it exactly. For a known vertex, the bounds can be certified against any bounded error in the measured edge directions.

AI.tldr: 论文研究三垂边交点（箱角/墙角）的图像组合几何，证明单个交点对应显式凸相机集合，仅焦距未知时为正区间并有闭式解；多交点标定转化为凸可行性问题，给出焦距上界存在的判别与精确确定条件，并可对测量方向误差做有界认证。
AI.motivation: 箱角、墙角等三条相互垂直棱边在图像中呈现为交于一点的三条线段，这类简单特征在自然场景中极其常见。作者希望回答：此类三垂交点（junction）究竟能揭示未标定相机的哪些内参信息，从而在无需标定物、仅凭图像几何的情况下获得焦距等内参的约束，并厘清单点约束的极限与多点联合标定的可行性。
AI.method: 将每个三垂交点视为对相机内参的约束，构造与其一致的所有相机所成的集合，并证明该集合为显式凸集；当仅焦距未知时，该集合退化为一条可用闭式表达给出的区间。由仅依赖图像的交点集合出发，把多交点标定表述为凸可行性问题（焦距区间之交）。进一步分析何时单个交点给出焦距下界、何时还给出上界，以及多交点何时把焦距唯一确定；对已知顶点情形，在测量边方向存在任意有界误差时给出界估计的认证。
AI.result: 单个交点即对应一个显式凸的相机集合；仅焦距未知时为闭式区间。几乎所有交点都提供焦距的下界，论文刻画了额外提供上界的条件，并给出多个交点精确确定焦距的充要/充分条件。多交点标定构成凸可行性问题，可高效求解；已知顶点时，所得界可在边方向有界误差下获得认证。
AI.conclusion: 三垂交点是无需标定物即可产生凸内参约束的强几何特征：单点给出显式焦距区间，多点联合为凸可行性问题，多数情况下可给出可靠下界，并在适当条件下确定或夹逼焦距，且对测量误差具有可认证的鲁棒性。这为基于自然场景结构的未标定相机自标定提供了严谨的几何与优化框架。

title: UCLIR: Unsupervised Continual Learning using Independent Representations
summary: In continual learning, regularization-based methods aim to mimic neuroplasticity by updating network weights to learn new tasks while constraining changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks through penalty terms. However, as the number of tasks increases, preserving knowledge from earlier tasks becomes less effective. This is mainly because updates for new tasks are distributed across the entire network, where parameters are highly interdependent due to the dense connectivity between neurons. Inspired by the Exponential Distance Rule (EDR), which states that the number of neural connections decreases with increasing physical distance, learning is naturally locally correlated while inter-area updates remain less task-dependent. Motivated by this principle, in this paper we demonstrate that applying weight regularization to multiple small and independently learned complementary representations is more effective than regularizing a single large shared representation. By decomposing the input into independently learned components, learning new tasks induces only localized parameter updates within specific representation, which limit interference and improve knowledge retention across tasks. We employ independent autoencoders that learn different parts of the input independently through unsupervised regularization. At inference time, a linear classifier is used for evaluation. The experimental results on a sequence of tasks using 5-Splits MNIST, sequence of 5-datasets, 5-Splits CIFAR-10, 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet shows competitive results with supervised and replay-based methods. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出受"指数距离规则（EDR）"启发，将权重正则化施加于多个小规模、独立学习的互补表征上，而非单一大型共享表征，从而把新任务引起的参数更新局部化、减少干扰，实现更好的持续学习知识保持。
AI.motivation: 正则化类持续学习方法通过惩罚项约束对旧任务重要的参数来模拟神经可塑性，但随着任务序列增长，旧知识保持效果下降。核心原因在于：新任务的更新分布在整个网络中，而神经元间的稠密连接使参数高度耦合，导致全局干扰。作者从EDR（神经连接数量随物理距离增大而减少）获得启发：学习天然具有局部相关性，区域间更新与任务依赖性较弱。
AI.method: 核心思想是将输入分解为多个独立学习的成分，用多个独立自编码器（independent autoencoders）通过无监督正则化分别学习输入的不同部分，形成互补表征；对每个小表征分别施加权重正则化。由于各成分独立学习，新任务只在特定表征内部引发局部化参数更新，限制跨任务干扰。推理阶段在学到的表征之上使用线性分类器进行评估。
AI.result: 在 5-Splits MNIST、5-datasets 序列、5-Splits CIFAR-10、10-Splits Tiny ImageNet 等任务序列上的实验表明，该方法与监督式方法及基于回放（replay）的方法相比具有竞争力的表现。文末提供代码。
AI.conclusion: 对多个小型、独立学习的互补表征进行权重正则化，比正则化单一大型共享表征更有效；表征分解带来的参数更新局部化是缓解灾难性遗忘的关键机制，为无监督、非回放的持续学习提供了可行路径。

title: Proprioceptive Simultaneous Base and Terrain Elevation Estimation for Legged Robot Locomotion
summary: Legged robots in visually degraded environments must rely exclusively on proprioceptive sensing, under which global position and yaw are unobservable. Vertical drift is particularly detrimental, as it corrupts the height reference required by swing-leg trajectories and can destabilize the robot. We treat the terrain itself as a persistent proprioceptive landmark: every footstep provides a height measurement that anchors the vertical axis. We propose Simultaneous Base and Elevation Estimation (SBEE), a real-time open-source framework in which a Left-Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (LI-EKF) for floating-base estimation and a grid-based elevation map are coupled in a bidirectional loop, mirroring SLAM with terrain elevation in place of landmarks. Stable foot contacts insert uncertainty-aware height samples into the map, and previously mapped cells are fed back as uncertainty-weighted vertical pseudo-measurements that act analogously to loop closures. Unlike contact-aided invariant filters, the LI-EKF consumes a kinematic velocity measurement instead of augmenting the state with a contact model per leg, so its state dimension is independent of the number of legs. We evaluate SBEE in MuJoCo on quadrupedal and bipedal platforms and on the ANYmal-D GrandTour dataset over 296 m of locomotion, reducing the absolute trajectory error by 22.1% relative to the best of three state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators.

AI.tldr: 提出SBEE框架，将地形高度图作为本体感知地标，与LI-EKF双向耦合实时估计浮动基座状态与地形高程，在视觉退化环境下显著降低垂直漂移。
AI.motivation: 视觉退化环境中足式机器人只能依赖本体感知，此时全局位置与偏航不可观；垂直漂移尤为有害，会破坏摆腿轨迹所需的高度参考并导致失稳，因此需要一种在无外部感知条件下锚定垂直轴的实时估计方法。
AI.method: SBEE由两部分构成并双向耦合：用于浮动基座估计的左不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（LI-EKF）与栅格化高程地图，形成以地形高程替代路标的类SLAM回路。稳定足端接触将带不确定度的测高样本插入地图；已建图栅格则以不确定度加权的方式回灌为垂直伪量测，起到类似回环约束的作用。与接触辅助不变滤波不同，LI-EKF采用运动学速度量测而非为每条腿增广接触模型，状态维数与腿数无关。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中对四足与双足平台进行评估，并在ANYmal-D GrandTour数据集上测试约296 m行走里程；相较三种先进本体感知估计器中的最优者，绝对轨迹误差（ATE）降低22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将地形高程视为持续存在的本体感知地标，可有效抑制垂直漂移并稳定高度参考；SBEE以与腿数无关的状态维数实现实时、开源的基座—高程联合估计，验证了“地形即地图”的类SLAM思路在视觉退化足式导航中的有效性。

title: Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control
summary: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. To intervene selectively while preserving safe nominal behavior, RTS uses the same predicted prefix-risk criterion as both the search trigger gate and hard feasibility gate: safe nominal plans execute directly, whereas alarms trigger local Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) search to minimize nominal deviation within the feasible set. To prevent isotropic Euclidean minimal modification from shrinking obstacle-directed actions into zero-amplitude stalling, we introduce an amplitude-preserving metric $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$ that retains tangential progression while maintaining a unique zero at the nominal plan. Under unified gating and this unique-zero condition, bypassing safe-state search yields closed-loop trajectories strictly identical to every-step same-kernel search. Evaluated under a process-safety benchmark and Safe Arrival Rate (SAR) metric across five tasks, RTS improves SAR over Direct by 12.67--41.67 percentage points on navigation and articulated control and +2.08/+4.17 pp on Cube/PushT boundary cohorts, maintaining 100% action identity with every-step search while cutting controller time by 17.71%--70.41% across 1,968 paired trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出风险触发搜索(RTS)：在冻结JEPA世界模型中展开动作条件潜在前缀，用轻量风险头预测过程风险，并以同一前缀风险判据同时作为搜索触发门与硬可行性门，配合保幅度量d_AP实现选择性CEM搜索，在保持与逐步搜索完全一致闭环轨迹的同时显著提升安全到达率并降低控制耗时。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉世界模型虽能从当前与目标观测生成多步动作计划，但仅以终端接近为目标的优化无法阻止穿越禁区或刚性体碰撞滑动；纯视觉接口缺乏解析动力学、结构化状态与显式碰撞几何，因此必须由模型内部预测"动作条件的过程风险"。此外，静态状态特征无法区分共享同一观测的候选计划。
AI.method: 1) 在冻结JEPA世界模型中展开动作条件的未来潜在前缀；2) 以过程违规监督训练轻量风险头，对候选前缀给出风险预测；3) 用同一预测前缀风险判据同时充当搜索触发门与硬可行性门：安全名义计划直接执行，报警时触发局部CEM搜索，在可行集内最小化对名义计划的偏离；4) 引入保幅度量d_AP，取代各向同性欧氏最小修改，保留切向推进并保证在名义计划处唯一零点；5) 理论上证明在统一门控与唯一零点条件下，跳过安全状态搜索所得的闭环轨迹与每步同核搜索严格一致。
AI.result: 在过程安全基准与SAR指标上，跨五个任务评估：导航与关节控制任务SAR较Direct提升12.67–41.67个百分点，Cube/PushT边界队列提升+2.08/+4.17个百分点；在1,968条配对轨迹上与每步搜索保持100%动作一致性，同时将控制器耗时降低17.71%–70.41%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于潜在前缀的过程风险预测可作为有效的选择性干预信号：RTS在不牺牲安全性与行为保真度（动作完全一致）的前提下大幅降低计算开销，说明冻结世界模型中的动作条件潜在展开足以支撑过程级安全推理，无需解析动力学或显式几何。

title: Angular Conditional Distillation: Overcoming Classifier Geometry Mismatch
summary: Classifier outputs provide a fundamental and univer- sally available knowledge interface for knowledge distil- lation (KD). However, standard logit objectives entangle transferable semantic relations with architecture-dependent parameterization artifacts, causing a classifier geometry mismatch that makes direct knowledge transfer unreliable. To address this, we propose Angular Conditional Distilla- tion (ACD). First, the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) reconstructs the student classifier using angular coordi- nates, suppressing magnitude and bias effects to provide a geometry-compatible space. Then, Scale-Invariant Condi- tional Distillation (SICD) standardizes outputs and exclu- sively transfers conditional non-target relations, filtering out untransferable absolute confidence. Together, ACI de- fines where to transfer, while SICD defines what to transfer. Extensive experiments show that ACD achieves state-of-the- art performance over existing KD methods. Moreover, as a universal drop-in replacement, it consistently improves existing distillation pipelines while requiring no feature adapters or additional inference-time cost. Code is avail- able at https://github.com/laniusnan/ACD.

AI.tldr: 提出角度条件蒸馏（ACD），通过角度坐标接口（ACI）重构学生分类器以消除幅值与偏置造成的几何不匹配，并用尺度不变条件蒸馏（SICD）只迁移条件性的非目标类别关系，实现几何兼容、免特征适配器与零额外推理开销的SOTA蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 分类器输出是知识蒸馏中普遍可用的知识接口，但标准logit目标将可迁移的语义关系与依赖架构的参数化伪影纠缠在一起，导致师生分类器几何不匹配，直接迁移知识不可靠。
AI.method: 分两步：1）Angular Coordinate Interface（ACI）——用角度坐标重构学生分类器，抑制幅值与偏置影响，构造几何兼容空间，回答"在哪里迁移"；2）Scale-Invariant Conditional Distillation（SICD）——对输出做标准化，仅迁移条件性的非目标类别关系，过滤不可迁移的绝对置信度，回答"迁移什么"。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ACD在现有KD方法中达到SOTA；作为通用即插即用替代方案，可一致提升已有蒸馏流程，且无需特征适配器、无额外推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: 借助"几何对齐（ACI）+选择性迁移（SICD）"的解耦设计，ACD在仅使用logit接口的前提下提升了蒸馏的可迁移性与鲁棒性，具备良好的通用性与部署友好性。

title: The 7th International Verification of Neural Networks Competition (VNN-COMP 2026): Summary and Results
summary: This report summarizes the seventh International Verification of Neural Networks Com- petition (VNN-COMP 2026), held as part of the Symposium on AI Verification (SAIV) co-located with the International Conference on Computer-Aided Verification (CAV) at FLoC 2026 in Lisbon, Portugal. The goal of the competition is to provide an objective comparison of the state-of-the-art methods in neural network verification, in terms of scal- ability and speed. Along this line, we used standard formats (ONNX for neural networks and VNNLIB for specifications), standard hardware (all tools are run by the organizers on AWS), and tool parameters provided by the tool authors. This report summarizes the rules, benchmarks, participating tools, results, and lessons learned from this competition.

AI.tldr: 本报告总结了在CAV/FLoC 2026（里斯本）举办的第七届国际神经网络验证竞赛（VNN-COMP 2026），采用ONNX网络格式、VNNLIB规约格式、统一的AWS硬件与作者提供的参数，客观比较了当前神经网络验证方法在可扩展性与速度方面的表现，并汇报了规则、基准、参赛工具、结果与经验总结。
AI.motivation: 神经网络验证领域方法众多，但缺乏统一、客观、可复现的横向比较，难以为方法进展提供可信基准。竞赛旨在以标准化设置消除实现细节与调参差异的影响，公平比较各方法在规模可扩展性与求解速度上的优劣。
AI.method: 以竞赛形式组织评测：统一采用ONNX表示神经网络、VNNLIB表示待验证规约，所有工具由组织者在AWS同一硬件上运行，各工具使用作者提交的参数配置，依据预设的评分规则在统一基准集上进行对比。
AI.result: 报告给出了竞赛规则、基准集构成、参赛工具清单及最终排名结果，反映了各验证器在可扩展性与速度方面的相对表现，并据此归纳出若干经验教训。
AI.conclusion: 标准化格式、统一硬件与工具自带参数的评测协议可支撑神经网络验证方法的客观比较，竞赛结果与经验总结有助于识别当前技术的强项与瓶颈，并为后续基准建设与验证器研发提供参考。

title: Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables (including supplementary material). Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/
summary: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. From a single RGB-D frame, WACO estimates both shifts without ground-truth extrinsics or extra data, canonicalises the image to the calibration viewpoint and the state, action and start pose to the calibration base frame, and fine-tunes the unmodified policy under the artefacts of its own estimator. We also introduce LIBERO-PoseShift, the first benchmark for RGB VLAs with graded camera, base and compound shifts. Across LIBERO-PoseShift, the LIBERO-Plus camera track and four real-world tasks on a UR5e robot, WACO consistently outperforms the standard few-shot recipe and prior viewpoint-robust methods, raising shifted success by 13.2 points in simulation and by 36.7 points on the real robot, recovering 90% of the simulation gap to a ground-truth oracle and 87% of the real-robot gap, and establishing a new state of the art among methods that use no perturbed training data, with no test-time calibration. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/.

AI.tldr: WACO：用世界锚定的规范化框架，把相机漂移与机器人底座偏移统一视为相机-底座外参变化，无需额外数据即可消除VLA策略的位姿脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 少样本微调的VLA策略会隐性记忆数据采集时的相机与底座位姿，三脚架被碰或底座重新对接几厘米就会抓错位置。作者指出相机移动与底座移动本质是同一现象——相机到基座外参的变化，且机器人自身携带了可恢复该变化的全部信息。
AI.method: 提出WACO框架：以正向运动学得到实测关节角下的机械臂作为度量标定靶，以静态场景作为世界锚点来区分"相机移动"与"机器人移动"。仅凭单帧RGB-D即可在无真值外参、无额外数据条件下同时估计两种偏移，将图像规范化到标定视角，并将状态、动作和起始位姿规范化到标定基座坐标系，最后在自身估计器引入的误差伪影下对未改动的策略进行微调。同时构建LIBERO-PoseShift基准，含分级相机、底座及复合偏移。
