AI.result: 在LIBERO-PoseShift、LIBERO-Plus相机轨道及UR5e真机四个任务上，WACO一致优于标准少样本配方与既有视角鲁棒方法：仿真偏移成功率提升13.2点，真机提升36.7点，分别弥补了90%与87%至真值oracle的差距；在无扰动训练数据、测试时无标定的方法中达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将相机漂移与底座漂移统一建模为外参变化并利用机器人自身几何做自标定，是解决VLA位姿脆弱性的有效途径；配合估计器误差下的微调策略，可在零额外数据与零测试时标定条件下获得显著鲁棒性收益。

title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
summary: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.

AI.tldr: 提出"分辨率即注意力"(RAA)记忆感知机制，将历史交互渲染为图像并按相关性动态调整分辨率，在LLM智能体中以视觉分辨率作为注意力分配手段，减少token消耗50%以上而不损失任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程复杂任务中会积累大量交互历史，记忆管理对性能与可扩展性至关重要。现有方法主要关注"保留什么/检索什么"，却忽视了应为每条历史交互分配多少感知细节（粒度），作者认为有效记忆不仅取决于保留的信息，也取决于感知的粒度。
AI.method: 将历史交互渲染为图像，并在每一步依据其与智能体即将做出的决策的相关性动态调整分辨率：关键交互保留细粒度信息，低相关交互降低视觉token消耗。为自适应确定感知保真度，训练轻量级相关性估计器，采用教师模型引导，并进一步优化以在降低视觉token成本的同时保持智能体决策一致性。
AI.result: 在多个任务与多种基座模型上，RAA在任务性能不下降的前提下将token消耗降低50%以上；且可作为插件式感知层与现有记忆管理方法结合，带来进一步token节省。
AI.conclusion: 自适应感知构成智能体记忆的一个互补维度：记忆管理不仅应关注信息取舍，还应关注感知的粒度分配，RAA为高效、可扩展的智能体记忆提供了新方向。

title: SIGNTOK: A Text-Aligned Continuous Pose Tokenizer for Sign Language Generation
summary: Text-conditioned sign language generation (SLG) depends not only on the generator but also on the space in which signing is generated. Existing approaches generate directly in pose space, in quantized code spaces, or in learned latent spaces trained for reconstruction. We find that these spaces are organized largely by signer identity rather than linguistic content: on CSL-Daily, a test clip's nearest neighbor in raw pose space is the same sentence signed by another person in only 2% of cases. To address this, we propose SIGNTOK, a continuous pose tokenizer whose latent space is shaped by three training-only heads: a kinematics head that predicts motion dynamics, a sentence-level head that aligns signing with the overall text, and a word-level head that aligns short motion windows with content words. Together, these objectives raise the same-sentence cross-signer nearest-neighbor rate to 82%. On three sign language benchmarks, the same generator trained in the SIGNTOK latent instead of pose space raises back-translation BLEU-4 in five of six benchmark-scorer settings at comparable joint accuracy, and word-level alignment gives higher back-translation scores than sentence-level alignment on every benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SIGNTOK，一种连续姿态分词器，通过三个仅训练时使用的预测头（运动学、句子级对齐、词级对齐）重塑潜空间，使潜空间由语言内容而非签名者身份主导，从而提升文本条件手语生成的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本条件手语生成（SLG）方法直接在姿态空间、量化码空间或为重建而训练的潜空间中生成，但作者发现在这些空间中，样本的组织主要依据签名者身份而非语言内容——例如在 CSL-Daily 上，原始姿态空间中测试片段最近邻为"同一句话由他人签出"的比例仅为 2%。这表明生成空间本身存在缺陷，需要被重新塑形。
AI.method: 提出 SIGNTOK，即一个连续姿态分词器，其潜空间由三个仅在训练阶段起作用（推理时移除）的辅助头共同塑形：运动学头（预测运动动力学）、句子级头（将手语序列与整体文本对齐）、词级头（将短运动窗口与内容词对齐）。
AI.result: 同句跨签名者最近邻率从 2% 提升至 82%。在三个手语基准上，将同一生成器改为在 SIGNTOK 潜空间中训练（而非姿态空间），在六个基准-评分器组合中的五个上提升了回译 BLEU-4，且关节精度相当；并且在每个基准上，词级对齐均比句子级对齐带来更高的回译分数。
AI.conclusion: 手语生成的效果不仅取决于生成器，也取决于生成所处的表示空间；通过以语言学内容（而非身份）为导向塑形潜空间，可显著改善跨签名者的语义组织并在不牺牲关节精度的前提下提升回译指标，其中细粒度词级对齐尤为有效。

title: QuantAtlas-OM: Taming Neural Spectral Bias in Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Ocean Dynamics
summary: Autoregressive neural networks exhibit spectral bias in long-horizon spatiotemporal prediction. As rollouts progress, high-frequency details decay, blurring the predicted fields and destabilizing long-range forecasts. Ocean dynamics offer a particularly stringent test because kinetic energy is concentrated in mesoscale eddies and fronts spanning tens of kilometers. This degradation stems from coupling large-scale phase evolution and small-scale energy retention in a shared feature space. Evolution on a coarse grid smooths out high-wavenumber eddies, whereas evolution on a fine grid amplifies small-scale phase errors and triggers rollout instability. We introduce QuantAtlas-OM (QuantAtlas Ocean Model), a scale-spectral decoupling framework that confines deep temporal evolution to a low-wavenumber latent manifold for long-term stability while routing full-resolution eddy and front residuals through an outer bypass to the decoder. Across physical regimes, the evolution core pairs non-local attention with resolution-invariant dilated spatial gating. Across three western boundary currents, QuantAtlas-OM retains $43.7\%$ to $86.5\%$ of mesoscale spectral energy along the $k^{-3}$ cascade at Day $120$, sustains anomaly correlation coefficients of $0.81$ to $0.88$ at Day $60$, and reaches $0.66$ at Day $120$ in the Kuroshio ($2.5\times$ to $7.7\times$ the best baselines). Trained at $0.25^\circ$, QuantAtlas-OM transfers zero-shot to a global $0.125^\circ$ grid ($0.81$ Day-$10$ spatial correlation) and leads global $0.25^\circ$, $23$-level 3D ocean simulations ($120$ days) and coupled ocean-atmosphere forecasts ($60$ days), ranking first on $15$ of $16$ metrics and cutting $60$- to $120$-day salinity RMSE by $13\%$ to $27\%$ across global ocean basins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuantAtlas-OM 框架，通过“尺度-谱解耦”将深度时间演化限制在低波数潜流形上以保证长期稳定，同时将全分辨率涡旋与锋面残差经外旁路送入解码器，显著缓解自回归长时预测中的谱偏置与高频细节衰减。
AI.motivation: 自回归神经网络的长期时空预测存在谱偏置：随着 rollout 推进，高频细节衰减，预测场模糊并导致长程失稳。海洋动力学中动能集中于数十公里尺度的中尺度涡与锋面，因此是极严苛的测试场景。作者将退化归因于大尺度相位演化与小尺度能量保持被耦合在共享特征空间中：粗网格演化会抹平高波数涡旋，细网格演化则放大小尺度相位误差并引发 rollout 失稳。
AI.method: QuantAtlas-OM 采用尺度-谱解耦框架：深度时间演化仅在低波数潜流形上进行，以换取长期稳定性；全分辨率的涡旋与锋面残差通过外层旁路直接送入解码器。演化核心在多种物理机制下把非局部注意力与分辨率无关的膨胀空间门控相结合。
AI.result: 在三条西边界流上，模型在第 120 天沿 k^-3 级联保持 43.7%–86.5% 的中尺度谱能量；第 60 天异常相关系数为 0.81–0.88，黑潮第 120 天达 0.66（为最优基线的 2.5–7.7 倍）。在 0.25° 训练可零样本迁移至全球 0.125° 网格（第 10 天空间相关 0.81）；在全球 0.25°、23 层三维海洋模拟（120 天）与海气耦合预报（60 天）中，16 项指标中 15 项居首，并将各海盆 60–120 天盐度 RMSE 降低 13%–27%。
AI.conclusion: 尺度-谱解耦是抑制自回归长时预报谱偏置的有效途径，可在保持长期稳定性的同时保留中尺度能量细节，并在区域与全球、乃至海气耦合任务上取得领先性能。

title: SearchDiffusion: Information-Guided Diffusion Planning for Object Search
summary: Object search in unknown environments requires robots to gather useful observations while avoiding obstacles and accounting for limited sensor visibility. We present SearchDiffusion, a diffusion-based planner that generates position and heading trajectories using a learned dense utility map. The map represents geometric accessibility, useful visibility, and semantic progress. It conditions trajectory generation and provides an objective for sampling guidance. Sampled map hypotheses provide additional geometric context, while geometric and heading guidance, validity checks, and analytical selection support execution. Across 90 simulated tasks on 24 map layouts, SearchDiffusion achieved 95.6\% target detection at greater computational cost. Ablations show complementary benefits from utility and guidance, with limited additional detection benefit from runtime map hypotheses. In ten physical quadruped trials using OneMap relevance maps, eight were successful under operator assessment, without fine-tuning on real-robot data. These results support combining learned spatial utility with guided trajectory generation for object search under partial observability.

AI.tldr: 提出SearchDiffusion——一种基于扩散模型的规划器，利用学习到的稠密效用图生成长度与朝向轨迹，用于未知环境下的目标搜索。
AI.motivation: 未知环境中的目标搜索要求机器人在避障的同时收集有用观测，并需应对有限的传感器可见性（部分可观测）。
AI.method: 扩散式轨迹规划器生成位置与朝向轨迹；以学习到的稠密效用图（编码几何可达性、有效可见性与语义进展）作为条件，并为采样引导提供目标函数；采用采样的地图假设提供额外几何上下文，结合几何与朝向引导、有效性检查及解析式选择以支持执行。
AI.result: 24个地图布局上90个仿真任务中目标检测率达95.6%，但计算开销较大。消融实验显示效用与引导具有互补收益，运行时地图假设带来的额外检测收益有限。使用OneMap相关性地图的四足机器人10次物理试验中8次在操作员评估下成功，且未在真机数据上微调。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将学习到的空间效用与引导式轨迹生成相结合，用于部分可观测条件下的目标搜索。

title: From real to synthetic: PSG-GAN learns sleep apnea signal dynamics for AI training
summary: Synthetic polysomnography (PSG) data has great potential in healthcare applications, for example in substituting real data that is sensitive and challenging to collect. Previous research on synthetic PSG data has been largely focused on short segments of individual signals, overlooking the inter-signal dynamics related to sleep disorders. In this study, we developed a generative adversarial network (PSG-GAN) for co-synthesizing longer segments of multiple PSG signals with diverse and complex characteristics typical of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). The synthetic signals appeared realistic, and the electroencephalography and electrooculography band powers were similarly distributed across sleep stages. Moreover, the PSG-GAN learned to mirror signal interactions such as changes in photoplethysmography-based heart rate during and after breathing obstructions. An automatic scoring model trained solely with automatically scored synthetic signals reached good performance on sleep staging (\k{appa}=0.71 and 0.63) and respiratory event segmentation (\k{appa}=0.57 and 0.60), on two test sets consisting of healthy volunteers and OSA patients, respectively. This demonstrates the potential of synthetic data in supporting algorithm development for sleep diagnostics. The source code is available at https://github.com/rikuhuttunen/psg-gan.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出PSG-GAN，可协同生成多通道、较长时段且包含OSA特征的多导睡眠图合成数据，并保留信号间动力学关系，仅用合成数据训练的自动判读模型在睡眠分期与呼吸事件分割上取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 真实PSG数据敏感且难以采集，现有合成研究多局限于单个信号的短片段，忽略了与睡眠障碍相关的跨信号动力学特征。
AI.method: 构建生成对抗网络PSG-GAN，对多个PSG信号进行长时段协同合成，模拟阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）典型的多样复杂特征；并通过分布比较、频带功率分析及信号交互（如呼吸暂停期间与之后PPG心率变化）评估真实性；再用自动标注的合成信号训练自动判读模型。
AI.result: 合成信号具有真实性，EEG与EOG频带功率在各睡眠期分布相近，模型学到信号间交互；仅用合成数据训练的模型在健康志愿者与OSA患者两个测试集上，睡眠分期kappa为0.71与0.63，呼吸事件分割kappa为0.57与0.60。
AI.conclusion: 多通道长时段合成PSG数据可支撑睡眠诊断算法开发，代码已开源。

title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MobileGym基准，沿奖励覆盖、数据覆盖、特征覆盖三个维度系统拆解GUI智能体训练环境的完备性，发现奖励与数据覆盖需完整、特征可裁剪，并据此构建低成本高性能的MobileGym-Lite（成功率55.48% vs 51.61%）。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体训练环境在构建时出于降低成本、批量搭建、减少人工等工程考量，各自舍弃了环境的部分内容（奖励路径、应用数据、应用特征），但这些取舍对训练效果的影响从未被量化。论文要回答的核心问题是：一个环境要多完整才能训练出有能力的智能体，且应在哪些维度上保持完整。
AI.method: 在MobileGym中分别独立调整三个维度（奖励覆盖、数据覆盖、特征覆盖），以Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct为训练对象做受控消融，且所有策略均回到原始完整环境中评估。进一步分析特征裁剪增益与回合加权方式（等权、长度加权、任务内平衡）的交互作用，最后据此构建MobileGym-Lite。
AI.result: 仅奖励单条参考路径的验证器使成功率下降10.53个百分点；移除任务非必需的记录（数据覆盖缩减）同样降低成功率。反之，裁剪任务未用到的特征可将成功率从51.61%提升至56.13%，且增益完全来自环境未被改动的那部分任务。该增益在每回合等权时反转，在仅对裁剪任务回合做平衡时消失；不裁剪时，长度加权会在裁剪任务上强化“长绕路”式成功，从而侵蚀其他任务的技能。
AI.conclusion: 环境完备性诉求依维度而异：奖励覆盖与数据覆盖应保持完整，而冗余特征可安全裁剪，并需配合合适的回合加权以放大增益。据此构建的MobileGym-Lite在完整环境中以更低构建成本超过Full环境。

title: SoU-RHS: Bayesian Structured Sparsity for Compact Architecture Recovery in CNNs
summary: Highly parameterized convolutional neural networks often achieve strong predictive performance, but their memory, computation, and deployment costs motivate the search for methods that recover compact architectures from large reference models. We propose SoU-RHS, a Bayesian structured-sparsity procedure that augments Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) with the so-called Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local mechanism (SoU-SGL). The resulting model sharpens the separation between active and inactive filters, providing an effective mechanism for architecture recovery. A key property of SoU-RHS is stability: across different overparameterized starting widths and under a reasonable range of pruning thresholds, it recovers compact architectures with similar total size and layer-wise allocation. This supports the interpretation that the procedure is identifying a compact structure adapted to the data, rather than merely compressing each initial model separately. Across standard image-classification benchmarks, SoU-RHS recovers substantially smaller architectures than deterministic structured-sparsity baselines, while maintaining competitive accuracy, achieving lower negative log-likelihood in every evaluated configuration and generally lower expected calibration error.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯结构化稀疏方法 SoU-RHS，在 RHS 基础上加入 SoU-SGL 机制以增强活跃/非活跃滤波器区分度，从而从大型参考模型中稳定地恢复紧凑架构，并保持竞争性精度与更好的不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 高度参数化的 CNN 预测性能强，但内存、计算与部署成本高，促使研究者从大参考模型中恢复紧凑架构。现有确定性结构化稀疏方法在压缩率与稀疏结构稳定性方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 将 Regularized Horseshoe Shrinkage (RHS) 与 Sources of Uncertainty Sparse Global-Local 机制 (SoU-SGL) 结合，构建贝叶斯结构化稀疏过程，强化活跃滤波器与非活跃滤波器之间的分离度以支持架构恢复；并在不同过参数化初始宽度与合理剪枝阈值范围内考察其稳定性。
AI.result: 与确定性结构化稀疏基线相比，SoU-RHS 恢复出显著更小的架构，同时精度具竞争力；在所有评估配置中取得更低的负对数似然 (NLL)，并通常具有更低的期望校准误差 (ECE)；在不同初始宽度与阈值下恢复的紧凑架构在总规模与逐层分配上高度相似。
AI.conclusion: SoU-RHS 表现出稳定性，说明其识别的是适配数据的紧凑结构而非仅对单个初始模型做压缩；贝叶斯结构化稀疏在架构恢复中兼顾紧凑性、精度与不确定性校准方面具有优势。

title: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track (41 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables). Project page: https://ophd-hahao.github.io/projects/Rethink-CF/
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了基于VLM的自动驾驶中反事实（CF）推理的真实作用，发现CF推理并未带来基于视觉证据的真正因果理解，而是一种重塑动作分布的语言捷径。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶存在捷径学习与因果混淆，泛化性差。近期工作将语言推理（尤其反事实推理）引入驾驶决策以提升因果理解，但尚不清楚语言推理是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅将捷径从视觉表征转移到语言模式，制造因果理解的"错觉"；且现有方法常将干预式推理与CF推理混为一谈，真正CF推理的效果未被单独考察。
AI.method: 对VLM自动驾驶模型中的CF推理进行多角度剖析：(1) 分析CF推理对动作分布、推理不确定性与决策不确定性的影响，并在强化微调下检验其持久性；(2) 通过视觉注意力分析考察CF推理是否改变视觉定位（visual grounding）；(3) 在事故场景中设计因果干预实验，分别遮蔽因果相关与因果无关因素，比较决策改变率。
AI.result: CF推理使动作分布向更保守的行为偏移，同时增加推理与决策的不确定性，且该效应在强化微调后依然存在，说明并非短暂伪影；视觉注意力分析显示CF推理未改变视觉定位；在事故场景中遮蔽因果相关因素与非因果因素导致相近的决策改变率。
AI.conclusion: CF推理并未引发以视觉证据为基础的真正因果推理，而是充当一种语言捷径，重塑动作分布，使模型"学会说什么"而非"学会如何推理"，揭示了VLM自动驾驶中语言推理与因果理解之间的鸿沟。

title: Study and Improvement of Search Algorithms in Stochastic Perfect-Information
summary: In this article, we generalize Unbounded Minimax, the state- of-the-art search algorithm for deterministic zero-sum two- player games with perfect information to the framework of stochastic zero-sum two-player games with perfect informa- tion. We experimentally show that this generalized algorithm achieves better performance than the main stochastic search algorithms.

AI.tldr: 将确定性完全信息零和博弈的最先进搜索算法 Unbounded Minimax 推广到随机完全信息零和两人博弈框架，并实验证明其性能优于主流随机搜索算法。
AI.motivation: Unbounded Minimax 在确定性、完全信息、零和两人博弈中表现最优，但其适用性受限于确定性环境；而现实中大量博弈（含随机转移）需要随机博弈下的高效搜索方法，因此需要将其推广到随机博弈框架以填补方法空缺。
AI.method: 对 Unbounded Minimax 进行算法推广：在原有基于上界/下界剪枝的无界极小极大搜索基础上，引入对随机状态转移（机遇节点/chance nodes）的处理，使搜索可在随机完全信息零和两人博弈中运行。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该推广算法相比主要的随机搜索算法取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: Unbounded Minimax 可自然扩展至随机完全信息零和博弈，并保持相对现有随机搜索算法的性能优势。

title: VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
summary: Recent video foundation models generate high-quality and limited-length clips, but orchestrating them into minute-level, story-coherent films remains an open problem. Existing video agents highly rely on natural-language planning or predefined workflows, which make their production hard to program, customize, and extend. Therefore, we introduce VOL-Agent, a programmable video agent built on a Video Orchestration Language (VOL). With static compilation and verification, followed by runtime dynamic loading, VOL-Agent decouples structural reliability from execution flexibility. Through the skill-driven executor, VOL-Agent dynamically resolves tools and skills from an open-world repository and supports user-defined skills in natural language. Moreover, VOL-Agent is capable of crafting new director skills from learned knowledge and improves itself through feedback to accumulate filmmaking knowledge. To overcome the disconnect between different segments, we apply a structural memory mechanism to record and recall world and entity states, sustaining entity and scene consistency across different shots. Critic feedback supports local revision, while reusable filmmaking knowledge and experiences can be retained for subsequent tasks. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VOL-Agent generates minute-scale videos with strong overall quality and limited cost.

AI.tldr: 提出可编程视频智能体 VOL-Agent，基于视频编排语言 VOL 实现分钟级、故事连贯的长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基础模型只能生成高质量但时长有限的片段，将其编排成分钟级、叙事连贯的影片仍是开放问题；现有视频智能体过度依赖自然语言规划或预定义工作流，导致生产流程难以编程、定制与扩展。
AI.method: 构建 Video Orchestration Language（VOL）作为可编程编排语言；采用静态编译与验证、运行时动态加载的两阶段设计，将结构可靠性与执行灵活性解耦；通过技能驱动执行器从开放世界仓库动态解析工具与技能，支持自然语言定义的用户技能；智能体可基于所学知识生成新的导演技能并通过反馈自我改进，积累影视制作知识；引入结构化记忆机制记录与召回世界及实体状态，维持跨镜头实体与场景一致性；辅以评论家（critic）反馈进行局部修订，并保留可复用的制作知识与经验。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的实验表明，VOL-Agent 能以较低成本生成整体质量较高的分钟级视频。
AI.conclusion: 以编排语言为核心的可编程智能体范式，可在保证结构可靠性的同时保持执行灵活性，并通过结构化记忆与反馈学习有效缓解长视频分段间的断裂问题。

title: Adaptive Action Horizon Selection via Flow-Field Uncertainty
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimates are important for adaptive execution in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Existing approaches such as Adaptive Action Chunking (AAC) estimate action entropy from multiple sampled action chunks, introducing additional inference cost and capturing both uncertainty within an action trajectory and diversity across alternative strategies. We introduce Divergence-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Action Chunking (DUAC), a post-hoc method that extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA. Building on a closed-form flow-posterior covariance formulation, DUAC derives action-level uncertainty scores from a single generated chunk using Jacobian-vector products, without retraining or multiple endpoint samples. DUAC strongly correlates with AAC, while capturing distinct information: AAC measures global dispersion across sampled chunks, whereas DUAC measures local uncertainty around the trajectory selected for execution. Consequently, DUAC is less sensitive to diversity among distinct but valid action strategies. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa, DUAC-based adaptive horizon selection performs favorably among the evaluated methods, combining strong task success with low uncertainty-estimation latency. These results establish the flow vector field as an efficient, trajectory-conditioned source of predictive uncertainty for robot decision making.

AI.tldr: 提出DUAC，一种无需重训练的后处理方法，利用预训练VLA流向量场的雅可比-向量积从单个动作块中提取轨迹条件化的预测不确定性，用于自适应动作块长选择，在多个基准上兼顾成功率与低延迟。
AI.motivation: VLA模型的自适应执行需要可靠的不确定性估计。现有如Adaptive Action Chunking（AAC）需多次采样动作块并计算动作熵，带来额外推理开销；且其熵同时混入了轨迹内部不确定性与不同策略间的多样性，难以区分。
AI.method: 基于闭式的流后验协方差公式，从预训练VLA的流向量场导出动作级不确定性分数，仅用一次生成的块和雅可比-向量积（Jacobian-vector products）计算，无需重训练或多次端点采样。该方法度量所选执行轨迹附近的局部不确定性，区别于AAC的跨采样块全局离散度。
AI.result: DUAC与AAC高度相关，但信息互补；对多样但有效的不同策略不敏感。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa上，基于DUAC的自适应视界选择在所评估方法中表现较优，兼具较高任务成功率与较低的不确定性估计延迟。
AI.conclusion: 流向量场可作为机器人决策中高效且轨迹条件化的预测不确定性来源，DUAC为VLA自适应执行提供了低成本、可靠的替代方案。

title: Constructive Infinitely Differentiable Guidance Vector Fields for Robotic Control
summary: Guidance vector fields (GVFs) are a popular framework for tasks such as robotic path-following and multi-robot motion coordination, but existing approaches may be non-differentiable or have large derivatives, limiting their use in controllers that require derivatives of the guidance signal, which is common when the GVF is used as an input in a cascaded controller. This paper proposes an infinitely differentiable constructive GVF. The resulting vector field depends on a smoothing parameter and is a generalization of [1], recovering the original GVF in the limit as this parameter approaches zero. It also admits a simple and efficient implementation that preserves smoothness under discretization and can reduce computation time by using substantially fewer curve samples while maintaining small path-following errors. We establish the main theoretical properties and demonstrate its practical advantages through numerical and real-world experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无限可微的构造型引导向量场（GVP/GVF），通过平滑参数推广已有方法并在极限下退化为原GVP，具有计算高效、离散保持光滑、可减小路径跟踪误差的优点。
AI.motivation: 现有引导向量场（GVF）方法在机器人路径跟踪与多机器人运动协调中广泛应用，但存在不可微或导数过大问题，限制了其在需要引导信号导数的级联控制器中的使用。
AI.method: 构造一类无限可微的引导向量场：引入平滑参数对原向量场进行光滑化，使其在参数趋零时收敛到[1]中的原始GVP；同时给出简单高效的实现，在离散化下保持光滑性。
AI.result: 建立了主要理论性质；数值实验与实机实验表明，该方法可用显著更少的曲线采样点、更短计算时间，同时维持较小的路径跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: 该光滑GVF适用于需要引导信号导数的级联控制器，兼顾可微性、实现效率与跟踪精度。

title: The Largest Tractable Subclass of Multi-Scale Allen Temporal Reasoning
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel model for temporal reasoning over multi-scale intervals. We show that this model yields a complete reasoning framework and exhibits other particularly interesting properties. Furthermore, we identify the maximal tractable subalgebra for this model, as well as for the other complete model, in the qualitative scales context, which exhibits weaker properties but whose results can be derived by transfer from our new model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种新的多尺度区间时序推理模型，给出完整的推理框架，并刻画了该模型与另一完备模型在定性尺度下的极大可处理子代数。
AI.motivation: 多尺度区间的时序推理缺乏完整且可处理的形式化框架；已有的完备模型在定性尺度背景下性质较弱，需要借助新模型来统一处理。
AI.method: 构造新的多尺度区间关系代数模型，证明其推理框架的完备性并分析其性质；随后确定该模型的极大可处理子代数，并利用结果转移（transfer）方法推导另一完备模型的对应结果。
AI.result: 新模型给出完备的推理框架并具备若干有趣性质；分别得到了新模型与另一完备模型在定性尺度下的极大可处理子代数，其中后者的结果可由新模型转移得到。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度区间时序推理可在统一的代数框架下处理，新模型可作为更强的基础模型，用于导出性质较弱的完备模型的可处理性结论。

title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
summary: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. The hazard turns division timing into a survival likelihood that can be tested against real cycle lengths. On 325 held-out MitoCheck tracks spanning 17 knockdowns and a control, MitoWorld lowers FID by 34.6\% and the video metric JEDi by 45.6\% relative to the strongest baselines. Its latent-space prediction intervals achieve near-nominal 90\% coverage, are 35\% narrower than those of a model with freely fitted noise. The hazard also yields cell-cycle length distributions with KS distance close to the model-based finite-sample reference. Testable single-cell stochastic dynamics thus offer a generative tool for time-lapse perturbation screens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MitoWorld，一种随机世界模型，可在高斯参考隐空间中生成基因敲低后单细胞外观的连续演化轨迹，并以分裂风险函数终止、由条件扩散渲染器转为图像，实现单细胞轨迹与分裂时序的联合建模。
AI.motivation: 基因敲低后的单细胞未来形态演化与分裂时间均不确定；现有方法要么预测终点，要么预测群体水平变化，缺乏对个体轨迹与分裂时序的联合建模，且难以给出可检验的随机动力学。
AI.method: 构建随机世界模型：以高斯参考隐空间中的连续状态转移描述外观演化，其常规定义可证明保持高斯参考性质、使噪声与动力学耦合；利用成对观测识别离散转移（边际平稳分布无法做到）；以分裂风险函数将分裂时间转化为生存似然，可对照真实周期长度检验；最后由条件扩散渲染器生成图像。
AI.result: 在涵盖17种敲低与1个对照的325条留出MitoCheck轨迹上，相比最强基线FID降低34.6%、视频指标JEDi降低45.6%；隐空间预测区间达到接近名义的90%覆盖率，且比自由拟合噪声的模型窄35%；风险函数给出的细胞周期长度分布与基于模型的有限样本参考的KS距离接近。
AI.conclusion: 可检验的单细胞随机动力学为延时扰动筛选提供了生成式工具，可同时刻画形态演化与分裂时序。

title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

AI.tldr: 提出LwU统一框架，在突触级别解决持续学习与机器遗忘的冲突：对每个权重双重打分并划分四区分别更新，无需重训练即同时实现保知、删除与新任务学习。
AI.motivation: 持续学习（CL）要求获取新知识且不遗忘旧知识，机器遗忘（MU）要求破坏特定知识且不损害其余部分。二者在同一模型中共享权重、目标相互拉扯，针对一方的编辑会损害另一方，现有方法难以在同一系统中统合两者。
AI.method: LwU在单个突触层面化解冲突：对每个权重分别针对"需保留数据"和"需删除数据"打分，将网络划分为四个区域并施加不同更新规则——仅需保留的权重冻结；仅需删除的权重清零并作为空闲容量回馈网络；争议权重沿正交于保留梯度的方向做梯度上升步；剩余容量通过特权教师的自蒸馏学习新任务。删除事后完成，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在CL与MU两类任务上，LwU优于或匹配最强基线；在自建的物理人工智能（PAI）数据集上验证了实际可用性；在图像生成任务及有害内容移除任务中，其表现优于最接近的基线（见Fig.1）。
AI.conclusion: 以突触级权重分区与差异化更新规则为核心，LwU在同一框架内统一了持续学习与机器遗忘，兼顾知识保留、定向删除与新任务获取，且无需重训练，并具备真实场景与生成式任务的有效性。

title: Homeward: No Place Like the Training View
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies implicitly assume that third-person cameras remain fixed at their data-collection poses; once a camera is bumped, remounted, or swapped at deployment, task success degrades precipitously even though the underlying task and robot remain unchanged. We present Homeward, a training-free, plug-and-play observation adapter that canonicalizes observations from an uncalibrated deployment camera back into the training view for frozen VLA policies. Our design stems from a closed-loop diagnostic paradox in simulation: while re-rendering perturbed views into the training camera with oracle geometry recovers much of the lost performance, substituting an off-the-shelf feed-forward 3D foundation model can leave the policy worse off than applying no correction at all. This degradation concentrates on the thin, articulated robot arm, which feed-forward depth prediction tears and scatters - yet the arm's exact 3D state is already known from robot kinematics. Homeward exploits this asymmetry: it estimates what is unknown - camera parameters and static scene depth - from the live RGB frame and a single training-view reference, and renders what is known - the moving robot links - directly from the kinematic model. Evaluated across $\sim$300,000 closed-loop episodes spanning four frozen VLAs, Homeward boosts success across all 1,599 camera variants of LIBERO-Plus from 62.5%, 76.5%, 68.0%, and 3.6% to 77.6%, 95.1%, 91.2%, and 26.4% for OpenVLA-OFT, $π_{0.5}$, $π_0$, and OpenVLA, respectively. Without any scene fine-tuning or deployment camera calibration, Homeward extends to 6-DoF random placements, focal-length changes, and, with per-step pose estimation, continuous intra-episode camera drift, while matching or surpassing a calibrated, scene-trained view-synthesis baseline on three of four policies on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: Homeward：一种免训练、即插即用的观测适配器，将未标定部署相机视角的图像规范化回训练视角，使冻结的VLA策略在相机被碰动/重装/更换后仍保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略隐含假设第三人称相机固定在数据采集时的位姿，部署中相机一旦被碰撞、重装或替换，即使任务与机器人不变，成功率也会急剧下降。而现有补救手段存在问题：仿真中的闭环诊断显示"悖论"——用oracle几何把扰动视角重渲染回训练视角能大幅恢复性能，但改用现成的前馈3D基础模型反而可能比不校正更差，退化集中于细长、多关节的机械臂，因为前馈深度预测会把手臂撕裂、打散。
AI.method: 利用"未知与已知"的非对称性：未知部分（相机参数、静态场景深度）由实时RGB帧加一张训练视角参考图估计；已知部分（运动的机器人连杆）直接由运动学模型渲染。整个适配过程无需训练、无需场景微调、无需部署时相机标定，作为即插即用模块接在冻结VLA之前。
AI.result: 在约30万次闭环episode、4个冻结VLA上评估：LIBERO-Plus全部1,599种相机变体下成功率由OpenVLA-OFT 62.5%、π0.5 76.5%、π0 68.0%、OpenVLA 3.6%提升到77.6%、95.1%、91.2%、26.4%。可扩展到6-DoF随机位姿、焦距变化，并借助逐步位姿估计处理episode内连续相机漂移；在LIBERO-Plus上4个策略中有3个达到或超过经过标定、场景训练的视图合成基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入机器人运动学先验、只从图像估计相机与静态几何的规范化方案，比端到端前馈3D重建更可靠地修复VLA的相机位姿脆弱性，且保持免训练、免标定的部署友好性。

title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
summary: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出零代码智能体 ABSClaw，将自然语言请求编译为"现实锚定"的社会仿真（人群/环境/交互网络取自调查普查、地理与真实网络数据，状态转移由 26 个原子操作组合表达），并构建 193 项真实世界任务的 ABSBench 基准，取得总体最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的人工社会虽行为丰富但缺乏科学根基：人格与环境靠假设、交互网络为合成、模拟器由自由形式代码生成，导致结果难与真实人群对应且对骨干模型敏感。作者主张"模拟世界应从观测数据中采样，模拟逻辑应由共享的、任务无关的原子操作组合实现"。
AI.method: 1) ABSClaw：把自然语言请求编译为可执行仿真；"谁行动、在哪行动、与谁交互"分别锚定于调查/普查数据、地理空间数据源与真实网络；状态转移由 26 个原子操作表达。2) 通过生命周期作用域的技能（lifecycle-scoped skills）在不修改内核的前提下扩展能力。3) ABSBench：193 个真实世界社会仿真任务基准。
AI.result: 在 ABSBench 上，ABSClaw 在所评估的社会仿真器中取得最佳总体性能；三个真实案例分别表明对人格、环境、交互网络进行锚定均提升与观测结果的一致性；借助一项运行时技能，ABSClaw 完成 13 次人口规模仿真，合计涉及 2500 万智能体。
AI.conclusion: ABSClaw 在真实世界保真度、可扩展性与规模化方面得到验证，为 LLM 社会仿真提供了数据锚定、模块化可扩展的范式。

title: SimplePro: A Simple Baseline for Proactive Video Understanding
summary: Proactive video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to decide not only what to answer as a video unfolds, but also when newly arrived evidence warrants a response and when to remain silent. Although modern VLMs excel at offline long-video understanding, they struggle in proactive streaming settings, leading prior work to introduce task-specific reinforcement learning or auxiliary triggering modules. We find that explicit reporting rules and structured streaming context substantially improve a frozen VLM's proactive response performance. We exploit this observation to build SIMPLEPRO, a training-free baseline for proactive video understanding. At each decision step, the model combines recent high-resolution frames, bounded historical observations, and prior answer records to determine whether new information warrants a response and, when needed, generate a concise answer. The system then filters consecutive duplicate answers while retaining the raw outputs as context for subsequent decisions. Without any parameter updates or auxiliary triggers, SIMPLEPRO with a 4B backbone consistently outperforms specialized proactive systems across OVO-Bench, StreamingBench-PO, and ProactiveVideoQA. SIMPLEPRO shows overall performance gains as backbone size increases from 2B to 32B. We hope this simple yet effective method will serve as a strong baseline for proactive video understanding, and we will release our code and inference pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的基线方法 SIMPLEPRO，通过显式报告规则与结构化流式上下文，让冻结的 VLM 在主动式流媒体视频理解中超越专用系统。
AI.motivation: 主动式视频理解要求 VLM 不仅决定"答什么"，还要判断"何时作答、何时保持沉默"。现有 VLM 擅长离线长视频理解，但在流式主动场景中表现不佳，先前工作因此引入任务特定的强化学习或辅助触发模块，代价高且泛化性受限。
AI.method: 发现显式报告规则与结构化流式上下文可显著提升冻结 VLM 的主动响应能力，据此构建免训练基线 SIMPLEPRO：每个决策步将近期高分辨率帧、有界历史观测与既往作答记录结合，判断新信息是否值得响应并生成简洁答案；系统随后过滤连续重复答案，但保留原始输出作为后续决策的上下文；全程不更新参数、不使用辅助触发器。
AI.result: 4B 骨干的 SIMPLEPRO 在 OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO 与 ProactiveVideoQA 三个基准上均稳定优于专用主动式系统；随骨干规模从 2B 增至 32B，整体性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 简单有效的免训练方法可作为主动式视频理解的强基线，作者将开源代码与推理流程以支持后续研究。

title: Continuous Noisy-Loop Models
summary: Efficient learning and inference need not imply a compact probabilistic circuit. We quantify this distinction for continuous noisy readings of agreement between adjacent latent spins on a known square grid with $d$ edges. With known margins and bounded Lipschitz channels, minimax squared Hellinger risk is $Θ(\min\{1,dN^{-2/3}\})$ from $N$ independent vectors, without a reliability lower bound. A spline estimator reaches this rate in polynomial arithmetic time given a fixed positive reliability bound; an exponential-size mixture removes that requirement. At fixed positive reliability, nonnegative decomposable circuits need $\exp(Θ(\sqrt d))$ nodes for fixed total-variation error below one, even when each leaf uses at most $αd$ coordinates, $0<α<1$. Optimal Kullback--Leibler (KL) approximation error is $Θ(d/\max\{\log d,\sqrt\ell\})$ in either direction with at most $d^r$ nodes and leaf scopes $\ell\leqαd$, for fixed $r>1$ and $0<α<2/3$. Node counts exclude leaf computation. For three fixed masks, optimal joint conditional KL has order $d/\log d$ when $\ell\leq(\log d)^2$. Local cycle identities relate joint divergence to identifiable channel products and separate weak-channel recovery from density estimation. Factorized evidence preserves a planar zero-field Ising model: given local integrals, exact queries cost $O(d^{3/2})$ arithmetic operations and one root extraction.

AI.tldr: 在已知方格图上对相邻隐自旋一致性的含噪观测做极小极大Hellinger风险的精确刻画，并证明"高效学习/推断"与"紧凑概率电路表示"之间存在指数级分离：在固定正可靠性下，非负可分解电路表示该分布需 exp(Θ(√d)) 个结点，而学习与推断却可多项式时间达到最优速率。
AI.motivation: 论文关注的区分问题：能否用紧凑的概率电路来表示一个可被高效学习与高效推断的分布。作者想量化"统计/计算上的高效性"与"电路表示紧致性"之间的差距，具体选取方格图上相邻二元隐自旋一致性的含噪观测这一模型作为测试床，因为其具备已知的图结构、可解析的KL/全变差下界以及天然的局部结构，适合做双向（上界与下界）精确分析。
AI.method: 1) 模型设定：已知 d 条边的方格图，含噪观测通道 Lipschitz 有界，边缘分布已知，分有无可靠性下界两种情形。2) 统计侧：给出极小极大平方 Hellinger 风险的匹配上下界，构造样条估计器（固定正可靠性下多项式算术时间可达最优速率），并指出指数规模混合模型可去除可靠性下界要求。3) 表示侧：对非负可分解电路证 exp(Θ(√d)) 结点下界（即使每叶仅用 ≤αd 个坐标、全变差误差固定小于1）；给出双向最优 KL 近似误差 Θ(d/max{log d, √ℓ})（结点数 ≤d^r、叶作用域 ℓ≤αd）。4) 进一步分析三种固定掩码下的最优联合条件 KL（ℓ≤(log d)^2 时为 d/log d 阶），并利用局部环恒等式把联合散度与可辨识的通道乘积联系起来，将弱通道恢复问题与密度估计问题分离。5) 推断侧：利用因子化证据保持平面零场 Ising 模型，给定局部积分后精确查询只需 O(d^{3/2}) 算术运算与一次开根。
AI.result: 极小极大平方 Hellinger 风险为 Θ(min{1, dN^{-2/3}})，在无可靠性下界时仍成立；样条估计器在固定正可靠性下以多项式时间达到该速率，指数规模混合可去掉该要求。固定正可靠性下，非负可分解电路将全变差误差压到 1 以下需 exp(Θ(√d)) 个结点。双向最优 KL 误差为 Θ(d/max{log d, √ℓ})；三种固定掩码下联合条件 KL 为 d/log d 阶。平面零场 Ising 情形下精确查询代价 O(d^{3/2}) 并仅需一次根提取。结点计数不含叶子计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可学习性、可推断性与紧凑电路可表示性是可分离的：存在分布类既能在多项式时间内以最优速率学习并支持高效精确推断，又不存在多项式规模的（非负可分解）电路表示，其表示复杂度为 exp(Θ(√d))。局部分解恒等式进一步揭示了弱通道恢复与密度估计的本质差异，并说明因子化证据结构可在平面零场模型上带来接近线性的代数复杂度。

title: When to Refine: Selective Search for Frozen Visual World Models
summary: Planning with a visual world model requires deciding both which actions to execute and how long to search for them. We introduce Selective CEM Refinement (SCR), a learned rule for deciding whether to continue cross-entropy method (CEM) search with a frozen LeWorldModel. After five it- erations, the gate measures how far the mean first action chunk has moved, how much the mean terminal cost of elite plans has fallen, and how widely their first chunks vary. It returns the current plan for execution or continues the same search for ten more iterations. The gate requires no addi- tional world-model rollout. On 16 PushT scenes evaluated with two planning seeds, SCR succeeded in 25 of 32 trials, compared with 28 of 32 for fixed 15-iteration search (Fixed-15). All 25 SCR suc- cesses occurred in trials that Fixed-15 also solved, yield- ing 89.29% paired success retention. Across complete episodes, including replanning, SCR evaluated 23.81% fewer candidate plans and reduced mean controller time per eight-environment batch by 17.22%. Its observed suc- cess rate was 5.36 percentage points above an analytic mix- ture of the two fixed-depth controllers at the same expected candidate workload, although the difference changed sign across planning seeds. Compared with gating only at the initial solve under the same random-draw padding proto- col, gating again at replanning produced nine additional early exits. This reduced total candidate evaluations by 15.79%, while successes fell from 27 to 25.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性CEM精化（SCR）门控规则，用冻结的LeWorldModel判断是否继续CEM搜索：5次迭代后依据首动作块均值位移、精英计划终端代价下降幅度与首块多样性决定提前退出或再搜索10次，无需额外世界模型推演；PushT上以25/32成功率换取约24%候选评估与17%控制时间的节省。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型规划需同时决定"执行什么动作"与"搜索多久"，固定迭代深度（如15次）计算开销大，而现有做法缺少自适应的搜索终止判据。
AI.method: 设计学习型门控：在CEM第5次迭代后提取三个统计量（均值首个动作块移动距离、精英计划平均终端代价下降量、精英首块之间的分散度），输出二值决策——返回当前计划执行，或继续同样的搜索至15次迭代。门控本身不引入额外世界模型rollout，并可与重规划阶段结合使用。
AI.result: 16个PushT场景×2个规划种子共32次试验中，SCR成功25次，Fixed-15成功28次；SCR的全部25次成功均被Fixed-15覆盖，配对成功率保留率89.29%。整回合（含重规划）中候选计划评估减少23.81%，八环境批次的平均控制器时间下降17.22%；成功率比同期望候选工作量下两个固定深度控制器的解析混合高5.36个百分点，但该差异在不同规划种子间变号。相对仅在初始求解处门控，在重规划处再次门控额外产生9次提前退出，候选评估再降15.79%，但成功数由27降至25。
AI.conclusion: SCR以小幅成功率损失换取显著计算节省，且成功案例几乎完全落在固定深度可解子集内，说明其收益主要来自对"易解情形"的提前退出；重规划门控可进一步降低开销但代价是成功数下降。效果对规划种子敏感、差异不稳定，需在更多场景与种子下验证统计显著性。

title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出面向多模态知识图谱推理的噪声感知生成框架NaviGATE，通过结构与文本语义对齐、结构感知内部知识激活、噪声感知双视角指令微调和结构约束解码，兼顾细粒度查询推理与抗噪能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于嵌入的方法虽能刻画图拓扑，但其固定的多模态表示难以支撑查询相关的细粒度语义推理；基于生成的方法则易受噪声检索干扰并可能生成非法实体。两类方法在推理精度与鲁棒性上均存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 将图导出的结构表示与文本语义对齐；2) 利用多模态实体摘要并注入结构token微调多模态语言模型，实现结构感知的内部知识激活；3) 噪声感知双视角指令微调，同时优化无检索与有检索视角——对可靠检索候选进行对比logit锐化强化，对误导候选通过参数一致性蒸馏抑制；4) 推理阶段采用结构约束解码，将生成限制在目标图谱的合法实体范围内。
AI.result: 在标准基准上持续优于强单模态、多模态及生成式基线，并在含噪检索场景下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NaviGATE通过融合参数化内部知识与检索外部知识并结合噪声抑制与结构约束，为多模态知识图谱推理提供了一种有效且抗噪的生成式方案。

title: DORMS: Image Segmentation via Depth-Ordered Region Merge Trees
summary: We introduce DORMS (Depth-Ordered Region Merging for Segmentation), a purely algorithmic approach to image segmentation from monocular depth maps, requiring no neural networks or learned parameters in the segmentation process. An off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator provides the input depth maps. Our method constructs depth-ordered merge trees through a deterministic union-find sweep, combining component area, depth persistence, and spatial contact constraints to guide region merging. A threshold search determines the segmentation granularity according to a specified target region count, while global depth detrending improves the separation of local geometric structures. Extensive experiments on COCO Panoptic, Cityscapes, and ADE20K demonstrate consistent improvements over classical segmentation baselines and competitive performance against zero-shot neural segmentation models. Notably, our method outperforms all evaluated zero-shot models on Cityscapes, while remaining competitive with several approaches on COCO and ADE20K. These results highlight the potential of purely algorithmic geometric reasoning for image segmentation without learned segmentation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DORMS，一种完全基于算法的单目深度图分割方法，分割过程不含神经网络与学习参数，通过深度序区域合并实现分割。
AI.motivation: 现有图像分割多依赖学习型模型，缺少对纯几何推理能力的探索；作者希望验证仅凭单目深度图的几何结构即可完成有效分割。
AI.method: 以现成单目深度估计器提供深度图；通过确定性并查集扫描构建按深度排序的合并树，结合区域面积、深度持久性和空间接触约束指导合并；用阈值搜索按目标区域数确定分割粒度；并用全局深度去趋势提升局部几何结构可分性。
AI.result: 在COCO Panoptic、Cityscapes和ADE20K上，方法一致优于经典分割基线，并与零样本神经分割模型具有竞争力；在Cityscapes上超越所有评测的零样本模型，在COCO与ADE20K上与若干方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 纯算法式几何推理在无学习分割模型的情况下仍具分割潜力，为非学习型分割路线提供了可行性证据。

title: Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Scaling laws are widely used to predict foundation model performance and guide compute allocation. However, tabular foundation models (TFMs) differ from conventional foundation models in that they are pretrained on virtually unlimited synthetic data from configurable distributions, while ultimately being evaluated on real-world datasets. We investigate whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models reliably extrapolate to larger compute budgets and generalize across evaluation settings. Our analysis reveals differences between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior and shows that accurately fitting a scaling law does not necessarily yield reliable prescriptions on unseen datasets. In particular, selecting configurations using too few evaluation datasets leads to systematically over-optimistic performance estimates. We further demonstrate that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes alongside model size and training compute. Increasing the maximum numbers of rows and features sampled during pretraining improves performance and produces more predictable scaling trends. These insights guide the training of more efficient TabPFNv2-like models, using the open-source training pipeline of nanoTabPFN.

AI.tldr: 本文考察 TabPFNv2 类表格基础模型（TFM）的缩放定律是否可外推至更大算力预算并跨评测设置泛化，指出合成数据预训练与真实数据评测的缩放行为存在差异，且拟合良好并不等于能给出可靠配置建议；过度依赖少量评测数据集会导致系统性乐观偏差，算力最优缩放需同时扩展合成预训练数据集规模（行数与特征数上限）。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型基于可由分布配置的近乎无限的合成数据预训练，却在真实数据集上评测，这与常规基础模型的缩放范式不同；现有缩放定律能否可靠外推、能否指导实际配置选择尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于 nanoTabPFN 开源训练流程，训练 TabPFNv2 风格模型，在多种算力预算下系统改变模型规模、训练算力与合成预训练数据规模（采样行数上界、特征数上界），并在不同规模的真实数据集评测集合上比较缩放曲线与配置选择结果。
AI.result: 合成与真实数据的缩放行为不一致；能精确拟合的缩放定律在未见数据集上并不必然给出可靠处方；用过少评测数据集选配置会系统性高估性能；扩大合成预训练数据集规模（最大行数与特征数）可提升性能并使缩放趋势更可预测。
AI.conclusion: TFM 的算力最优缩放需与合成数据规模协同扩展，而非仅增大模型与算力；评测集覆盖度是缩放结论可靠性的关键前提，可为训练更高效的 TabPFNv2 类模型提供指导。

title: RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback
summary: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.

AI.tldr: RECLAIM：一种免训练、推理时为冻结VLA策略抵御对抗补丁的防御方法，利用VLA自身对局部视觉干预的注意力响应引导视觉净化，在闭环操作任务中显著恢复成功率且每步决策仅548.9 ms。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过感知-动作闭环控制具身智能体，其物理交互特性使得对抗补丁不仅能破坏当前动作预测，还会通过改变后续观测形成级联影响。现有防御依赖策略微调或辅助模型，需额外训练或推理开销，难以适用于冻结VLA的部署场景。
AI.method: 提出RECLAIM，无需训练、仅在推理时运行的防御框架：(1) 以冻结VLA对局部图像编辑的注意力变化作为反馈信号，指导“在哪里净化、如何净化”；(2) 结合机器人几何信息细化补丁定位并选择局部处理策略；(3) 在智能体动作持续改变场景的过程中对候选处理进行再验证，形成闭环自适应的净化流程。
AI.result: 在多种操作任务套件、四种对抗攻击方法生成的补丁、冻结VLA控制条件下评估：至少一个rollout成功的任务占比达95%；LIBERO-Object上rollout成功率由无防御的0%提升至70.0%；平均每控制步决策时间为548.9 ms。
AI.conclusion: 策略引导的视觉净化是防御具身智能体对抗补丁攻击的有效途径，可在不训练模型的前提下恢复闭环任务执行，兼具有效性与实时性。

title: AGAMOTTO: An AI-Enabled Framework for Time-Critical Tactical Course-of-Action Evaluation and Generation
summary: Current command and control (C2) platforms lack integrated simulation capabilities that would allow commanders to dynamically explore courses of action (COAs) during live operations. This paper presents ongoing research and contributions to the development of AGAMOTTO (Advanced Guidance and Analytics for Military Operations, Tactical Threats, and Outcomes) as part of the overarching NGC2 program, which advances the Army's efforts to modernize C2 systems, such as the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK). The paper outlines the current design, preliminary findings, and the remaining research tasks, with an emphasis on how the completed work will support tactical decision-making in future time-constrained environments. While the full system is still under development, initial development and results demonstrate the feasibility of AGAMOTTO. Early experiments highlight both the potential benefits and practical constraints of deploying AI-enabled tools in operational settings, and introduce lessons learned and a viable training strategy to make AI-generated COAs feasible in tactical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AGAMOTTO系统，将仿真与AI分析能力集成到指挥控制（C2）平台中，使指挥官能在实时作战中动态探索行动方案（COA），并报告了初步可行性与实践经验。
AI.motivation: 现有C2平台缺乏集成仿真能力，指挥官无法在实时作战中动态评估和探索行动方案（COA）；在时间受限的战术环境下，亟需AI赋能工具辅助决策。研究依托NGC2计划，服务于TAK等C2系统的现代化改造。
AI.method: 以AGAMOTTO（面向军事行动、战术威胁与结果的高级引导与分析系统）为对象，开展系统设计（当前架构基于NGC2框架）、原型开发与早期实验验证；总结部署约束并提出可行的培训策略。
AI.result: 初步开发与实验结果验证了AGAMOTTO的可行性；早期实验同时揭示了AI工具在作战环境中部署的潜在收益与实际约束，并提炼出经验教训与可操作的培训策略。
AI.conclusion: AGAMOTTO尚在开发中，但已证明将AI生成的COA引入战术场景的可行性；后续研究任务将继续完善系统，以支撑未来时间受限条件下的战术决策。

title: SEE: Unlocking the Hidden Perception of Frozen VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) grasp the overall content of an image but often miss the fine details a question hinges on, such as a small object in a large photo or a number in a dense infographic. Yet even when their answer is wrong, the region they point to often contains the evidence. We introduce Self-Elicited Evidence (SEE), a training-free method that lets a frozen VLM look again where it points. When the initial answer has low confidence, SEE prompts the model to propose regions where the details may appear, answers the question on these enlarged crops, and aggregates the answers with the original prediction through confidence-weighted voting. The model also answers with its own transcript, which helps on text-rich images. SEE needs no detector or OCR engine. Across five backbones, SEE improves every small-object benchmark by 2.3-13.1 points and outperforms five training-free baselines on small objects. With SEE, Qwen3.5-4B surpasses the direct answer of Qwen3.5-9B and matches the 6 times larger Qwen3.5-27B.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的“自唤证据”(SEE)方法：当VLM初次作答置信度低时，让冻结模型自行提出证据区域、在放大裁剪上重答，并以置信度加权投票聚合答案；无需检测器或OCR，在五个骨干模型上对小型目标基准提升2.3–13.1个点。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型能把握图像整体内容，但常忽略问题所依赖的细微信息，如大幅照片中的小物体或密集信息图中的数字；不过即使答错，模型指向的区域往往已包含关键证据，因此可利用这一“指向偏差”做二次探查。
AI.method: SEE为免训练方法，冻结VLM参数：初始答案置信度低时，提示模型自行提出可能包含细节的区域，将这些区域放大裁剪后再次作答，并与原始预测通过置信度加权投票聚合；模型还以自身转写结果作答，以增强富文本图像表现；整个流程不依赖目标检测器或OCR引擎。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型上，SEE使所有小型目标基准提升2.3–13.1个点，并在小物体任务上优于五个免训练基线；借助SEE，Qwen3.5-4B超过Qwen3.5-9B的直接作答，并追平规模大6倍的Qwen3.5-27B。
AI.conclusion: 模型“指向区域”中蕴含的证据可被自举利用，通过区域重访与多视图置信度加权聚合即可显著提升细粒度视觉问答性能，且无需额外训练或外部工具，为小型模型带来接近大模型的效果。

title: TRESS: A Fixed-Size History Representation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
summary: A fixed number of recent observations may span minutes for one variable and days for another. Earlier measurements can still reveal whether the latest value is unusual for that variable. We propose TRESS (Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries), a forecasting model that retains the latest observations at their original times and summarises the full history of each variable. For a given set of variables and event budget, this representation stays the same size as the record grows. Its query-conditioned event lifting module weights deviations from the latest value according to the age of each observation and the forecast horizon. A channel-specific decoder combines the resulting features with historical statistics and a summary shared across variables to predict a correction to the latest value. Retaining 8 to 16 observations per variable, TRESS records the lowest mean test MSE and MAE among the methods compared on all four benchmarks. Serving 32 successive query times from one encoded history reduces CPU inference time by a factor of 2.12--2.60 across the four datasets. The code is at https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-TRESS.

AI.tldr: 提出TRESS模型，按时保留每条变量最近若干观测并汇总全历史统计量，在四个基准上取得最低MSE/MAE，并从单次编码历史服务32个查询时间使CPU推理加速2.12–2.60倍。
AI.motivation: 固定数量的“最近观测”跨变量时跨度差异大（分钟级到天级），但更早的测量对判断最新值是否异常仍有价值；同时需在记录持续增长时保持表示规模恒定。
AI.method: TRESS（Timestamped Recent Events and Statistical Summaries）：按原始时间戳保留每个变量最近8–16条观测，并对全历史做统计汇总，使表示规模与记录长度无关；查询条件事件提升模块依据观测年龄与预测步长对“相对最新值的偏差”加权；通道特定解码器将上述特征与历史统计量及跨变量共享摘要结合，预测对最新值的修正量。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，TRESS的平均测试MSE与MAE均最低；由一次编码历史服务32个连续查询时间，CPU推理时间缩短2.12–2.60倍。
AI.conclusion: 以“近期事件+统计摘要”的紧凑表示可在规模恒定的前提下兼顾远期信息，配合查询条件加权与通道特定解码实现精度与效率双优。

title: Single-Controller Teleoperation and Multimodal Dataset Generation for a Mobile Manipulator
summary: Robot learning systems require synchronized, high-quality demonstrations that combine visual, proprioceptive, and action data. However, collecting such datasets with mobile manipulators is often slowed down by fragmented teleoperation interfaces and manual post-processing workflows. This paper presents an integrated framework for teleoperated multimodal data collection on a Clearpath Dingo-O mobile base equipped with a Kinova Gen3 Lite manipulator and an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera. The framework combines single-controller operation of the base, arm, and recording process with an automated ROS-based pipeline for data capture, image-quality filtering, temporal synchronization, visualization, and export to machine-learning-ready Zarr datasets. We validate the system on a pick-and-place mobile-manipulation task in which the robot transports a bottle between two surfaces. The results show that the unified controller supports complete task execution and recording without external commands, while the data pipeline produces synchronized datasets for short demonstrations and identifies corrupted visual frames. The proposed framework provides a practical basis for producing structured demonstrations for robot-learning research.

AI.tldr: 提出一套面向移动操作机器人的集成遥操作多模态数据采集框架，单控制器完成底盘、机械臂与录制操作，并配套自动化ROS流水线实现同步、质量过滤与Zarr数据集导出。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要视觉、本体感知与动作三者同步的高质量示教数据，但移动操作平台的数据采集受制于碎片化的遥操作界面与人工后处理流程，效率低下。
AI.method: 硬件为Clearpath Dingo-O移动底盘+Kinova Gen3 Lite机械臂+Intel RealSense RGB-D相机；软件上采用单一控制器统一操控底盘、机械臂与录制，并基于ROS构建自动化流水线，涵盖数据采集、图像质量过滤、时间同步、可视化及导出为可直接用于机器学习的Zarr数据集。
AI.result: 在"两平台间搬运瓶子"的抓放移动操作任务上验证：统一控制器无需外部命令即可完成任务执行与录制；数据流水线可为短示教生成同步数据集，并能识别损坏的视觉帧。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为机器人学习研究提供结构化示教数据的实用基础，可降低移动操作数据采集与处理成本。

title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
summary: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame

AI.tldr: 在实时视觉游戏（仅看屏幕、思考时游戏仍在运行）中，比较"模型即策略"与"代码即策略"两种自我改进范式，发现代码即策略显著更优。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型能读懂屏幕并推理游戏，但面对陌生游戏仍需学习如何玩。研究问题：智能体能否仅凭自身少量尝试（每次至多8次、每次一分钟的执行）在未见游戏中自我改进，且必须在实时约束下进行。
AI.method: 对比两种可承载自我改进的策略：(1) 模型即策略——模型在游戏过程中直接选动作，采用实时分块（real-time chunking），使已提交动作在模型推理时持续执行，并为此训练2B规模控制器；(2) 代码即策略——模型在多次尝试之间编写、测试、修订程序，由程序在游戏内实时执行。评测覆盖170个GameWorld任务、5类游戏。
AI.result: 代码即策略达到47.80%平均进度，训练的控制器为30.90%，且在全部五类游戏中均领先；仅在单一游戏上微调控制器权重只带来有限提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持让模型离线思考、将所学知识固化为在实时环境中执行的程序，而非在实时回路中直接以模型充当策略；权重层面的在线适配收益有限。

title: Dual-Manifold Variational Autoencoders
summary: In latent diffusion models, expanding the latent dimension of variational autoencoders (VAEs) is essential to push the upper bound of reconstruction quality. However, without explicit structural constraints, such unregularized expansion easily yields a rugged and ill-conditioned latent manifold, causing generated latents to drift off the manifold during generation (i.e., off-manifold problem). Recent works smooth this manifold by using external foundation models (e.g., DINOv2) as a topological regularizer. However, we argue that tying the latent space to frozen external priors inherently restricts generalization: bound by their pre-training distributions and semantic biases, they may fail to capture faithful visual details on out-of-distribution domains. Observing that low-dimensional latents naturally form a smoother, generation-friendly manifold, we propose dual-manifold VAE (DM-VAE) to leverage internal representations as a topological regularizer. Specifically, DM-VAE pairs a high-dimensional reconstructive branch with a low-dimensional branch that extracts a clean topological skeleton, anchoring the high-dimensional manifold to this smooth subspace. Building upon this framework, we further introduce topological representation alignment (TRA) to supervise intermediate generator features during training, and internal guidance with topological skeleton (IG_TS) to guide structural components while preserving high-frequency details at inference. On ImageNet-1K (256x256), our foundation-model-free DM-VAE achieves a state-of-the-art rFID of 0.12 and a generation FID50K of 1.28 (w/o CFG) and 1.20 (w/CFG), and further reaches 1.11 when orthogonally combined with DINOv2.

AI.tldr: 提出双流形 VAE（DM-VAE），用内部低维分支形成的平滑拓扑骨架作为隐空间正则，避免依赖外部基础模型；并配合拓扑表示对齐（TRA）与内部骨架引导（IG_TS），在 ImageNet-1K 上取得 rFID 0.12、FID50K 1.28/1.20 的 SOTA 结果。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散模型中扩大 VAE 潜维可提升重建上限，但缺乏结构约束会使潜流形崎岖、病态，导致生成时潜变量偏离流形（off-manifold 问题）。现有用 DINOv2 等外部基础模型作拓扑正则的做法受其预训练分布与语义偏置限制，难以在分布外域上捕获真实视觉细节，泛化性受限。作者观察到低维潜空间天然形成更平滑、更利于生成的流形，因此希望用内部表示代替外部先验作正则。
AI.method: 提出 DM-VAE：高维重建分支与低维分支并行，低维分支提取干净的拓扑骨架，将高维流形锚定到该平滑子空间。框架之上进一步引入拓扑表示对齐（TRA），在训练时监督生成器中间特征；以及内部骨架引导（IG_TS），在推理时引导结构成分并保留高频细节。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K（256×256）上，不依赖基础模型的 DM-VAE 取得 SOTA 的 rFID 0.12；生成 FID50K 为 1.28（无 CFG）与 1.20（有 CFG）；与 DINOv2 正交结合后进一步提升至 1.11。
AI.conclusion: 内部低维表示可替代冻结外部先验，作为更通用、有效的潜空间拓扑正则；双流形结构配合训练期特征对齐与推理期骨架引导，同时改善重建保真度与生成质量，且与外部正则方法可叠加增益。

title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
comment: This paper is submitted to Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. Evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid architecture achieves the strongest predictive performance among all evaluated models. The proposed hybrid model achieves the best performance with an R^2 score of 0.8022 and mean absolute error of 2.879 MPa, highlighting the importance of incorporating mesh topology in biomechanical prediction tasks. The proposed framework provides a scalable and computationally efficient alternative for FEM-based orthopedic analyses and fracture risk assessment. The code is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出GCN-SAGE-Residual混合图神经网络框架，基于图结构有限元数据预测股骨应力，R²=0.8022、MAE=2.879 MPa，为FEA提供高效代理。
AI.motivation: 髋部骨折在老龄化人群中发病率上升、致残致死负担重；有限元分析（FEA）可评估股骨强度但计算成本高，传统机器学习代理模型虽快却无法捕捉有限元网格的空间与拓扑结构。
AI.method: 将有限元建模（FEM）数据转化为图结构，提出GCN-SAGE-Residual架构，融合图卷积、邻域聚合（GraphSAGE式）与残差学习，以建模网格单元间的空间依赖与应力传播；主实验系统对比14个模型（经典ML与基线GNN），并辅以针对性消融实验分离各组件贡献。
AI.result: 混合架构在所有评估模型中预测性能最佳，R²=0.8022，MAE=2.879 MPa，表明引入网格拓扑对生物力学预测任务至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为基于FEM的骨科分析与骨折风险评估提供了可扩展、计算高效的替代方案，代码已在GitHub公开。

title: OmniFish: A Bioinspired, Modular, Reconfigurable Soft Robotic Fish Enabling Multi-Modal Swimming
comment: Under review at Bioinspiration & Biomimetics. 10 figures, 7 tables
summary: In this work, we introduce OmniFish, a bioinspired modular soft robotic fish designed to emulate the full spectrum of body and/or caudal fin (BCF) locomotion modes within a single robotic platform. The design combines morphology averaging across representative fish species with a tendon-driven compliant segmented spine whose effective stiffness can be reconfigured through progressive mechanical jamming. By selectively constraining body segments, OmniFish shifts deformation from whole-body undulation to posterior body bending and localized tail oscillation, enabling bioinspired Anguilliform, Subcarangiform, Carangiform, Thunniform, and Ostraciiform swimming using a single tendon-driven actuator. The design was guided by morphometric analysis and evaluated through caudal-fin thrust characterization, numerical body-drag simulations, kinematic analysis, and swimming performance experiments. Kinematic analysis confirmed the intended robot transition from distributed body undulation to localized tail oscillation. Swimming experiments demonstrated distinct mode-dependent performance, with the Ostraciiform configuration achieving the highest straight-line velocity of 8.14 cm/s and the lowest cost of transport of 2.42 at 1.5 tail beats/s. These proof-of-concept results show that a mechanically simple stiffness-reconfigurable architecture can generate distinct BCF swimming modes and provide a versatile strategy for developing multimodal soft robotic fish.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmniFish——一种仿生模块化软体机器鱼，通过肌腱驱动+渐进式机械阻塞实现刚度可重构的分段脊柱，用单一驱动器即可复现五种BCF游动模式。
AI.motivation: 现有机器鱼通常针对单一游动模式设计，难以在单一平台上同时实现从鳗行式到箱鲀式的全谱系BCF（身体/尾鳍）游动模式；需在保持机械简洁性的前提下获得模式多样性。
AI.method: 设计综合代表性鱼种的形态学平均与形态计量分析；采用肌腱驱动的柔性分段脊柱，通过渐进式机械阻塞（jamming）重配置有效刚度；选择性约束身体节段，使变形由整体波动转向后体弯曲与局部尾摆；评估手段包括尾鳍推力表征、数值体阻模拟、运动学分析与游动性能实验。
AI.result: 运动学分析证实机器人可自分布式身体波动过渡至局部尾摆振荡；游动实验显示性能随模式变化，Ostraciiform构型在1.5 tail beats/s下取得最高直线速度8.14 cm/s与最低运输成本2.42。
AI.conclusion: 概念验证表明，机械结构简单、刚度可重构的架构即可产生多种BCF游动模式，为多模态软体机器鱼提供通用设计策略。

title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
summary: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.

AI.tldr: GateWatch 将激活探针的决策规则表达为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔逻辑电路，在仅用 3.8 个 SAE 特征和 3.5 个逻辑门的情况下达到 80.49% 平均准确率，仅比全 16K 特征 SAE 探针低 1.17 个百分点，同时将探针内存降低 99.98%。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 及其智能体被广泛部署，监测其行为（识别不安全或非预期动作）日益重要。现有激活探针存在权衡：原始激活探针缺乏可解释输入；稀疏自编码器（SAE）探针虽使用可解释特征，但依赖加性分类器与大型 SAE 编码器，可解释性受限且内存开销高。作者希望同时兼顾准确率、可解释性与计算开销。
AI.method: 提出 GateWatch——一个紧凑、可解释的分类器，将完整决策规则显式表达为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的布尔逻辑。在给定门数预算下探索三种电路构建方法；并设计 GateWatchServe 以支持高效部署：仅计算被选中的 SAE 特征、在推理时跨层流式传递其二进制取值、利用紧凑查找表并行评估多个 GateWatch 分类器。
AI.result: 在 Gemma-2-9B 的 24 个任务上，GateWatch 平均仅用 3.8 个 SAE 特征、每个探针 3.5 个逻辑门，即取得 80.49% 的平均测试准确率，仅比使用全部 16K 特征的 SAE 探针低 1.17 个百分点，并在 10 个任务上持平或超越，同时探针内存减少 99.98%。在 vLLM 中，1,000 个并发的多层、多 token GateWatch 分类器仍保留 97–98% 的基线吞吐与 99.8% 的 KV-cache 容量。
AI.conclusion: GateWatch 表明，以少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔电路作为探针，可在几乎不损失准确率的前提下大幅提升可解释性并显著降低内存与推理开销，且可在 vLLM 等推理框架中高并发部署，适合 LLM 与智能体的运行时行为监测。

title: TOMAS: Topology-Aware Operation Modeling and Adaptive Staging for Egocentric Hand Forecasting
summary: Forecasting future hand movements from egocentric videos plays an important role in understanding human intentions and hand-object interactions. However, different manipulation intentions can lead to substantially different hand trajectories even when interacting with the same object. Existing methods have not sufficiently explored the intrinsic relationships between articulated hand movements and object semantics to capture such operation-dependent motion patterns. Therefore, we propose TOMAS, a topology-aware operation modeling and adaptive staging framework for egocentric hand forecasting. Specifically, we develop a topology-aware hand-object reasoning mechanism that associates hand skeletal structures and articulation dynamics with object semantics and spatial relationships to jointly infer potential interaction targets and latent manipulation operations. The resulting object-operation representations provide interaction conditions for future hand trajectory prediction, with supervision adapted to the annotations available in each dataset. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive staging mechanism that organizes future hand movements into ordered latent stages with learnable temporal boundaries. Stage-specific geometric subgoals are then incorporated to guide trajectory refinement according to the underlying manipulation patterns. Experimental results on multiple publicly available benchmarks demonstrate that TOMAS achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-dimensional and multi-target hand motion forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出TOMAS框架，通过拓扑感知的“手-物”推理与自适应分段机制，从第一视角视频预测未来手部运动，在多个公开基准上取得多维度、多目标手部运动预测的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 第一视角视频中未来手部运动预测对理解人类意图与手-物交互至关重要，但同一物体在不同操作意图下会产生截然不同的手部轨迹。现有方法未能充分挖掘关节化手部运动与物体语义之间的内在关联，因而难以捕捉这种“操作依赖”的运动模式。
AI.method: 1）拓扑感知的手-物推理机制：将手部骨骼结构与关节运动动力学同物体语义及空间关系相关联，联合推断潜在交互目标与隐含操作类型，得到“物体-操作”表征作为未来轨迹预测的交互条件，并按各数据集的标注可用性调整监督方式；2）自适应分段机制：将未来手部运动组织为带可学习时间边界的有序隐阶段，并引入阶段特定的几何子目标引导轨迹细化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集上的实验表明，TOMAS在多维度、多目标手部运动预测任务上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模手部关节结构与物体语义的拓扑关联、并借助可学习的分阶段子目标约束，可有效刻画操作依赖的手部运动模式，验证了“操作意图条件化+阶段化几何引导”这一思路对第一视角手部轨迹预测的有效性。

title: Supervised Hebbian Class Networks: Learning Without Backpropagation
summary: This paper introduces Supervised Hebbian Class Networks as a method for training multi- layer perceptrons and convolutional networks without gradient calculations or backpropa- gation. Each neuron in a learned layer is assigned a class, while connections follow the usual fully connected or convolutional pattern. The method combines a class-based supervision rule shared across layers with a Lion optimizer adapted to Hebbian activity products. All layers train together throughout the run, and their activities provide class predictions di- rectly, without a separately trained classifier. The experiments test the method on MNIST with a multilayer perceptron and on CIFAR-10 with a convolutional networ

AI.tldr: 提出监督式Hebbian类别网络（SHCN），以类监督Hebbian规则替代反向传播训练MLP与CNN，所有层并行训练且各层激活直接给出类别预测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络依赖梯度计算与反向传播，存在全局误差回传、非生物合理性以及计算/存储开销高等问题；作者希望探索一种无需梯度、无需BP、且不必单独训练分类器的多层网络训练范式。
AI.method: 为学习层的每个神经元分配一个类别标签，连接仍采用常规全连接或卷积结构；采用各层共享的类监督规则，并将Lion优化器改造为适配Hebbian活动乘积的形式；所有层在整个训练过程中同步训练，各层活动值直接作为类别预测，无独立分类器。
AI.result: 在MNIST上以多层感知机验证，在CIFAR-10上以卷积网络验证（摘要未给出具体精度数值）。
AI.conclusion: 实验初步表明，无需梯度与反向传播的类监督Hebbian训练可驱动多层感知机与卷积网络学习，为免BP的深度模型训练提供可行路径。

title: TinyARM-X: A Series of Open-Source, Configurable, and Transparent Torque-Controlled Desktop-Scale Robotic Manipulators
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to a robotics Journal. Reviews have not come in yet
summary: Visuomotor policies have demonstrated that imprecise low-cost robots can autonomously complete complex manipulation tasks. However, most inexpensive manipulators rely on compact and rigidly position-controlled servos for actuation, which complicate simulation, operation, and safety. This work introduces TinyARM-X, a framework for easily manufacturable, configurable, and torque-controllable low-cost (<350 USD) serial manipulators. By using a single hardware/software architecture, a <7 Degree of Freedom (DoF) TinyARM can be manually reconfigured to an operational >3 DoF robot within 10 min. Actuator modeling and dynamic compensation enable torque-controlled applications like mixed-reality impedance control teleoperation and simulator force feedback rendering. Experiments include mechanical benchmarking and real-world force-aware telemanipulation. The TinyARM-7 has a payload of 33.5 g, a max speed of 0.77 m/s, and a reach of 210 mm. Moreover, with dynamic compensation, the robot has a backdrive-breakaway force of 1.4 N and a backdrive-running force of 0.7 N. Additionally, Cartesian-Impedance Control (CIC) attains a translational stiffness of >15 N/m. Lastly, the TinyARM-X stack is open-sourced to disseminate accessible desktop-scale torque-controlled robotic manipulation to the community.

AI.tldr: 提出 TinyARM-X：低成本（<350 美元）、可快速重构、支持力矩控制的串联机械臂软硬件框架，实现混合现实阻抗遥操作与仿真力反馈。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动策略已证明低成本不精确机器人可完成复杂操作任务，但廉价机械臂多用紧凑刚性位置控制舵机，导致仿真建模、运行与安全性困难，缺乏力矩控制能力。
AI.method: 采用统一硬件/软件架构，支持<7自由度机械臂在10分钟内手动重构为>3自由度可用机器人；通过执行器建模与动态补偿实现力控，支撑混合现实阻抗控制遥操作与仿真器力反馈渲染。
AI.result: 机械基准测试与真实力觉遥操作实验：TinyARM-7负载33.5 g、最大速度0.77 m/s、臂展210 mm；动态补偿下反向驱动启动力1.4 N、运行力0.7 N；笛卡尔阻抗控制平移刚度>15 N/m。
AI.conclusion: TinyARM-X 以统一架构实现低成本、可重构、力矩控制的桌面级机械臂，并开源整套软件栈，推动力控机器人操作的可及性。

title: Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) can run on commodity hardware and support privacy-preserving, on-premises clinical deployment, but their medical explanations are often short and poorly structured compared with large language models. Recent supervised approaches such as Meerkat transfer chain-of-thought reasoning into 7B-8B backbones, yet their training objective does not directly target the style or organization of the generated rationales. Building on the instruction-tuned Mistral-7B backbone, we investigate whether a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) step can improve explanation structure without human preference labels.We apply Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with LoRA adaptation to 2,000 Meerkat-derived medical prompts, guided by a simple self-supervised reward that favors longer, lexically diverse, and well-punctuated responses while penalizing very short ones. Training for about 170 PPO steps on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU yields a stable increase in the average reward. Quantitative and qualitative comparisons show that the RL-tuned model produces longer, more organized, multi-point explanations while preserving the underlying medical content.We discuss the promise and the limitations of self-rewarded RL for shaping the style of medical explanations.

AI.tldr: 在Mistral-7B（经Meerkat链式思考微调）基础上，用LoRA+PPO结合自监督奖励（偏好更长、词汇多样、标点规范、惩罚过短）进行约170步RL微调，使小型语言模型的医学解释更长、更有条理、多点化，同时保留医学内容。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型（SLM）可本地部署、保护隐私，适配临床场景，但其医学解释相比大模型过短、结构松散。现有Meerkat等监督方法虽把链式思考迁移到7B-8B骨干，训练目标却不直接针对生成理由的风格与组织性；且无人工偏好标签可用。
AI.method: 以指令微调的Mistral-7B为骨干，在2,000条Meerkat衍生的医学提示上，采用LoRA适配的PPO，奖励函数为简单的自监督形式：鼓励更长、词汇多样、标点良好的回答，惩罚过短回答。单张NVIDIA A100上约170个PPO步。
AI.result: 平均奖励稳定上升；定量与定性对比显示，RL微调后的模型生成更长、更有组织、多要点的解释，同时保留原有医学内容。
AI.conclusion: 自奖励RL可在无人工偏好标注下有效塑形医学解释的风格与结构；作者进一步讨论了该方法在医学解释风格塑造上的潜力与局限。

title: Agreement Is Not Accuracy: LiDAR Elevation Errors Hidden in LiDAR-Camera Extrinsics
summary: LiDAR and cameras provide complementary measurements for 3D vision, yet agreement between their observations does not establish the accuracy of either sensor's internal geometry. We show that systematic LiDAR elevation biases can be absorbed into the estimated extrinsics. Using synchronized LiDAR intensities and camera-estimated checkerboard poses, we jointly estimate a sensor-specific elevation correction shared across recordings and extrinsics for each recording. Ray-plane intersections locate the checker pattern without using reported ranges, preventing range errors from directly moving the lookup. Under matched intensity and correction models, this lookup gives smaller camera-consistency residuals than measured-point lookup. Across six identically designed rigs using the same sensor models, recording-excluded corrections reduce the mean translation-reference distance from 7.57 to 3.04 mm. On separate structures, they reduce inter-plane angle errors against references from independent dense camera scans and improve image-edge alignment. Rolling the rigs shifts the plane pairs exhibiting the largest angular improvements, as predicted for an elevation-only correction. Within the ray-plane model, calibration-target projections and loop-consistency residuals change little despite these geometric improvements. These findings show why agreement after extrinsic calibration need not establish correct internal LiDAR geometry. Synchronized observations of a familiar checkerboard provide a practical route to estimating and testing elevation corrections without a dedicated large calibration field. We plan to release code and data for reproducing the main results.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，LiDAR与相机观测之间的一致性并不能证明任一传感器内部几何的准确性：系统性LiDAR高程偏差可被外参吸收。作者利用同步的LiDAR强度与相机估计的棋盘格位姿，联合估计跨录制的传感器特定高程校正与逐录制外参，通过光线-平面求交定位棋盘格（不依赖测量距离），在六个同型号设备上将平移参考距离从7.57 mm降至3.04 mm，并改善面间夹角与图像边缘对齐，证明无需大型标定场即可估计并检验高程校正。
AI.motivation: LiDAR与相机测量互补，但标定后两者观测一致（残差小）常被当作传感器内部几何正确的证据。实际上系统性LiDAR高程偏差可以被外参估计吸收，从而"掩盖"内部误差。论文旨在揭示这一混淆，并提供无需大型专用标定场的实用解决方案。
AI.method: 使用同步的LiDAR强度与相机估计的棋盘格位姿，联合估计一个跨录制共享的传感器特定高程校正，以及每个录制的外参。利用光线-平面求交定位棋盘格图案，而非使用传感器报告的距离，避免测距误差直接影响查表位置；并在强度与校正模型匹配的条件下，将该方法与基于测量点的查表进行对比。
AI.result: 在匹配模型下，光线-平面查表比测量点查表具有更小的相机一致性残差。在六个相同设计的同型号传感器设备上，基于录制留一的高程校正将平均平移参考距离从7.57 mm降至3.04 mm；在独立结构上，相对于独立稠密相机扫描参考，降低了面间夹角误差并改善图像边缘对齐。旋转设备时，角度改进最大的平面组合发生转移，符合仅高程校正的预测。值得注意的是，在光线-平面模型内，标定靶投影与回环一致性残差变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 标定后的一致性不足以确立LiDAR内部几何正确；同步观测常见棋盘格为估计和检验高程校正提供了实用途径，无需专用大型标定场，并计划公开代码与数据以复现主要结果。

title: Structure-Preserving Neural Approximation of Convex, Semiconvex, and Quasiconvex Functions
summary: Input convex neural networks provide a natural way to enforce convexity globally through architectural constraints. We study how this structure-preserving approximation framework extends to semiconvex, quasiconvex, and convex transformable functions. For $C^{1,1}$ convex functions on compact convex domains, we establish the sharp $W^{1,p}$ minimax rate $m^{-1/d}$ under max-affine approximation with $m$ affine pieces, and show that every max-affine function admits an exact bounded-width ICNN representation with complexity linear in $m$. The same $W^{1,p}$ approximation rate extends to semiconvex functions through quadratic lifting and to convex transformable functions through monotone composition. For general Lipschitz quasiconvex functions, we develop a quantitative finite-probe approximation theory based on monotone responses to affine projections and obtain a structure-preserving IqCNN with an $L^\infty$ approximation guarantee. We further show that these approximation results extend to ReLU-transferable smooth activations, including Softplus and ELU. Numerical experiments on PDE-based approximation problems compare the proposed architectures with parameter-matched MLPs and validation-tuned shape penalties, demonstrating global structural validity without penalty tuning while maintaining competitive approximation accuracy. Overall, the results identify recoverable convex latent structure as the key mechanism enabling gradient-level structure-preserving approximation beyond convexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究输入凸神经网络（ICNN）的结构保持逼近能力如何从凸函数推广到半凸、拟凸与凸可变换函数，建立尖锐的W^{1,p}极小极大逼近率与精确的有限宽度ICNN表示，并提出拟凸神经网络IqCNN。
AI.motivation: ICNN通过架构约束天然实现全局凸性，但现实问题中的函数常为非凸（半凸、拟凸等），亟需回答：这种结构保持框架能否、以何种代价扩展到凸性之外，以及在何种机制下可实现梯度层面的结构保持逼近。
AI.method: 对紧凸域上的C^{1,1}凸函数，在m片max-affine逼近下建立W^{1,p}率m^{-1/d}，并证明每个max-affine函数存在复杂度线性于m的有界宽度ICNN精确表示；通过二次提升处理半凸函数、通过单调复合处理凸可变换函数；针对Lipschitz拟凸函数，基于仿射投影的单调响应建立有限探针定量逼近理论并构造IqCNN；进一步推广至Softplus、ELU等ReLU可迁移光滑激活。
AI.result: 获得凸函数在max-affine逼近下的尖锐W^{1,p}极小极大率m^{-1/d}；半凸与凸可变换函数继承相同逼近率；IqCNN获得L^\infty逼近保证；在PDE逼近问题上，与参数量匹配的MLP及验证集调优的形状惩罚相比，无需惩罚调参即实现全局结构有效性且保持有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出“可恢复的凸潜在结构”是超越凸性实现梯度级结构保持逼近的关键机制，为ICNN类架构在非凸问题中的理论可靠性与实际应用提供了统一框架。
