title: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
summary: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.

AI.tldr: SHAPE：以EEF离散动作token作为辅助监督、由共享flow-matching专家输出EEF与关节双执行流的VLA模型，实现从人类自我中心视频向22自由度双臂机器人的技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类自我中心录像比精细机器人示范廉价得多，可直接用于预训练与技能学习；但人机形态与运动学不同，人类数据缺少关节位置与执行器指令，只能提供重定向后的末端执行器(EEF)动作，因此需要回答两个问题：(1)人类数据应如何监督策略；(2)灵巧机器人在部署时应如何读出动作。
AI.method: 提出SHAPE（Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams）。骨干网络将EEF动作块的离散token预测作为辅助任务；共享的flow-matching专家并行输出两条可执行流——EEF流与关节流。在22自由度手的双臂机器人上进行匹配对照实验，比较离散监督与连续监督、关节直读与基于IK的EEF读出。
AI.result: 匹配实验表明：离散监督有助于从人类数据中学习，能驱动骨干网络梯度并在跨域上塑造具动作信息的表征。部署于标准控制管线时，关节直读在机器人示范下擅长精细控制，六项任务平均0.80，优于π0.5的0.63；而基于IK的EEF读出更擅长人→机迁移。以人类数据与离散token预训练后，SHAPE可仅凭人类示范学习新任务，无需任务特定的机器人数据。
AI.conclusion: 离散动作token监督与双流并行执行构成一套兼顾"人类数据监督"与"部署动作读出"的统一方案：读出方式应随数据来源与精度需求选择（机器人数据偏关节直读，人类迁移偏IK-EEF），据此SHAPE实现了无任务特定机器人数据的人类示范技能学习。

title: Movie2Game-Bench: Holistic Evaluation of Film-to-Game Adaptation Beyond Playability
summary: Adapting a film into a game requires selecting source elements and translating them into player actions, rules, and feedback. We introduce Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench), a benchmark for evaluating film-to-game adaptation beyond playability. M2G-bench combines general evaluation, movie-specific evaluation, and playtesting by three GUI model players. The protocol connects source content to gameplay steps and implementation evidence, capturing both content preservation and interactive realization. The benchmark comprises 22 films and 658 source-specific reference items. Evaluating 14 models on the same films with their selected primary harnesses reveals complementary strengths in game quality, adaptation, and player experience. A shared weakness concerns playable sequences: this category has the lowest content-presence mean in all 14 models, averaging 37.9 out of 100 compared with 54.8 for iconic elements. Among judgments of retained emotionaldevelopment content, narrative choices account for 60.0% and scenario operation for 7.2%. These findings identify two linked priorities for film-to-game adaptation: preserving source situations that can support gameplay and connecting retained content to player actions and consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench)，一个超越"可玩性"的电影改编游戏评测基准，将通用评估、电影专属评估与三名GUI模型玩家的试玩测试结合，包含22部影片与658条源特定参考条目，并在14个模型上揭示了"可玩序列"内容保留度的系统性短板。
AI.motivation: 电影改编游戏需要选取源元素并转化为玩家动作、规则与反馈，但现有评测多止步于"能否玩"，无法同时衡量内容保真与交互实现。作者希望建立把源内容与玩法步骤、实现证据相连接的评测协议，用以诊断改编的真实质量。
AI.method: 构建 M2G-bench：整合三类评估——通用评估、电影专属评估，以及由三个GUI模型玩家完成的试玩测试（playtesting）。协议将源内容映射到玩法步骤与实现证据，从而同时刻画内容保留（content preservation）与交互实现（interactive realization）。基准规模为22部影片、658条源特定参考条目；在相同影片上以各模型自选的主harness评测14个模型。
AI.result: 14个模型在游戏质量、改编度与玩家体验上呈现互补优势；共同弱点是可玩序列（playable sequences）——该类别在全部14个模型中内容呈现均值最低，为37.9/100，而标志性元素为54.8/100。在保留的情感发展内容判定中，叙事选择占60.0%，场景操作仅占7.2%。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出电影改编游戏的两项联动优先级：一是保留能够支撑玩法的源情境，二是将保留下来的内容与玩家动作及其后果相连接。M2G-bench 提供了可诊断内容保真与交互落地差距的评测框架。

title: SIRAZ: Sparse Inter-Layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-Shot Visual Neural Decoding
summary: Brain-computer interfaces aim to establish direct communication between neural activity and external systems, making interpretation of brain signals an important problem. In this context, neural visual decoding seeks to infer visual information from neural activity by learning a mapping between brain responses and the corresponding visual stimuli. It investigates how visual information emerges from neural signals and relates to perceptual processing while enabling the reconstruction or retrieval of visual stimuli from neural signals. Our brain primarily follows a hierarchical pathway to process visual information captured by the eye. However, neural representations learned by existing methods differ fundamentally from those produced by the biological visual system. To bridge this gap and mimic the human vision hierarchy, we introduce Sparse Inter-layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-shot (SIRAZ). SIRAZ is a framework that aligns neural visual representations by jointly modeling early visual processes via fovea- and magnocellular-pathway-inspired Difference-of-Gaussians transformations. To align the semantic information with neural information, it extracts multiple intermediate representations of the image at multiple depths and passes them through the Residual Gated Adapter Mechanism. To study the temporal dynamics of neural signals, the Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention Encoder is introduced to align the learned neural representation with the final visual representation. The proposed framework achieves 92.5% top-1 and 99.27% top-5 accuracy in the intra-subject setting on the THINGS-EEG dataset, and 50.25% and 75% top-1 and top-5 accuracy in the THINGS-MEG dataset. The results indicate that combining biologically motivated visual representations with the structured modalities of neural dynamics improves cross-modal alignment and zero-shot image retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出SIRAZ框架，通过模拟人类视觉层级通路对齐神经与视觉表征，提升零样本脑信号图像检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经视觉解码方法所学习的神经表征与生物视觉系统的表征存在本质差异，未遵循人脑层级化的视觉处理通路，导致跨模态对齐不足。
AI.method: SIRAZ框架包含三部分：1) 基于中央凹与巨细胞通路启发的Difference-of-Gaussians变换联合建模早期视觉过程；2) 提取图像多深度中间表征并经由Residual Gated Adapter Mechanism处理，实现语义与神经信息对齐；3) 引入Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention Encoder建模神经信号时间动态，将学习到的神经表征与最终视觉表征对齐。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG数据集受试者内设置下达到92.5% top-1与99.27% top-5准确率；在THINGS-MEG数据集上达到50.25% top-1与75% top-5准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将生物启发的视觉表征与结构化神经动态模态相结合，可有效改善跨模态对齐与零样本图像检索性能。

title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Weather Forecasting: Conformal Prediction Under Spatiotemporal Dependence
summary: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage and has begun to be applied to gridded weather forecasts. Marginal coverage concerns the long-run fraction of covered points at a location, not how coverage behaves jointly across space and time on a given day. I benchmark eight interval-construction procedures (Gaussian, pooled and per-cell split conformal, per-season, adaptive conformal inference and rolling windows) for gridded 2 m temperature forecasts at eight lead times from 6 hours to 10 days, using ERA5 at 5.625 degree resolution, a deliberately modest convolutional forecaster and ECMWF's operational HRES, with calibration in 2017-2018 and testing in 2019-2021. Alongside coverage, width and interval score, I report dependence diagnostics: a spatial overdispersion index, quantiles of daily spatial coverage and miss persistence relative to a shuffled-days null. Per-cell methods reach near-nominal marginal coverage, yet the day-to-day variance of the fraction of cells covered is roughly 3 to 10 times what independent cells would give, and misses cluster in time; both effects grow with lead time for the CNN, also appear for HRES, and are shared by all methods. An oracle that divides each day's normalised errors by that day's mean removes 81 to 92 percent of the excess dispersion for the CNN and 93 to 98 percent for HRES, so days of large errors across much of the grid account for most of it. A day-scale predicted from seasonal terms and already-verified errors lowers the overdispersion index without widening intervals but improves interval score by at most 0.6 percent; on HRES from 12 hours to 3 days it has the lowest overdispersion index while ACI or season-conditional calibration has the best interval score, so no method is best on both. The study covers one variable, one coarse grid, a reanalysis target and two forecasters.

AI.tldr: 该文在网格化2m温度预报上基准测试了8种区间构造方法，发现尽管边际覆盖率接近名义值，但空间覆盖率的天间方差是独立假设的3–10倍且漏报在时间上聚集，这种过度离散在各方法、各提前期及HRES上普遍存在，主要由"大范围误差日"驱动。
AI.motivation: 共形预测仅保证边际覆盖率（长期覆盖比例），而天气网格预报实际关心的是某一天在空间与时间上的联合覆盖行为。现有评估缺乏对空间/时间依赖结构的诊断，因此需要量化并诊断网格预报区间的不确定性在空间-时间上的表现。
AI.method: 在ERA5 5.625°分辨率、6小时至10天共8个提前期上，使用一个刻意精简的卷积预报器与ECMWF业务HRES，2017–2018校准、2019–2021测试，比较8种区间构造方法（Gaussian、pooled与per-cell split conformal、per-season、ACI、滚动窗口）。评估指标除覆盖率、宽度、interval score外，还引入依赖诊断：空间过度离散指数、每日空间覆盖率分位数、相对于"打乱天数"零假设的漏报持续性。并构造一个oracle（用当日平均归一化误差除各点误差）以及基于季节项和已验证误差的日尺度预测。
AI.result: Per-cell方法达到接近名义的边际覆盖，但每日被覆盖格点比例的天间方差约为独立格点情形的3–10倍，漏报在时间上聚集；两种效应随CNN提前期增加而增强，HRES亦存在，且所有方法共有。oracle可消除CNN 81–92%、HRES 93–98%的过度离散，说明大范围误差日贡献了绝大部分。日尺度预测在不加宽区间的情况下降低过度离散指数，但interval score最多仅改善0.6%；在HRES 12小时–3天上其过度离散最低，而ACI或季节条件校准的interval score最优，无单一方法两者兼优。
AI.conclusion: 边际共形覆盖掩盖了显著的空间-时间依赖与漏报聚集，主要由日尺度大范围误差驱动；改善日尺度校准可降低过度离散但不显著提升区间得分，且不存在同时最优的方法。研究局限：仅一个变量、一个粗网格、再分析真值和两种预报器。

title: Hydrodynamics of robotic micro-swimmers in confinement
summary: Inspired by seminal work by E.M. Purcell, we discuss the problem of predicting and optimizing the performance of autonomous robots swimming in confinement. Our approach is based on the explicit numerical resolution of the fluid flow induced by the swimmer, and it is validated experimentally on a cm-size prototype composed of a cargo head and a rotating propulsive tail. Using hydrodynamic scaling, we predict the performance of replicas of our prototype scaled down to mm- and sub-mm-size to test the feasibility of autonomous micro-robots navigating in narrow vessels. The main result of our theoretical, computational, and experimental analysis is that, while hydrodynamics seems to place no fundamental obstruction to the vision of autonomous micro-robots navigating in narrow lumens inside the human body, it does provide useful and strict guidelines for rational design at different length scales.

AI.tldr: 受Purcell工作启发，结合数值流体求解、实验验证与流体力学标度分析，研究受限环境中自游机器人的性能预测与优化，发现流体力学不构成微机器人在狭窄管腔中推进的根本障碍，但为不同尺度设计提供严格准则。
AI.motivation: 检验"自主微型机器人在人体狭窄管腔内导航"这一设想的流体力学可行性，并为其多尺度设计提供依据。
AI.method: 显式数值求解游泳体诱导的流场；以厘米级原型（载货头部+旋转推进尾部）进行实验验证；再用流体力学标度律预测缩小至毫米及亚毫米尺度的复制体性能。
AI.result: 数值、实验与标度分析结果一致：受限流体动力学未对微型机器人于狭窄管腔中游动构成根本性障碍，但给出随尺度变化的严格性能约束。
AI.conclusion: 该设想在流体力学上可行，限制主要来自具体尺度的定量要求；所得规律可作为跨尺度理性设计的指导原则。

title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.

AI.tldr: 通过"策略诱导能力区域"视角重新分解长时程稀疏奖励问题，提出配对优势与反向到正向的渐进课程，在ALFWorld/WebShop上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: RL训练LLM智能体处理长时程任务时，稀疏的终端奖励使信用分配与探索十分困难；需要一种更可学习的信号结构来缓解稀疏性问题。
AI.method: 定义策略诱导能力区域（当前策略可可靠完成任务的状态集合）。在区域边界附近，少量动作即可到达更易求解的状态，从而把长时程任务拆为两个耦合子问题：到达该状态、以及从该状态完成任务。为此引入配对优势（paired advantages）为两个子问题提供分离的信号；并设计渐进式"反向到正向"课程：先沿成功参考轨迹向后扩展能力区域，再通过在线策略探索扩展到非参考状态。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop上，于两个模型规模上均优于有竞争力的agentic RL方法；Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct成功率分别为90.1%/96.1%（ALFWorld）与80.2%/82.6%（WebShop）。
AI.conclusion: 以能力区域边界为核心的重分解与配套优势估计、课程机制，可有效改善稀疏奖励下的信用分配与探索，提升LLM智能体长时程任务表现。

title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.

AI.tldr: WaveView将warp后的源图像注入预训练视频扩散模型初始噪声的相位中（基于DT-CWPT实现局部各向异性相位注入），在不改变架构、几乎无额外开销的前提下提升新视角合成的几何一致性与速度。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式新视角合成中，显式warp方法需用视频扩散模型重投影源图像，隐式方法需编码相机参数或3D线索；二者都带来推理开销，且生成布局常偏离真值。
AI.method: 利用双树复小波包变换（DT-CWPT）将warp后的源图像注入预训练生成器初始噪声的相位，实现局部且各向异性的相位注入，使生成器在遮挡解离区和极线方向上的约束更弱；不修改网络架构。
AI.result: 在DL3DV基准上，各重叠区间均优于所有基线；最难区间中，共视区域PSNR比共享生成器的MetaView高0.84 dB，且速度快2.1倍。动态NVS中，用同样噪声微调AnyView，使其在AnyViewBench上的零样本PSNR由11.58 dB提升至12.35 dB。
AI.conclusion: 相位域注入是一种轻量、架构无关且有效的条件注入范式，兼顾精度与效率，并可迁移至动态新视角合成。

title: OpenGNS: An Open Dataset of the Gradient Noise Scale across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
summary: The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. Building on this dataset, we study how the GNS depends on hyperparameters, scale, and training progress, and how it relates to the CBS. We find that the GNS behaves as a consistent "temperature of training", remaining stable across model sizes under muP at equivalent loss, and our results suggest task-dependent biases in its relation to the CBS: a tendency to overestimate the CBS for classification and to underestimate it for generative tasks, consistent in direction across common CBS definitions. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/olympique-marcel/OpenGNS

AI.tldr: 本文发布OpenGNS数据集（400余条GNS测量轨迹，覆盖ResNet、GPT、DiT三类架构，11M–1B参数、muP下稠密批量与学习率扫描），并基于此系统研究GNS与超参、规模、训练进程及CBS的关系：GNS表现为稳定的"训练温度"，在等价损失下跨模型规模稳定；GNS与CBS的关系存在任务相关偏差——分类任务倾向高估CBS，生成任务倾向低估CBS，且方向在不同CBS定义下一致。
AI.motivation: 梯度噪声尺度（GNS）可近似临界批量大小（CBS），虽在前沿模型技术报告中出现，但缺乏跨现代架构的公开GNS测量数据集，阻碍了系统性研究。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建并公开OpenGNS数据集：超过400条GNS测量轨迹，涵盖三个域——ResNet图像分类、GPT自回归语言建模、Diffusion Transformer图像生成；模型规模11M至1B参数，在Maximal Update Parameterization（muP）下进行稠密批量大小与学习率扫描。基于该数据集分析GNS对超参数、规模、训练进度的依赖及其与CBS的关系。
AI.result: GNS表现为一致的"训练温度"，在muP下等价损失处跨模型规模保持稳定；GNS与CBS的关系呈现任务依赖偏差：分类任务倾向高估CBS，生成任务倾向低估CBS，且该方向在常见CBS定义下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: GNS是跨规模稳定的可迁移度量，但其到CBS的映射并非任务无关；实践者应警惕按任务类型修正CBS估计偏差，OpenGNS为后续研究提供公开基准。

title: Conceptual full-vehicle modeling of a modular all-wheel-drive robotic ADS test platform as a foundation for a digital twin architecture
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures. Supplementary project files are available at https://git-ce.rwth-aachen.de/asil-lab-cologne/03_publications/02_pixkitcmdigtwin
summary: This paper presents the development of an initial full-vehicle simulation model of the PixKit modular electric test platform in IPG CarMaker. The objective is to create a physics-based and extendable model structure that can serve as a low-level foundation for future digital twin applications. The reference vehicle is a skateboard chassis combining unconventional vehicle characteristics such as four independent wheel-hub motors and rear axle steering capable of high steering angles. Since complete measurement data of the vehicle is not yet available, the model parameterization is based on a combination of manufacturer documentation, derived values and engineering assumptions. The modeling approach focuses on the system-level integration of the main vehicle subsystems rather than on a fully validated representation. The resulting model was assessed through basic driving scenarios with different steering inputs and configurations. The simulations showed stable model behavior and physically plausible interaction between the subsystems. The all-wheel-drive configuration produced symmetric wheel responses in longitudinal driving, while counter-phase rear axle steering increased the yaw response and reduced the simulated turning circle diameter compared with front axle steering only. The circular driving scenario further indicated bounded roll and slip behavior. Overall, the implemented CarMaker model provides a traceable and functional simulation basis for the PixKit vehicle. It can support future model refinement, calibration with real vehicle data and development with the goal of creating a validated digital twin architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文在IPG CarMaker中搭建了PixKit模块化电动试验平台（滑板底盘、四轮毂电机、大转角后轮转向）的初始整车仿真模型，作为未来数字孪生应用的低层基础。
AI.motivation: 为PixKit滑板底盘车辆建立可扩展、基于物理的整车模型，作为未来数字孪生架构的底层基础；由于缺少完整实测数据，需先建立系统级、可追溯的功能性模型。
AI.method: 在IPG CarMaker中构建整车模型，重点在于各子系统（四独立轮毂电机、后轴转向等）的系统级集成而非完全验证；参数化基于厂商文档、推导值与工程假设；通过不同转向输入与配置的基础驾驶场景（直线、圆周行驶等）进行评估。
AI.result: 仿真表现稳定且子系统交互物理合理：全轮驱动在纵向行驶中产生对称车轮响应；后轴反相位转向相较仅前轮转向提高了横摆响应并减小了仿真转弯直径；圆周工况显示有界的侧倾与滑移行为。
AI.conclusion: 所实现的CarMaker模型为PixKit车辆提供了可追溯且可运行的仿真基础，可支撑后续模型细化、基于实车数据的标定，以及构建经验证的数字孪生架构。

title: F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
summary: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. Trained once on only 200 examples and deployed with a growing experience library, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on MolmoSpaces and RoboLab without any training on RoboLab: over native Cosmos 3 Nano, it raises success by 12.0 pp and 10.8 pp, reduces steps to success by 12.2% and 11.3%, and cuts regressions by 57%.

AI.tldr: 提出F$^3$框架，从"存什么、何时用、用在哪"三方面重塑世界-动作模型的经验利用方式，将成功与失败轨迹统一压缩为验证过的操作记录，并学习预测其可用性，仅用200个样本训练即在MolmoSpaces与RoboLab上取得SOTA，成功率分别提升12.0pp与10.8pp，回归失败减少57%。
AI.motivation: 已部署的世界-动作模型（WAM）要持续改进必须善用自身经验。现有方法将检索到的轨迹或示范作为上下文输入策略，但这种经验常使原本已解决的任务重新失败。作者主张经验的价值不取决于源轨迹是否成功，而取决于"存什么、何时用、从何处进入策略"，因此需要重新设计经验的组织、调用与注入机制。
AI.method: F$^3$包含三个组件：Form——将成功与失败轨迹一律压缩为简短、经过验证的操作记录（operation records）；Fit——训练策略阅读记录并预测该记录是否有帮助（可用性预测）；Fusion——以prefix形式注入记录中的图像与文本，并将动作作为action prior注入策略。模型仅在200个样本上训练一次，部署时配合不断增长的经验库。
AI.result: 在MolmoSpaces与RoboLab上取得SOTA，且未在RoboLab上训练。相对原生Cosmos 3 Nano，成功率提升12.0pp与10.8pp，成功所需步数减少12.2%与11.3%，回归（regressions）减少57%。
AI.conclusion: 经验的价值在于"使用"而非"来源成功与否"；通过Form、Fit、Fusion三项设计可显著提升经验利用效率，在极少训练样本下实现跨环境泛化并大幅抑制灾难性回归，为WAM的持续自我改进提供了可行范式。

title: ReSynth: Constructing Synthetic Supervision for Multi-Image Understanding
summary: People often understand the world by comparing different views of it. Vision-language models (VLMs), however, receive these views as separate images and still struggle to relate them. One problem is data. Training on these tasks requires groups of images with a known relationship: the same object from different viewpoints, or the same scene before and after a change. Such examples are hard to collect at scale from existing photo collections. We introduce ReSynth, which turns single-image perception and controllable image generation into cross-image relational supervision. Localized editing produces before-and-after pairs, viewpoint generation produces multiple views of the same instance, and verified scene contents support comparisons of counts and attributes. ReSynth combines Qwen3-VL-8B's captioning, grounding, and counting capabilities with Qwen-Image-2.1's generation and editing capabilities. It verifies single-image facts such as object counts and attributes, then combines these facts to construct multi-image QA. Using GRPO on approximately 440K ReSynth questions, with no real images during training, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B improve by 17.73 and 6.10 average points on BLINK, MUIRBench, and VLM2-Bench, while single-image performance is broadly preserved on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and improves across all four evaluated benchmarks on Qwen3-VL-8B. Notably, this supervision enables the 8B perception model itself to outperform Qwen3-VL-235B on BLINK and MUIRBench.

AI.tldr: ReSynth 将单图感知与可控图像生成转化为跨图像关系监督数据，在无真实图像训练的情况下显著提升 VLM 的多图推理能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在理解世界时需比较不同视角的图像，但现有模型将各视图作为独立图像输入，难以建立跨图像关联。核心瓶颈在于数据：跨图像任务需要具备已知关系的图像组（同一物体多视角、同一场景变化前后），这类样本难以从现有照片库中大规模采集。
AI.method: 提出 ReSynth 数据合成框架：结合 Qwen3-VL-8B 的描述、定位与计数能力，以及 Qwen-Image-2.1 的生成与编辑能力，通过局部编辑生成前后对比对、通过视角生成产生同一实例的多视图、并利用经过验证的场景内容支撑计数与属性比较。流程先验证单图事实（如物体数量、属性），再组合这些事实构建多图问答对；最终在约 440K 条 ReSynth 问题上使用 GRPO 进行强化学习训练。
AI.result: 训练全程不使用真实图像。Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 BLINK、MUIRBench、VLM2-Bench 上平均分别提升 17.73 与 6.10 分；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的单图性能基本保持，Qwen3-VL-8B 在四项评测基准上全面提升。此外，该监督使 8B 感知模型在 BLINK 与 MUIRBench 上超越 Qwen3-VL-235B。
AI.conclusion: 以合成方式构造的跨图像关系监督可有效替代昂贵的真实多图数据，显著增强 VLM 的多图比较与关系推理能力，并可在不损害（甚至提升）单图能力的前提下实现小模型对超大模型的反超。

title: Tell Me How Sure You Are: Communicating Uncertainty in Auxiliary Evidence to Foundation Models
summary:
In many queries, the context information provided to generative foundation models, such as LLMs and VLMs, is inherently uncertain, including its representations of the physical world. While conventional prompting discards the associated uncertainty, this paper, for the first time in the literature, systematically demonstrates that communicating such uncertainty in context provides useful additional cues for downstream decisions and yields improvements across a wide range of settings.
  We formulate the decision-making problem as a zero-shot foundation model-assisted image classification task supported by auxiliary text-based characteristics. We choose this due to the availability of well-defined auxiliary properties, associated uncertainty, and unambiguous task correctness. Using five downstream foundation models across three datasets, we extensively evaluate uncertainty arising from both humans and learned models when observing or predicting auxiliary evidence. Across all settings, we find that communicating uncertainty substantially improves downstream LLM classification performance: macro-F1 improves up to $26.18$ percentage points compared to when the uncertainty information is not communicated.
  We further observe how the foundation models process such uncertainty information and find that auxiliary uncertainty contains predictive information about the correctness of downstream decisions. Together, these results establish uncertainty as useful contextual information and motivate more systematic consideration of uncertainty communication in future foundation-model inference pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该文首次系统证明：将上下文中的不确定性信息显式传达给生成式基础模型（LLM/VLM）可提升下游决策质量，在零样本图像分类任务中macro-F1最多提升26.18个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有提示（prompting）通常丢弃上下文所附带的不确定性（包括对物理世界的表征不确定性），而这类不确定性可能为下游决策提供有用线索，此前文献缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 将决策问题形式化为零样本、基础模型辅助的图像分类任务，辅以文本形式的辅助特征；借助辅助属性的明确定义、其不确定性及任务正确性的可判定性进行受控评估。使用三个数据集、五个下游基础模型，系统评估来自人类与学习模型在观察或预测辅助证据时产生的不确定性，并分析模型如何处理此类不确定性信息。
AI.result: 在所有设置中，传达不确定性均显著改善下游LLM分类性能，macro-F1相比不传达不确定性最高提升26.18个百分点；辅助不确定性本身包含关于下游决策正确性的预测性信息。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性是有用的上下文信息，应在未来基础模型推理流程中被更系统地考虑与传达。

title: Hierarchical Admittance-Impedance Control for Mobile Manipulator Load Transfer
comment: Accepted at the International Symposium on Robotics Research (ISRR 2026); 5 figures
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical admittance-impedance controller that combines an inner Cartesian impedance controller, an outer 6D admittance supervisor, and workspace-aware mobile-base assistance for guided load transfer. The method is motivated by assistive tasks such as airport baggage handling, where a robot should support a payload while a human worker guides its motion through small physical forces. Following an interaction-role interpretation of admittance and impedance, the torque-controlled Franka Research 3 manipulator behaves as a Cartesian impedance at the robot-object interface, providing compliant load support around a commanded equilibrium pose. At the human-facing interaction level, the outer admittance supervisor converts measured human wrench input into smooth Cartesian reference motion. The workspace-aware assistance layer shares the admittance-generated translational motion between the manipulator and a velocity-controlled base when larger motion is required, while front-side load alignment keeps the carried object near the robot's frontal region for safer and more intuitive guidance. The system was implemented in ROS and validated through a suitcase transfer experiment, showing that the robot can support the load while allowing the human to guide the transfer with relatively little effort.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层导纳-阻抗控制器，将内层笛卡尔阻抗控制、外层6D导纳监督器与工作空间感知的移动底座辅助相结合，实现人机协同导引式负载搬运。
AI.motivation: 面向机场行李搬运等辅助任务：机器人需在承载负载的同时，让人类以较小交互力引导其运动。
AI.method: 基于导纳/阻抗的交互角色解读构建三层架构：力矩控制的Franka Research 3机械臂在机器人-物体界面表现为笛卡尔阻抗，围绕指令平衡位姿提供柔顺负载支撑；外层6D导纳监督器将测得的人力六维力旋量输入转换为平滑的笛卡尔参考运动；工作空间感知辅助层在需要大范围移动时，将导纳生成的平移运动分配给机械臂与速度控制移动底座，并通过前侧负载对齐使被搬运物体保持在机器人前方区域。系统在ROS中实现。
AI.result: 通过手提箱搬运实验验证，机器人能够承载负载，并允许人类以较小体力完成导引搬运。
AI.conclusion: 分层导纳-阻抗控制结合移动底座工作空间感知辅助与负载对齐，可有效实现低交互力、更安全直观的人机协同负载搬运。

title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
comment: Technical report. 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
summary: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vibe-Trading：一个 agent 原生的金融交易框架与一体化工作区，通过结果—证据—研究历史—交易权限相连的架构，实现可追溯、可复现、且仅在显式授权下执行的交易智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI agent 多基于相对静态的工作流，难以在环境变化时保持可靠状态。金融交易中价格、新闻、市场条件、持仓与资金持续演化，使该局限影响尤为严重：结果只有与正确的时间、数据快照和执行上下文绑定才有意义。
AI.method: 构建 agent 原生交易框架，统一市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、组合分析、模拟交易（paper trading）、多智能体协作与可选券商执行。核心机制包括：每个结果保留来源、时间范围、配置与产出运行；共享证据接地（evidence grounding）以支持验证；版本化研究记录以支持可复现的继续研究；显式权限门（authority gate）将策略研究与实盘执行分离。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要贡献为架构与系统设计：结果可追溯（保留来源、时间范围、配置、运行记录）、研究可复现并可续接、研究到执行之间有明确的权限边界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为交易智能体提供了可追溯、可复现、且仅在显式授权下执行的实践基础，将状态与证据的一致性作为研究到行动全流程的核心。

title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
summary: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8% on ChestXray14, CheXpert, PadChest, RSNA, and SIIM-ACR, respectively. Relative to the matched global-only controls, the findings and relation objectives yield consistent gains across the evaluated datasets. These results demonstrate the practical value of treating observed and unobserved report concepts differently during medical image--text representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 \model{}，在全局图文对齐基础上引入"观测掩码的发现监督"与"软关系目标"，区分报告中已确认、明确否定与未提及的概念，在3个CT与5个胸片基准上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 常规全局图像—报告对比学习将"已确认发现""明确否定""未提及概念"三种不同证据状态压缩为单一研究级目标，丢失了细粒度监督信息。
AI.method: 对称全局图像—报告对齐 + 观测掩码的发现监督（文本导出的发现原型与局部视觉token对齐，不确定/未提及概念不参与直接发现标签）+ 针对已确认报告概念的软关系目标。
AI.result: CT-RATE、RAD-ChestCT、INSPECT 宏AUROC为73.6%、66.5%、68.8%；ChestXray14、CheXpert、PadChest、RSNA、SIIM-ACR为80.2%、91.4%、78.5%、86.5%、90.8%。相对匹配的纯全局对照，发现与关系目标在各数据集上一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 在医学图像—文本表征学习中区别对待已观测与未观测报告概念具有实际价值。

title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
summary: Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. Predictive performance and training time identify useful operating points and the limits of compression.

AI.tldr: 提出VAFL纵向分析型联邦学习框架，用正则化最小二乘在固定本地表征上拟合分类/回归头，并给出全维等价求解与两种降宽策略。
AI.motivation: 智能服务常依赖不同机构持有的互补信息，但又不允许集中汇聚原始数据，因此需要纵向联邦学习；同时希望在固定本地表征之上高效拟合预测头，降低拟合开销。
AI.method: VAFL框架：通过正则化最小二乘在固定的本地表征上拟合分类与回归头；采用智能体辅助的受保护计算流程支持两方与多方协作；提出全维等价求解，将块因子直接作用于目标矩阵以避免构造完整逆矩阵；并研究两种降宽策略——(1) 本地谱投影加系数提升（压缩预测空间），(2) 全维本地拟合加低秩跨方校正（保留协作子空间之外的局部分量）；并建立其代数性质并分析计算范围。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上验证了两种降宽策略的精度—开销权衡，并显示其与多种冻结骨干网络的兼容性；预测性能与训练时间揭示出可用工作点及压缩的极限。
AI.conclusion: VAFL可在不汇聚原始数据的前提下高效拟合预测头，全维等价求解降低拟合开销，两种降宽策略各有适用范围，需在精度与成本间取舍。

title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.

AI.tldr: HINT-WAM 是首个用于世界动作模型（WAM）的在线自蒸馏框架：利用演示的未来视频作为后见信息，让同一模型教师在其自身采样轨迹上为学生动作专家提供稠密的条件动作分布监督，并采用能量分数进行分布级蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法难以将 WAM 的泛化与数据效率转化为可靠的任务执行：离线监督微调虽在专家轨迹上提供稠密监督，但其流匹配动作专家只在加噪的演示动作上训练，从未见过自身采样器产生的中间状态，且任务适配可能损害预训练能力；在线强化学习虽基于策略自身行为训练，但稀疏任务奖励导致探索与信用分配困难，稠密奖励塑形仍只给出标量评价而非直接的动作目标。
AI.method: 针对每条演示观测，学生通过自身的去噪轨迹生成动作；在该轨迹上的各个状态处，同一模型作为教师，额外以演示的未来视频（后见信息）为条件，输出条件动作分布作为稠密训练目标。学生仅需部署时输入，无需环境奖励或模拟器交互。为将该监督迁移至流匹配动作专家，采用能量分数这一分布级目标，从学生自身样本中匹配教师的动作分布，而非回归其速度场。
AI.result: 提出 HINT-WAM 框架，实现有后见信息下的在线自蒸馏，并以能量分数目标完成分布级蒸馏（摘要未给出具体实验数值）。
AI.conclusion: 上线后训练可借助模型自身的后见条件化作为特权信息，在无需环境奖励与模拟器交互的情况下为流匹配动作专家提供稠密、分布级监督，弥补离线微调与在线强化学习各自的不足。

title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
summary: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. The resulting accounting decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss, separating planning from fixed-role heuristics. Across forty paired routing anchors, five open-weight

AI.tldr: 提出"预算配对反事实审计"评估协议，在固定公开证据与区域绑定的前提下仅扰动剩余预算或任务参数，并用精确续接价值对每条已获取历史记账，从而把期望精度损失分解为逐步采集损失与终端决策损失。
AI.motivation: 高密度文档视觉智能体需在有限观测预算下于候选区域间分配注意力，但现有答案精度指标混淆了三件事：智能体"看哪里"、对剩余读取的适应方式、以及观测停止后如何作答，导致规划能力与固定角色启发式难以区分。
AI.method: 预算配对反事实审计：保持公开证据与区域绑定不变，仅扰动剩余预算或声明的任务参数，构造配对反事实情形；对每个已获取的观测历史赋予精确续接价值（exact continuation value），据此进行归因记账。
AI.result: 通过记账将期望精度损失分解为逐步采集损失（stepwise acquisition loss）与终端决策损失（terminal decision loss）两部分；在四十个配对路由锚点上进行实验，涉及五个开放权重模型（摘要在此处截断，具体数值结论未给出）。
AI.conclusion: 该协议提供了可分解的评价框架，能够将规划行为与固定角色启发式区分开，弥补单一答案精度指标的归因缺陷。

title: Choosing Supervised Post-Processing for Frozen Person Detectors: Information, Object Changes, and Complete Cost
summary: A frozen detector computes hypotheses that can support better final outputs through supervised post-processing. Choosing a readout requires knowing which available information improves detection and what its processing costs. We compare candidate scores, class distributions, geometry, native-set summaries and adapted neighborhood meta classification under common candidate, supervision and operating-point conditions. On 320 held-out CrowdHuman images, adding native-set context to a 97-dimensional readout yields 275 more matches and 96 more unmatched predictions. On a separate 319-image cohort, Full100 matches 6004 objects,versus 5848 for source-selected raw WBF and 6002 for a MetaDetect-style adaptation. Its gain over raw contains 300 added and 144 lost discoveries. After execution-equivalent optimization, Full100 and the meta-statistics readout both take approximately 95 ms per complete warm request on a fixed 64-image workload. Source-frozen transfer gives positive point results on 223 MOT17Det frames from seven sequences, while the main MIAP result shows no improvement. The study supports using sufficiently informative output readouts while retaining optimized meta classification as a competitive option. It also shows why feature dimension and net detection gain alone are unreliable guides to adoption.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了冻结检测器之上的多种后处理读出方案（候选分数、类分布、几何特征、原生集合摘要与自适应邻域元分类），在统一候选、监督与工作点条件下评估其检测增益与计算成本，结论是应采用信息足够丰富的输出读出，同时优化后的元分类仍是具竞争力的选择。
AI.motivation: 冻结检测器的输出需通过有监督后处理才能转化为更好的最终结果，而选择哪种读出（readout）取决于"哪些可用信息能提升检测"以及"其处理成本"，现有工作缺乏在共同条件下的系统性对比。
AI.method: 在统一的候选生成、监督信号与工作点条件下，比较候选分数、类分布、几何特征、原生集合（native-set）摘要，以及自适应的邻域元分类（MetaDetect 式）等方案；在 CrowdHuman 留出图像与 MOT17Det 帧上进行冻结源迁移实验，并做执行等价（execution-equivalent）优化后测量延迟。
AI.result: 在320张留出 CrowdHuman 图像上，向97维读出加入原生集合上下文后多获得275个匹配、96个未匹配预测；在另一319张图像队列上，Full100 匹配6004个目标，优于源端选择的原始 WBF（5848）与 MetaDetect 式自适应（6002），相对原始方案净增300个新发现、丢失144个；执行等价优化后，Full100 与元统计读出在固定64张图像负载下的完整热请求均约95 ms；源冻结迁移在七个序列的223帧 MOT17Det 上点估计为正，而 MIAP 主结果无提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持采用信息足够充分的输出读出，同时保留优化后的元分类作为有竞争力的备选；并表明特征维度与检测净增益本身不足以作为采纳读出的可靠依据。

title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化（LLM-Assisted MFBO），将专家关于低保真模型缺失物理的定性知识经LLM转化为成对判断，并用成对高斯过程构建知识基函数，由高保真数据校准其贡献与符号，在锂电池设计问题上将传统MFBO的regret AUC降低61%。
AI.motivation: MFBO依赖LF-HF残差关系，但HF数据稀缺时难以从数值数据中学到该差异，尤其当LF模型缺失的物理效应依赖于设计变量时。然而专家通常已知缺失何种物理及其影响增大的条件，现有MF模型无法直接利用这类定性知识。
AI.method: 在常规MF模型上增加"知识基"：由专家描述缺失物理，LLM判断两设计间所需带符号残差修正的较大者，成对高斯过程将这些成对判断转化为基函数；HF数据用于校准该基的权重与符号，避免盲目信任知识。并通过独立变化知识质量与LLM选择的控制实验及知识级消融进行验证。
AI.result: 在锂离子电池设计问题上，regret曲线下面积相对传统MFBO降低61%；控制实验表明知识质量而非LLM选择决定搜索是否加速；知识级消融量化了每条知识陈述的贡献。
AI.conclusion: LLM所解释的专家知识可作为数值数据之外的信息源补充MFBO，在HF数据稀缺时有效加速搜索。

title: Planner-Controller Interaction for Ackermann Navigation: A Matched Simulation and Hardware Benchmark
comment: 32 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/HWUD-AIMBeyonD/qcar and https://github.com/HWUD-AIMBeyonD/QCarSim
summary: Global planners and path-tracking controllers are often evaluated independently, although their interaction determines how a vehicle follows a planned path. Whether simulation accurately predicts the performance of specific planner-controller combinations on Ackermann-steered hardware remains uncertain. This study evaluated three geometric controllers (Regulated Pure Pursuit, Stanley, and Vector Pursuit) paired with two global planners (Hybrid A* and NavFn) on a 1/10-scale Quanser QCar and in a matched Gazebo simulation. Both environments used shared custom planning and control algorithms, matched route geometry and goals, ground-truth pose references, and a common evaluation pipeline. Five runs per configuration and environment yielded 60 benchmark runs. Controller rankings for tracking accuracy and command smoothness transferred consistently between environments, with Spearman correlations of 0.77-0.94. However, planner-dependent effects showed substantially weaker agreement. In simulation, planner selection changed the root-mean-square (RMS) angular acceleration of the commanded velocities by no more than 0.030 rad/s^2, whereas Hybrid A* increased it by 0.141-0.843 rad/s^2 on hardware, depending on the controller. These differences coincided with planner-dependent achieved speeds that the simulation's idealised longitudinal response did not reproduce. Mean controller computation times remained below 0.5 ms on the Jetson TX2. The findings demonstrate that agreement in controller rankings does not guarantee accurate prediction of planner-dependent performance for specific controller pairings on hardware, highlighting the importance of physical validation.

AI.tldr: 该文在1/10 Quanser QCar实车与匹配的Gazebo仿真中，用统一规划/控制算法与评估流程对3种几何控制器×2种全局规划器进行60次基准测试；控制器排序可跨环境复现（Spearman 0.77–0.94），但规划器相关效应一致性差，仿真无法复现实车速度响应差异。
AI.motivation: 全局规划器与路径跟踪控制器通常被独立评估，而二者交互才决定车辆实际循迹表现；仿真能否准确预测特定"规划器-控制器"组合在Ackermann转向硬件上的性能尚不确定。
AI.method: 构建实车-仿真匹配实验：三种几何控制器（Regulated Pure Pursuit、Stanley、Vector Pursuit）搭配两种全局规划器（Hybrid A*、NavFn），在1/10 Quanser QCar 与 Gazebo 仿真中进行；两环境共享自定义规划与控制算法、匹配的路径几何与目标点、真值位姿参考及统一评估管线；每配置每环境5次重复，共60次基准运行。
AI.result: 跟踪精度与指令平滑度的控制器排序在两环境间一致传递，Spearman相关系数0.77–0.94；但规划器相关效应一致性显著较弱：仿真中规划器选择对指令角加速度RMS影响≤0.030 rad/s²，而实车中Hybrid A*使其增加0.141–0.843 rad/s²（依控制器而异）；差异伴以规划器相关的实际速度差异，仿真的理想化纵向响应未能复现；Jetson TX2上控制器平均计算时间均低于0.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 控制器排序一致并不保证仿真能准确预测特定规划器-控制器组合在硬件上的规划器相关性能，强调物理验证（实车实验）的必要性。

title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
summary: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. The graph supports joint saving and restoration of rules and world states, while dynamic object binding grounds rule-specified entities in visual instances and uses stored states to constrain generation from their first appearance. We further introduce object attribute state replacement and counterfactual reconstruction training, enabling accurate attribute control and compatible appearance and motion changes while limiting interference with unrelated content. We develop an automated data collection and annotation pipeline using GTA-V and Habitat to construct RuleVerse, a dataset of rule-driven interactions with detailed state and event annotations, including cases where rules take effect before affected objects become visible. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRuler in preserving rule-state consistency across saving and loading and accurately realizing rule outcomes on designated objects and attributes.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldRuler：以可执行 3D 规则图组织规则定义、依赖与物体状态，并将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈闭环连接，实现可定制规则驱动的交互世界生成，并构建 RuleVerse 数据集。
AI.motivation: 规则决定玩家动作如何改变交互世界，不同规则在相似场景与动作空间下产生不同玩法。面向可定制玩法，生成式世界模型必须遵循用户自定义规则而非仅真实世界行为。实现该目标面临两大挑战：规则-状态持久性（跨保存/加载保留规则定义、依赖与世界状态）与规则到视觉的实现（在指定物体和属性上准确呈现规则引发的改变，尤其当受影响物体尚未可见时）。
AI.method: 1) 构建可执行 3D 规则图，统一组织规则定义、依赖关系与物体状态；2) 将规则执行、视频生成与感知反馈组成闭环；3) 该图支持规则与世界状态的联合保存与恢复；4) 动态物体绑定将规则指定实体对齐到视觉实例，并用已存状态在物体首次出现时约束生成；5) 引入物体属性状态替换与反事实重建训练，实现精确属性控制及外观与运动的兼容变化，同时抑制对无关内容的干扰；6) 基于 GTA-V 与 Habitat 搭建自动数据采集与标注流水线，构建 RuleVerse 数据集，含详细状态与事件标注，包括规则在受影响物体可见前即生效的情形。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 WorldRuler 在保存/加载前后保持规则-状态一致性方面有效，并能准确实现规则在指定物体与属性上的结果。
AI.conclusion: WorldRuler 通过规则图与闭环框架解决规则-状态持久性与规则到视觉实现两大难题，配合 RuleVerse 数据集验证了其在可定制规则驱动交互世界生成中的有效性，为遵循用户自定义规则的生成式世界模型提供了可行方案。

title: Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: FreeForward4D 用预训练视觉模型提供的相机、深度与目标轨迹先验，经度量尺度校准与跨窗配准统一到单一度量坐标系，实现仅依赖 RGB 视频的前馈 4D 重建，在 Waymo 上取得 27.66 dB PSNR 与 0.836 SSIM。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 4D 重建方法依赖数据集提供的相机参数、LiDAR 深度或 3D 框标注，难以用于无标注驾驶视频；而预训练视觉模型的预测彼此几何不一致（多视图预测为短窗口、尺度与坐标系各自独立，单目深度仅逐图度量），无法直接使用。
AI.method: 核心思路是将不一致先验统一到单一度量坐标系：以单目度量深度校准相互重叠的预测窗口，并将其跨时间配准到同一坐标系；在该几何上把 2D 轨迹跨相机在 3D 空间关联，目标运动采用分层建模——共享目标速度加局部高斯修正；训练与推理均只需 RGB 视频。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 上达到 27.66 dB PSNR、0.836 SSIM，且无需尺度对齐即可恢复度量尺度的相机与深度；全图 PSNR 超过依赖数据集标注的 STORM、SLARM-F、UFO、DGGT、StreetForward，在 8 秒窗口上取得最佳 RGB 保真度；经 RGB-only 微调可迁移至 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉先验在统一到单一度量坐标系后足以替代数据集标注，支撑纯 RGB 前馈 4D 驾驶场景重建，并具备跨数据集的良好可迁移性。

title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
summary: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place. Every unit of the circuit is a 0/1 predicate on tokens, and every map between predicates is a minimised truth table. Short tables, such as the product of a query code and a key code, are minimised exactly, and wide feature-to-feature transitions become implication rules by noise-tolerant minimisation. Blocks are replaced one at a time from the output down, in the manner of the Ship of Theseus, and after each replacement the remaining soft part re-adapts to the frozen circuit. Attention selection takes two forms, a row-wise comparison of integer scores (order selection) and a learned rule (rule selection). Both are fitted on the ordinary training set alone, and only on the examples that the teacher classifies correctly, so that the circuit imitates the teacher where the teacher is right. On TweetEval-emotion, the complete circuit of DistilGPT2 reaches a test gold accuracy of 66.5 $\pm$ 1.3% with order selection and 57.4 $\pm$ 2.5% with rule selection over three seeds, against 74.7% for the teacher and 64.0% for a bag of word pieces fitted on the same tweets, and that of BERT-base reaches 70.0 $\pm$ 0.5% with order selection and 63.7 $\pm$ 1.2% with rule selection against 77.8%. The circuit needs no multiplier and no weight traffic, and its exported hardware description reproduces it bit for bit. By a synthesis-based estimate it classifies one tweet in about 1-2 $μ$s (DistilGPT2) and 3-5 $μ$s (BERT) on an FPGA card and in 5-9 $μ$s on a palm-sized board whose module draws 7.5-15 W, two to three orders of magnitude faster than the network on a GPU at batch 1 (measured, 0.9-2.6 ms for DistilGPT2 including an optimised CUDA-graph baseline), at a cost of 8.5 (DistilGPT2) and 8.6 (BERT) points of gold accuracy for the synthesised seed-0 circuits.

AI.tldr: 该文将训练好的注意力网络（含注意力）整体转换为可在硬件上逐比特复现的硬逻辑谓词电路，通过“忒修斯之船”式的自输出向下逐块替换与剩余软部分再适配，在TweetEval-emotion上以牺牲约8.5–8.6个点金标准准确率换取无乘法器、无权重搬运的FPGA实现，推理速度较GPU（batch 1）快2–3个数量级。
AI.motivation: 注意力网络推理依赖乘法器与权重访存，难以在低功耗边缘硬件上高效部署；作者希望把整个网络（包括注意力选择机制）编译成纯0/1逻辑谓词电路，从而摆脱乘法与权重流量，获得可综合、可逐比特复现的高速硬件实现。
AI.method: 将电路每个单元定义为token上的0/1谓词、每个谓词间映射定义为最小化真值表：窄表（如query码与key码之积）精确最小化，宽的特征到特征转移用容噪最小化转为蕴含规则；按忒修斯之船方式从输出端向输入端逐块替换，每次替换后剩余软部分对冻结电路再适配；注意力选择采用逐行整数分数比较（order selection）与学习规则（rule selection）两种形式，仅用普通训练集且仅用教师分类正确的样本拟合；导出硬件描述由综合估计性能。
AI.result: TweetEval-emotion上，DistilGPT2完整电路在三个随机种子下order selection达66.5±1.3%、rule selection达57.4±2.5%（教师74.7%，同数据词片袋模型64.0%）；BERT-base为70.0±0.5%与63.7±1.2%（教师77.8%）。电路无需乘法器与权重流量，导出硬件描述可逐比特复现。综合估计：FPGA卡上单条推文约1–2 μs（DistilGPT2）与3–5 μs（BERT），掌心大小板卡（模块功耗7.5–15 W）上5–9 μs，比GPU batch 1（实测0.9–2.6 ms，含优化CUDA-graph基线）快2–3个数量级，代价是种子0综合电路损失8.5（DistilGPT2）与8.6（BERT）个点金标准准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力网络整体编译为硬逻辑谓词电路在技术上是可行的：可获得无乘法器、无权重搬运、可逐比特复现且速度提升2–3个数量级的低功耗硬件实现，但代价是显著的准确率下降（约8–9个点）；order selection明显优于rule selection，且相对词片袋模型仍具优势（DistilGPT2）。电路仅在教师正确样本上模仿教师，性能上限受教师正确性约束。

title: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
summary: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.

AI.tldr: RoboMorpher：形态条件化的动作分词器，联合重建关节角与连杆位姿，配合MorphGen生成运动学监督，预训练后冻结接入VLA策略，并引入EmbodiBench基准，跨本体泛化显著优于连续关节空间控制。
AI.motivation: 跨本体操作依赖共享动作表示，但相同关节值在不同机器人上对应不同空间构型，仅从关节值学习的表示存在歧义，缺少与运动学效果关联的几何监督。
AI.method: 提出RoboMorpher，一种形态条件化动作分词器，同时重建关节角与连杆位姿，将控制坐标与其运动学效应关联；MorphGen基于调研所得几何先验生成串联臂描述，提供可扩展的运动学监督；在4000万形态-状态对上预训练，冻结后集成进视觉-语言-动作策略，实现离散预测加连续细化；另构建EmbodiBench（每任务30个生成URDF，共10个任务）。
AI.result: 在下游URDF未参与分词器预训练条件下，策略在RoboTwin 2.0达56.40%成功率，EmbodiBench达23.27%，分别较连续关节空间控制高9.73和15.34个百分点；去除连杆位姿监督使EmbodiBench成功率下降17.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 形态感知的几何（连杆位姿）监督对关节动作表示学习有实质贡献，联合重建关节角与连杆位姿可有效提升跨本体操作的表示可迁移性与策略性能。

title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. However, existing work focuses mainly on what the agent can achieve with cloud-hosted models. What a local deployment costs in power, energy, tokens and time on real simulation tasks, and what its choices trade against one another, has received little quantitative investigation under comparable conditions. To address this gap, a systematic evaluation framework is presented in this paper. It applies locally served models to agentic power electronics tasks, from the converter level to the system level, and measures their power, energy, token and time costs. Based on these measurements, the capability boundary of a local agent on such tasks and the cost per solved task are characterized. The results are expected to provide practical insight for the use of agentic AI in power electronics and the power systems it serves.

AI.tldr: 提出面向本地部署智能体AI在电力电子仿真闭环中的系统评估框架，在变压器级到系统级任务上测量功率、能耗、Token与时间成本，刻画本地智能体的能力边界与单任务成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI正进入电力电子领域，用于自动化原本依赖人工的"建模—仿真—测量—修订"设计闭环。出于数据与出口管制敏感、仿真器本地授权等原因，部分机构只能选择本地部署（云端API不可用）。此时智能体成为本地设备上的电负载，每次运行都消耗功率、能量、Token与时间。但现有工作多关注云端托管模型能达成什么，本地部署在真实仿真任务上的功率/能量/Token/时间成本及其取舍关系缺乏可比条件下的定量研究。
AI.method: 构建系统性评估框架：将本地部署（本地推理设备/本地服务模型）的智能体应用于电力电子智能体任务，任务覆盖变换器级到系统级（含所接入网络的仿真研究）；在统一可比条件下记录并量化其功率、能耗、Token消耗与运行时间等成本指标。
AI.result: 基于上述测量，刻画本地智能体在此类任务上的能力边界，并给出"每解决一个任务"的成本（cost per solved task），以及各类成本/性能之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 预期结果为电力电子及其所服务电力系统中应用智能体AI提供实用参考，尤其在必须本地化部署的场景下，帮助衡量能力与功耗、能耗、时间成本之间的取舍。

title: HHW-Ego: DSLR-Quality Enhancement for Multi-Source Wearable Ego Imaging
summary: Wearable ego-centric images are now in high demand for scenarios ranging from daily smart glass usage to embodied intelligence. But the image quality is far behind smart phone due to the lacking paired high-quality reference images and the dedicated enhancement systems. To solve this, a customized degradation pipeline is designed to generate paired samples matching wearable camera images, boosting the upper limit of enhancement performance. Besides a two-stage enhancement framework is further built: first, tuning an efficient model on the paired dataset to enhance real wearable images; second, using hyperspectral data to refine color temperature for better quality. Moreover we present HHW-Ego, a multi-source paired dataset integrating with Hyperspectral, High-dynamic range and Wearable Ego-centric data, which includes 5,000 image groups spanning indoor/outdoor and day/night scenes. On held-out paired data, Stage-1 fine-tuning improves PSNR, SSIM, Lab distance, and LPIPS for Real-ESRGAN and PFT-SR. On real wearable images, no-reference metrics, human preference, gamut analysis, and visual comparisons characterize the effects of Stage 2.

AI.tldr: 针对可穿戴自我中心图像质量远逊于手机的问题（缺配对高质量参考与专用增强系统），本文设计了匹配可穿戴相机的定制退化流程以生成配对样本，构建两阶段增强框架（先在有监督配对数据上微调高效模型增强真实图像，再用高光谱数据精修色温），并发布多源配对数据集 HHW-Ego（融合高光谱、HDR 与可穿戴自我中心数据，含 5,000 组室内外/昼夜图像）。实验表明 Stage-1 微调提升 Real-ESRGAN 与 PFT-SR 的 PSNR、SSIM、Lab 距离与 LPIPS；在真实图像上以无参考指标、主观偏好、色域分析与视觉对比验证 Stage-2 效果。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴自我中心（ego-centric）图像需求旺盛（智能眼镜、具身智能等），但成像质量远不及手机。核心瓶颈是缺少配对的高质量参考图像，也缺乏针对性的增强系统，导致有监督增强方法难以直接应用。
AI.method: 1) 设计定制化退化流水线，模拟可穿戴相机的成像退化以生成配对训练样本，提升增强性能上限；2) 构建两阶段增强框架：Stage-1 在配对数据上微调高效增强模型处理真实可穿戴图像，Stage-2 借助高光谱数据精修色温以进一步提升画质；3) 构建 HHW-Ego 多源配对数据集，融合高光谱、HDR 与可穿戴自我中心数据，覆盖室内外与昼夜场景，共 5,000 组图像。
AI.result: 在留出配对数据上，Stage-1 微调使 Real-ESRGAN 与 PFT-SR 的 PSNR、SSIM、Lab 距离和 LPIPS 均有改善；在真实可穿戴图像上，通过无参考指标、人眼偏好评测、色域分析及视觉对比刻画了 Stage-2 的增益效果。
AI.conclusion: 定制退化建模与配对数据是突破可穿戴图像增强上限的关键，两阶段框架（有监督微调+高光谱色温精修）可有效提升真实可穿戴图像质量，HHW-Ego 数据集为该方向提供了多源配对基准。

title: Temporal Rank in Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are a natural framework for temporal modelling, yet are often dismissed due to their sequential, non-parallelisable computation and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies, typically attributed to vanishing and exploding gradients. We identify a distinct and under-explored limitation: an information bottleneck induced by rank-constrained hidden state dynamics, which limits the number of independent input directions that can be preserved over time, as reflected in the rank of the input-to-state mapping. We show that this constraint restricts temporal capacity independently of gradient stability. To address this, we introduce structured high-dimensional state dynamics that preserve temporal separability and prevent saturation of the input-to-state Jacobian over time. On controlled sequence tasks, the resulting model exhibits rapid learning despite remaining strictly within a standard RNN formulation. Our results demonstrate that RNN performance is governed by the evolution and preservation of temporal rank, and suggest that mitigating gradient pathologies alone is insufficient without explicitly maintaining temporal capacity.

AI.tldr: 该文指出RNN除梯度消失/爆炸外还存在"秩约束隐状态动力学导致的信息瓶颈"，并提出结构化高维状态动力学以保持时间可分离性，在标准RNN框架内实现快速学习。
AI.motivation: RNN因顺序计算不可并行、长程依赖难捕获（通常归因于梯度消失/爆炸）而被轻视。作者认为存在一个被忽视的独立限制：隐状态动力学秩受限造成的信息瓶颈，它限制了输入-状态映射中可随时间保留的独立输入方向数。
AI.method: 从输入-状态映射的秩（temporal rank）角度形式化分析RNN的时间容量，证明该约束独立于梯度稳定性；进而设计结构化高维状态动力学，保持时间可分离性并防止输入-状态雅可比随时间饱和，模型仍严格属于标准RNN形式。
AI.result: 在受控序列任务上，所得模型展现出快速学习能力，且未偏离标准RNN表述，说明缓解梯度病理本身不足以提升性能。
AI.conclusion: RNN性能由时间秩的演化与保持所支配；若不显式维持时间容量，仅消除梯度病态是不够的。该工作为RNN能力分析提供了秩视角的新框架。

title: DiWALI: Diffusion Policy Learning in World Models via Latent Action Inference from Human and Robot Play
summary: Learning robot manipulation is constrained by the availability of action-labeled robot data, for both imitation and world models. Humans can demonstrate skills in seconds, but their demonstrations lack the required robot actions. We introduce DiWALI, a framework that learns and improves diffusion policies within a world model trained on human and robot play. DiWALI infers latent actions from consecutive frames using an inverse dynamics model, enabling world model training without action labels, and grounds them in robot commands through a decoder trained separately on robot play. Skill policies are trained over latent actions from action-free human demonstrations and improved with reinforcement learning in imagination. On the CALVIN benchmark, DiWALI policies trained solely from human demonstrations substantially outperform baselines trained with robot demonstrations. Incorporating human play into the world model training also yields stronger policies after fine-tuning than using the same amount of robot play alone. Experiments on a physical robot show that skills learned primarily from human demonstrations are further improved in imagination with a world model trained on human and robot play. Together, these results demonstrate that human experience can support both manipulation skill acquisition and subsequent policy improvement, reducing reliance on action-labeled robot data. Videos, dataset and code are available at https://diwali.cs.uni-freiburg.de.

AI.tldr: DiWALI 框架利用无动作标签的人类演示，通过逆动力学模型推断潜在动作来训练世界模型，并在其中学习与改进扩散策略，从而减少对带动作标签机器人数据的依赖。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作学习受限于带动作标签的机器人数据稀缺（模仿学习与世界模型均需动作标签），而人类演示虽高效却缺乏机器人动作标注。因此需要一种能同时利用无动作人类演示与少量机器人数据的框架。
AI.method: 提出 DiWALI：(1) 用逆动力学模型从连续帧推断潜在动作，使世界模型可在无动作标签下训练；(2) 用单独在机器人 play 数据上训练的解码器将潜在动作映射为机器人指令；(3) 在潜在动作空间上基于无动作人类演示训练扩散策略，并在想象（imagination）中通过强化学习改进。
AI.result: 在 CALVIN 基准上，仅用人类演示训练的 DiWALI 策略显著优于用机器人演示训练的基线；在世界模型训练中加入人类 play 后，微调所得策略优于使用等量机器人 play；物理机器人实验表明，主要从人类演示学到的技能可在由人类与机器人 play 训练的世界模型中通过想象进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 人类经验既能支撑操作技能获取，也能支撑后续策略改进，从而降低对带动作标签机器人数据的依赖。

title: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
comment: Accepted at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS), Edinburgh, United Kingdom, October 6-9, 2026. Awarded one of 2026 Ada Lovelace Awardees for Excellent Paper Submissions to ACS
summary: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer's behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model's self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"评审者价值"的特质理论，主张人类评审者的边际价值由元认知校准（行为自信与实际正确性的一致性）决定，并用AI辅助会计系统六个月的541,621条评审事件验证：纯行为专家画像会倒置真实水平，而校准逻辑可将92.5%的人力集中于真实错误。
AI.motivation: 在"强模型+人"协同决策中，人类评审者究竟贡献什么价值尚不清晰；现有衡量往往依赖活跃度、速度、一致率或资历等代理指标，作者认为这些都不是价值的真正来源，需要将问题精确化为单一认知特质——元认知校准。
AI.method: 构建五条主张的"评审者价值特质理论"：(1)价值由校准度而非活跃度、速度、一致性或任期决定；(2)校准在行为遥测中留下可观测痕迹；(3)这些痕迹本身不具诊断性，需结果门控才能区分"校准专家"与"自信新手"；(4)人类校准与模型自我知识属同一构念，系统应在每个条目上服从更校准的一方；(5)个体校准只能在单次判断之上被因果识别。在六个月生产窗口的AI辅助会计系统中实证检验（541,621条事件、483名评审者）。
AI.result: 纯行为专家画像会颠倒真实情况：过度自信组的修正存活率为5.2%，却被评为高于真实专家（99.2%）；评审者质量在职级/任期内基本平坦，说明该特质并非在岗习得；将同一校准逻辑应用于模型后，92.5%的人力被集中到真实错误上。
AI.conclusion: 人类评审者的价值核心是元认知校准，而非活动量或资历；校准可作为人机共同指标用于逐项路由。但理论须承认边界：在多数投票聚合下，个体因果价值不可识别。

title: FlyVQA: Seeing Video Frame Interpolation Quality through Fly Eyes
summary: The ultimate ambition of visual quality assessment is to reproduce the neural computations of human vision and thereby achieve full alignment with human perception. However, the immense complexity of human visual circuitry makes this goal difficult to realize. Recently released fly visual connectomes provide a tractable biological starting point. Despite differences between fly and human vision, the fly's well-characterized motion pathways motivate us to investigate their potential for assessing the perceptual impact of temporal distortions. In this paper, we use a shared, frozen fly visual circuit to perform full-reference quality assessment of frame-interpolated videos, whose artifacts can disrupt temporal consistency. Specifically, compound-eye sampling maps reference and distorted sequences into the circuit, while a connectome-aware readout quantifies discrepancies in cell-type-specific activity and excitatory--inhibitory synaptic dynamics. Reference-guided temporal pooling and a lightweight regression head integrate these differences into a quality score. Experiments across multiple interpolation methods demonstrate better agreement with human ratings than CNN, RNN, and Transformer baselines with comparable parameters, supporting a biologically grounded approach to perceptual quality modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种生物启发的视频质量评估方法：利用共享冻结的果蝇视觉连接组电路，评估帧插值视频的时间失真，在多种插值方法上与人主观评分的吻合度优于参数量相当的CNN、RNN与Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉质量评估的终极目标是复现人类视觉的神经计算并与人类感知完全对齐，但人脑视觉回路的复杂度使该目标难以实现。果蝇视觉连接组的发布提供了一个可处理的生物学起点；尽管果蝇与人类视觉存在差异，其刻画充分的时间（运动）通路促使作者探究其在评估时间失真感知影响方面的潜力。
AI.method: 采用共享、冻结的果蝇视觉电路做全参考质量评估，输入为帧插值视频。具体地：以复眼采样（compound-eye sampling）将参考序列与失真序列映射进电路；使用连接组感知读出（connectome-aware readout）量化细胞类型特异性活动及兴奋—抑制突触动力学上的差异；再通过参考引导的时间池化与轻量回归头将这些差异整合为质量分数。
AI.result: 在多种插值方法上的实验表明，该方法与人类评分的吻合度优于参数量相当的CNN、RNN和Transformer基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用基于生物学的途径进行感知质量建模，即以果蝇视觉连接组电路为骨干评估时间失真视频质量是可行且有效的。

title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
summary: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve production-scale training and inference performance, but identifying effective optimization strategies and consistently translating local improvements into end-to-end gains remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RSIBench-Infra 基准，包含 20 个训练与推理任务（最高 32 卡，覆盖 NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU），允许智能体从官方可运行基线出发跨引擎、算子与指令层修改软件栈，并通过 OCI 镜像层提交协议与独立评测在质量约束下测量端到端性能。结果显示 66.2% 的任务达到经校验的 >1.10× 加速。
AI.motivation: 现有面向智能体驱动的优化基准多聚焦于单一软件层（如 kernel），无法判断智能体能否在生产级负载下带来端到端性能收益；因此需要端到端评测来检验"递归自我改进"中训练/推理基础设施效率这一实际环节。
AI.method: 构建 RSIBench-Infra：20 个覆盖多模型族与多模态的训练/推理任务，部署规模最高 32 个加速器（NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU）；智能体从基于官方配方得到的可运行基线出发，可跨 engine、kernel、instruction 三个层级修改软件栈；采用 OCI image-layer 提交协议记录改动以保证可复现部署；由独立评测在任务特定质量约束下测量端到端性能。
AI.result: 全部任务结果中 66.2% 取得经校验的超过 1.10× 加速。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体已能在生产规模下提升训练与推理性能，但识别有效优化策略、并将局部改进稳定转化为端到端收益仍具挑战。

title: Communications-free Collective Intelligence Via Allocentric Belief
summary: A team of skilled card players share no information amongst each other, and yet still are able to coordinate their play by watching the same players and reading the same tells. Autonomous systems have failed to exploit this logic, relying instead on explicit communication or complex state estimation schemes that can fail when it matters most. Without it, decentralized agents diverge in their world beliefs, and coordination collapses. Here we show that anchoring all agents to a single shared external actor, a common witness whose reactions encode team state, produces spontaneous, communication-free coordination. An allocentric belief network trained on witness behavior allows each agent to independently reconstruct full team state, keeping group beliefs consistent with no inter-agent exchange. Across five competitive environments allocentric belief alignment outperforms egocentric approaches in collective performance, and even scales to sixty-agent teams where standard methods fail. These results establish a new principle for collective intelligence: in the absence of communication, a shared gaze replaces a shared channel.

AI.tldr: 提出"共同见证者"（common witness）机制：所有智能体锚定同一外部行动者的反应来编码团队状态，通过"异我中心信念网络"（allocentric belief network）使各智能体独立重建完整团队状态，实现无通信的分布式协调。
AI.motivation: 人类高手（如牌手）无需显式交流，仅通过观察同一对象与共同线索即可协调行动；而现有多智能体系统依赖显式通信或复杂状态估计，通信受限或失效时易导致信念发散、协调崩溃，缺乏这种隐式协调逻辑。
AI.method: 引入单一共享外部行动者作为"共同见证者"，其反应隐式编码团队状态；训练一个以见证者行为为输入的异我中心信念网络，使每个智能体在无智能体间信息交换的情况下独立重建全队状态，从而保持群体信念一致（异我中心信念对齐）。
AI.result: 在五个竞争性环境中，异我中心信念对齐在集体性能上优于自我中心方法，并可扩展至60个智能体的团队，而标准方法在此规模下失效。
AI.conclusion: 在缺乏通信时，"共同注视"可替代"共同信道"，即通过共享外部参照实现去中心化多智能体协调，为集体智能提供了一条新原理。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Targets in Radiology Language-Image Pretraining
summary: CLIP-style contrastive image-text pretraining is widely used in radiology data, where each image is paired with one report and every other report in the batch is treated as a negative. Under this recipe, two failures appear, neither of which is systematically addressed by existing contrastive learning theory: zero-shot evaluation peaks then degrades while training loss keeps decreasing, and training fails to learn from large batches. We hypothesize the cause is structural rather than radiology-specific: many unpaired reports share clinical findings with a given image, so CLIP's paired-identity target is systematically biased, not merely noisy. To test this, we construct CLEVR-Radiology, a synthetic testbed that preserves only this overlapping-fact structure and reproduces both failures. With evidence that the structure is sufficient to reproduce the failures, we develop a target-misspecification theory that explains both failures from a single deterministic gradient bias amplified by batch size, and use it to motivate a minimal compatibility-based correction, CorLIP: text is treated as positive whenever its clinical assertions agree with the image, with no architecture changes. Beyond benchmark improvements, CorLIP largely removes the post-peak degradation, makes large-batch training succeed where it previously collapsed, substantially amplifies the gains from more data, and is the only configuration that remains stable up to B=2048. The correction transfers from chest X-ray to 3D CT modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出目标错配理论解释CLIP式放射图文预训练中"零样本性能先升后降"与大batch训练失效两大问题，并提出无需改架构的兼容性校正方法CorLIP。
AI.motivation: CLIP式对比预训练在放射学数据中把batch内其他报告一律当作负样本，但许多未配对报告与图像共享临床发现，导致配对身份目标系统性有偏（而非仅噪声）。现有对比学习理论未系统解释两个现象：零样本性能峰值后随训练损失下降而退化；大batch训练反而学不到东西。
AI.method: 假设该失败源于结构性（非放射特异）原因；构建合成测试平台CLEVR-Radiology，仅保留"重叠事实"结构以验证其足以复现两种失败；据此建立目标错配理论，用单一确定性梯度偏置及其随batch size放大来解释两者；提出最小化校正CorLIP——只要文本的临床断言与图像一致即视为正样本，不改动模型架构。
AI.result: 在基准上取得提升；基本消除峰值后退化；使原本崩溃的大batch训练成功；显著放大数据量增加带来的收益；是唯一在B=2048时仍保持稳定的配置；校正方法可从胸部X光迁移至3D CT模态。
AI.conclusion: CLIP对比目标的配对身份假设在放射学中系统性错配，是两大失败的共同根源；基于临床断言一致性的正样本判定是简洁有效的通用校正，具跨模态迁移性。

title: MINT: Meeting-time Indicators for Truncation in Multi-Step Off-Policy RL
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 81 pages, 40 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/seungyubhan/mint
summary: Many multi-step off-policy temporal-difference methods handle policy mismatch through products of per-step trace coefficients, leading to a trade-off between variance control and long-horizon signal. The maximum trace length consequently becomes a sensitive hyperparameter. We propose MINT (Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation), which replaces these products with a binary stopping indicator: one until coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, zero thereafter. At the true value function, the indicator's idempotence yields a variance bound governed by meeting-time survival. For practical implementation, a single sampled action provides a model-free surrogate for the stopping rule, requiring no transition model or mixing-time estimate. We derive separate sufficient conditions for contraction of the state-coupled operator and its practical surrogate under fixed-policy evaluation. On MuJoCo and DeepMind Control tasks, MINT outperforms the reported multi-step baselines; the main MuJoCo comparison uses a common cap without per-task cap-length tuning. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of MINT on Atari 100k, RWRL, and OGBench experiments; MINT adapts the backup horizon to reduce target variability relative to long fixed-horizon backups across tasks and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MINT（Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation），用二元停止指示器替代多步 off-policy TD 中逐步迹系数的乘积，使截断长度自适应于行为轨迹与目标轨迹的首次"相遇时刻"，从而在控制方差的同时保留长视野信号，并在多类基准上优于多步基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多步 off-policy 时序差分方法通过逐步迹系数（trace coefficients）的连乘处理策略不匹配问题，导致方差控制与长视野信号之间存在权衡；最大迹长度（截断长度）因此成为敏感的、需逐任务调参的超参数。
AI.method: 提出 MINT：以二元停止指示器取代迹系数乘积——在耦合的行为轨迹与目标轨迹首次相遇之前取 1，之后取 0。理论上，在真实值函数处，指示器的幂等性（idempotence）给出由"相遇时间生存概率"控制的方差界；实现上，用单个采样动作构成无模型的停止规则代理，无需转移模型或混合时间估计。作者分别给出了固定策略评估下状态耦合算子及其实际代理算子的收缩性充分条件。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 与 DeepMind Control 任务上，MINT 优于所报告的多步基线，且主要 MuJoCo 对比使用统一截断上限、未做逐任务长度调参；在 Atari 100k、RWRL 与 OGBench 上亦验证有效。跨任务与动力学条件，MINT 自适应调整 backup 视野，相对长固定视野 backup 降低了目标方差。
AI.conclusion: 以"相遇时刻"为准则的二元截断机制可在无需额外模型与调参的前提下自动确定有效多步视野，兼顾低方差与长视野信号，是一种通用且实用的多步 off-policy TD 截断方案。

title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
summary: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入"智能体相对动态目标"表示，使策略可在仿真中可控地生成如紧贴尾随、对抗性加塞等复杂交互行为，用于自动驾驶长尾场景测试。
AI.motivation: 大规模多智能体自博弈能在仿真中训练鲁棒的驾驶策略，但如何控制模型生成特定的安全关键边缘场景仍是难题。现有目标条件自博弈框架主要依赖静态地图位置目标，无法可靠产生激进的尾随、对抗性加塞等复杂智能体交互，而这些交互对于严格的自动驾驶测试是必要的。
AI.method: 提出一种扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入智能体相对（agent-relative）的动态目标表示；将策略条件化于该扩展的目标表示，从而实现对场景合成的定向、可控生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够成功生成静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为自动驾驶测试中的长尾场景生成提供了灵活工具。
AI.conclusion: 智能体相对动态目标条件化是提升自博弈场景生成可控性与交互复杂度的有效途径，可支撑面向安全关键场景的自动驾驶测试。

title: Semi-Supervised GAN-Based Segmentation of CTPA Scans for Pulmonary Emboli Boundary Extraction
comment: 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a pulmonary vascular disease associated with high morbidity and mortality, where delayed diagnosis can be fatal. While computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the clinical gold standard for PE detection, interpreting these scans manually is time-consuming and error-prone. In this work, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation method, employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to leverage large pools of unlabeled CTPA scans. The proposed method addresses more effectively the challenges of CTPA image segmentation than previous methods by employing the dice loss and the cross-entropy loss to tackle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA scans, the feature matching loss to encourage the generator to produce anatomically plausible segmentation maps that are indistinguishable from ground truth, as well as the self-training loss to reinforce learning from highly-confident pseudo-labeled samples. The experimental evaluation on a publicly available dataset shows that the proposed method maintains accurate segmentation, despite a limited number of labeled CTPA scans. with a Dice coefficient of 88.75% and a 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of 1.74, outperforming fully supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于生成对抗网络（GAN）的半监督分割方法，利用大量无标注CTPA扫描检测肺栓塞，在有限标注数据下Dice达88.75%、HD95为1.74，优于全监督基线。
AI.motivation: 肺栓塞（PE）发病率与死亡率高，延迟诊断可致命；CTPA是临床金标准，但人工判读耗时且易出错。同时，高质量标注的CTPA数据稀缺，而图像本身存在高度类别不平衡，因此需要能在少量标注下有效利用大量无标注扫描的分割方法。
AI.method: 采用半监督分割框架，以GAN机制利用大规模无标注CTPA数据。损失设计包括：Dice损失与交叉熵损失应对CTPA高度不平衡；特征匹配损失（feature matching loss）促使生成器输出与真实标注难以区分的、解剖上合理的分割图；自训练损失（self-training loss）强化对高置信度伪标注样本的学习。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上评估，即使在标注CTPA扫描数量有限的情况下仍保持准确分割，Dice系数88.75%，95百分位Hausdorff距离（HD95）为1.74，优于全监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合Dice/交叉熵、特征匹配与自训练损失的GAN半监督方案，能有效缓解标注稀缺与类别不平衡问题，在CTPA肺栓塞分割上超越全监督基线，具备临床应用潜力。

title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
