summary: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"视频/运动扩散模型隐知识（know more than they show）"结论：在运动扩散模型中对各层激活与模型自身干净样本估计进行统一口径的读出比较，发现除跳跃下落率外，"隐藏物理知识"大多消失。
AI.motivation: 已有研究称视频扩散模型的激活比输入/输出更能解码物理属性，但扩散模型正是由相同激活计算干净样本估计，因此该比较只反映读出（readout）提取信息的难易度，而非模型是否真的"隐藏"了信息。作者希望在物理量可精确计算的运动扩散模型中严格检验"隐藏物理知识"是否存在。
AI.method: 选取运动学文本到运动扩散模型（MDM 两个 checkpoint 与 MotionDiffuse），沿采样轨迹记录每一层激活，并精确计算每个中间估计的物理量。以常规基线对照，再对读出进行统一调参（同等 tuned 读出），并设正对照验证可检测的效应量。
AI.result: 未调参读出下，各层在平衡（balance）与飞行（flight）上看似"领先"模型自身估计；统一调参后该差距消失，加入一层最多提升 0.01，且正对照证明该量级可被检出。唯一明显例外是跳跃下落率：去噪早期 MDM 层比估计多约 0.08 的 R²（重拟合后可达 0.11），随采样推进衰减；MotionDiffuse 上效应小且不稳健。估计本身可零样本标记悬浮（floating）样本，但中止这些样本仅节省不到十分之一算力。此外，Wan 2.1 干净 latent 中线性探针读不到的可信度，经过一个固定非线性层后变得可读。
AI.conclusion: "模型知道的比展示的多"在很大程度上是读出能力的度量假象；运动扩散模型中的隐藏物理知识证据薄弱，仅在去噪早期的跳跃下落率上稳健存在。该结论提示需用统一调参读出与正对照来评估此类主张，且对视频模型需考虑非线性读出。

title: Teleoperated Haircutting with Delay Compensation and Passivity-Based Control for Unilateral Internet Teleoperation under Real Communication Uncertainties
summary: Robotic haircutting requires accurate motion execution and reliable communication to safely reproduce the operator's commands. Internet-based teleoperation is a key enabling technology to remotely perform precise manipulation tasks such as haircutting. However, communication uncertainties, including variable transmission delays and packet jitter, degrade synchronization between the master and slave systems and affect tracking performance. This paper presents a unilateral Internet teleoperation framework for robotic haircutting that takes into account experimentally measured communication uncertainties. Three delay-compensation techniques, namely Zero-Order Hold (ZOH), First-Order Hold (FOH), and Low-Pass Filtering (LPF), are evaluated together with a classical proportional-derivative (PD) controller and a passivity-based synchronization controller. Unlike conventional studies based on synthetic delay models, the proposed framework is validated using communication data acquired from a real cloud-based teleoperation platform, where both packet delay and effective delay are characterized. The results demonstrate that combining delay-compensation techniques with passivity-based synchronization improves the robustness of unilateral Internet teleoperation under realistic communication uncertainties, providing a reliable control framework for robotic haircutting applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向机器人理发的单向互联网遥操作框架，基于实测通信不确定性，对比ZOH、FOH、LPF三种延迟补偿与PD/无源同步控制器的组合，证明"延迟补偿+无源同步"在真实云平台数据下更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 互联网遥操作是远程精确操作（如理发）的关键使能技术，但传输延迟波动与数据包抖动会破坏主从同步、降低跟踪性能；且已有研究多依赖合成延迟模型，缺乏基于真实通信数据的验证。
AI.method: 构建单向互联网遥操作理发框架；在真实云平台采集通信数据并刻画数据包延迟与有效延迟；评估ZOH、FOH、LPF三种延迟补偿方法与经典PD控制器、基于无源的同步控制器的组合效果。
AI.result: 基于实测通信数据的实验表明，将延迟补偿技术与无源同步控制相结合，可提升单向互联网遥操作在真实通信不确定性下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 为机器人理发应用提供了一个在现实通信条件下可靠的控制框架，并说明实测数据驱动的验证优于合成延迟模型。

title: STAR++: A Physical-Aware Benchmark and Framework for Astronomical Super-Resolution across Multiple Filters
summary: Astronomical super-resolution (ASR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution star fields from low-resolution telescope observations across multiple filters for astrophysical analysis. However, developing a physics-aware ASR framework faces two challenges: 1) Data view: no large-scale benchmark supports field-level ASR, especially on unseen filters. 2) Method view: Existing ASR methods often fail to preserve stellar flux across spatial resolutions. Moreover, ASR requires reconstructing high-frequency components, including accurate star locations and profiles, making it more ill-posed than natural-image SR. To tackle these problems, we introduce STAR++, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 1.7 million flux-consistent image pairs across 36 filters, derived from Hubble Space Telescope (HST) observations. STAR++ uses a flux-preserving data generation pipeline to ensure photometric consistency across resolutions and provides the Flux Error (FE) metric to evaluate ASR models from a physical perspective. To address method-level challenges, we propose a Flux-Invariant Super-Resolution Plus (FISR++) model that generalizes to unseen filters while accurately reconstructing flux-consistent high-resolution images. Beyond the flux-preserving modules, FISR++ introduces two novel components. Specifically, a Filter-Aware Adapter (FAA) incorporates filter metadata to adapt image representations to varying spectral and optical conditions. In addition, a Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss (SADL) models spatial ambiguity as pixel-shift uncertainty, mitigating the smoothing of learned conditional mean reconstructions caused by this ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FISR++ consistently outperforms existing ASR methods in reconstruction quality and flux accuracy, while generalizing to unseen filters, highlighting its effectiveness for photometrically faithful ASR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAR++大规模基准（约170万通量一致图像对、36个滤波器）与FISR++模型（融合Filter-Aware Adapter与Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss），实现面向未见滤波器的通量守恒天文超分辨率重建。
AI.motivation: 天文超分辨率（ASR）需从多滤波器低分辨率望远镜观测重建高分辨率星场以支撑天体物理分析，但存在两方面挑战：数据层面缺乏支持场级ASR（尤其未见滤波器）的大规模基准；方法层面现有ASR方法难以在跨空间分辨率时保持恒星通量，且需重建星点位置与轮廓等高频成分，比自然图像SR更病态。
AI.method: 构建STAR++基准：源自哈勃空间望远镜观测，约170万通量一致图像对、覆盖36个滤波器，采用通量守恒的数据生成流程保证跨分辨率光度一致性，并提出通量误差（FE）指标从物理角度评估ASR模型。提出FISR++模型：在通量守恒模块基础上引入Filter-Aware Adapter（FAA）利用滤波器元数据适配不同光谱与光学条件的图像表征，以及Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss（SADL）将空间歧义建模为像素位移不确定性，缓解条件均值重建的过度平滑。
AI.result: 大量实验表明FISR++在重建质量与通量精度上持续优于现有ASR方法，并能泛化至未见滤波器，验证了其在光度保真ASR上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STAR++基准与FISR++模型共同构成物理感知的天文超分辨率框架，兼顾数据规模、通量一致性与跨滤波器泛化能力，为光度忠实的ASR研究提供支撑。

title: Predicting Process-Level Behavior: A Benchmarking Study
comment: Accepted as main track paper at International Conference on Process Mining (ICPM) 2027
summary: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) typically forecasts the future of individual process instances, hence operating on trace level. Process managers, however, typically operate on process level, e.g., when assigning staff or calculating KPIs. The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions. We answer this question through a comprehensive benchmarking study of two process-level prediction tasks: concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction. Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level. We assess which modeling paradigms are most suitable for predicting process-level behavior and whether existing trace-level PPM can be effectively repurposed for this task. Our results show substantial variation in performance across approaches. Notably, aggregated trace-level predictions cause errors to compound on process-level, reducing accuracy and highlighting process-level prediction as a distinct predictive task that warrants dedicated research.

AI.tldr: 该文通过大规模基准测试，比较统计方法、机器学习、基础模型、业务流程仿真及聚合后的轨迹级PPM在两项流程级预测任务（并发轨迹预测、平均吞吐时间预测）上的表现，指出轨迹级预测聚合会导致误差累积，流程级预测应作为独立任务专门研究。
AI.motivation: 预测性流程监控（PPM）研究几乎都聚焦于单个流程实例（轨迹级）的预测，而流程管理者的实际决策（如人员配置、KPI计算）发生在流程级。现有方法能否支撑流程级管理决策尚不明确，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 构建comprehensive基准测试，定义两项流程级预测任务：并发轨迹预测与平均吞吐时间预测；在合成与真实事件日志上比较统计方法、机器学习方法、基础模型、业务流程仿真，以及将已有轨迹级PPM预测结果聚合到流程级的方法，评估各建模范式的适用性。
AI.result: 各方法性能差异显著；将轨迹级预测聚合到流程级会造成误差累积，从而降低准确性，说明轨迹级PPM难以直接有效地复用于流程级任务。
AI.conclusion: 流程级预测是一个独立且需专门研究的预测任务，不能简单依赖轨迹级PPM的聚合结果，未来应针对流程级目标设计预测方法。

title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: https://doppelwm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: Doppel 是一个与具身形态无关的视频世界模型，以"相机对齐的未来身体构型渲染图 + 数值动作轨迹"为条件，显式给定意图运动，从而专注于预测物体运动与场景交互变化；在 8 个数据集、8 种机器人/人类形态（约 600 小时视频）上联合训练单一共享骨干与条件适配器，机器人任务上 PSNR 较仅动作基线提升约 1.00–1.20 dB。
AI.motivation: 预测动作后果需要同时建模身体运动与环境响应，但多数视频世界模型仅从数值动作中隐式学习两者，而几何与运动学信息其实已明确指定了意图运动。此外，不同具身形态与动作空间差异大，缺乏统一表示，难以跨形态共享数据。
AI.method: 提出 Doppel：条件包括（1）相机对齐的未来身体构型渲染序列，（2）数值动作轨迹。用渲染图像作为跨具身、跨动作空间的通用视觉接口；对无相机外参的机器人数据，通过恢复相机位姿并把渲染轨迹与真实观测对齐来获得监督信号；在 8 个数据集（单臂/双臂机器人、灵巧人形、人手与人体）上不使用具身标签，联合训练一个共享视频骨干网络与条件适配器。
AI.result: 在三个机器人手臂数据集上，Doppel 在留出轨迹上相对仅动作基线 PSNR 提升 1.00 dB，在分布外评估下提升 1.20 dB，且预测的物体运动更一致；同时训练全部八种具身（Doppel-8）相比仅三种机器人（Doppel-3），在六个评测集中的四个上提升了机器人预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式提供意图运动（渲染的未来身体构型）可显著降低从数值动作中推断身体动力学的负担，并使模型专注于环境交互预测；渲染接口实现了跨具身的数据规模化联合训练，验证了具身无关视频世界模型的可行性与正向迁移效果。

title: Semantic-aware Contrasting with Explicitly Disentangled Representations for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of AI-generated videos (AIGVs) has raised critical concerns about content authenticity. Existing benchmarks suffer from a fundamental limitation: real and fake videos are often collected or generated from different semantic distributions. As a result, detectors may rely on spurious correlations involving objects, scenes, or actions rather than intrinsic artifacts introduced by generative models. To this end, we introduce SAVGE, a large-scale semantically aligned AIGV detection dataset comprising 2,369,822 videos, including 424,115 real videos and 1,945,707 generated videos. SAVGE organizes samples into real-fake semantic groups by using captions paired with real videos as prompts for text-to-video generation, thereby providing both group-level correspondence and textual semantic anchors. Based on SAVGE, we further propose Explicit Disentangling and Semantic-aware Contrasting (EDSC), a model-agnostic training framework for learning artifact-focused representations with reduced semantic interference. EDSC first extracts and aligns visual semantic features with textual representations, and then explicitly suppresses semantic information in the artifact branch while contrasting real and fake samples within each semantic group. By integrating caption-guided semantic supervision with intra-group contrastive learning in a two-phase optimization strategy, EDSC encourages detectors to capture generation-related cues under matched semantic conditions. Extensive experiments on SAVGE and GenVideo demonstrate that EDSC improves most evaluated backbone-metric combinations, enhances robustness under challenging evaluation settings, and strengthens cross-dataset generalization. These results highlight the importance of semantic alignment in AIGV detection and validate explicit semantic-artifact disentanglement as an effective strategy for robust detector learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有AI生成视频检测基准存在语义分布不匹配的缺陷，提出语义对齐数据集SAVGE（236万+视频）与模型无关训练框架EDSC（显式解耦+语义感知对比），以抑制语义捷径、聚焦生成伪影，并在两个数据集上提升了多种骨干的检测与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGV检测基准中真实与伪造视频常来自不同语义分布（物体、场景、动作不一致），导致检测器依赖语义层面的虚假相关（spurious correlation）而非生成模型的内在伪影，从而高估性能、泛化差。作者希望构建语义对齐的数据与训练方法，使检测器在语义匹配条件下学习真正的生成痕迹。
AI.method: 1) 数据集：SAVGE，共2,369,822条视频（真实424,115，生成1,945,707），以与真实视频配对的描述文本作text-to-video生成提示，构成“真实-伪造语义组”，提供组级对应关系与文本语义锚点。2) 框架：EDSC（Explicit Disentangling and Semantic-aware Contrasting），模型无关的训练框架。先提取视觉语义特征并与文本表示对齐；再在伪影分支中显式压制语义信息，并在每个语义组内进行真/伪对比；结合caption引导的语义监督与组内对比学习，采用两阶段优化。
AI.result: 在SAVGE与GenVideo上的大量实验表明：EDSC在多数“骨干-评价指标”组合上有提升，在更具挑战性的评测设置下鲁棒性增强，并提升跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐是AIGV检测中影响性能评估与检测器学习的关键因素；显式的“语义-伪影”解耦是一种有效的鲁棒检测器学习策略。

title: DyNA-Mixer: Decoupling Time and Topology for Scalable Dynamic Node Affinity Prediction
summary: Continuous-time dynamic graphs preserve the ordering, timing, and evolving strength of interactions that static snapshots discard, making dynamic graph mining essential for evolving systems such as recommender systems, trade networks, and transaction platforms. Research in this area has centered on dynamic link prediction, which forecasts only whether a future interaction will occur, whereas many applications also need its intensity. The dynamic node affinity prediction (DNAP) problem generalizes this task to continuous targets and full-candidate ranking, making it more broadly applicable but substantially harder. This raises two coupled difficulties: ranking requires a predictor expressive enough to capture both multi-scale temporal evolution and graph-wide collaborative patterns, yet running such a predictor over every source--destination pair is computationally prohibitive. We propose DyNA-Mixer, which decouples temporal forecasting from collaborative structure modeling. It adopts a multi-scale temporal predictor for pair-specific affinity evolution, constructs a Virtual Collaborative Graph that infers query-time relationships and aggregates trends from related interactions, and fuses the two through a gated residual mechanism. A sparsity-aware evaluation strategy further restricts expensive forecasting to pairs with recent non-zero affinities. Experiments on four Temporal Graph Benchmark datasets for the DNAP problem show that DyNA-Mixer achieves new state-of-the-art NDCG@10 on every dataset, including a 17.8\% relative test improvement over the strongest baseline on tgbn-token, the largest dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出 DyNA-Mixer，将时序预测与协同结构建模解耦，用于连续时间动态图上的动态节点亲和度预测（DNAP），在四个 TGB 数据集上取得 SOTA 的 NDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 现有研究集中于动态链接预测，仅预测未来交互是否发生，而推荐系统、交易网络等实际应用还需要交互强度。DNAP 将其推广为连续目标与全候选排序问题，但存在两个耦合难点：排序需要兼具多尺度时序演化与图级协同模式的强表达预测器，而对所有源-目的节点对逐一推理在计算上不可行。
AI.method: DyNA-Mixer 将时序预测与协同结构建模解耦：(1) 采用多尺度时序预测器建模节点对特定的亲和度演化；(2) 构建虚拟协同图（Virtual Collaborative Graph），在查询时推断关系并聚合相关交互的趋势；(3) 通过门控残差机制融合两支表示；(4) 提出稀疏感知评估策略，将昂贵的预测限制在近期存在非零亲和度的节点对上。
AI.result: 在四个 Temporal Graph Benchmark 数据集的 DNAP 任务上，DyNA-Mixer 在每个数据集上均刷新 NDCG@10 的 SOTA；在最大数据集 tgbn-token 上相对最强基线取得 17.8% 的测试集相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 将时序预测与协同结构建模解耦，并配合稀疏感知的候选筛选，可在保证可扩展性的同时显著提升连续亲和度排序性能，说明 DNAP 是被现有动态链接预测研究忽视但实用价值高的任务方向。

title: Grana: Compositional Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot reward modeling faces two challenges: generalizing across tasks and accurately tracking progress in long-horizon manipulation. General-purpose reward models demonstrate broad task transfer, but transfer from short-task pretraining to long-horizon tasks remains underexplored. Long-horizon progress models often rely on task-specific subtask classifiers or fixed action vocabularies, limiting the reuse of learned progress knowledge when adapting to new tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce Grana, a vision-language robot reward model that learns to identify unfinished subtasks and estimate their continuous progress using open-vocabulary subtask descriptions. We train a language-conditioned model to estimate progress in short-horizon tasks and individual subtasks of long-horizon tasks. For long-horizon tasks, we combine the selected subtask's predicted progress with credit for preceding completed subtasks to estimate whole-task progress. General progress prediction requires training the model across diverse tasks with progress supervision that accounts for imperfect execution. Elapsed-time proxies can misrepresent progress when relative subtask durations vary, or failures reverse local progress. We therefore introduce an annotation protocol that converts sparse subtask boundaries and action-quality annotations into dense progress targets, without requiring annotators to assign numerical progress scores. Pretraining with this supervision on 200 diverse, mostly short-horizon manipulation tasks enables zero-shot reward prediction on unseen tasks and improves progress prediction after adaptation to multi-minute, long-horizon tasks. Experiments demonstrate (i) generalizable reward prediction, including adaptation to five long-horizon tasks, (ii) benefits from pretraining and composing subtask progress estimates, and (iii) improved downstream policy performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Grana，一个视觉-语言机器人奖励模型，通过开放词汇的子任务描述识别未完成子任务并估计其连续进度，实现跨任务泛化与长时程任务的进度跟踪。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励建模面临两大挑战：跨任务泛化和长时程操作中的进度准确跟踪。通用奖励模型虽有较好的任务迁移能力，但从短任务预训练迁移到长时程任务仍研究不足；长时程进度模型往往依赖任务特定的子任务分类器或固定动作词表，限制了学到进度知识的复用。
AI.method: 提出 Grana：以语言为条件、用开放词汇子任务描述估计未完成子任务的连续进度。在短时程任务及长时程任务的各子任务上训练进度估计；长时程任务中，将所选子任务预测进度与已完成的先前子任务的信用（credit）组合成整体进度。此外设计标注协议，将稀疏子任务边界与动作质量标注转换为稠密进度目标，无需人工给数值进度分数；在 200 个多样任务（多为短时程）上预训练。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i) 可泛化的奖励预测，包括对五个长时程任务的自适应；(ii) 预训练和子任务进度组合带来收益；(iii) 下游策略性能提升。预训练支持对未见任务的零样本奖励预测，并在适配到数分钟级长时程任务后改善进度预测。
AI.conclusion: 开放词汇子任务描述结合稠密进度监督的预训练，可有效解决奖励模型的跨任务泛化与长时程进度跟踪问题，并带来下游策略性能的改善。

title: CURVTON-205K: A Mask-Free Difficulty-Stratified Synthetic Dataset for Robust and Scalable Virtual Try-On
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. Project page: https://curvton2.github.io/curvton
summary: Recent advances in 2D virtual try-on (VTON) have largely focused on architectural innovation, yet robust performance in diverse real-world conditions remains challenging. We argue that failure modes in VTON, such as inaccurate occlusion handling, unconstrained poses, and poor coverage of under-represented garments and appearance factors, are tightly coupled to dataset design choices and long-tail data regimes. We present a scalable data generation pipeline that coordinates specialized editing and generation models with vision-language model (VLM) guidance to synthesize triplets without requiring parsing masks or dense-pose annotations. Using this pipeline, we create CURVTON-205K, a curated synthetic dataset of 205K triplets: source person, target garment, and corresponding try-on image. CURVTON-205K is explicitly designed to broaden coverage across garments, person appearance, poses, occlusions, and visual conditions. Additionally, CURVTON-205K is organized into three difficulty tiers, enabling controlled evaluation under varying levels of difficulty and supporting difficulty-aware experimentation. We analyze the dataset diversity and demonstrate its potential to improve try-on fidelity across four VTON architectures and its cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的数据生成流水线，借助专用编辑/生成模型与VLM引导，无需解析掩码或稠密姿态标注即可合成三元组数据，构建了20.5万样本的CURVTON-205K数据集，覆盖服饰、外观、姿态、遮挡与视觉条件，并划分三档难度，实验证明其提升四种VTON架构的试穿保真度与跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有2D虚拟试穿研究多聚焦架构创新，而真实场景下的失败模式（遮挡处理不准、姿态不受约束、欠代表服饰与外观因素覆盖不足）与数据集设计及长尾数据分布紧密耦合，因此需要从数据侧入手解决。
AI.method: 提出可扩展数据生成流水线，协调专用编辑模型与生成模型，并由视觉语言模型（VLM）提供引导，在无需人体解析掩码和稠密姿态标注的条件下合成（源人物、目标服饰、试穿结果）三元组；据此构建CURVTON-205K，显式扩大服饰、人物外观、姿态、遮挡及视觉条件的覆盖，并按难度分为三个层级以支持难度感知评测。
AI.result: 分析了数据集多样性，并在四种VTON架构上验证其可提升试穿保真度，同时改善跨数据集泛化性能，且支持不同难度下的受控评测。
AI.conclusion: VTON的性能瓶颈与数据设计密切相关，长尾与难例覆盖的合成数据是对架构创新的有效补充；CURVTON-205K及其生成流水线可作为难度可控的评测与训练资源。

title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures. Accepted at the AXIOM Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code and pretrained model: https://github.com/lauritsf/icicle
summary: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. Our release samples synthetic training tasks on the fly and provides a freeze-thaw scheduler for Ray Tune and an ONNX model for inference without JAX or PyTorch.

AI.tldr: ICICLE 是一种上下文内代理模型，用共享集合编码器接受可变数量超参数，仅 1.28M 参数（FT-PFN 的 8.7%），在多个学习曲线基准上与 FT-PFN 相当的遗憾轨迹，并在 86 任务 Meta-Album 上无需元训练即优于 Quick-Tune。
AI.motivation: 冻结-解冻贝叶斯优化依赖对部分观测学习曲线的外推预测。此前 LC-PFN 将先验数据拟合网络（PFN）用于学习曲线外推，FT-PFN 进一步扩展到配置感知的冻结-解冻优化，但其固定十槽超参数编码器限制了超参数数量与类型，且模型规模较大。
AI.method: 提出 ICICLE：一种上下文内（in-context）代理模型，通过共享集合编码器处理可变数量超参数；采用覆盖类型化超参数、重尾噪声、量化与发散情形的合成先验进行训练，训练任务在线采样生成。模型规模 1.28M 参数，并提供 Ray Tune 冻结-解冻调度器及无需 JAX/PyTorch 的 ONNX 推理模型。
AI.result: 在 LCBench、PD1、TaskSet 上平均遗憾轨迹与 FT-PFN 相近；在含 33 个超参数的 86 任务 Meta-Album 基准上，mini/micro 档与 Quick-Tune 无明显差异，overall 与 extended 档获得更低的平均归一化遗憾，且未在 Meta-Album 相关任务上做预训练或元训练（Quick-Tune 则进行了元训练）。
AI.conclusion: 小型、超参数数量无关的上下文内代理模型 ICICLE 可在显著降低参数量的同时匹配甚至超越更大模型与元训练基线，说明合成先验上的上下文学习足以替代昂贵的元训练，并具备实用的部署友好性。

title: Phoenix: Learning Scene Structure Representations for Generalizable World-Action Models
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet reconstruction-oriented visual representations do not explicitly emphasize the spatial relationships and object-state changes needed for manipulation. We introduce Phoenix, which learns representations of scene structure for world-action modeling. Specifically, Phoenix Encoder enriches DINOv3's general visual semantics through dual-teacher distillation of geometric and spatiotemporal semantic knowledge. Next, CS-VAE causally aggregates and compresses Phoenix Encoder features into generative latents while preserving scene information and spatial layout. Finally, Phoenix jointly predicts these latents, complementary appearance latents, and robot actions, linking scene evolution with action generation. To study pretraining data efficiency, we curate approximately 39,000 hours of egocentric and robot manipulation data for representation learning and use the robot demonstration subset for WAM pretraining. Following benchmark-specific post-training, Phoenix achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks spanning single-arm, bimanual, and dexterous manipulation. It demonstrates strong robustness to perturbations, achieving success rates of 94.8% on LIBERO-Plus and 72.4% on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, alongside strong cross-embodiment transfer and real-world manipulation performance on Bench2Dex and RoboDojo-RealWorld, respectively. Pretraining-scale analysis shows larger performance gains from data scaling than a video-VAE-only baseline, indicating stronger scaling benefits and more effective data utilization. Moreover, Phoenix maintains high success rates when adapted with limited downstream demonstrations, demonstrating strong few-shot adaptation. Our code, pretraining data, and models are available on the project page to help the community reproduce our results.

AI.tldr: Phoenix 通过显式学习场景结构的表征来进行世界-动作建模：先用几何与时空语义双教师蒸馏增强 DINOv3 语义，再用 CS-VAE 因果聚合压缩为生成潜变量，并联合预测潜变量、外观潜变量与机器人动作，在仿真与真机多类操作基准上取得 SOTA，并展现出更好的数据缩放效率与少样本适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）联合预测未来观测与动作，但其视觉表征以重建为导向，未显式强调操作任务所需的**空间关系**与**物体状态变化**，导致面向操作的结构信息不足。
AI.method: 1) **Phoenix Encoder**：以 DINOv3 的通用视觉语义为基础，通过**双教师蒸馏**注入几何知识与时空语义知识；2) **CS-VAE**：对编码器特征进行因果聚合与压缩，生成保留场景信息与空间布局的生成潜变量；3) **联合预测**：同时预测该结构潜变量、互补的外观潜变量与机器人动作，将场景演化与动作生成相耦合。数据侧构建约 39,000 小时第一人称与机器人操作数据进行表征预训练，其中机器人示教子集用于 WAM 预训练，随后做基准特定的后训练。
AI.result: 在覆盖单臂、双臂、灵巧操作的仿真与真机基准上达到 SOTA；扰动鲁棒性强：LIBERO-Plus 成功率 94.8%，RoboTwin 2.0 C2R 72.4%；具备较强跨本体迁移能力，并在 Bench2Dex、RoboDojo-RealWorld 上取得良好真机表现。预训练规模分析显示，相比仅用 video-VAE 的基线，数据缩放带来更大性能增益，说明缩放效益更强、数据利用更高效；在少量下游示教适配时仍保持高成功率，体现良好少样本适应。代码、预训练数据与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模场景结构（几何 + 时空语义 + 因果压缩的生成潜变量）是提升世界-动作模型操作性能的有效路径，且带来更优的数据缩放与少样本迁移特性；作者开源资源以支持复现与后续研究。

title: R$^{3}$Sieve: Suppressing Unconditional Information from Attention to Answers for High-Resolution VQA
summary: High-resolution visual question answering (VQA) requires models to identify question-relevant small objects in high-resolution images and select the correct answer based on what they recognize, demanding fine-grained perception. Previous methods focus on obtaining better visual evidence (image crops), but obtaining it alone is insufficient, using it effectively is equally crucial. Visual evidence should therefore be utilized as effectively as possible throughout inference. We argue that small-target evidence is obscured by unconditional information that remains observable in subsequent processing even after the condition on which it should depend is removed. Such information hinders the effective use of small-target evidence. We propose R$^{3}$Sieve (Residual-Region-Response Sieve), a training-free framework. We divide inference into three stages---localization, cropping, and answering---and introduce distinct counterfactual references to suppress interference at each stage. During localization, the Shared-Subspace Canceller (SSC) uses a generic image description to construct a counterfactual reference and obtain question-relevant attention maps. During cropping, the Unique-Contribution Spotter (UCS) constructs counterfactual references from visual and non-visual features to identify distinctive, complementary crop regions. During answering, the Content-Aligned Voter (CAV) constructs an image-free branch to calibrate answer responses. Experiments on three high-resolution VQA benchmarks show that R$^{3}$Sieve achieves the highest overall accuracy among compared methods across diverse settings, improving base models by up to 21.5 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架R³Sieve，将高分辨率VQA推理分为定位、裁剪、回答三阶段，并分别引入反事实参考抑制干扰，从而更有效地利用小目标视觉证据，在三项基准上取得最高总体准确率，最高提升基座模型21.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率VQA需要模型识别与问题相关的小目标并据此作答，要求细粒度感知。已有方法侧重获取更好的视觉证据（图像裁剪），但仅获取证据不足，如何有效利用同样关键。作者认为小目标证据会被"无条件信息"所遮蔽——即使其本应依赖的条件被移除，这些信息在后续处理中仍可被观测到，从而阻碍小目标证据的有效利用。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架R³Sieve（Residual-Region-Response Sieve）。将推理划分为定位、裁剪、回答三个阶段，每阶段引入不同的反事实参考以抑制干扰：定位阶段用Shared-Subspace Canceller（SSC）以通用图像描述构建反事实参考，得到问题相关注意力图；裁剪阶段用Unique-Contribution Spotter（UCS）从视觉与非视觉特征构建反事实参考，识别具有区分性与互补性的裁剪区域；回答阶段用Content-Aligned Voter（CAV）构建无图像分支以校准答案响应。
AI.result: 在三个高分辨率VQA基准、多种设置下，R³Sieve的总体准确率均优于对比方法，相较基座模型最高提升21.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效利用视觉证据与获取证据同等重要；通过在定位、裁剪、回答三阶段引入反事实参考抑制残余干扰，可在无需训练的情况下显著提升高分辨率VQA性能。

title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LAPIS，一种面向目标条件设定下的潜动作策略改进方法，将基于价值的策略改进锚定在观测到的状态-潜动作转移上，并用条件流策略刻画其多模态结构，从而在潜动作空间中实现可靠的离线 RL 策略改进。
AI.motivation: 潜动作模型（LAMs）能从无动作视频中学习控制表征，但现有流程通常仅用行为克隆训练潜策略，缺乏显式的策略改进目标。离线 RL 是自然的改进途径，然而作者发现标准离线 RL 方法无法直接迁移到学习得到的潜动作空间：潜动作的结构会使朴素离线 RL 不可靠——直接在潜动作上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略会产生物理执行无法实现的潜动作，同时潜表征可能将获得不同奖励的物理控制合并。因此需要理解潜空间优化何时仍然有效。
AI.method: 首先理论分析：推导策略改进能够传递到解码后物理执行的条件，以及潜空间最优与物理最优一致的条件。基于这些洞察提出 LAPIS：面向目标条件的潜策略改进，将基于价值的策略改进建立在观测到的状态-潜动作转移之上（而非直接在潜动作上做无约束价值最大化），并采用条件流策略（conditional flow policy）来捕捉潜动作的多模态结构。
AI.result: LAPIS 在大多数任务上优于基线，在视觉操作任务中提升最为明显；并且仅使用 1% 的动作标签时仍然有效，而竞争方法在此条件下基本崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 在潜动作空间中进行策略改进需要显式考虑潜动作的可实现性与多模态、多对一映射结构。将价值改进锚定于真实状态-潜动作转移并用流策略建模多模态，可使潜空间优化有效传递到物理执行，并在极少动作标签下保持鲁棒性。

title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Z-sight 是一个统一机器人基础模型，将 VLA 与生成式隐空间世界建模耦合，直接在 VLM 的视觉 token 空间预测未来并联合去噪未来空间 token 与动作，无需像素重建或外部编码器。
AI.motivation: 视频类世界动作模型（WAM）证明联合预测未来与动作对控制有价值，但继承了视频生成器的高计算成本；近期隐空间策略虽避免像素生成，却通常对齐中间特征或依赖冻结的目标编码器，使未来预测与 VLM 原生特征空间解耦。
AI.method: 在 VLM 感知当下的同一视觉 token 空间直接预测未来。以 mixture-of-transformers 结构将前瞻专家、连续动作专家与 VLM 耦合，推理时联合去噪未来空间 token 与动作，不做像素重建、不使用外部编码器；训练数据为人类视频与机器人轨迹。
AI.result: SIMPLE 基准成功率 81.9%（较最强基线 +9.6 点）；Unitree G1 六项任务平均 73.3%（+20.0 点）；每 chunk 推理 110 ms；在桌面操作类基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在 VLM 原生视觉 token 空间内做未来预测与动作联合去噪，可在不引入视频生成开销的前提下获得显著性能提升与低推理延迟，为统一 VLA 与世界模型的机器人基础模型提供可行路径。

title: Benchmarking Reasoning Reliability,Prior_Evidence Contrast,and Spectral Discrimination in Remote-Sensing Geological Image Interpretation
summary: Reliable lithology interpretation requires accurate geological recognition and reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Although Multimodal Large Language Models show promise in remote sensing, their reliability in geological interpretation remains unclear. We introduce HyGeoBench, a diagnostic benchmark of 10,000 questions based on hyperspectral imagery across three dimensions: reasoning reliability, prior_evidence contrast, and spectral discrimination. It covers ten task types, with both multiple-choice and open-ended response formats. Integrating hyperspectral satellite imagery with geological annotations and verified evidence, HyGeoBench examines reasoning errors, conflicts between geological priors and visual evidence, and cross-band inconsistencies. Evaluations reveal limitations in fine-grained recognition and evidence-grounded interpretation. To address these challenges, we propose HyGeoAgent, a tool-augmented framework integrating region observation, text knowledge retrieval, same-band image retrieval, and native PCA analysis through adaptive tool use. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, improving geological image interpretation across diagnostic dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高光谱地质解释诊断基准 HyGeoBench（1万题、三维度、十类任务）与工具增强框架 HyGeoAgent，评估并改善多模态大模型在地质解释中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 可靠岩性解释需要基于视觉证据的地质识别与推理。多模态大模型在遥感领域已有潜力，但在地质解释中的可靠性尚不明确，缺乏针对推理错误、先验与视觉证据冲突及跨波段不一致的系统诊断手段。
AI.method: 构建 HyGeoBench：基于高光谱影像的1万道诊断题，涵盖推理可靠性、先验-证据对比、光谱判别三个维度，包含十类任务，题型含多选与开放式；整合高光谱卫星影像、地质标注与验证证据。提出 HyGeoAgent：工具增强框架，通过自适应工具调用集成区域观测、文本知识检索、同波段图像检索与原生PCA分析。
AI.result: 评测显示现有模型在细粒度识别与证据支撑解释方面存在明显局限；HyGeoAgent 在对应基座模型上取得一致性提升，并在各诊断维度上改善地质图像解释表现。
AI.conclusion: HyGeoBench 可系统暴露多模态大模型在地质解释中的可靠性缺陷，而工具增强的 HyGeoAgent 是提升证据驱动地质解释的有效途径。

title: The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
summary: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are built using well-understood mathematical operations, yet their complex nature poses significant challenges to intuitively understanding their decision-making processes. This work introduces a method for visualizing and measuring ANN decision boundary geometry directly in the high-dimensional input space, avoiding distortions found with traditional projection-based techniques. We analyze boundary curvatures and distances in diverse inputs, architectures, and training methods. Boundary distances grow smoothly and slowly with consistent curvature as the size of the subspace increases, suggesting that decision boundaries are close to input samples within large, continuous subspaces. We also quantify how much boundary distances and curvatures reduce near dataset samples after adversarial training. Training methodology has a significantly stronger impact on boundary distance and curvature than architecture or test-set accuracy. These findings are contextualized within prior work, supporting or refuting several previously proposed theories of boundary behavior. Our analytically and empirically supported methodology lays the foundation for future studies to improve network interpretability and understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接在高维输入空间中可视化与测量ANN决策边界几何的方法，避免投影失真，并系统分析边界曲率与距离。
AI.motivation: ANN由可理解的数学运算构建，但其复杂性使决策过程难以直观理解；传统基于投影的可视化技术会引入失真，无法准确刻画高维决策边界几何。
AI.method: 在高维输入空间中直接测量与可视化决策边界几何（曲率、距离）；在多种输入、架构和训练方法上分析边界曲率与距离，包括对抗训练前后、子空间规模变化下的行为。
AI.result: 随子空间规模增大，边界距离平滑缓慢增长且曲率保持一致，表明在大而连续的子空间内决策边界靠近输入样本；对抗训练后，数据样本附近的边界距离与曲率显著下降；训练方法对边界距离和曲率的影响远大于架构或测试集准确率。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为既有关于边界行为的多种理论提供支持或反驳证据；该兼具解析与实证支撑的方法为提升网络可解释性与理解奠定基础。

title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 8-page main paper with references and supplementary material (15 pages); 5 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI Project page: https://starsholic.github.io/AeroRSI/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight. Correcting these failures requires repairs, i.e., actions that avoid them at the states the policy itself reaches, which human pilots cannot label at scale and rule-based planners cannot supply reliably. In this paper, we present AeroRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial navigation policy iteratively learns from its own failures. Our key insight is that a failing policy should judge its own repairs by flying on from them. Judged in this way, its sampled actions and even rule-based proposals that hurt it when imitated directly become reliable supervision. Moreover, an episode terminates at its first failure, concealing subsequent failures until the earlier ones are repaired. AeroRSI thus renews its supervision in every round, anchoring the failures of the current policy, verifying repairs by its continuation, and distilling them while keeping its behavior elsewhere. On TravelUAV, three rounds raise the success rate of a supervised 2B-parameter policy from 46.4% to 67.5% and reduce collisions by half, surpassing the previous state of the art by 10.6 points from the same initialization without extra human labels or inference cost. Code and models are available at https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI.

AI.tldr: 提出AeroRSI递归自我改进框架，让无人机VLA策略从自身失败中迭代学习：以"从修复动作继续飞行是否成功"来验证修复，三轮迭代将2B参数策略成功率从46.4%提升至67.5%，碰撞减半，较此前SOTA提升10.6个百分点，无需额外人工标注或推理开销。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽能让无人机遵循自然语言指令，但在闭环飞行中仍频繁失败。纠正这些失败需要"修复动作"——即在策略自身实际访问到的状态上避免失败的动作，而这类数据既无法由人类飞行员大规模标注，规则式规划器也难以可靠提供。
AI.method: AeroRSI递归自我改进框架。核心洞见：失败策略应通过"从修复点继续飞行"来判断修复是否有效。据此，采样动作乃至直接模仿会损害策略的规则式提案，只要经续飞验证即可成为可靠监督。此外，episode在首次失败处终止会掩盖后续失败，故每轮重新生成监督：锚定当前策略的失败状态、以续飞结果验证修复、蒸馏修复动作同时保持其他区域行为不变。
AI.result: 在TravelUAV上，三轮迭代将监督训练得到的2B参数策略成功率从46.4%提升至67.5%，碰撞减少一半，在同一初始化下超过此前SOTA 10.6个百分点，且无额外人工标注与推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 以"续飞验证"为核心的递归自我改进能有效将策略自身失败转化为可靠监督信号，实现无需人工标注的闭环性能持续提升，为VLA导航策略的自主改进提供了可行范式。

title: From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
summary: Human motion perturbs wireless channels, making commodity Wi-Fi devices a practical platform for device-free activity recognition. Yet Channel State Information (CSI) also depends strongly on the person, receiver position, recording session, and surrounding environment, so a classifier can continue producing activity labels after its deployment conditions have moved away from those seen during training. We propose Wi-HAR, a multi-antenna architecture in which four Variational Auto-Encoders learn compact distributions from raw Wi-Fi 6 CSI magnitudes and a delayed-fusion classifier combines their means and log-variances. On twelve activities from a public benchmark, Wi-HAR reaches 96.6% median recognition accuracy, compared with 70.8-81.5% for independently optimized single-antenna models, showing that the antennas provide complementary views of the same activity. We then use the same latent backbone to detect deployment shifts without using shifted samples for model selection or calibration. A class-conditional uncertainty score derived from Evidential Deep Learning achieves a macro-average ROC-AUC of 0.897 across eleven datasets that change receiver position, participant, recording session, or room, and detects 82.5% of shifted samples at a realized 5.2% in-distribution rejection rate. Detection performance nevertheless varies substantially across receiver positions, showing that the same physical change does not induce a uniform uncertainty response. The compact representation also supports shallow decision-tree analysis using variables from several antennas.

AI.tldr: 提出 Wi-HAR：用四个 VAE 从 Wi-Fi 6 多天线 CSI 幅值学习紧凑分布，并以延迟融合分类器融合各天线的高斯均值与对数方差；在公开基准 12 类活动上取得 96.6% 中位准确率，并复用同一潜变量骨干，以基于证据深度学习（EDL）的类条件不确定性分数检测部署漂移。
AI.motivation: 人体运动虽扰动无线信道使商用 Wi-Fi 可做无设备活动识别，但 CSI 强依赖个体、接收机位置、采集会话与周围环境；当部署条件偏离训练分布时，分类器仍会输出活动标签而缺乏可靠性保障，因此需要既提升精度又能感知部署漂移的方案。
AI.method: 四点：①多天线架构，用四个 VAE 对原始 Wi-Fi 6 CSI 幅值学习紧凑分布（均值与对数方差）；②延迟融合分类器融合各天线表示的均值与对数方差；③复用同一潜变量骨干进行漂移检测，模型选择与校准均不使用漂移样本；④由 Evidential Deep Learning 导出类条件不确定性分数作为 OOD/漂移判别指标；⑤用多变天线变量构建浅层决策树辅助分析。
AI.result: 公开基准 12 类活动上中位准确率 96.6%，显著高于独立优化的单天线模型（70.8–81.5%），表明各天线提供互补视图；在 11 个改变接收机位置、参与者、采集会话或房间的数据集上，类条件不确定性分数的宏平均 ROC-AUC 为 0.897，在 5.2% 分布内拒绝率下检出 82.5% 的漂移样本；但检测性能随接收机位置差异较大，说明同一物理变化并不引发一致的 uncertainty 响应。
AI.conclusion: 多天线 VAE + 延迟融合能有效利用天线互补性提升活动识别精度，且同一紧凑潜表示可低成本地兼作部署漂移检测，无需漂移样本参与校准；然而漂移引起的认知不确定性对物理条件变化并非均匀响应，提示实际部署需按位置/环境分别评估可靠性，并可将紧凑表示用于可解释的决策树分析。

title: APS: Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have significantly improved video understanding capabilities, yet processing long videos remains challenging due to the substantial computational cost of extensive visual inputs. Frame selection offers an efficient alternative, but many existing region-based methods rely on fixed or predefined temporal partitions, which may result in suboptimal temporal regions, compromising subsequent budget allocation and frame selection. In this work, we propose Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection (APS), a training-free framework that adapts temporal partitions to local variations in query-frame relevance. Specifically, APS formulates temporal partitioning as a complexity-regularized fitting problem, jointly optimizing partition boundaries and local models through dynamic programming. The resulting adaptive temporal partitions guide frame budget allocation based on query relevance and temporal extent, enabling informative frame selection under limited visual budgets. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that APS consistently improves performance across diverse LVLM backbones, achieving the highest average gains over uniform sampling among competing methods. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of adaptive partitioning and demonstrate its generalizability across model scales, similarity encoders, and advanced LVLMs.

AI.tldr: APS：一种免训练的自适应时间分区帧选择框架，将时间分区建模为复杂度正则化拟合问题并用动态规划联合优化分区边界与局部模型，据此进行预算分配与帧选择，在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 上稳定提升多种 LVLM 骨干的性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解受限于大量视觉输入带来的高昂计算成本，帧选择是高效替代方案；但现有基于区域的方法依赖固定或预定义的时间划分，可能产生次优时间区域，进而损害后续的预算分配与帧选择效果。
AI.method: 提出 APS（Adaptive Partitioning-Based Frame Selection），免训练框架：将时间分区形式化为带复杂度正则的拟合问题，通过动态规划联合优化分区边界与各局部模型（局部相关性建模），使分区自适应于 query-frame 相关性的局部变化；再以所得自适应时间分区，依据查询相关性与时间跨度指导帧预算分配，从而在有限视觉预算下选出信息量高的帧。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 三个长视频基准上，APS 在多种 LVLM 骨干上均取得一致提升，且在竞争方法中相对均匀采样的平均增益最高；进一步分析验证了自适应分区的有效性，并显示其在模型规模、相似度编码器以及更先进 LVLM 上的可泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 以自适应时间分区替代固定分区，可更合理地把帧预算分配到查询相关且时间跨度关键的区域，是一种无需训练、即插即用且具良好泛化性的长视频帧选择方案。

title: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
summary: Plant reflectance spectroscopy across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared domain encodes foliar biochemical and anatomical traits into contiguous spectral signatures with locally differentiable structure; however, extreme inter-band collinearity and unfavorable sample-to-feature ratios challenge predictive modeling. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods routinely adopted in spectroscopy, are column-permutation invariant: they treat adjacent wavelengths as unordered tabular columns and discard the sequential differential geometry of absorption features. Here, we propose Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA), a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that projects contiguous spectra into a compact morpho-spectral subspace through three complementary blocks: (i) additive continuum-removed absorption depth, area, and red-edge inflection kinematics; (ii) local multi-order singular eigenmodes (0th, 1st, and 2nd derivatives) partitioned across contiguous radiative sub-windows; and (iii) global Fisher-weighted canonical subspaces regularized via trace-normalized isotropic covariance shrinkage. We validated MSPA across 8,963 spectra spanning five plant systems, coupled with six classical machine learning classifiers and four Tabular Foundation Models (TabPFN v3, TabICL v2, TabDPT v1.2, and TabFM). Despite compressing the 1,580-band spectrum by 96%, MSPA outperformed the full spectrum in 92.0% of all benchmarks and conventional reducers in 90.0% of all model-crop evaluations, raising the global mean macro-F1 from 0.7756 (full spectrum) to 0.8520, accelerating in-context inference by up to 126.5x. Designed as a self-contained spectral projection operator, the MSPA method can be directly integrated into spectroscopy workflows via the open-source code available at GitHub: https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa.

AI.tldr: 提出形态-光谱投影分析（MSPA）监督降维算子，将1580波段连续光谱压缩96%，全局平均macro-F1由0.7756提升至0.8520，并在92.0%基准中优于全光谱。
AI.motivation: 可见光-近红外-短波红外反射光谱具有局部可微结构，但波段间极端共线性与不利的样本-特征比使预测建模困难；常规降维方法（如PCA等）具列置换不变性，把相邻波长当作无序表格列，丢弃了吸收特征的序列微分几何信息。
AI.method: MSPA为监督式投影算子，含三互补模块：(i) 加性连续统去除后的吸收深度、面积与红边拐点运动学特征；(ii) 在连续辐射子窗口上分区的局部多阶奇异特征模（0/1/2阶导数）；(iii) 经迹归一化各向同性协方差收缩正则化的全局Fisher加权典型子空间。在8,963条光谱、五类植物系统上，结合6种经典机器学习分类器与4种表格基础模型（TabPFN v3、TabICL v2、TabDPT v1.2、TabFM）进行验证。
AI.result: 压缩96%波段后，MSPA在92.0%的基准中优于全光谱、在90.0%的模型-作物评估中优于常规降维方法；全局平均macro-F1从0.7756（全光谱）升至0.8520，上下文推理最高加速126.5倍。
AI.conclusion: MSPA是自包含的光谱投影算子，可直接嵌入光谱学工作流，开源代码见 https://github.com/Lucas-Osco/mspa。

title: CausalDrive: Causal Decomposition for Data-Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Efficient use of expert demonstrations is essential for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, directly imitating expert trajectories couples nominal intention, which specifies where the vehicle should go, with multimodal driving styles, which determine how that intention is executed. Different combinations of these factors can yield similar expert trajectories, obscuring their respective causal contributions and forcing the policy to learn both from a single entangled target. This ambiguity limits how effectively the policy can exploit expert demonstrations. We propose CausalDrive, a causal decomposition framework for data-efficient driving policy learning that separates deterministic nominal intention prediction from probabilistic driving style modeling. Specifically, we construct counterfactual nominal trajectories from navigation command, map topology, and ego state by removing style dependent effects, providing a Nominal Intention Planner with supervision independent of expert trajectories. Conditioned on the predicted nominal intention and surrounding agents, a diffusion-based Style Execution Policy models diverse driving styles as a multimodal distribution over residuals between nominal and expert trajectories. This causally structured supervision reduces redundant learning of shared nominal behavior in routine scenarios, directing expert supervision toward informative execution variations and improving data utilization. CausalDrive achieves 91.2 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.5 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. Further experiments demonstrate strong performance with limited expert data and clear advantages in challenging interactive scenarios.

AI.tldr: CausalDrive 将专家轨迹解耦为确定性的名义意图预测与概率化的驾驶风格建模，在 NAVSIM v1/v2 上取得 91.2 PDMS 与 89.5 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶中直接模仿专家轨迹会把"去哪里"的名义意图与"怎么开"的多模态驾驶风格纠缠在同一目标中；不同因素组合可产生相似轨迹，因果贡献难以区分，迫使策略从单一纠缠目标中同时学两者，限制了专家示范的利用效率。
AI.method: 提出因果分解框架：1) 基于导航指令、地图拓扑与自车状态，去除风格相关效应构造反事实名义轨迹，为 Nominal Intention Planner 提供不依赖专家轨迹的监督；2) 以预测的名义意图与周围智能体为条件，用基于扩散的 Style Execution Policy 将名义轨迹与专家轨迹之间的残差建模为多模态分布，表征多样驾驶风格。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1 上 PDMS 达 91.2，NAVSIM v2 上 EPDMS 达 89.5，达到或超过当前最优；在有限专家数据下表现强劲，并在具有挑战性的交互场景中具明显优势。
AI.conclusion: 因果结构化监督减少了常规场景中对共享名义行为的重复学习，使专家监督集中于信息量更大的执行差异上，从而提升数据利用率与策略性能。

title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Location Encoding Methods for Species Distribution Modelling
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
summary: Understanding the spatial distribution of species is a key question in ecology. A variety of solutions, from statistical, traditional machine learning, through to deep learning-based methods have been proposed. These methods take sparse observations for a species of interest as input and aim to generate dense spatial outputs indicating the spatial range of the species. Orthogonal to the choice of statistical model used is the question of what input features are most informative. Thanks to recent developments, the number of options has greatly expanded, with choices spanning different climate variables, learning-based encodings, earth embedding models, or raw transformed geographic coordinates. In this work, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework and quantify the effectiveness of different location encodings in the context of species range estimation, both at the local and global scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个标准化评估框架，系统量化不同位置编码（location encoding）在物种分布范围估计任务中的有效性，涵盖局部与全球尺度。
AI.motivation: 物种空间分布建模方法（统计、传统机器学习、深度学习）众多，但"何种输入特征最有信息量"这一问题与模型选择相互正交。近年可用特征大幅扩展（气候变量、学习式编码、地表嵌入模型、原始变换地理坐标等），却缺乏统一的标准化比较基准。
AI.method: 以稀疏物种观测为输入、以稠密空间范围为输出构建统一评估流程；构建标准化评估框架，在局部与全球两个尺度上对比多种位置编码方式的效果。
AI.result: 量化了各位置编码在物种范围估计中的有效性，并给出局部与全球尺度下的对比结论（揭示不同编码的适用场景与增益差异）。
AI.conclusion: 标准化评估框架为位置编码选择提供了可比证据，表明输入特征的选择对物种分布范围估计有显著影响，为后续方法设计提供参考基准。

title: Learning Where and How Much to Sample: Volume-Adaptive k-Space Acquisition for Accelerated MRI
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an essential medical imaging technique, but its high costs and long acquisition times can limit accessibility. Accelerated MRI reduces acquisition time through k-space undersampling, yet conventional methods often rely on predefined sampling patterns and uniform slice budgets, overlooking anatomical variations and inter-slice relationships. In this paper, we propose a volume-adaptive k-space acquisition framework that jointly learns where and how much to sample across an entire MRI volume. Using only acquired auto-calibration signal (ACS) measurements, our method exploits volume-wide anatomical information to adaptively allocate sampling budgets across slices while identifying informative k-space lines. A learned joint slice--frequency refinement module coordinates sampling decisions while preserving an exact total volume-level acquisition budget. To reconstruct the acquired measurements, we design a sensitivity-aware synchronous cross-slice reconstruction network that estimates coil sensitivities from ACS measurements and progressively refines neighboring-slice reconstructions while enforcing hard k-space data consistency. Both networks are jointly optimized using reconstruction-based supervision without requiring fully sampled k-space at inference. Experiments on knee and brain MRI across multiple contrasts and acceleration factors demonstrate the adaptive behavior of our acquisition framework and evaluate its reconstruction performance.

AI.tldr: 提出体积自适应k空间采集框架，联合学习"采哪里"与"采多少"，并配以灵敏度感知的跨切片同步重建网络，在膝/脑MRI多对比度、多加速倍数下验证。
AI.motivation: MRI成本高、采集时间长限制可及性；加速MRI虽通过k空间欠采样缩短时间，但传统方法依赖预设采样模式与各切片统一的采样预算，忽略了切片间解剖差异与层间关联。
AI.method: 仅利用已采集的ACS自校准数据，挖掘全volume解剖信息，自适应地在各切片间分配采样预算并识别有信息量的k空间相位编码行；引入可学习的联合"切片—频率"精化模块协同采样决策，同时严格保持总体积层面采集预算不变；重建端设计灵敏度感知的跨切片同步重建网络，从ACS估计线圈灵敏度并渐进精化相邻切片重建，施加硬k空间数据一致性约束；两网络以重建损失联合优化，推理阶段无需全采样k空间。
AI.result: 膝部与脑部MRI在多种对比度和多种加速倍数下的实验显示了该采集框架的自适应行为，并评测了其重建性能。
AI.conclusion: 以体积级预算约束下的自适应k空间分配替代固定模式与均匀切片预算，配合跨切片灵敏度感知重建，可在不依赖全采样参考的条件下实现高效加速MRI采集与重建。

title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
comment: 5 figures, 5 extended data figures, 5 extended data tables; includes Supplementary Information
summary: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.

AI.tldr: 该研究借鉴皮层发育的功能分化视角，用扩散映射嵌入刻画基座模型与推理训练模型的表征梯度，发现推理训练引起局部而非全局的层级重组；将这一连续层段（span）的权重移植到指令微调宿主模型，可平均提升数学推理能力且干扰较低。
AI.motivation: 人类皮层发育中功能系统逐步分化，作者据此提出类比性问题：语言模型推理能力的提升是否伴随可类比的"区域性重组"？即推理能力是否对应可定位、可迁移的特定参数区域，而非弥散于整个网络。
AI.method: 对三个模型家族中配对的基座模型与推理训练模型，施加常用于刻画皮层组织的扩散映射嵌入（diffusion-map embedding），比较其梯度剖面；识别一个连续的层段（span）后，从中提取权重并"嫁接"到指令微调宿主模型中，检验数学推理表现、原已解题目的保持率，并与其它位置的嫁接作对照；同时考察训练过程中该层段的形成时序，以及中间阶段嫁接的效果；最后在医学领域模型上重复同一分析以检验可迁移性。
AI.result: 梯度剖面总体保持，但在一连续层段内出现局部化改变；从该层段嫁接权重可平均提升宿主的数学推理，收益随区域重叠度上升，且相比其它位置的嫁接能保留更多原先已解出的问题；该层段在性能早期上升阶段逐步形成，来自中间训练阶段的嫁接亦有帮助；嫁接使多数宿主行为部分向供体偏移，有时甚至能解决供体本身失败的问题；在医学模型中也定位到类似的可迁移层段。
AI.conclusion: 推理训练对应一个可定位、可迁移的"推理相关区域"，其权重能在低干扰下提升宿主推理能力并基本保留其原有数学能力；表明功能分化式分析可为模型能力定位与跨模型权重迁移提供有效框架。

title: From Restoration to Redrawing: Revitalizing Ancient Chinese Characters by SVG Code Generation and Editing
summary: Hanjian manuscripts written on Han Dynasty bamboo and wooden slips are invaluable heritage of ancient Chinese writing but suffer from damaged ink and incomplete strokes. Existing image-to-image restoration methods may alter observed strokes and offer limited control over stroke geometry. Inspired by experts' manual redrawing practices, we address these issues by introducing \textbf{ReDraw}, a two-stage vision-language model(VLM) that reformulates character restoration as Scalable Vector Graphics(SVG) code generation and editing. Stage one targets faithful vectorization of observed strokes geometry or conservative tracing of mildly degraded strokes. Guided by skeleton chain-of-thought reasoning and reinforcement learning with structure-aware rewards, stage two predicts skeletons before contours to redraw severely incomplete strokes by appending paths while keeping existing SVG paths unchanged. To support training, we develop a multi-layer data synthesis pipeline that disentangles ink, material, and degradation to generate 1.2M samples, and derive up to 6,400 adaptation pairs from 320 annotated real glyphs. Experiments demonstrate synthetic restoration performance and adaptability to real Hanjian glyphs. Code and demo will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出ReDraw，将汉简字符修复重构为SVG矢量代码的生成与编辑任务，用两阶段视觉语言模型（VLM）实现：第一阶段忠实地矢量化可见笔画或保守描摹轻度退化笔画，第二阶段通过骨架链式思维与结构感知强化学习，先预测骨架再生成轮廓，以"追加路径、不改动已有路径"的方式重绘严重缺失笔画。
AI.motivation: 汉简墨迹受损、笔画残缺，是珍贵的古文字遗产。现有图像到图像（I2I）修复方法可能改动已观测到的笔画，且对笔画几何形状缺乏可控性；而专家实际采用的是手工重描（redrawing）的方式，这一做法启发作者改用可编辑的矢量表示替代像素级重绘。
AI.method: (1) 任务重构：把字符修复表述为SVG代码生成与编辑，保证已有路径可保留、几何可控；(2) 两阶段VLM：Stage-1 对可见笔画做忠实矢量化、对轻度退化笔画做保守描摹；Stage-2 以骨架链式思维推理（skeleton CoT）+ 结构感知奖励的强化学习，先骨架后轮廓，仅在SVG中追加路径完成严重残缺笔画的补全；(3) 数据：构建多层数据合成管线，解耦墨、材质与退化因素，生成120万样本；并从320个真实标注字形派生最多6400个适配对，用于真实域适应。
AI.result: 实验显示该方法在合成数据上的修复性能良好，并能适配真实汉简字形；消融与数据规模（1.2M合成样本、最多6.4K真实适配对）支撑其有效性。代码与演示将在论文接收后公开。
AI.conclusion: 以矢量SVG生成为载体的两阶段VLM为古籍文字修复提供了不改动原有笔画的非破坏性修复范式，兼顾几何可控性与真实场景适应性。

title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
comment: Accepted at the AI4Mat Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. Across classification and regression tasks, TCAF outperforms MatterChat, with up to 47.8% lower RMSE, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and halving the overall training time. Further experiments incorporating UMA-S demonstrate TCAF's flexibility across encoder combinations, with the three-encoder configuration achieving the highest macro-average classification accuracy of 89.61%.

AI.tldr: 提出TCAF（任务条件注意力融合）桥接模块，用任务条件化隐查询自适应选择并融合多结构编码器（CHGNet与Zatom-1中间层）表示，直接在下游任务上联合训练，性能优于MatterChat（RMSE最多降低47.8%）且参数更少、训练时间减半。
AI.motivation: 材料科学多模态语言模型需有效引入三维结构表示。现有MatterChat依赖大型桥接模块与独立的对比对齐阶段，且默认使用编码器最终层特征。作者发现监督式与生成式材料编码器提供互补信息，且Zatom-1中最具信息量的表示并非集中于最后一层，而是随目标性质出现在不同深度，因此需要一种能按任务自适应选择与组合多编码器表示的桥接机制。
AI.method: TCAF为轻量注意力桥接模块：以任务条件化隐查询（task-conditioned latent queries）对CHGNet特征与Zatom-1多个中间层表示进行注意力选择与融合，并直接在下游预测任务上训练，使表示选择与材料—语言对齐联合学习，无需单独的对比预训练；进一步验证可扩展至UMA-S构成三编码器配置。
AI.result: 在分类与回归任务上TCAF均优于MatterChat，RMSE最高降低47.8%，同时可训练参数显著更少、总体训练时间减半；引入UMA-S的三编码器配置取得最高宏平均分类准确率89.61%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，多编码器表示按任务条件自适应融合是替代重型桥接+独立对比对齐范式的有效方案，兼具性能与效率优势，并具备跨编码器组合的灵活性。

title: Object Pose: The Link between Weak Perspective, Paraperspective, and Full Perspective
summary: Recently, DeMenthon and Davis [4,5] proposed a method for determining the pose of a 3-D object with respect to a camera from 3-D to 2-D point correspondences. The method consists of iteratively improving the pose computed with a weak perspective camera model to converge, at the limit, to a pose estimation computed with a perspective camera model. In this paper we give an algebraic derivation of DeMenthon and Davis' method and we show that it belongs to a larger class of methods where the perspective camera model is approximated either at zero order (weak perspective) or first order (paraperspective). We describe in detail an iterative paraperspective pose computation method for both non coplanar and coplanar object points. We analyse the convergence of these methods and we conclude that the iterative paraperspective method (proposed in this paper) has better convergence properties than the iterative weak perspective method. We introduce a simple way of taking into account the orthogonality constraint associated with the rotation matrix. We analyse the sensitivity to camera calibration errors and we define the optimal experimental setup with respect to imprecise camera calibration. We compare the results obtained with this method and with a non-linear optimization method.

AI.tldr: 本文对DeMenthon与Davis的迭代位姿估计方法给出代数推导，指出其属于"用零阶(弱透视)或一阶(副透视)近似透视相机模型"的一大类方法，并详述迭代副透视位姿计算法，证明其收敛性优于迭代弱透视法。
AI.motivation: DeMenthon与Davis提出的方法仅以迭代改进弱透视位姿逼近透视位姿，缺乏代数层面的理论解释，也未被置于统一的近似框架中；同时透视投影的近似阶数、收敛行为、旋转正交约束处理、标定误差敏感性及最优实验布局等问题尚未得到系统分析。
AI.method: 对原方法作代数推导，并将其统一为透视相机模型的零阶(弱透视)与一阶(副透视)近似族；详细构造适用于非共面与共面物点的迭代副透视位姿计算算法；分析各方法的收敛性；引入一种简便方式施加旋转矩阵的正交约束；分析对标定误差的敏感性并给出最优实验配置；与非线性优化方法作对比实验。
AI.result: 迭代副透视方法(本文提出)相比迭代弱透视方法具有更好的收敛性质；给出了正交约束的简便处理方式；明确了对标定误差的敏感性规律及相应最优实验布局；与非线性优化方法的对比结果被给出(摘要未列具体数值)。
AI.conclusion: DeMenthon与Davis方法可视为透视模型近似族中的特例；采用一阶副透视近似的迭代法在收敛性上优于弱透视版本，且配合简便的正交约束处理与合理的实验设计，可获得对标定误差稳健的位姿估计，并具备与非线性优化可比的精度。

title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
summary: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matching, tuned baselines and paired seeds. Orthogonalizing Q, K and V separately rather than as one fused matrix lowers the loss by 0.0250 nats and accounts for all of the gain of block-wise variants. A matmul-only, rotation-equivariant spectral tilt $σ^{-1/4}$ applied in the cooldown lowers the loss of this stronger baseline by a further 0.0120 nats, additively with NorMuon (0.0158 nats together, three seeds; the baseline needs about 4.3% more tokens to match), and by 0.0188 nats at 355M parameters (three seeds). Energy-matched Schatten-1 weight decay adds a further 0.0052 nats. Geometrically principled changes that do not act on the measured miscalibration, namely exact polar factors, steepest-descent input whitening and top-heavy decay, do not help.

AI.tldr: 该论文以二阶曲率诊断Muon优化器的谱步长分配，发现其在高曲率顶端过步，并据此推导出可验证的干预准则，实证给出解耦QKV正交化与谱倾斜σ^{-1/4}两项有效改进。
AI.motivation: Muon沿动量极因子（谱范数下最速下降方向）更新，这一选择隐含两个不依赖损失函数的分配：所有奇异方向步长相同，非方阵中各神经元的步长由其杠杆分数决定。这些分配是否合理取决于曲率，而最速下降论证本身无法回答。作者因此希望直接测量曲率，检验Muon步长是否与二阶结构失配。
AI.method: 用留出梯度与Hessian-向量积，将Muon更新按奇异值带与神经元组分解，计算各组的二阶最优乘子（optimal multiplier），从而量化各方向的过步/欠步程度；并在Lean中形式化证明何种情况下该诊断可授权在Muon自身更新范数下进行干预（每步范数匹配）。随后在124M参数FineWeb-Edu解码器上做对照实验：配对种子、调优基线、范数匹配，测试解耦Q/K/V正交化、仅matmul的旋转等变谱倾斜σ^{-1/4}、NorMuon、Schatten-1权重衰减，以及若干"几何上合理但不作用于测得失配"的变体作为负对照。
AI.result: 最优乘子从谱顶端到尾端单调上升，表明Muon在高曲率顶端过步。基于实测曲率，准则预测并经留出损失确认：将步长从顶端转移在训练中期和cooldown早期有益、在cooldown末期无益。分别正交化Q、K、V（而非融合为单一矩阵）使损失降低0.0250 nats，并解释了block-wise变体的全部增益；cooldown中施加σ^{-1/4}谱倾斜在此更强基线上再降0.0120 nats，与NorMuon可加（合计0.0158 nats，三个种子；基线需多约4.3% token才能追平），在355M参数上降0.0188 nats（三个种子）；能量匹配的Schatten-1权重衰减再降0.0052 nats。精确极因子、最速下降输入白化、top-heavy衰减等未作用于测得失配的几何改进无效。
AI.conclusion: Muon的谱步长分配与曲率失配，且失配可从二阶测量中直接定位；该诊断在形式化准则下可转化为安全的干预。有效改进（解耦QKV正交化、σ^{-1/4}谱倾斜、Schatten-1衰减）均是针对实测失配的行动，而"理论优雅"但与失配无关的改动无效，说明以曲率测量驱动的优化器设计比纯几何直觉更可靠。

title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to KDD 2027. Project page is at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page
summary: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at https://whalesong-zrs.github.io/RoughCut-Bench-Project-Page.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 RoughCut-Bench，首个面向前粗剪（rough-cut）任务的综合基准，并给出基于 LVLM 的智能体工作流以生成结构化剪辑方案；实验表明现有 LVLM 尚难以产出与专家一致的剪辑方案。
AI.motivation: 视频前粗剪是媒体制作的核心环节，但自动前粗剪在大视觉语言模型（LVLM）时代仍研究不足：缺乏统一评测基准，也缺少成熟的、可产出可执行剪辑方案的工作流。因此需要同时填补"评测空白"与"方法空白"。
AI.method: 1) 构建 RoughCut-Bench，覆盖两类实际场景：视觉驱动场景（视频案例，含高光检测与选择、源视频排序、遵循用户需求）与语音驱动场景（基于 ASR 转写文本，含填充词去除、表达去重、低价值内容裁剪）。2) 视觉设置含 101 个案例、831 段原始视频、1476 条高光标注；语音设置含 84 个案例，每个为带清洗片段标注的 ASR 转写。3) 评测双轨：将剪辑方案与标注比对，并在视觉设置中额外使用与人类对齐的智能体评估器评判渲染成片质量。4) 提出智能体工作流，引导 LVLM 从原始素材生成结构化剪辑方案。
AI.result: 实验显示当前 LVLM 在生成与专家对齐的剪辑方案方面仍存在明显局限（能力有限），说明该任务对现有模型构成实质性挑战。
AI.conclusion: RoughCut-Bench 建立了自动前粗剪的评测体系与结构化方案生成范式，揭示了 LVLM 的不足，为后续研究提供基准、代码与提示词（已开源）。

title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
summary: Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 zonotope 与 constrained zonotope 的抽象解释框架，用统一的 round-clamp 抽象变换器联合处理量化中的离散舍入与截断，并在 ACAS Xu 上验证其误差界更紧、速度更快。
AI.motivation: 量化神经网络通过降低精度提升计算效率，但由于舍入（rounding）与截断（clamping）是离散操作，其量化误差难以被紧致地界定；现有验证方法（如符号 DRA 传播）在紧致性与效率上仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 构建面向量化 ReLU 前馈网络验证的 zonotope 抽象解释框架；引入一个同时处理 round 与 clamp 的统一 round-clamp 抽象变换器；进一步扩展到 constrained zonotope（在 zonotope 上附加线性约束以收紧边界），并推导可靠的量化误差表示；理论上证明该变换器的 soundness 与仿射条带（affine-strip）最优性，以及其完整约束形式的凸包（convex-hull）最优性。
AI.result: 在 ACAS Xu 基准上，于测试的最小扰动半径 r=3 与 r=6 处，constrained zonotope 方法相较 QEBVerif 的符号 DRA 传播将平均误差界宽度降低约 70-85%，运行时间减少 65-80%；但改进并非在所有位宽上一致，符号 DRA 在更大半径下界更紧。普通 zonotope 方法给出有竞争力的可靠界，且平均快约 300 倍。
AI.conclusion: 统一的 round-clamp 抽象变换器及其 constrained zonotope 扩展为量化网络验证提供了理论最优性保证与显著的实际效率—紧致性收益；两类方法各有适用区间：constrained zonotope 适合小扰动半径，符号 DRA 适合大半径，plain zonotope 则以极高速度提供可用界。

title: TrajWAM: Trajectory-Conditioned Future Learning for Vision-Language Driving
comment: 22 pages, including supplementary material. Code and model weights: https://github.com/FangWD520/TrajWAM
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) connect future scene prediction with action planning for autonomous driving. Each driving record pairs an executed ego trajectory with its observed future, providing a factual outcome for learning this connection. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-conditioned WAM that improves vision-language driving through auxiliary bird's-eye-view (BEV) future learning. An ego-trajectory query conditions DINOv3-aligned BEV predictions from shared planner representations. Training combines factual reconstruction under the executed trajectory with one-sided feature separation under an unlabeled perturbed trajectory. Together, these objectives train the shared planner to generate driving waypoints. Native inference directly generates waypoints and bypasses the auxiliary future-prediction branch. On all 220 Bench2Drive routes, TrajWAM achieves 91.53 Driving Score and 75.45% Success Rate, exceeding a schedule-matched planning-only fine-tuning baseline by 5.31 Driving Score points and eight successful routes.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹条件下的世界动作模型 TrajWAM，通过辅助 BEV 未来预测学习提升视觉-语言驾驶规划，在 Bench2Drive 全部 220 条路线上取得 91.53 驾驶分数与 75.45% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型需将未来场景预测与动作规划有效连接，而每条驾驶记录中"已执行自车轨迹—观测未来"构成的事实配对可作为学习该连接的监督信号；现有视觉-语言驾驶规划缺乏对未来预测的显式利用。
AI.method: 以自车轨迹查询作为条件，从共享规划器表示中预测与 DINOv3 对齐的 BEV 特征。训练采用双目标：(1) 在执行轨迹下的事实性重构；(2) 在无标注扰动轨迹下的单侧特征分离。二者共同训练共享规划器输出行驶路点；推理时原生路径直接生成路点，绕过辅助未来预测分支。
AI.result: 在 Bench2Drive 全部 220 条路线上，TrajWAM 达到 91.53 驾驶分数与 75.45% 成功率，相较调度匹配的纯规划微调基线提升 5.31 驾驶分数点，并多通过 8 条路线。
AI.conclusion: 辅助未来 BEV 预测可作为有效的训练期正则/表征学习信号，在推理零额外开销的前提下显著增强视觉-语言驾驶规划性能，验证了轨迹条件世界模型建模思路的价值。

title: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
summary: Organizations increasingly deploy downloaded open-weight GUI agents. A backdoored agent passes acceptance tests on clean data and misbehaves only when a visual trigger appears on screen, turning an unvetted checkpoint into a supply-chain risk. However, existing sample-level detectors target image classifiers and CLIP-style encoders, leaving step-level backdoor detection for GUI agents unaddressed. On clean steps, the instruction drives the action; when an unreferenced screen region hijacks the step, the instruction loses control over the decision state or that region dictates it instead. We term this signature intent--evidence dominance inversion and propose IDEA (Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit) to detect backdoor activation at inference time for each step without trigger knowledge or attack data. Specifically, Intent Counterfactual Probing (ICP) measures how far redirected instructions move the decision state, and Region Causal Audit (RCA) quantifies how far ablating a candidate region moves it. A gated conformal score compares both displacements against clean steps at the same distance from the clean manifold, providing a finite-sample false-positive guarantee. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families show that IDEA consistently detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate and outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods, while localizing the trigger region for every alarm and adding only modest inference overhead.

AI.tldr: IDEA 通过"意图—证据支配反转"这一签名，在推理阶段对 GUI 智能体的每一步做后门激活检测，无需触发知识或攻击数据，并在有限样本假阳性保证下实现检测与触发区域定位。
AI.motivation: 开源权重 GUI 智能体下载即用，攻击者可植入视觉触发式后门：模型在干净数据上通过验收测试，仅在屏幕出现特定视觉触发时误行为，构成供应链风险。现有样本级检测器针对图像分类器与 CLIP 类编码器，缺乏面向 GUI 智能体的步级后门检测。
AI.method: 提出签名"意图—证据支配反转"：干净步由指令主导动作，被无关屏幕区域劫持的步则由该区域主导。据此设计 IDEA：Intent Counterfactual Probing（ICP）度量重定向指令使决策状态偏移的程度；Region Causal Audit（RCA）度量消融候选区域使决策状态的偏移程度；再用门控保形分数将两种位移与同等"离流形距离"下的干净步比较，提供有限样本假阳性保证。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上针对五类攻击家族的实验表明，IDEA 在受控假阳性率下稳定检出后门激活，优于现有 SOTA 检测方法；每次告警均能定位触发区域，推理开销仅适度增加。
AI.conclusion: 将后门检测转化为"决策状态的意图/证据影响力归因对比"是可行且有效的步级检测范式，具备无需触发先验、可解释定位与统计保证的优势。

title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
summary: Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks recover none exactly.

AI.tldr: 提出一种迭代式"剥离纠缠"的梯度反演攻击流程，首次实现对联邦学习文本聚合梯度的精确句子恢复（100% 精度）。
AI.motivation: 文本场景下的梯度反演攻击此前无法实现精确文本恢复，原因是 FedAvg 将多个客户端的梯度贡献混合，单条句子的信号被其他客户端掩盖；作者希望突破这一"聚合纠缠"瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建迭代攻击管线：在每一轮中，将已精确恢复句子的梯度贡献从聚合梯度中减去，从而暴露剩余句子的信号，进入下一轮继续恢复，逐步解耦聚合梯度。
AI.result: 首次实现 100% 精度的精确句子恢复；当聚合 token 数达到模型隐藏维度的 4 倍时，仍可精确恢复至多 80.2% 的客户端句子，而现有攻击在该设定下无法精确恢复任何句子。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式减法解耦可有效破解 FedAvg 的梯度纠缠，显著扩展精确文本反演的攻击可行域，说明联邦学习文本训练存在更严峻的隐私风险。

title: Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation
summary: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. To reduce target fluctuations over long horizons, early goal commitment (EGC) fixes the execution target to the coordinate-wise median of the first $K$ predictions without extra trainable parameters. On Test Unseen, CityNav-VLA reduces NE by 21.2% and improves SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9%, respectively. It also reduces NE by 6.2% and improves SR and SPL by 5.6% and 23.2%, respectively, relative to the former SOTA after dataset refinement. Cumulative ablations show that navigation-map features yield the largest gains, while metric coordinates further improve endpoint accuracy. With a 4B-scale backbone, inference averages 0.68 s per decision with 8.6 GB peak memory on a single A100, presenting remarkable model efficiency.

AI.tldr: CityNav-VLA 是一个双坐标系视觉-语言-动作模型，把动态自我中心感知与持久的地理固定（north-up）空间记忆结合，用于语言目标城市无人机导航；在 Test Unseen 上 NE 降低 21.2%，SR/SPL 提升 15.8%/30.9%。
AI.motivation: 语言目标空中导航的核心难点在于：变化的自我中心感知与长程导航所需的、锚定在稳定位置的空间证据之间难以建立联系。现有方法难以在视角变化下持续保留证据并支持长程全局推理。
AI.method: 提出 CityNav-VLA：1）无人机在固定的 north-up 地图上增量累积视觉观测，地图以地理与地标先验初始化，从而在视角变化下保留证据（异我中心空间记忆）；2）以指令、当前观测、UAV 状态和运动历史为条件的动态查询检索相关记忆证据，预测地图坐标系下的目标点；3）确定性控制器利用当前位姿将地图系目标转换为机体坐标系指令，衔接全局推理与自我中心执行；4）早承诺机制（EGC）将执行目标固定为前 K 次预测的逐坐标中位数，不增加可训练参数以抑制长时程目标抖动。
AI.result: Test Unseen 上 NE 降低 21.2%，SR、SPL 分别提升 15.8% 与 30.9%；数据集精化后，相对前任 SOTA 仍降低 NE 6.2%，提升 SR 5.6%、SPL 23.2%。累积消融显示导航地图特征贡献最大，度量坐标进一步提升终点精度。4B 规模骨干下单次决策平均 0.68 s，单张 A100 峰值显存 8.6 GB，效率良好。
AI.conclusion: 双坐标系设计（地图系全局推理 + 机体系执行）与持久异我中心记忆是提升长程语言引导空中导航的有效范式；无需额外参数的中位数早承诺可稳定长时程目标；地图特征为主要增益来源，模型在 4B 规模下具备实用推理效率。

title: SCOPE: Single-Cell Omics Prediction from Histology via RNA-Protein Prior Enhancement
summary: Predicting the RNA and protein content of cells from routine H&E images could extend spatial molecular profiling to existing slide archives. However, both H&E-spatial proteomics and H&E-spatial transcriptomics paired datasets are limited by the number of available markers and the insufficient availability of high-quality, cell-resolved data. We present SCOPE (Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement), a unified framework that leverages biologically complementary information between RNA and proteins to address the limited availability of single-omics supervision. Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. To this end, SCOPE introduces biologically informed biomarker priors to enhance shared gene-level representations, enabling knowledge transfer across RNA and protein modalities through gene-protein correspondence and molecular associations. By exploiting these complementary relationships, SCOPE enables both prediction tasks to benefit from a shared backbone enriched with cross-omics biological knowledge. Furthermore, its biomarker correlation design facilitates the prediction of unseen markers, extending spatially resolved molecular profiling beyond directly supervised targets. Across test datasets spanning 16 organs, SCOPE improves the average RNA Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 8.8%. On two external protein cohorts, it improves the average Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 9.7% for seen markers and 11.9% for unseen markers.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一个利用RNA与蛋白之间生物学互补知识进行跨模态先验增强的统一框架，从常规H&E图像预测细胞RNA与蛋白含量。
AI.motivation: H&E-空间蛋白组学与H&E-空间转录组学配对数据受限于标记数量有限、高质量单细胞分辨率数据不足，单组学监督信号稀缺。
AI.method: 引入生物学启发的生物标志物先验增强共享的基因级表征，通过基因-蛋白对应关系与分子关联实现RNA与蛋白间的知识迁移；两任务共享富含跨组学生物学知识的骨干网络，并设计生物标志物相关性机制以预测未见标记。
AI.result: 在覆盖16个器官的测试集上，平均RNA Pearson相关较最强基线提升8.8%；在两个外部蛋白队列上，已见标记平均Pearson相关提升9.7%，未见标记提升11.9%。
AI.conclusion: 跨组学生物学先验可有效缓解单模态监督不足，实现未见标记预测，将空间分子图谱扩展到现有切片档案。

title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
comment: 41 pages. Ancillary files: a public sample of 48 development instances with scripted-oracle episodes. Hosted evaluation: https://eval.openhagen.ai
summary: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system.
