On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Openhagen Worlds——含27个程序化生成环境、178个校准难度级别的实验推理与科学发现基准；每个级别仅在"脚本预言机≥0.75、最强非演绎策略≤0.25、各捷径≤0.35"时被接纳。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在84个留出前沿实例上默认努力解出32题、最高努力解出57题（预言机79），多阶段campaign仍是最大瓶颈；on-policy专家迭代使9B模型核心层成功率由0.090升至0.148且GPQA Diamond无退化。
AI.motivation: 现有科学发现基准无法把"主动设计实验并从结果推理"这一核心能力与记忆召回、未言明的评分规则或捷径策略区分开，导致测得的分数难以归因于真正的实验推理能力。作者希望构建一个评分规则完全显式、难度经过标定、可排除捷径的环境套件，从而干净地测量智能体的实验设计与推断能力。
AI.method: 构建27个程序化生成环境（部分为有限真值空间），覆盖经典实验推理谜题、基于模拟器的物理与化学等，智能体在预算内做实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器对照隐藏真值判分；每条观测均披露完整评分规则。难度采用三级校准门控：64个开发实例上，脚本预言机成功率≥0.75、最强合理非演绎策略≤0.25、每个受门控捷径≤0.35，才被纳入。共178级：92个核心级覆盖全部27个族并针对小模型规模设计；86个前沿阶梯在15个发现世界上加难，并引入同一隐藏系统上3、5、8+阶段的连续campaign。评测使用84个族×阶梯各一的留出前沿实例，并采用on-policy专家迭代训练9B模型。
AI.result: 在84个留出前沿实例上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 默认推理努力（每次调用16,384 tokens）解出32题，最高努力（单次调用至多393,216 tokens）解出57题，预言机为79，说明测试时算力可显著提升表现但仍有可观余量；剩余差距在八阶段campaign中最突出，表明长程多阶段实验设计是主要瓶颈。训练侧，on-policy专家迭代使9B模型在已训练族上的核心层成功率从0.090提升到0.148，部分收益来自动作格式改善，且在GPQA Diamond上无可检测的性能损失。另有一个托管服务完成了核心层留出实例的评测。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式评分规则、基于预言机与捷径的难度门控以及分阶段campaign，Openhagen Worlds 提供了一个能隔离实验推理能力的可扩展基准，揭示了当前前沿模型与预言机之间仍存在的明显差距，尤其是长程多阶段实验规划；同时表明on-policy专家迭代可为小模型带来真实但有限的提升。不过摘要中9B模型提升幅度仍小，核心层成功率仅0.148，说明该能力对现有训练方法依然具有挑战性。

title: ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events
summary: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.

AI.tldr: ALIVE：利用事件流对冻结DINOv3编码器的多层特征进行增量式更新，无需重复运行图像编码器即可在图像观测之间刷新视觉基础模型特征；仅用合成数据训练，直接迁移到真实事件流，在检测/分割/深度估计上全面优于现有事件方法，并降低82.4% FLOPs与2.5倍时延。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型特征随视觉内容变化而"过时"，刷新特征需新帧并反复运行高成本图像编码器，计算开销大；事件相机具备高时间分辨率与低冗余，天然适合在帧间增量更新特征。
AI.method: 以锚点图像经冻结DINOv3提取的多层特征为起点，用其后的事件流将其"传输+校正"到当前时刻；设计轻量级更新器，端到端训练，仅使用合成数据、无下游任务监督；训练后零样本直接迁移至真实事件流。
AI.result: 在3个真实数据集、5个任务-数据集设置的检测、语义分割、深度估计上，所有指标均优于所评估的事件方法。DSEC上锚帧时龄200 ms时，检测+30.9 mAP、分割+11.6 mIoU、深度AbsRel改善15.9%；相比重编码图像，FLOPs减少82.4%，时延降低2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的特征增量更新可有效替代高成本的图像重编码，实现基础模型特征的时序刷新；合成数据训练+零样本迁移验证了方法的泛化性，为低成本、低时延的连续视觉感知提供可行范式。

title: EVF-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for E-commerce Visual Effects in Video Generation
summary: E-commerce visual effects (EVF) are dynamic, product-centered visual presentations in e-commerce videos, often accompanied by promotional text. They play an important role in attracting viewer attention and conveying product information. However, general measures of visual quality and text relevance alone do not establish whether generated videos preserve product appearance, maintain readable text, and produce coherent, contextually appropriate effects. To address this issue, we introduce EVF-Bench, a dedicated benchmark spanning six evaluation dimensions: visual quality and text relevance as general dimensions, and motion, product consistency, text stability, and creative rationality as EVF-specific dimensions. To complement the benchmark and support task-aligned research and model adaptation, we further construct EVF-32K, a dataset of over 32000 curated image-text-video triples tailored to e-commerce scenarios. Using this suite, we systematically evaluate representative video generation models and their domain-adapted variants. The results reveal complementary strengths, with no evaluated configuration leading all six dimensions. Together, EVF-Bench and EVF-32K provide a task-oriented evaluation framework and a supporting data resource for e-commerce video generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向电商视觉效果（EVF）的评测基准 EVF-Bench 与配套数据集 EVF-32K，用于系统评估视频生成模型在电商场景下的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 电商视觉特效（EVF）是电商视频中以商品为中心、常配促销文字的动态视觉呈现，对吸引注意力和传递商品信息至关重要。但通用的视觉质量与文本相关性指标无法判断生成视频是否保持商品外观、文字可读性，以及效果是否连贯、语境合理，缺乏针对性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 EVF-Bench 基准，涵盖六个评测维度：通用维度为视觉质量与文本相关性，EVF 专用维度为运动、商品一致性、文字稳定性与创意合理性；同时构建 EVF-32K 数据集，包含 3.2 万余条面向电商场景的精选图文视频三元组，以支撑任务对齐的研究与模型适配，并对代表性视频生成模型及其领域适配变体进行系统评测。
AI.result: 评测结果显示各模型能力互补，没有任何一个被测配置能在全部六个维度上领先；领域适配变体在部分 EVF 专用维度上有提升，但整体仍存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: EVF-Bench 与 EVF-32K 共同提供了面向任务的评测框架与数据资源，为电商视频生成的研究与模型改进奠定基础。

title: Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
comment: 15 pages (9 main + references + appendix), 5 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference (NLDL 2027); to appear in PMLR vol. 352
summary: Gradient-based meta-learners such as model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) adapt to a new task with an inner loop of gradient descent that has to be differentiated through, and they meta-learn every network weight. Meta-LSQ instead fits each task with one regularised least-squares solve over a fixed random Fourier basis and meta-learns only three scalars, a bandwidth, a ridge and a derivative weight. Since the derivative of a sinusoid is again a sinusoid, the same solve can also take derivative observations, and the fitted model has exact closed-form derivatives of any order. On 10-shot sinusoid regression Meta-LSQ trains in 14 s and ends with a 5.5 times lower error than a first-order MAML baseline that trains 36 times longer, and a Gaussian-process control suggests that most of this gain comes from sharing one kernel across tasks. In simulated beam tuning at DESY's ARES facility with model derivatives it is slightly more accurate than an ALPaCA-style model and well ahead of gradient descent. Over DESY's full range of target beams, again in simulation and from measurements alone, its best setting has a median error of 7.3 $μ$m, against 14.4 for the published final beams of their reinforcement-learning agent, which has the lower median on their 300 trials of small targets. On real sensor-calibration data a learned prior mean puts it ahead of MAML on two of four targets, but an exact Gaussian process with the same change and an ALPaCA-style model stay more accurate on most targets, and it breaks down on non-smooth targets. On noiseless targets outside the span of the basis, in-sample criteria such as generalised cross-validation choose too small a ridge.

AI.tldr: 提出 Meta-LSQ：在固定随机 Fourier 基上对每个任务做一次正则化最小二乘求解，仅元学习带宽、岭系数与导数权重三个标量；训练仅需 14 秒即在 10-shot 正弦回归上比一阶 MAML 误差低 5.5 倍，并在仿真束流调谐中具备竞争力，但在真实数据与非光滑目标上存在局限。
AI.motivation: MAML 类梯度元学习器需要对内循环梯度下降做二阶微分并元学习全部网络权重，计算与显存开销大。作者希望用解析可解的闭式模型替代内循环优化，把元学习自由度压缩到极少量标量，同时天然支持导数观测与任意阶闭式导数。
AI.method: 对每个任务在固定随机 Fourier 基上求解一次正则化最小二乘（岭回归）。因正弦函数的导数仍为正弦，同一求解可直接纳入导数观测，模型导数任意阶精确闭式可得。元学习参数仅为三个标量：基带宽、岭系数、导数项权重。对比基线包括一阶 MAML、GP 控制、ALPaCA 风格模型与梯度下降。
AI.result: 10-shot 正弦回归：训练 14 s，误差比训练时长 36 倍的一阶 MAML 低 5.5 倍；GP 对照表明增益主要来自跨任务共享同一核。DESY ARES 仿真束流调谐（含模型导数）：略优于 ALPaCA 风格模型，显著优于梯度下降；全目标束范围下最优设置中位误差 7.3 μm，对比已发表 RL 智能体最终束的 14.4 μm，但后者在其 300 次小目标试验上中位误差更低。真实传感器标定数据：学习先验均值使其在 4 个目标中的 2 个上优于 MAML，但同设置的精确 GP 与 ALPaCA 风格模型在多数目标上更准，且在非光滑目标上失效。无噪声、超出基张成空间的目标下，GCV 等样本内准则选择的岭系数过小。
AI.conclusion: Meta-LSQ 以极小元学习参数换取了训练效率与导数可解析性，在合成回归与部分束流调谐场景中有效，但并非普遍优于 GP/ALPaCA 类贝叶斯方法；其适用性依赖目标平滑性与基函数张成范围，且基于样本内准则的岭选择在分布外情形不可靠。

title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出DRIFT：将轻量语言模型(小于150M)嵌入端到端自动驾驶，并用从LM蒸馏的代理推理特征训练可运行时切换的规划模块，实现255M参数下Bench2Drive DS 97.03、成功率89.39%，且可绕过LM而不损失驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: VLM为端到端自动驾驶提供场景描述与推理能力，但计算开销大；且现有方法无法在运行时自由开关语言推理而不损害闭环性能，阻碍实际部署。
AI.method: 1) 将中间驾驶表征高效投影到语言嵌入空间，使紧凑LM同时完成视觉问答与动作评论；2) 引入运行时灵活的规划模块，训练时使用从LM蒸馏的代理推理特征，推理时可按需以LM或代理特征为条件，从而可完全绕过LM；3) 支持以选定推理频率交错使用LM与代理推理。
AI.result: 仅255M参数，在Bench2Drive上DS达97.03、成功率89.39%（三次运行均值），与最强非语言模型持平且远小于现有VLM方案；在真实场景NAVSIM与AlpaSim上取得有竞争力结果，计算成本显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 轻量语言模型结合代理推理蒸馏可在保持紧凑与低算力的同时获得强闭环性能，并提供可部署的运行时推理开关灵活性。

title: How Well Do Generalist CT Foundation Models Differentiate Liver Tumors?
summary: Generalist CT foundation models detect many findings with high performance, but their ability to differentiate detected lesions remains largely unevaluated. This retrospective study evaluated two generalist models, RADAR and Merlin, for differentiating liver tumors using a public single-institution multiphase CT dataset (517 cases: hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, breast and colorectal cancer liver metastases, and hemangioma). The models were evaluated in a zero-shot setting using their existing outputs and with linear probing, in which only a linear classifier was trained on frozen image features (stratified fivefold cross-validation repeated five times). In the zero-shot setting, RADAR achieved an accuracy of 54.4% (95% CI: 49.9, 58.8) and a $κ$ of 0.37 for four-class differentiation at the portal venous phase and predicted 31% (129 of 421) of malignant tumors as hemangioma. With linear probing of four-phase features, its accuracy improved to 79.9% (95% CI: 76.6, 83.4) with a $κ$ of 0.72, and 1% (five of 421) of malignant tumors were predicted as hemangioma; Merlin achieved an accuracy of 60.9% (95% CI: 56.9, 65.0). Generalist CT foundation models showed limited zero-shot ability to differentiate liver tumors, which improved substantially with linear probing alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估通用CT基础模型（RADAR、Merlin）在肝脏肿瘤鉴别诊断上的能力：零样本表现有限，但仅用线性探针即可显著提升。
AI.motivation: 通用CT基础模型能以高性能检出多种病灶，但其区分已检出病变（如不同肝脏肿瘤类型）的能力尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，采用公开单中心多期相CT数据集（517例，含肝细胞癌、肝内胆管癌、乳腺癌与结直肠癌肝转移、血管瘤）。在零样本设置下直接使用模型既有输出，并进行线性探针评估（冻结图像特征，仅训练线性分类器；分层五折交叉验证重复五次）。
AI.result: 零样本下，RADAR在门静脉期四分类准确率54.4%（95% CI: 49.9–58.8），κ=0.37，并将31%（129/421）恶性肿瘤预测为血管瘤。基于四期相特征做线性探针后，准确率升至79.9%（95% CI: 76.6–83.4），κ=0.72，仅1%（5/421）恶性肿瘤被预测为血管瘤；Merlin零样本准确率为60.9%（95% CI: 56.9–65.0）。
AI.conclusion: 通用CT基础模型零样本鉴别肝脏肿瘤的能力有限，但仅通过线性探针即可获得实质性提升，提示其特征具备可用判别信息，但需任务适配。

title: How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
summary: The rapidly expanding generative AI landscape brings together methods that differ in architecture, learning objective, mathematical representation and sampling procedure. A concise, selectively organised technical guide can provide an accessible starting point for developing a coherent understanding of this increasingly complex landscape. This article takes a generation-centred approach, connecting how models produce new observations with the modelling and learning principles that make generation possible. We develop a two-level perspective: first, distinguishing three recurring generation routes-direct transformation or decoding, sequential conditional construction, and iterative updating or transport; and second, examining the modelling and learning principles underlying these routes. Representative approaches are introduced through their key components, learning objectives and sampling procedures. We then examine their broader connections, including how different architectures and generation mechanisms can overlap or be combined. By bringing together essential technical explanations within a compact conceptual framework, the article aims to help readers develop a working understanding of unfamiliar approaches, recognise connections among models they have encountered, and navigate different approaches within the broader generative AI landscape.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇面向生成式AI的技术综述/指南，以"生成方式"为中心将各类方法组织为两条线索：三条生成路径（直接变换/解码、序列条件构造、迭代更新/传输）与其下的建模与学习原理，从而为规模庞大、架构与目标各异的方法体系提供统一的概念框架。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI领域迅速扩张，各类方法在架构、学习目标、数学表示和采样程序上差异显著，初学者与跨领域研究者难以建立连贯的认识；现有文献多为单一范式或单一模型的深度介绍，缺少一个紧凑、精选组织、便于快速上手的整体性技术导引。
AI.method: 采用"以生成过程为中心"的分析视角，构建两级框架：第一级按"模型如何产生新观测"归纳出三条反复出现的生成路径——直接变换或解码（direct transformation/decoding）、序列条件式构造（sequential conditional construction）、迭代更新或传输（iterative updating/transport）；第二级考察支撑这些路径的建模与学习原理。对代表性方法，以关键组成部分、学习目标与采样程序三项要素进行介绍，并进一步讨论不同架构与生成机制之间的重叠与组合方式。
AI.result: 形式上产出的是一个统一的概念框架与选择性技术导引，而非新的实验结果或量化指标；其"结果"体现为该框架能够将架构、学习目标、数学模型与采样过程彼此关联，并说明各生成路径之间如何交叉、衔接与组合。
AI.conclusion: 通过把核心的技术解释压缩进紧凑的概念框架，文章旨在帮助读者建立对不熟悉方法的可操作理解、识别已接触模型之间的内在联系，并在更大的生成式AI版图中定位与比较不同方法；其定位是导引与整合，而非穷尽式综述。

title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
summary: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.

AI.tldr: 世界模型无法单独回答反事实问题，但利用"自然不作跳跃"（动力学二阶连续）性质，仅凭事实转移数据即可构建无额外数据/参数/重训的反事实世界模型，误差为 O(h²) 并给出匹配的极小极大下界，在多个仿真器上将反事实 R² 从 38–46% 提升至 86–96%。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在无法完全观测的环境中运行。当隐藏扰动（如推动船只的水流）改变动作结果时，会产生反事实问题：在同一扰动下采取不同动作会怎样？其答案可区分"决策失误"与"运气不佳"。论文指出，仅有事实转移训练的世界模型理论上无法回答该问题，因此需要一种无需反事实数据的替代方案。
AI.method: 证明仅用事实转移训练的模型无法回答反事实问题（无论数据量或容量）；利用物理系统的"自然不作跳跃"性质——当动作与扰动作为独立力作用时，二者交互在时间上是二阶的，故一阶近似下反事实结果 = 观测结果 + （世界模型在替代动作与事实动作下预测之差）。由此得到无需反事实数据、额外参数或重训练的反事实世界模型。理论分析给出相对扰动方差的 O(h²) 误差界与来自非配对事实数据的匹配极小极大下界，并刻画在间断点、坐标折叠、以及缩放指令型扰动下的失效情形。在冻结的 DINOv2 与 MAE 编码器上用 JEPA 世界模型从像素验证。
AI.result: 在四个渲染仿真器上，反事实 R² 从 38–46% 提升至 86–96%（同一世界模型）；第五个水下航行器场景在 16 倍事实数据下达到 90–94%。另外四种冻结编码器（DINOv3、SigLIP 2、CLIP、EVA-02）在同一批仿真器上取得 81–95%。在后见之明规划中，该方法在 35–69% 的事件中找到能达成目标的动作，而知道仿真器但不知结果的 oracle 规划器仅为 14–23%。
AI.conclusion: 反事实推断无需反事实数据即可实现，其关键在于利用动作与扰动的二阶交互结构；该方法具有理论保证（O(h²) 上界与匹配下界）、明确失效边界，并在多编码器、多仿真器上表现稳健，还能显著改善后见之明规划，为从事实数据中分离"坏决策"与"坏运气"提供了实用途径。

title: PatchAdaNet: Unsupervised class incremental learning using local patches and global adapters
summary: Biological learning systems acquire knowledge incrementally through broad, reusable representations established early and kept largely stable, while integrating new experience with minimal interference with previously learned knowledge. Replay-based methods approximate this by storing samples or features from previous tasks and mixing them into the current task. However, memory buffers grow with the number of tasks and may retain task-specific noise that reduces generalization. To address these limitations, we propose PatchAdaNet (Patch Adapter Network), an unsupervised class-incremental learning method for image classification that continually updates feature representations using autoencoders. Since images share structural features such as edges, corners, and shapes, we first divide each image into patches and train independent autoencoders on external data to reconstruct each patch. The layers of all patch encoders are aggregated into global frozen layers that generalize across tasks and remain fixed throughout learning. Learnable adapters then build global image representations from these features to reconstruct the entire image. To prevent feature drift without storing data, we introduce the Global Feature Centroid (GFC), a fixed-size running average of adapter outputs updated after each task to penalizes representation drift. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is applied to the learnable layers to preserve previously learned features by constraining important weights. Finally, a linear classifier is trained on the frozen latent representation and GFC for class-incremental evaluation. We evaluate PatchAdaNet in both CNN and Vision Transformer settings on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, miniImageNet and 5-Datasets, providing a comparative study of the two architectures under identical class-incremental settings. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 提出PatchAdaNet：一种无监督类增量学习方法，将图像分块并用独立自编码器提取特征、聚合为冻结全局层，再用可学习adapter与全局特征质心(GFC)、EWC约束抑制表示漂移，实现无需存储样本的类增量分类。
AI.motivation: 生物学习系统能增量获取知识且几乎不遗忘。基于回放的方法通过存储旧任务样本/特征来近似，但记忆缓冲区随任务数增长，且可能保留任务特有的噪声，降低泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 将每张图像划分为patch，在外部数据上训练独立自编码器重建各patch；2) 把所有patch编码器层聚合为跨任务通用的冻结全局层；3) 可学习adapter在这些特征上构建全局图像表示并重建整图；4) 引入固定大小的全局特征质心GFC——adapter输出的滑动平均，每个任务后更新，以惩罚表示漂移（无需存数据）；5) 对可学习层施加EWC约束重要权重；6) 在冻结潜在表示+GFC上训练线性分类器用于类增量评估。
AI.result: 在CNN与Vision Transformer两种设置下，于CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、miniImageNet和5-Datasets上进行评估，并给出相同类增量设定下两种架构的对比研究。
AI.conclusion: PatchAdaNet以patch级自编码器+冻结通用表示+轻量adapter的组合，配合GFC与EWC，实现无需记忆缓冲区的无监督类增量学习，避免记忆增长与任务噪声问题，并系统比较CNN与ViT在该设定下的表现。

title: Approximate Dynamic Programming with Basis Function Learning
summary: This work presents a novel approach for approximating the value function in Markov decision processes (MDPs). Our approach is grounded in the approximate linear programming (ALP) framework, wherein basis functions (BFs) play an important role. Traditionally, BFs have been pre-defined, randomly generated, or restricted to specific structures, which both limits the accuracy that can be achieved and leaves no mechanism for improving a given approximation. We instead learn BFs from the model itself, by repeatedly applying the Bellman operator to the current value estimate. We introduce the Bellman operator basis function (BOBF) learning method, and prove that each learned BF improves the approximation by a quantifiable amount and that the method converges to the optimal value function. Its shrunken counterpart (SBOBF) retains this guarantee while capping the number of BFs, and therefore the computational effort per iteration. For large-scale problems, where the number of constraints is prohibitive, we develop hybrid variants (HBOBF and SHBOBF) that combine constraint sampling with BF learning, and we show that the improvement and finite-termination guarantees are preserved under explicitly stated conditions. Numerical experiments on (continuous) perishable inventory and queueing control problems demonstrate that our BF learning techniques significantly outperform existing methods in the literature.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Bellman算子基函数学习的近似线性规划方法（BOBF及其变体），可证明逐次改进并收敛至最优值函数。
AI.motivation: ALP中基函数传统上为预定义、随机生成或受限于特定结构，既限制逼近精度，又缺乏改进已有逼近的机制。
AI.method: 以ALP为框架，通过对当前值估计反复施加Bellman算子从模型中学习基函数，提出BOBF；并给出限制基函数数量的SBOBF、结合约束采样的混合变体HBOBF与SHBOBF。
AI.result: 证明每个学习到的基函数带来可量化的逼近改进、方法收敛到最优值函数；SBOBF保持该保证并限定每轮计算量；混合变体在明确条件下保持改进性与有限终止性。在连续易腐库存与排队控制实验中显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 基函数可从模型中学得而非预设，兼顾理论保证与大规模问题的可计算性，实证效果优于文献中现有方法。

title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the WAM-AD Workshop, WACV 2027. Code: https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter
summary: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input. On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at https://github.com/binayksingh/does-action-matter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动作条件语义预测中的“动作依赖性”，用测试时动作干预与标准分割指标来验证预测是否真正依赖条件动作，而非仅看预测保真度与规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型评估聚焦预测保真度与规划表现，很少验证预测是否真正依赖所条件的自车动作，导致“准确率提升”可能掩盖模型对动作的不敏感性。
AI.method: 以过去语义分割和自车动作预测未来语义分割；对比特征级（feature-wise）与输入级（input-level）动作条件化模型及其无动作输入的相同模型；通过测试时动作干预（执行动作、错误动作）用标准分割指标衡量动作依赖性；在已知动作依赖动力学的合成环境中验证，再应用于 Cityscapes 与 BDD100K，并做数据集内与跨两种车辆平台的评估。
AI.result: 执行动作最多将中期 mIoU 提升 2.5 点（Cityscapes）与 0.6 点（BDD100K）；错误动作则最多使其下降 23.2 与 7.0 点，低于无动作输入模型。真实数据上特征级条件化在相近精度下对动作的依赖是输入级的 1.6 倍；而在历史无法决定动作的合成环境中，两者依赖程度相同。
AI.conclusion: 精度提升只能说明驾驶世界模型使用了动作，并不能说明其预测对动作的依赖强度；需以动作干预方式单独评估动作依赖性。

title: Inherited Adapter Experts for Replay-Free Domain-Incremental Learning
comment: 21 pages (8 pages main text, plus references and supplementary material), 8 figures, 23 tables
summary: Replay-free domain-incremental learning trains a model on the same classes in successive domains without keeping earlier images. Per-domain learners freeze a pre-trained ViT and train an additional expert for each new domain: the small set of parameters and the classification head learned on that domain. Test images carry no domain label, so a router selects one expert for each image. Recent work trains this router. However, a training-free Mahalanobis router costs the analyzed learners under 2.7 points of final accuracy relative to always selecting each image's own-domain expert. The experts, not this router, limit accuracy. Our learner, Lamarck, therefore uses this router and strengthens the experts. Its adapters, small trainable layers that correct every image token after each deep ViT block, add 4.4 points of final accuracy on the deepfake benchmark CDDB-Hard. In addition, each expert is initialized from its predecessor at no extra cost: the domains share their classes, so an image misrouted to a later expert loses less. Against twelve frozen-backbone baselines under one protocol, Lamarck is first on CDDB-Hard by 5.2 points, second on DomainNet and OfficeHome, and highest in mean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Lamarck：一种无回放（replay-free）的域增量学习方法。它冻结预训练 ViT，为每个新域训练一个专家，用免训练的 Mahalanobis 路由器在推理时选择专家；并针对"瓶颈在专家而非路由器"的发现，强化专家设计——使用校正每个图像 token 的适配器，并让每个专家由前一个专家初始化。在 CDDB-Hard 上按统一协议对比十二个冻结骨干基线，Lamarck 排名第一（+5.2 点），在 DomainNet 与 OfficeHome 上排名第二，平均准确率最高。
AI.motivation: 该论文的动机源于一个诊断性观察：在无回放域增量学习中，现有工作致力于训练路由（router），但作者发现瓶颈不在路由器——免训练的 Mahalanobis 路由器相对"始终选择正确域专家"的 oracle 仅损失不到 2.7 个点的最终准确率，真正限制性能的是专家（expert）本身。因此应将改进重心放在专家质量上。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 沿用免训练的 Mahalanobis 路由器为无域标签的测试图像选择专家，避免额外路由训练；(2) 强化专家：每个专家在冻结 ViT 的深层 block 之后加入小型可训练适配器层，对每个图像 token 进行校正；同时利用"各域共享同一类别集合"的性质，让每个专家在无额外开销下由其前驱专家初始化，从而缓解误路由到后续专家时的性能下降。
AI.result: 在 CDDB-Hard 深度伪造基准上，适配器带来 4.4 个点的最终准确率提升；在统一协议下与十二个冻结骨干基线对比，Lamarck 在 CDDB-Hard 上领先第二名 5.2 个点位居第一，在 DomainNet 与 OfficeHome 上位列第二，且平均准确率最高。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明：在免回放的域增量学习中，路由并非主要瓶颈，专家容量与质量才是关键；通过 token 级适配器增强专家并结合前驱初始化，可在不保存历史图像、不训练路由器的前提下取得领先的平均性能，同时保持较低的训练成本与简洁的流水线。

title: Uneven gains in protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material included as an ancillary file
summary: Accurate matched affinities determine mutation effects, but gains in aggregate affinity prediction may transfer unevenly to average effects, ordering and local accuracy. We evaluated eleven method families using method-specific matched populations. Controlled CoPRA reduced absolute-affinity mean absolute error from 1.2898 to 1.1431 pKd. Across 220 mutation pairs from 20 families, it generated stronger responses and improved mean-effect accuracy, with uncertain ranking gains and no decrease in mean centered local error. In an independent external test (24 quantitative pairs from three source-matched families), absolute and ordinary mutation-effect errors fell in all three families. Mean centered local error fell from 0.4198 to 0.3761 pKd, with improvements in two families and higher error in one. Error decomposition localized gains in landscape means. PRA-Pred feature tracing, fixed-weight M2-PRNet input controls and matched supervision interventions identified specific restrictions on mutation response. These results establish the need to evaluate average effects, ordering and quantitative local variation jointly.

AI.tldr: 论文评估了11类方法在"方法特异的匹配群体"上的突变效应预测表现，指出总体亲和力预测的增益并不能均匀转化到平均效应、排序与局部精度三个维度上。受控CoPRA将绝对亲和力MAE从1.2898降至1.1431 pKd；在20个家族220对突变上响应更强、平均效应更准，但排序增益不确定、中心化局部误差未下降。外部独立测试中绝对与常规突变效应误差在三家族均下降，中心化局部误差由0.4198降至0.3761 pKd（两家改善、一家变差），误差分解将增益定位在landscape均值上。
AI.motivation: 准确匹配的亲和力是判定突变效应的前提，但以往工作多以总体（聚合）亲和力预测精度为评价指标，隐含假设这些增益会均匀迁移到突变效应的平均效应、突变对排序以及局部定量精度上。本文旨在检验这一假设，并揭示不同方法族在匹配群体下的真实表现差异及其误差来源。
AI.method: 采用方法特异的匹配群体对11类方法族进行评测；提出受控CoPRA方法；构建由20个家族220对突变组成的评测集与24对定量突变的独立外部测试集（3个来源匹配家族）；采用误差分解（将误差拆分到landscape均值等成分）定位增益来源；并结合PRA-Pred特征追踪、固定权重M2-PRNet输入控制与匹配监督干预实验，识别对突变响应的具体限制。
AI.result: 受控CoPRA使绝对亲和力MAE由1.2898降至1.1431 pKd；在220对突变中产生更强响应并提升平均效应精度，但排序增益不确定，中心化局部误差未见降低。外部测试中3个家族的绝对误差与常规突变效应误差均下降；中心化局部误差由0.4198降至0.3761 pKd，其中2个家族改善、1个家族上升。误差分解表明增益主要集中于landscape均值；特征追踪与控制实验揭示了若干限制突变响应的具体因素。
AI.conclusion: 聚合亲和力预测的精度增益并不会均匀转化为突变效应预测的各子目标收益。因此，对突变效应方法应联合评估平均效应、排序与局部定量变异三类指标，而非仅依赖总体亲和力精度。

title: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
summary: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出NereidVLA视觉-语言-动作模型，通过Sea2Know海洋空间预训练迁移至语言条件的3D水下导航，仿真成功率由72.4%提升至84.4%，实测水池试验达78.75%。
AI.motivation: 水下导航需将视觉空间线索转化为运动，但现有海洋视觉-语言数据集极少包含配对的机器人轨迹，缺乏动作监督，导致空间知识难以直接用于下游运动学习与物理导航。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：先在约200万海洋样本上训练Sea2Know，学习目标定位、空间关系与场景结构（无配对机器人运动监督）；再用仿真水下航行器动力学下采集的专家轨迹进行适配。模型输入RGB历史与语言指令，输出离散运动token，解码为局部3D轨迹用于闭环跟踪。评估包括独立的六维水下导航理解基准、离线预测与闭环导航。
AI.result: 在匹配的导航训练与执行设置下，海洋空间预训练使仿真成功率从72.4%升至84.4%；未在真实测试环境微调情况下，实验室水池机器人试验成功率达78.75%，对比InternVLA-N1的47.50%。
AI.conclusion: 海洋空间监督可有效支撑下游运动学习与真实水下物理导航，验证了"空间预训练+动作适配"范式的可迁移性与闭环执行可行性。

title: SEER: Semantic Evidence for Executable Region Propagation in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) has made strong progress by adapting CLIP-like representations to dense prediction, but its remaining errors are often local, structured, and tied to the active label space. A successful correction must be visually plausible, legal under the target vocabulary, and executable in the segmentation score field. We propose SEER, a training-free test-time repair layer for Semantic Evidence and Executable Region propagation. SEER casts post-prediction OVSS repair as evidence-conditioned label propagation. The OVSS score space proposes compact candidate labels, a frozen VLM verifies closed-set regional evidence, and an execution gate certifies whether the evidence is legally and semantically actionable. The accepted label is then propagated by an OVSS-side policy: coherent high-confidence regions allow broad propagation, while object- or boundary-risk cases use conservative score-grounded propagation. Across eight standard OVSS benchmarks, SEER reaches 58.0 average mIoU without updating OVSS weights. Matched-input controls isolate the repair mechanism, while resource measurements report the cost of the complete frozen system.

AI.tldr: SEER:一个免训练的后预测修复层，将开放词汇语义分割(OVSS)的错误修正建模为"证据条件下的标签传播"，在冻结权重下于八个基准上达到58.0平均mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练OVSS方法通过将CLIP类表征适配到稠密预测已取得显著进展，但残余错误呈局部性、结构性、并依赖当前标签空间（label space）的特点。有效的修复必须同时满足三个条件：视觉上合理、在目标词表下合法、且能在分割得分场中可执行——而已有方法缺乏可同时保证这三点的事后修复机制。
AI.method: SEER（Semantic Evidence and Executable Region propagation）把修复转化为证据驱动的标签传播流程：(1) OVSS得分空间提出紧凑候选标签；(2) 冻结的VLM对候选进行闭集区域证据验证；(3) 执行门控(execution gate)判定该证据是否在词表与语义上可执行(legally and semantically actionable)；(4) 通过OVSS侧策略传播已接受的标签——高置信度的一致区域允许宽幅传播，涉及物体或边界风险的区域则采用保守的、基于得分的传播。全程不更新OVSS权重。
AI.result: 在八个标准OVSS基准上平均mIoU达58.0，且无需更新任何OVSS权重；匹配输入对照实验(matched-input controls)隔离出修复机制本身的贡献，资源测量报告了完整冻结系统的开销。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的测试时修复可作为OVSS的有效补充范式：以候选提议—VLM验证—执行门控—分层传播的闭环设计，在保持权重冻结的前提下提升精度，并具备可控的成本特性。

title: Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
summary:
Online A/B testing is the standard approach for evaluating changes to user-facing systems, such as a new recommendation or ranking policy, before deployment. While the difference-in-means estimator of a standard A/B test is unbiased, it often suffers from high variance. When the treatment and production policies choose the same actions with similar probabilities, the resulting observations can add noise while providing little information about the difference between the policies. Consequently, A/B tests can require large amounts of traffic and long durations to detect small treatment effects. Existing variance-reduction methods mainly improve the estimator after the data-collection scheme has been fixed, and recent overlap-aware designs only optimize a single traffic split between the two policies; thereby, they cannot direct traffic to the actions on which the policies disagree.
  In this paper, we jointly optimize how actions are sampled and how the resulting observations are used to estimate the treatment effect. Our contributions are two-fold. First, building on pairwise off-policy evaluation, we derive the variance-optimal action-level logging policy for estimating the average treatment effect between two policies, which has a closed-form solution for any fixed control variate. Second, we use historical logs to jointly optimize the logging policy and a control variate to further reduce variance. Our experimental results in simulated policy A/B tests show that our designs estimate the average treatment effect more accurately than existing variance reduction methods on every evaluated setting, while generally improving statistical power and reducing how often the worse policy is selected. As a result, our designs enable practitioners to reach reliable deployment decisions with considerably less online traffic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出联合优化日志策略（行为级采样）与控制变量的在线A/B测试设计，借助成对离策略评估推导方差最优的动作级日志策略（对任意固定控制变量有闭式解），并在模拟A/B测试中比现有方差缩减方法更准确地估计平均处理效应。
AI.motivation: 标准A/B测试的差值均值估计虽无偏但方差大。当处理策略与线上生产策略以相近概率选择相同动作时，这些观测只带来噪声，对区分两个策略贡献极小，导致检测小效应需大量流量与长时间。已有方差缩减方法多在数据收集方案固定后改进估计器，而近期的重叠感知设计只优化两个策略间的单一流量划分，无法把流量导向两策略存在分歧的动作。
AI.method: 联合优化动作采样方式与观测估计方式。第一，基于成对离策略评估（pairwise off-policy evaluation），推导用于估计两策略间平均处理效应（ATE）的方差最优动作级日志策略，对任意固定控制变量给出闭式解。第二，利用历史日志联合优化日志策略与控制变量，进一步降低方差。
AI.result: 在模拟策略A/B测试中，所提设计在所有评估设置下均比现有方差缩减方法更准确地估计平均处理效应，同时总体提升统计功效并降低选中较差策略的频率。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化日志策略与控制变量可使从业者以显著更少的在线流量做出可靠的部署决策。

title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
summary: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.

AI.tldr: 提出Game2Player框架，通过"环境构建者—玩家"协同循环把现有网页游戏改造成可验证任务环境并规模化采集游戏经验，构建568款游戏/3,436个任务/15.7K轨迹数据集，并用进度加权SFT训练VLM智能体，在PlayerBench与GameWorld上显著提升任务进度。
AI.motivation: 游戏是视觉智能体的重要测试平台，但人工采集人类游玩数据成本高；从游玩视频学习又需推断缺失动作；现有数据集覆盖游戏种类有限、缺乏明确任务与可验证结果。因此需要一种可规模化、多样化且结果可验证的游戏经验采集方案。
AI.method: Game2Player循环：Builder智能体改造现有网页游戏、暴露内部状态，并基于状态定义进度度量与成功判定的任务；Coding Player与VLM Player尝试任务并把问题反馈给Builder修复，使游玩过程同时充当环境验证与数据采集。基于此构建568款验证过的网页游戏、3,436个任务与15.7K条轨迹（307小时），留出50款游戏作为PlayerBench；训练时采用进度加权SFT，对推进任务进度的步骤赋更高权重。
AI.result: Game2Player-9B在PlayerBench上进度由14.3%提升至31.2%，在外部GameWorld基准上由30.0%提升至53.1%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明视觉智能体可通过"构建、验证并学习"现有游戏世界来规模化扩充游玩经验，为可扩展的游戏智能体训练提供了可行路径。

title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
summary: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. We show that the minimizers of the expected training objectives recover the optimal unbalanced Schrödinger bridge. Empirically, Elysium reconstructs state transitions, population size, and event distributions on simulated benchmarks with known killed-diffusion ground truth, outperforming existing deterministic and bridge-based solvers. On single-cell time courses, it interpolates cell state distributions at unobserved time points, tracks population expansion and contraction, and captures biphasic drug-response dynamics.

AI.tldr: Elysium 是一种无需模拟轨迹的求解器，联合学习状态转移与质量变化，用于从单细胞快照重建细胞动力学。
AI.motivation: 单细胞测量的破坏性使得无法追踪同一细胞随时间的变化，只能获得快照；细胞动力学本质上是随机的，并伴随增殖与凋亡带来的种群规模变化。基于增长的方法将种群变化表示为密度上的速率，无法把进出事件归因到个体细胞；非平衡薛定谔桥虽能建模个体事件，但其神经求解器需在训练中模拟被杀死的扩散桥轨迹，代价高。
AI.method: 提出 Elysium：以 killed Brownian 参考过程及其时间反演为基础，从最优端点耦合与条件桥分布构造直接的回归目标，训练过程无需模拟轨迹。理论上证明期望训练目标的最小化者恰好恢复最优非平衡薛定谔桥。
AI.result: 在具有已知 killed-diffusion 真值的模拟基准上，Elysium 能重建状态转移、种群规模与事件分布，优于现有的确定性方法与基于桥的求解器；在单细胞时间序列上可插值未观测时间点的细胞状态分布、追踪种群扩张与收缩，并捕捉双相药物响应动力学。
AI.conclusion: Elysium 提供了一种免模拟、可同时刻画状态转移与质量变化的非平衡薛定谔桥求解框架，在仿真与真实单细胞数据上均验证了其有效性。

title: GenRF: Generative Registration-free Image Fusion
summary: Multi-modal image fusion combines complementary observations to improve scene visibility and perception. However, in real-world acquisition, differences in sensing principles and configurations introduce geometric discrepancies, while degradations further compromise source quality. Existing methods typically rely on explicit registration, yet large parallax complicates correspondence estimation, while mismatched fields of view leave some regions without cross-modal counterparts. Meanwhile, independent restoration underuses cross-modal information, whereas restoration-fusion methods assuming alignment remain vulnerable to misregistration. This study revisits misaligned and degraded image fusion in the era of generative foundation models, in which cross-attention enables position-agnostic complementary information aggregation, while generative priors support degradation recovery and inference in missing regions. Building on this perspective, we propose GenRF, which adapts pretrained FLUX through LoRA to jointly enhance degraded observations, infer missing cross-modal context, and fuse complementary information without explicitly estimating deformation fields. Extensive experiments on real-world infrared and visible captures show that GenRF delivers high-quality fusion directly from unregistered, degraded images without preprocessing, while improving downstream task performance under misalignment. Additional experiments demonstrate that GenRF can generalize to misaligned multi-exposure and multi-focus image fusion without task-specific fine-tuning. Project: https://linfeng-tang.github.io/GenRF.

AI.tldr: 提出GenRF，基于预训练FLUX（LoRA微调）的生成式基础模型框架，在无需显式配准与预处理的情况下，直接从失配、退化、视场不完整的源图像完成多模态图像融合。
AI.motivation: 真实采集的多模态图像同时存在几何失配（大视差、视场不一致导致部分区域无跨模态对应）与退化问题。现有方法依赖显式配准，大视差下对应估计困难；独立复原忽略跨模态信息；而"先复原后融合"流程假定已对齐，对误配准脆弱。
AI.method: 重新审视生成式基础模型时代的失配+退化融合问题：利用交叉注意力实现位置无关的互补信息聚合，利用生成先验完成退化恢复与缺失区域推断。据此将预训练FLUX通过LoRA适配，联合执行退化增强、缺失跨模态上下文推断与互补信息融合，不显式估计形变场。
AI.result: 在真实红外与可见光数据上，GenRF可直接从无配准、退化的图像输出高质量融合，无需预处理；在失配条件下提升下游任务性能；并可零任务特定微调地泛化到失配多曝光与多聚焦图像融合。
AI.conclusion: 以生成式基础模型的交叉注意力与生成先验替代显式配准—复原—融合流水线，是处理失配退化多模态融合的有效范式，且具备跨任务泛化能力。

title: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
summary: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under ideal population conditions. Our model, HORIZON, uses an equivariant transformer to predict velocity and growth from the current tissue, so that a tissue can be generated continuously from a single initial snapshot. On a simulated tissue observed in perturbed coordinate frames, alignment improves reconstruction and projection reduces rigid drift. On four spatial transcriptomics time courses, HORIZON reconstructs tissue geometry, gene expression, and cell abundance more accurately than existing spatial and unbalanced trajectory methods, and interpolates held-out developmental stages.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 horizontal flow matching，将共享刚体运动从空间转录组时序动力学中商掉，用连续性-反应方程与 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何下的端点问题给出解析回归目标，并实现模型 HORIZON（等变 Transformer 预测速度与增长项），在模拟与四组真实时序数据上重建几何、基因表达与细胞丰度均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从空间转录组快照学习细胞时空动力学需跨坐标框连接不同细胞；切片间的旋转或平移会被误读为细胞运动，从而扭曲推断出的对应关系。因此需要在动力学建模中显式处理共享刚体运动这一干扰成分。
AI.method: 引入 horizontal flow matching：动力学由连续性–反应方程描述，其对共享刚体运动的作用不产生代价，所得 horizontal projector 在学习时从空间预测误差中、生成时从预测速度中剔除该分量。等价的端点问题在 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao 几何下联合估计对应关系与相对位姿，导出解析路径，其速度与增长作为回归目标；理想种群条件下回归这些目标可恢复 horizontal dynamics。模型 HORIZON 用等变 Transformer 从当前组织预测速度与增长，支持从单一初始快照连续生成组织。
AI.result: 在坐标框受扰动的模拟组织上，对齐改善重建、投影消除刚体漂移；在四组空间转录组时序数据上，HORIZON 对组织几何、基因表达与细胞丰度的重建精度优于现有空间方法与不平衡轨迹方法，并能内插留出的发育阶段。
AI.conclusion: 将共享刚体运动设为动力学的不变/零代价方向，可在流匹配框架下同时解决位姿对齐与轨迹推断；等变 Transformer 参数化的速度–增长场使单快照连续生成组织成为可能，并在多组真实时序数据上验证了优越性与内插能力。

title: AVTR: Adaptive Multimodal Reasoning with Visual Imagination
summary: Vision-Language Models increasingly rely on textual reasoning to solve advanced multimodal tasks. Despite its effectiveness, this paradigm faces two fundamental limitations. First, relying on textual reasoning alone can limit perceptual ability in vision-centric questions, where accurate answers depend on interpreting task-relevant visual evidence. Second, applying textual reasoning uniformly across inputs overlooks question-dependent variation in both reasoning modality and depth, often producing verbose and unnecessary traces when little logical inference is required. To this end, we propose Adaptive Visual-Textual Reasoning (AVTR), which introduces visual imagination as a complementary reasoning modality to textual thinking, enabling the model to revisit its visual observations and distill the salient evidence through generative visual reflection. Furthermore, we formulate reasoning-modality selection as a learned routing problem, allowing a single policy to adaptively harness the complementary strengths of visual reflection and textual reasoning in response to the perceptual and inferential demands of the input. Across 16 benchmarks, AVTR improves the average score by 4.5 points over Qwen3.5 baseline, while reducing inference latency by 33\%. It also scales effectively into a smaller size backbone, outperforming the evaluated 2B-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出AVTR，引入"视觉想象/视觉反思"作为文本推理的互补模态，并将推理模态选择建模为可学习路由问题，单一策略按输入自适应选择视觉反思或文本推理。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型依赖文本推理存在两点局限：一是纯文本推理削弱了以视觉为中心问题所需的感知能力，答案依赖对任务相关视觉证据的解读；二是对所有输入统一施加文本推理，忽视了推理模态与推理深度随问题而变化，在几乎无需逻辑推断时产生冗长冗余的推理链。
AI.method: AVTR：以视觉想象作为文本思维的补充推理模态，通过生成式视觉反思重新审视视觉观测并蒸馏显著证据；同时把推理模态选择形式化为学习式路由问题，使单一策略能根据输入的感知与推理需求自适应组合视觉反思与文本推理的优势。
AI.result: 在16个基准上，平均分较Qwen3.5基线提升4.5分，同时推理时延降低33%；并可有效迁移到更小规模骨干，性能优于所评估的2B级基线。
AI.conclusion: 多模态推理不应局限于文本链，视觉反思作为互补模态结合自适应路由，可在提升感知密集型任务表现的同时压缩冗余推理、降低时延，并具备向小模型骨干扩展的潜力。

title: Stabilizing Neural-to-Image Retrieval with Frequency-Domain Priors and Adaptive Supervision
summary: Visual neural decoding aims to infer perceived visual stimuli from brain activity, offering important insights into human visual cognition while enabling transformative applications in brain computer interfaces and artificial intelligence. Recent advances in pretrained vision-language models have provided a semantically rich representation space for this task. However, reliable alignment between EEG/MEG signals and visual embeddings remains challenging because neural responses are noisy, highly variable across trials, and subject dependent. To address this issue, we propose a unified neural-to-image retrieval framework that improves retrieval performance by aligning neural and image representations in a shared semantic space. The framework integrates dual-stream adaptation, frequency-domain calibration, and phase-guided temperature modulation to promote more robust cross-modal semantic alignment. Specifically, dual-stream adaptation models a low-dimensional shared subspace with correlation regularization to suppress redundant noise and enhance cross-modal consistency. Frequency-domain calibration conditionally modulates neural representations using amplitude and phase statistics. Phase-guided temperature modulation further adjusts the supervision strength in contrastive learning according to the stability of neural responses. Experiments on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG under both intra-subject and inter-subject settings demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms strong baselines. These results suggest that robust neural-to-image retrieval under heterogeneous neural conditions benefits from a stable shared semantic space, frequency-informed representation calibration, and adaptive supervision. Code will be released at github.com/wanfkuabc/Geometry-Regularized-Brain-Embeddings.

AI.tldr: 提出统一神经-图像检索框架，通过双流适配、频域校准与相位引导温度调制，在共享语义空间中实现稳健的脑电/脑磁到图像的跨模态对齐。
AI.motivation: 视觉神经解码可从脑活动中推断感知到的视觉刺激，对理解视觉认知及脑机接口、AI应用意义重大。预训练视觉-语言模型提供了语义丰富的表征空间，但EEG/MEG信号噪声大、试次间变异高且存在被试依赖，导致神经信号与视觉嵌入之间的可靠对齐仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出统一的神经到图像检索框架：1）双流适配，以相关性正则化建模低维共享子空间，抑制冗余噪声并增强跨模态一致性；2）频域校准，利用幅值与相位统计量条件性地调制神经表征；3）相位引导温度调制，依据神经响应稳定性调整对比学习中的监督强度。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG与THINGS-MEG数据集上，涵盖被试内与被试间两种设置，所提框架一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 异构神经条件下的稳健神经-图像检索受益于稳定的共享语义空间、频域信息驱动的表征校准以及自适应监督策略。

title: Reconstruction vs. Prediction Pre-Training of Discrete Video Representations for Continuous Control
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the PTA Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Self-supervised video encoders are commonly trained to either reconstruct pixels or predict latent features, yet it remains unclear how these objectives shape representations for downstream dynamics. We present a capacity-matched study isolating this choice: two identical video encoders with a shared FSQ bottleneck are trained under autoencoding and V-JEPA objectives on a continuous control environment. We introduce a simple asymmetric discretization scheme to apply the same bottleneck to the predictive model. The resulting representations exhibit a clear trade-off: the autoencoder preserves substantially more physical state information and achieves slightly better one-step latent prediction, while the predictive encoder accumulates less error under autoregressive rollout. Structural probes suggest that this advantage is associated with greater robustness to low-level visual perturbations and stronger dependence on temporal context. These results indicate that predictive and reconstructive objectives induce distinct representations of dynamics, trading state fidelity for properties that may benefit long-horizon prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文在容量匹配条件下对比自编码与V-JEPA两种视频编码目标，发现二者在动态表征上存在"状态保真 vs 长时程预测"的权衡。
AI.motivation: 自监督视频编码器常以像素重建或潜特征预测为训练目标，但这两类目标如何塑造下游动态任务所需的表征仍不清楚；且已有对比往往未控制模型容量，难以归因于目标本身。
AI.method: 构建容量匹配的对照实验：两个完全相同的视频编码器共享同一FSQ量化瓶颈，分别以自编码（重建像素）与V-JEPA（预测潜特征）目标在连续控制环境中训练；并提出一种简单的非对称离散化方案，使同一瓶颈也能施加于预测模型。
AI.result: 表征呈现明显权衡：自编码器保留显著更多的物理状态信息，单步潜预测略优；预测编码器在自回归滚动中误差累积更少。结构探针显示该优势与对低层视觉扰动的更强鲁棒性、以及对时间上下文更强的依赖相关。
AI.conclusion: 预测性与重建性目标诱导出不同的动态表征，二者以状态保真度换取可能有利于长时程预测的特性；目标选择应依据下游动态任务的需求而定。

title: Gaussian Primitive Fusion for Any-Resolution Multimodal Images
summary: Multimodal image fusion integrates complementary observations from different modalities into a unified representation. Existing methods typically estimate modality contributions on a common discrete grid. When source modalities have different native resolutions, constructing such a grid generally involves resampling, which may introduce artifacts and affect subsequent fusion decisions. To address this problem, we propose Gaussian Primitive Fusion (GPF), which reformulates heterogeneous-resolution fusion in a shared continuous Gaussian space. Instead of first converting source images to a common resolution, GPF directly fits their native-resolution observations with shared Gaussian geometry and modality-specific content representations, and learns modality contributions within the resulting continuous representation. Once optimized, the fused representation is rendered at the finest native resolution without resampling the sources. With heterogeneous-resolution inputs, GPF produces clearer target contours and finer textures, with less blurring and blocking artifacts than resample-then-fuse pipelines. Quantitatively, it achieves the best results on multiple infrared-visible benchmarks against state-of-the-art fusion methods equipped with interpolation or super-resolution frontends.

AI.tldr: 提出高斯基元融合（GPF），将异分辨率多模态融合重构到共享连续高斯空间，避免重采样伪影，直接在原生分辨率上拟合与渲染融合结果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态融合通常在共同离散网格上估计模态贡献；当源模态原生分辨率不同时，构建该网格需重采样，易引入伪影并影响后续融合决策。
AI.method: GPF 不先将源图统一到同一分辨率，而是用共享高斯几何与模态特定的内容表示直接拟合各源的原生分辨率观测，并在所得连续表示中学习模态贡献；优化完成后在最高原生分辨率上渲染融合表示，全程不重采样源图。
AI.result: 在异分辨率输入下，GPF 相较"先重采样再融合"流程产生更清晰的目标轮廓与更细致的纹理，模糊与块状伪影更少；定量上在多个红外-可见光基准上优于配备插值或超分前端的先进融合方法。
AI.conclusion: 以连续高斯表示替代离散公共网格，是处理异分辨率多模态融合的有效范式，可在不重采样源图的前提下获得更优的视觉与定量性能。

title: Learning Trajectories Leave Decodable Traces in Neural Network Weight Space and Internal Representations
summary: Neural networks trained on the same task develop related weight-space structures, yet remain distinguishable after learning. Do these differences merely reflect alternative solutions, or do they preserve information about individual learning histories? We tested whether final weights reveal initialization, task order, and earlier trajectory states. Training reorganized the ensemble: initial pairwise distances did not consistently predict final distances. Nevertheless, all 30 trained networks were correctly matched to their initial weights among ten candidates per dataset. Networks sharing an initialization also developed recognizable final hidden representations across different batch schedules, although direct comparisons with initial activity did not recover identity. Learning order remained readable as well. A linear probe decoded the order of two earlier tasks with 100% accuracy on 80 held-out networks after ten epochs of a common final task. Earlier intermediate weight states were partly predictable, but individual initial weights could not be reliably reconstructed. Final weights thus retain selective historical information rather than a complete trajectory record. Perturbed networks recovered classification performance without returning to their unperturbed training paths. This separation persisted across datasets, intervention times, and network layers. Moreover, 2,157 of 2,160 aligned endpoint pairs showed no positive loss barrier at sampled interpolation points, indicating low-loss connections between distinct solutions rather than convergence to one weight vector. Together, these findings show that a shared task constrains networks to related successful solutions without erasing their individual histories. Final weights reflect not only what a network has learned, but also where learning began and how it unfolded.

AI.tldr: 同一任务的网络中，最终权重并非互相替代的等价解，而是选择性地保留了个体训练历史信息（初始化身份、任务顺序、部分中间态），但无法完整重建初始权重或轨迹。
AI.motivation: 作者追问：同一任务上训练出的网络虽然权重空间结构相关，却仍彼此可区分——这些差异仅代表"另一种解"，还是携带着个体学习历史的信息？据此检验最终权重是否编码初始化、任务顺序与早期轨迹状态。
AI.method: 对30个受训网络做权重配对识别（每个数据集10个初始权重候选中匹配）；跨不同batch schedule比较同初始化网络的隐层表征；用线性探针从最终权重解码两个先前任务的顺序（80个留出网络）；预测早期中间权重状态；施加扰动检验性能恢复与轨迹回归；并以2,160对对齐端点做插值损失障碍分析。
AI.result: 训练重组了权重集合，初始两两距离不能稳定预测最终距离；但30个网络全部被正确匹配到各自的初始权重。共享初始化的网络在不同batch schedule下形成可识别的最终隐层表征（与初始活动的直接比较无法恢复身份）。在共同最终任务训练10个epoch后，线性探针以100%准确率解码两个先前任务的顺序。早期中间权重状态部分可预测，但初始权重无法可靠重建。被扰动网络恢复了分类性能却不回到原训练路径，该分离在数据集、干预时刻与网络层上均成立；2,160对对齐端点中有2,157对在采样插值点上无正的损失障碍，说明不同解之间存在低损失连通而非收敛到单一权重向量。
AI.conclusion: 共享任务将网络约束到相关而成功的解空间，却不抹除个体历史；最终权重既反映"学到了什么"，也反映"从何处开始、如何展开"，即承载选择性历史信息而非完整轨迹记录。

title: ViStep-RL: Stepwise Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Visual Agents
summary: Long-horizon visual agents must do more than inspect images: they must turn observations into evidence that remains usable as a task unfolds. Existing active-perception methods teach agents where and how to look, while a final-answer reward gives little structure for deciding which observations satisfy dependent subgoals or should be retained for later use. We present ViStep-RL (Visual Stepwise Reinforcement Learning), which models execution as a dependency-linked graph of evidence-bearing subgoals. A verifier tracks which subgoals are supported by valid evidence, and changes in graph potential provide a net-progress learning signal; an active memory protocol preserves evidence across turns and links retrieval to downstream use. On ViInteract, ViStep-RL reaches 60.0% strict completion with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, compared with 10.0% for the base model and 46.5% after supervised fine-tuning. Controlled studies show that incremental task-state rewards outperform cumulative rewards by 3.2 points, while active evidence writing improves strict completion by 7.75 points over automatic writing. Under a common interaction framework, the task-trained ViStep-RL policy achieves 59.5% answer accuracy, 24.0 points above the strongest of six general-purpose reference models. Held-out episodes confirm the gain at both Qwen scales, and gains extend to three external visual reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: ViStep-RL 将长时程视觉智能体的执行过程建模为依赖关联的“证据型子目标”图，用图势能变化提供净进展学习信号，并配合主动记忆协议跨轮保留证据，在 ViInteract 上以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 达到 60.0% 严格完成率，显著优于基线与 SFT。
AI.motivation: 现有主动感知方法只教会智能体“看哪里、怎么看”，而仅以最终答案作为奖励缺乏结构，难以判断哪些观测满足了有依赖关系的子目标、哪些应被保留以备后续使用；长时程视觉智能体需要把观测转化为可持续使用的证据。
AI.method: 提出 ViStep-RL：1）把执行建模为依赖关联的证据型子目标图；2）验证器判断哪些子目标已被有效证据支持，并以图的势能变化构造净进展（net-progress）学习信号；3）主动记忆协议在轮次间保存证据，并将检索与下游使用相关联；4）采用增量式任务状态奖励而非累积奖励，并用显式主动证据写入替代自动写入。
AI.result: ViInteract 上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的严格完成率达 60.0%，基线为 10.0%，SFT 后为 46.5%。消融显示增量任务状态奖励比累积奖励高 3.2 点；主动证据写入比自动写入在严格完成率上高 7.75 点。统一交互框架下，任务训练后的策略答案准确率为 59.5%，比六个通用参考模型中最强者高 24.0 点。留出集在两个 Qwen 规模上均验证增益，并扩展至三个外部视觉推理基准。
AI.conclusion: 以子目标依赖图与势能差构建的步级净进展奖励，配合主动证据记忆，可有效提升长时程视觉智能体的证据管理与任务完成能力，且增益在模型规模、留出集与外部基准上具有稳健性。

title: Bias-Only Training Dynamics in ReLU Networks
summary: Neural networks with randomly initialized, fixed weights and trainable biases are universal approximators, yet the dynamics of bias-only training remain largely unexplored. We study these dynamics in one-hidden-layer ReLU networks through activation codes, the binary patterns of active neurons that partition the input space into convex polyhedral regions. We show that the gradients with respect to the biases depend on each input only through its activation code, and hence the training dynamics can be characterized with these codes. In particular, as long as the activation codes remain fixed, training reduces to a linear least-squares problem with the codes as features. Training can then be understood as a sequence of least-squares problems, with transitions occurring when neurons change their activation states. We show that the fraction of switching neurons vanishes as the network widens, and the training dynamics approach those of linear least squares on the initial activation codes in the infinite-width limit. Our experiments support these theoretical findings, showing that while activation switches can noticeably affect training in narrower networks, their relative frequency and the associated changes in the dynamics diminish as the width increases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究随机固定权值、仅训练偏置的一隐层ReLU网络训练动力学，借助"激活码"（神经元激活状态的二值模式，将输入空间划分为凸多面体区域）刻画训练过程，并证明宽度趋于无穷时动力学收敛到初始激活码上的线性最小二乘。
AI.motivation: 随机初始化、权值固定而仅训练偏置的网络已被证明是通用逼近器，但"仅偏置训练"的动力学机制几乎未被研究，缺乏对训练过程的解析刻画。
AI.method: 以一隐层ReLU网络为对象，引入激活码（active neurons的二元模式）。证明偏置梯度仅通过输入的激活码依赖于输入，从而可用激活码刻画训练动力学；在激活码不变区间内，训练等价于以激活码为特征的线性最小二乘；训练整体被刻画为一系列最小二乘问题，神经元激活状态改变时发生"切换"。进一步分析宽度增大时切换神经元比例的行为。
AI.result: 理论结果表明：切换神经元的比例随网络加宽而消失，无限宽极限下训练动力学趋近于在初始激活码上的线性最小二乘。实验与理论一致：较窄网络中激活切换会明显影响训练，但随着宽度增加，切换的相对频率及由此带来的动力学变化均减小。
AI.conclusion: 激活码为理解仅偏置训练的动力学提供了有效工具；该训练过程可视为分段线性最小二乘，且在无限宽极限下退化为初始激活码上的线性最小二乘，切换效应随宽度增大而趋于消失。

title: ART: Bridging the Embodiment Gap in 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer
comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/
summary: 3D affordance acts as a critical link between perception and action, providing priors for robotic manipulation. While existing approaches predominantly leverage human priors as direct references, they often overlook that affordance is not an object-intrinsic property but is inherently coupled with the agent's embodiment. Due to the structural and morphological disparities between human hands and robot end-effectors, directly applying human priors causes severe incompatibility for robotic execution. Motivated by this, we introduce a novel task setting, 3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer, which addresses the affordance misalignment arising from distinct embodiment structures. To support this task, we construct the Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset (HPAD), the first large-scale 3D affordance benchmark in which every object is annotated with both human-prior and simulation-validated robot labels. HPAD covers 2,137 objects across 80 categories and 13 atomic action primitives, yielding over 27,000 object-action pairs. On top of HPAD, we propose the 3D Affordance tRansfer neTwork (ART). ART first filters geometric false positives in the human prior via a reliability gating stream, then reconstructs the prior into a robot-actionable distribution through hierarchical reconstruction and a graph-diffusion refinement that resolves the topological mismatch between human and robot affordances. Experiments on HPAD demonstrate the reliability of the proposed task and the superiority of ART. We further validate ART on a 6-DoF arm with a parallel-jaw gripper in a 2,400-execution benchmark across 12 objects and 4 action categories; ART attains the best success rate (86.5% over its 480 trials), confirming the practicality of the transfer paradigm. Project page: https://derek0907.github.io/ART/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"3D人到机器人可供性迁移"新任务，构建首个成对人类先验与仿真验证机器人标签的3D可供性基准HPAD，并提出ART网络实现几何与拓扑双重建的可供性迁移，在真实6-DoF机械臂上取得86.5%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性方法直接以人类先验作为参考，隐含假设可供性是物体固有属性；但可供性本质上与智能体具身结构耦合。人手与机器人末端执行器在结构和形态上的差异，导致直接迁移人类先验会造成严重的执行不兼容（可供性错配）。
AI.method: 1) 定义新任务：3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer，解决由不同具身结构引发的可供性错配。2) 构建HPAD数据集：2,137个物体、80类、13种原子动作原语、27,000+物体-动作对，每个物体同时标注人类先验标签与仿真验证的机器人标签。3) 提出ART网络：先通过可靠性门控流（reliability gating stream）过滤人类先验中的几何假阳性；再经分层重建（hierarchical reconstruction）与图扩散精炼（graph-diffusion refinement）将先验重构为机器人可执行分布，以解决人与机器人可供性之间的拓扑不一致。
AI.result: 在HPAD上的实验验证了任务设置的可靠性与ART的优越性；进一步在6-DoF机械臂+平行夹爪的真实平台、12个物体4类动作共2,400次执行基准中，ART在其480次试验上取得最佳成功率86.5%，证实迁移范式的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 可供性不应被视为物体固有属性，而应与智能体具身形态联合建模；通过"人类先验过滤—机器人分布重建"的两阶段迁移框架，可有效弥合人手与机器人末端执行器的可供性差距。HPAD基准与ART方法为具身感知到机器人操作的桥接提供了可复现的验证平台。

title: Prognosis Without Prediction: The Intrinsic Geometry of Survival
summary: Modeling systemic failure in high-dimensional environments is fundamentally limited by supervised algorithms that attempt to predict sparse, noisy or censored endpoints. To break this reliance on explicit outcome regression, we engineered the Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds (SOSM) framework, a deep learning architecture that decouples unsupervised representation learning from survival labels and treats time-to-event progression as an emergent geometric property. The system projects heterogeneous multi-omics arrays into a unified latent space governed by a pseudotime-weighted, curvature-minimizing graph Laplacian, organizing patient trajectories along low-dissipation geodesic flows. To validate the framework, we applied this architecture to a 184-patient clear cell renal cell carcinoma multi-omics cohort. Across a deterministic 5-fold cross-validation pipeline, SOSM achieved a mean Concordance Index of $0.768 \pm 0.068$, while out-of-fold risk stratification yielded significant survival divergence (log-rank $p < 0.001$) accompanied by a 14.7% increase in local manifold dissipation among high-risk patients. Furthermore, interrogating the network's encoder weights confirmed that the model autonomously recovered canonical metabolic and microenvironmental drivers of disease progression without supervised feature selection. By demonstrating that systemic failure can be mapped as a geometric phase transition, SOSM establishes a generalizable computational engine for prognostic modeling across biological, industrial and financial complex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出自组织生存流形（SOSM）框架，将无监督表征学习与生存标签解耦，把时间-事件进展建模为流形上的涌现几何性质；在184例ccRCC多组学数据上C-index达0.768，风险分层显著，并自动恢复出代谢与微环境驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 高维环境下的系统性失效建模长期受限于监督算法：需要对稀疏、噪声大或被删失的终点做显式回归，因而依赖显式结局预测。
AI.method: 构建SOSM深度学习架构：将异质多组学数组投影到统一潜空间，用伪时间加权、曲率最小化的图拉普拉斯算子约束，使患者轨迹沿低耗散测地流组织；生存进展作为涌现几何属性而非监督目标。验证采用184例透明细胞肾细胞癌多组学队列与确定性5折交叉验证流程，并检视编码器权重以评估特征恢复情况。
AI.result: 5折交叉验证平均C-index为0.768±0.068；折外风险分层生存差异显著（log-rank p<0.001）；高危患者局部流形耗散增加14.7%；编码器权重分析显示，模型在无监督特征选择下自主恢复出疾病进展的经典代谢与微环境驱动因子。
AI.conclusion: 将系统性失效映射为几何相变是可行的，SOSM可作为跨生物、工业与金融复杂系统的通用预后建模计算引擎。

title: VideoACE: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding through High-Frame-Rate Actions
summary: Agentic video understanding requires models to actively interact with video environments to gather evidence and form judgments. Evaluating this capability therefore requires assessing whether models can translate opportunities for interaction into better understanding. We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction. We focus on high-frame-rate action videos, where rapid, subtle changes make targeted observation especially valuable. The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage. Its evaluation environment combines video inspection tools with a user simulator, allowing models to adjust temporal coverage, sampling density, and spatial detail, and to revisit evidence and revise their judgments under simulated user feedback. We evaluate single-pass observation, autonomous tool use, and tool use combined with user feedback to examine how effectively models exploit these opportunities. Evaluation of five models reveals distinct patterns in how they acquire evidence and respond to opportunities for further interaction. These findings establish VideoACE as a testbed for examining agentic video understanding beyond performance under a fixed observation setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoACE 基准，用于评估模型能否将交互机会转化为更好的视频理解，聚焦高帧率动作视频中需主动观察的细粒度理解，并结合工具调用与用户模拟器考察单次观察、自主工具使用、工具+用户反馈三种设置下五模型的表现差异。
AI.motivation: 智能体式视频理解要求模型主动与环境交互以收集证据并形成判断，因此评估应关注模型能否把"可交互的机会"转化为"更好的理解"，而非仅在固定观测条件下比较性能。高帧率动作视频中快速、细微的变化使针对性观察尤为关键，现有评测缺少支持持续交互的设定。
AI.method: 构建 VideoACE 基准：含 1,000 道多项选择题，覆盖六类细粒度动作理解，并配有时间证据标注与经答案泄漏筛查的用户提示；评测环境由视频检查工具与用户模拟器组成，模型可调整时间覆盖范围、采样密度与空间细节，并能回访证据、在模拟用户反馈下修正判断；设置单次观察、自主工具使用、工具使用+用户反馈三种评测条件。
AI.result: 对五个模型的评测揭示了它们在证据获取方式及对进一步交互机会的响应上存在明显不同的模式。
AI.conclusion: VideoACE 可作为考察固定观测设定之外智能体式视频理解的测试平台，为分析模型如何利用交互机会提供了可复用的评测框架。

title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Published in the XXV ISPRS Congress 2026
summary: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将"插值"与"丰度映射估计"解耦的作物残茬高光谱解混框架，借助中间条件数据生成器注入光谱物理先验以扩充稀缺的地面真值数据，并对比了GD-Streamline、TCVAE两种生成器与MLP、FNO两种解混模型的组合效果。
AI.motivation: FINCH卫星的光谱范围缺乏标准光谱指数，必须依赖复杂的数据驱动解混模型；而此类模型需要密集、分布良好的数据流形，实测真值数据却稀疏且采集昂贵，因此亟需更充分地利用有限真值数据中的信息。
AI.method: 提出解耦式框架：以中间条件数据生成器将数据插值与丰度映射估计分离，从而引入解混模型本身无法直接获取的光谱物理先验，把数据集人工扩展为对总体风险的蒙特卡洛近似。具体实现两种条件生成器——带Conformer层的1D条件U-Net（GD-Streamline）与双路径Transformer条件变分自编码器（TCVAE），并搭配两种解混模型——多层感知机（MLP）与傅里叶神经算子（FNO）进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提解耦框架必须在框架内严格整合并引入光谱先验，否则生成器会出现域坍缩、模式坍缩与幻觉问题，导致所逼近的数据流形失真，最终使解混性能不理想且出现分布外表现。
AI.conclusion: 解耦框架结合物理先验具有潜力，但仅靠生成式扩充不足以替代先验约束；后续工作需在解耦框架范围内系统性地引入光谱先验，以保障生成数据的流形真实性与解混结果的可靠性。

title: Monitoring Unplanned Construction Using Satellite Change Detection
summary: Cities need land for homes, shops, roads, and public services. New construction changes that land. It can harm natural areas and water bodies, add to waste, and strain public services. NITI Aayog's 2021 report stated that 65% of 7,933 urban settlements in India had no master plan. That number tells us about planning coverage at the time. It does not tell us whether any single building was authorised. Artificial intelligence, which lets computers learn patterns from data, can help find physical changes by comparing satellite images taken on different dates. We test simple methods on two public datasets from outside India. First, we turn each image into a set of numbers using a pretrained neural network, a model already trained to recognise patterns in images. We feed those numbers to standard machine-learning classifiers that predict land categories and physical changes. The methods reach about 95 percent accuracy at spotting built-up land and about 83 percent accuracy at saying whether a small pair of images shows change, where each pair gets one label. We also train a small neural network on a standard change-detection benchmark. Separately, we run a preliminary descriptive check on an Agra sample of 48 patches, 7 of them positive. The results show that satellite images carry information about physical change. They do not show whether construction was planned or permitted.

AI.tldr: 本文检验用预训练神经网络特征+传统机器学习分类器，从卫星影像中识别建成区与地表变化的方法；在两个非印度公开数据集上分别达到约95%（建成区识别）和约83%（图像对变化判别）的准确率，并对阿格拉48个样本做初步描述性核查，强调影像只能反映物理变化，无法判断建设是否获批。
AI.motivation: 印度快速城市化中新建项目可能损害自然区域与水体、增加废弃物并加重公共服务压力。NITI Aayog 2021年报告指出7,933个城市聚落中65%没有总体规划，但该指标只反映规划覆盖情况，无法说明单栋建筑是否获得授权。因此需要一个可操作的、基于遥感的手段来检测地表物理变化，作为规划与审批监管的补充信息。
AI.method: 采用简单基线流程：先用预训练神经网络将多时相影像编码为特征向量，再输入标准机器学习分类器，分别完成土地类别预测与影像对变化判别；另在标准变化检测基准上训练一个小型神经网络作对照。同时以阿格拉48个图块（其中7个为正样本）开展初步描述性核查。研究使用两个来自印度境外的公开数据集。
AI.result: 建成区识别准确率约95%，影像对级变化判别准确率约83%（每对图像赋予单一标签）；小型神经网络在标准变化检测基准上完成训练。阿格拉样本的初步检查给出描述性结果。
AI.conclusion: 卫星影像确实携带关于地表物理变化的信息，简单方法在小规模公开数据上即可获得较好表现。但影像无法区分建设是否经过规划或获得许可，因此方法只能作为变化检测与合规审查的筛查工具，不能替代审批与合法性判断；未来需结合规划与许可记录加以验证。

title: Overlooked and Underutilized: Prototypes are the Missing Piece in Tabular XAI
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Intelligent Information Systems (Springer Nature)
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) is frequently applied to high-stakes tabular data, yet the field relies heavily on feature attribution methods. While these approaches offer technical transparency, evaluating dozens of isolated features demands excessive cognitive effort from non-expert users. In this paper, we argue that prototypes remain overlooked and underutilized, and should be integrated as a complementary, intuitive gateway to auditing complex machine learning models. Although entire exemplars function as an intuitive baseline for prototype-based explanations, we highlight prototypical parts as particularly valuable for tabular data. By grouping related features into bounded subspaces, prototypical parts technically embody human-understandable concepts, replacing isolated features with cohesive semantic units. We support this integration through two primary lenses. Cognitively, these parts align with Rosch's categorization theory and Kahneman's System 1 thinking to naturally reduce cognitive load for humans. Then, we introduce a Geometric Validity Triad to conceptualize why prototypes validate the data manifold - a critical dimension often neglected by existing methods. We contend that making tabular XAI genuinely comprehensible requires shifting toward composite explanation pipelines that pair intuitive similarity-based reasoning with rigorous feature-level auditing. The paper concludes by outlining open challenges of prototype-based methods and discussing potential solutions to guide future research.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文主张在表格数据XAI中重新重视原型（prototype）方法，尤其是"原型部件"（prototypical parts），并将其与特征归因结合为复合解释流水线。
AI.motivation: 表格数据高风险场景中XAI过度依赖特征归因方法；虽然提供技术透明性，但要求非专家用户同时评估数十个孤立特征，认知负荷过高，因此需要更直观的解释入口。
AI.method: 立场/观点论证：提出原型的整合价值；强调将相关特征分组为有界子空间形成"原型部件"，以人类可理解概念替代孤立特征；从认知视角（Rosch范畴化理论、Kahneman系统1思维）论证降低认知负荷；提出"几何有效性三元组"（Geometric Validity Triad）以概念化原型如何验证数据流形。
AI.result: 概念性论证结果：原型在认知契合度（符合人类范畴化与直觉判断）与几何有效性（数据流形验证）两方面优于纯特征归因；完整样例可作为直观基线，而原型部件更适合表格数据。
AI.conclusion: 表格XAI需转向复合解释流水线：将基于相似性的直觉推理与严谨的特征级审计配对使用；论文最后列出原型方法的开放挑战及潜在解决方向。

title: What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
summary: Despite the proliferation of survival analysis methods, current benchmarks often operate under narrow conditions: they heavily rely on the concordance index (C-index) for evaluation and model selection, and frequently either exclude deep learning (DL) methods or underrepresent challenging dataset regimes. To address these limitations, we conduct a large-scale, neutral benchmark comparing 10 classical, tree-based, and DL methods across 49 diverse datasets. Crucially, we treat the model selection criterion (optimizing for C-index, Integrated Brier Score (IBS), or Mean Absolute Error (MAE-PO)) as an independent experimental variable. Using Bayesian mixed-effects modeling, we demonstrate that evaluation design heavily dictates conclusions. For complex DL and tree-based architectures, selecting hyperparameters to optimize for IBS instead of C-index yields substantial improvements in probabilistic accuracy and calibration at a negligible cost to discriminative ranking. Furthermore, method performance (C-index, IBS, MAE-PO, and X-CAL) is fundamentally governed by dataset characteristics. While DL models scale exceptionally well with larger sample sizes, they suffer notable performance drops in high-dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, we expose a structural vulnerability where heavy censoring artificially inflates absolute calibration metrics, creating overly conservative tests. Ultimately, our findings challenge the utility of global single-number performance summaries and advocate for survival analysis results that transparently report the evaluation setup. Our code is available at: https://github.com/sdening/surv-bench-study

AI.tldr: 该文构建大规模中立基准，在49个数据集上比较10种经典、树模型与深度学习方法，并将模型选择准则（C-index、IBS、MAE-PO）作为独立实验变量，用贝叶斯混合效应模型证明评估设计本身会显著改变结论。
AI.motivation: 现有生存分析基准存在两大局限：过度依赖C-index进行评估与模型选择；常排除深度学习或对困难数据情形覆盖不足。作者希望揭示评估设计（尤其模型选择准则）对结论的决定性影响。
AI.method: 大规模中立基准：10种方法（经典、树基、深度学习）× 49个多样化数据集；将优化目标（C-index / IBS / MAE-PO）设为独立实验变量；采用贝叶斯混合效应模型分析方法性能与数据集特征（样本量、特征维度、删失率）的关系，并评估C-index、IBS、MAE-PO与X-CAL等指标。
AI.result: 对复杂DL与树模型，以IBS而非C-index选超参可在排序性能几乎无损的情况下显著提升概率精度与校准；方法性能主要由数据集特性决定：DL随样本量增长扩展性最好，但在高维特征空间性能明显下降；重删失会人为抬高绝对校准指标，使检验过于保守。
AI.conclusion: 评估设计严重左右结论，全局单一数值性能汇总价值有限；建议生存分析研究报告应透明说明评估设置（模型选择准则、指标与数据情形），代码已开源。

title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
comment: 25 pages, 14 figures, 8 tables; project page: https://ztmotalee.github.io/wmmllm/
summary: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. WM^MLLM keeps the world state outside every generator, as a panorama with a revision history, and lets the MLLMs write it: they turn each request into operations on this state, select where a local edit is written, and check every candidate before it becomes the next state. Image generators only propose views, and video only presents them. Users can walk to new places and return, edit objects through text or a box, place subjects, and change lighting, weather or season. By construction, a revisit at the same revision reproduces the earlier view exactly, a local edit leaves every panorama pixel outside its region unchanged, and each request starts from the result of the previous one. Against six world model baselines on MBench-A, WM^MLLM has the highest mean on all four environment-recovery metrics (Epipolar 91.5 versus 0.1 to 74.0) and completes the most camera round trips (85.3% versus at most 50.9%). It has the best value in all 15 CompBench columns against 15 baselines. On 112 local edits judged blind, selecting the region to write after generation raises completion from 34.8% to 83.0%. On 258 WBench and MBench-A items, all 46 revisits recover their earlier views, and all 97 local edits that pass the check leave panorama pixels outside their region unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出WM^MLLM——首个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的交互式世界模型，将世界状态外置于生成器之外，以带修订历史的全景图形式维护，实现单图输入下持久、可编辑的世界生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型把"世界"保存在生成器的上下文中，导致每次重访都被重新合成，此前的编辑会漂移甚至消失；即缺乏持久、可编辑的世界状态表示。
AI.method: 将世界状态存为全景图+修订历史，由MLLM负责"书写"：把每个请求转成对该状态的操作、选择局部编辑写入位置、对每个候选结果进行校验后才提交为下一状态；图像生成器仅负责提出视角，视频仅负责呈现。支持行走并返回、文本/框选编辑、放置主体、改变光照天气季节。
AI.result: MBench-A上四项环境恢复指标均值最高（Epipolar 91.5，基线0.1–74.0），完成最多相机往返（85.3% vs ≤50.9%）；CompBench 15列对比15个基线全部最优；112个盲评局部编辑中，先生成后选区域使完成率从34.8%升至83.0%；258个WBench/MBench-A条目中46次重访全部精确恢复，97个通过校验的局部编辑均未改变区域外像素。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构性设计保证三项一致性：同修订重访精确复现、局部编辑不溢出区域、请求链式衔接。实验证明外置状态+MLLM调度的范式在持久性与可编辑性上显著优于生成器上下文方案。

title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
summary: Neural surrogates for external vehicle aerodynamics are fast alternatives to physics-based computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations. Their foundational limitation is a lack of zero-shot generalization across vehicle classes, which results in an expensive, custom training campaign for each new vehicle design. Similar to pretrained models in other fields, a pretrained surrogate should adapt to a new vehicle class using only a few simulations and stay accurate on its pretraining domain. No prior study has systematically tested this transfer behavior. We conduct a large-scale, controlled benchmarking study on five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates across four independent target datasets. These datasets differ from the source in geometry, CFD solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions. We find that fine-tuning these surrogates outperforms training from scratch in fewer than half of the comparisons and lowers the accuracy of the surrogate on its source dataset. We introduce GeoReplay, a geometry- and gradient-aligned source replay that keeps source simulations resembling the target in training and applies their updates only when they agree with the target gradient. A risk bound separates geometric coverage from differences in the simulated physics, and we prove that every sufficiently small GeoReplay step decreases the target training objective. GeoReplay lowers the source error of fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings and matches its target accuracy.
